article.articleHeadline: 'Wear mask in crowded places': Delhi Medical Association amid surge in H1N1 cases - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: In Delhi, 138 new H1N1 cases were reported in the last 24 hours, with 2,446 H1N1 infections so far this year. The city has seen more than 3,000 influenza A and B cases this year, with H1N1 as the predominant subtype; last year, H3N2 was predominant. The Delhi Medical Association issued an advisory urging masks in crowded places and preventive measures: cover coughs/sneezes, wash hands, avoid touching the face, maintain distance from those with influenza-like illness, and avoid spitting in public. Individuals with flu symptoms should wear an N95 mask; healthcare workers should use masks in clinics, hospitals, and OPDs. Do not take antibiotics or antivirals without medical advice. Those with flu-like symptoms should avoid visiting relatives. Return travelers from areas with higher swine flu cases should monitor health for 10 days and report symptoms to a health centre. Masks in markets and public transport urged; stay alert, not panicking.

triage.headline_ja: 『混雑した場所ではマスクを着用』：H1N1症例急増でデリー医師会が呼びかけ - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1症例が急増し（24時間で138例、年間累計2,446例）、医師会が公衆衛生上の注意喚起を行っており、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の症例急増に関する報道。重症度や死亡者数に関する情報は記事に記載なし。デリー市内のみの局地的な公衆衛生対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で不明。

article.articleHeadline: Mỗi người cần làm gì để phòng ngừa các bệnh truyền nhiễm mới nổi?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What should everyone do to prevent emerging infectious diseases?
article.articleSummary: Emerging infectious diseases can appear suddenly and threaten health; prevention hinges on public measures and individual actions. Full vaccination protects against measles, influenza, chickenpox, diphtheria, pertussis, hepatitis B, COVID-19, and pneumococcal disease. Hand hygiene with soap and water is essential; if unavailable, use sanitizer with ≥60% alcohol. Wear masks to reduce respiratory spread, especially when symptomatic or caring for patients; ensure good ventilation. Cover coughs/sneezes with tissue or elbow; dispose of tissues and wash hands. Practice safe food handling: cook thoroughly, use clean water, keep raw and cooked foods separate, and avoid undercooked animal products. Avoid wildlife and sick animals; report unusual animal deaths. Prevent vectors by removing standing water, covering containers, nets, and repellents, especially where dengue and Zika circulate. Seek prompt medical care for high fever, breathing difficulty, severe symptoms, or dehydration, and follow health authorities. A healthy lifestyle supports immunity but cannot replace vaccines or targeted defenses.

triage.headline_ja: 新興感染症を予防するために各個人が取るべき対策は何か？
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、一般的な感染症予防に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、複数の既知感染症（麻疹・インフルエンザ・水痘・ジフテリア・百日咳・B型肝炎・COVID-19・デング・ジカ等）に対する一般的予防啓発記事。ベトナム国内の具体的発生事例への言及はないため、verified_locationsは該当なし。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola confirmed cases exceed 5,600 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - China Economic Net — National Economic Portal
article.articleSummary: On Aug 26, 2026, the WHO Africa Region reported that the current Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, while Uganda’s domestic Ebola outbreak has been declared over. As of Aug 24, 2026, DR Congo’s cumulative confirmed cases reached 5,656 with 2,715 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of about 48%. This marks the largest recorded outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain. Cross-border transmission risks remain high, and several African countries have upgraded emergency preparedness. The WHO urged urgent protection of humanitarian corridors, expedited funding for outbreak response, and strengthened cross-border joint prevention and control through collective action to curb further spread.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率約48%、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが高く、WHOが緊急対応を呼びかけているためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho realiza mais de 26 mil exames de malária em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho conducts more than 26,000 malaria tests in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, recorded 2,499 confirmed malaria cases from January 1 to August 17, 2026, up 8% from the same period in 2025. A total of 26,335 tests were performed: 22,615 thick-smear exams and 3,720 rapid tests. Of the confirmed cases, 2,293 were Plasmodium vivax, 188 Plasmodium falciparum, and 18 were mixed infections. Diagnosis and treatment are provided free by the public health system (SUS). Testing is available at Prontos Atendimentos, UPAs, labs, and basic health units across urban, rural, and district areas of Porto Velho. Health authorities emphasize surveillance, active case finding, vector control, and rapid treatment initiation. Symptoms include high fever, chills, headache, body pains, nausea, and vomiting, especially after exposure in forested areas, near rivers, or recreational sites. Prevention focuses on repellents, protective clothing, screens, bed nets, and access for health teams to perform mosquito-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョ、2026年に2万6千件以上のマラリア検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ロンドニア州の風土病であるマラリアに関する定例のサーベイランス報告であり、症例数の増加も8%程度で異常な流行や重篤な影響を示す記述はない。
triage.notes: マラリアはアマゾン地域(ロンドニア州)の風土病であり、本記事は保健当局の定期報告（検査数・確定症例数の統計）に過ぎない。死亡や重症化、医療体制逼迫等の記述はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu cases rise in Raj; Minister Meena hospitalised after
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (HINI) confirmed in Rajasthan as Agriculture Minister Dr Kirodi Lal Meena tests positive and is admitted to the Medical ICU at SMS Hospital in Jaipur late Tuesday night, with Bed No. 2 sealed as a precaution to prevent transmission. The patient’s condition reportedly deteriorated before admission, and hospital staff have intensified safety measures for both patient and medical personnel. Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma spoke with Dr Meena, seeking updates on his health from his brother Jagmohan Meena, and directed Dr Deepak Maheshwari, Principal of SMS Medical College, to ensure the best possible care. Health department data show Rajasthan recorded 129 swine flu cases in the first 15 days of August 2026, highlighting an ongoing H1N1 concern in the region. No death toll is mentioned in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州で豚インフルエンザ感染拡大、ミーナ州大臣も感染し入院
triage.triage_reason: 州の農業大臣が豚インフルエンザ(H1N1)でICU入院するという社会的注目度の高い事案であり、州内で8月前半だけで129例確認されるなど流行継続中であるため、動向確認のためピックアップする。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）流行であり異常性は低いが、州閣僚の入院という政治的注目度の高い事象のため経過観察目的でピックアップ。重症度の詳細（入院者数・死亡者数）は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: La vida en la retaguardia del ébola: cómo resiste la población de la RD del Congo frente a la epidemia sin vacuna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Life Behind the Ebola Front Line: How the Population of DR Congo Resists the Outbreak Without a Vaccine
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in northern Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and spreading from Ituri to Alto Uele, has registered over 4,400 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths as of August 17, 2026, making it the second-largest Ebola epidemic. There is no approved vaccine or specific antiviral; management relies on isolation, hydration, and palliative care. Declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (ESPII) due to high fatality and cross-border spillover risk to Uganda, South Sudan, and the Central African Republic. In Alto Uele and Kinshasa's Kingabwa, Mbamu, Ndanu, Nzadi, cases overwhelm clinics; laboratory results are delayed. In Pawa, case fatality exceeds 82%; patients come from informal mining sites like PK 51 and Niana. Critical shortages of PPE, chlorine, and water strain health workers. Community networks such as MONAGRI and RECO offer effective local response against distrust and misinformation. Border closures with Uganda and Bunia airport disruptions worsen shortages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの最前線を生きる人々：ワクチンなき流行に立ち向かうコンゴ民主共和国の住民たち
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC(ESPII)が宣言されたコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で、4400例超・死者2325人、致死率82%超の地域もあり、近隣国への越境拡大リスクも高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるDRC北部（イトゥリ州、アルトウエレ州、キンシャサ）の流行を主題としている。ウガンダ・南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国への越境リスクが言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。既にPHEIC宣言済みであり緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: OMS declara fin del brote de ébola en Uganda; casos aumentan en el Congo - Entre Líneas - Noticias de Chihuahua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares end of Ebola outbreak in Uganda; cases rise in the Congo - Between the Lines - Chihuahua News
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola outbreak in Uganda over. Uganda had declared the outbreak finished on 28 July, with WHO surveillance continuing through this week to confirm that no transmission chains were overlooked before the public declaration. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola cases continue to rise despite some progress, according to Dr. Marie Roseline Belizaire, director of emergency preparedness for WHO's Africa region, who spoke at a regional meeting. The situation underscores ongoing cross-border risk and the need for continued vigilance and regional coordination.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行終息を宣言、一方コンゴでは症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が増加しており、WHOアフリカ地域の緊急事態対応責任者が国境を越えたリスクと地域連携の必要性を指摘している。IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: ウガンダのエボラ流行はWHOにより終息宣言されたが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。コンゴ民主共和国での症例増加が主題であり、越境リスクが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例超5600例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 5,600.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) remains active, following Uganda’s domestic outbreak being declared over. As of August 24, 2026, the DRC has 5,656 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,715 deaths, a case fatality rate around 48%, making this the largest Bundibugyo strain outbreak on record. The World Health Organization Africa regional office notes ongoing transmission and rising cross-border diffusion risk, prompting heightened emergency preparedness across several countries. The report calls for maintaining humanitarian corridors, accelerating funding, and strengthening cross-border surveillance and coordinated control efforts to curb spread. The article does not provide details on laboratory methods or infection sources beyond outbreak characterization, but emphasizes collective action to prevent further diffusion.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定症例が5,600例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%、確定症例5,656例・死者2,715例に達し過去最大規模のブンディブギョ株流行であり、越境拡大リスクが指摘されているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダの国内流行は終息宣言済みのため対象国リストのウガンダは含めず（そもそも対象国リスト外）。DRCが主題として継続的な流行状況にある。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تعلن انتهاء تفشي فيروس إيبولا في أوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: WHO announced that the Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in Uganda has ended, with Uganda reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths. The government had declared on July 28 that Uganda was disease-free. WHO had continued surveillance to ensure no undetected transmission chains. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, transmission continued to rise despite some progress. Congo's outbreak is the second deadliest in history, with more than 2,700 deaths and over 5,600 cases reported as of yesterday. The WHO official cautioned that transmission remains highly active; the pace has slowed but authorities have not yet broken the outbreak curve. The contrasting situation highlights ongoing risk in the region even as Uganda ends its outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行の終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息は朗報だが、記事の主眼はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行が依然拡大中であり（死者2,700人超、感染者5,600人超）、深刻な公衆衛生への影響と国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(226074)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事の中心的懸念はDRCでの継続中の大規模エボラ流行であり、これが本イベントのリスク評価の主対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 국제보건위기 100일...한국 의심환자 3명 모두 '음성'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100 days of the Ebola Public Health Emergency of International Concern... Korea's three suspected cases all tested negative.
article.articleSummary: 100 days after Ebola was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, Korea reports three suspected cases linked to Uganda visits; all tested negative and no domestic transmission. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak persists: as of Aug 24, 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths (CFR 47.9%). Ituri Province accounts for 4607 cases and 2065 deaths; Nord-Kivu 714 cases and 490 deaths. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; France reports 1 case. Worldwide totals reach 5535 cases and 2644 deaths (CFR 47.8%). Five countries remain designated entry-inspection zones: DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, and Ethiopia; travelers must present a Q-CODE or health declaration, with 21-day monitoring for those who visited affected areas. No approved vaccines or therapeutics exist; incubation is 2–21 days, with fever, severe headache, fatigue, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and unexplained bleeding. Korea has 38 designated treatment beds and the National Medical Center stands by as a treatment facility.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)宣言から100日…韓国の疑い患者3人全員「陰性」
triage.triage_reason: 既にPHEICが宣言されている大規模エボラ流行(DRC中心に致死率約48%、5500人超感染)の継続拡大に関する情報であり、国際的拡大・渡航制限措置(入国検疫指定)も継続しているためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のPHEIC継続事案(DRCエボラ流行)に関する韓国国内の疑い症例報告とグローバル状況アップデート。ウガンダ・ルワンダ・エチオピア・スーダン・フランス・韓国は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 여수시, 소·염소 8327마리 구제역 백신 일제접종...방역 강화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yeosu City conducts simultaneous vaccination of 8,327 cattle and goats against foot-and-mouth disease... strengthening quarantine measures.
article.articleSummary: Yeosu City, South Korea, launches a fall vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) to curb overseas incursions, notably from China and other countries. From September 1–30, 2026, 425 farms totaling 8,327 livestock will be vaccinated: 3,939 cattle across 272 farms and 4,388 goats across 153 farms. Large farms (≥50 cattle or ≥300 goats) vaccinate Sept 1–14; farms with veterinary support vaccinate Sept 1–30. Animals vaccinated within the past four weeks are excluded; late-gestation cows (seven months pregnant) may be temporarily deferred if requested. The city will deploy public veterinarians or city vaccination teams and perform on-site checks to prevent omissions. Emphasis is on thorough vaccination and quarantine, with farm disinfection and biosecurity for entry vehicles and personnel to strengthen disease prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 麗水市、牛・ヤギ8,327頭に口蹄疫ワクチンを一斉接種...防疫強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国麗水市における口蹄疫の定期予防接種・防疫強化に関する内容であり、実際の発生事例の報告ではない。対象国での発生も確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンについてであり、中国での発生も言及されていない（『海外からの侵入防止』という一般的文脈のみ）。対象国での実際のFMD発生事例ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 云南省呼吸道传染病疫情形势平稳可控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic situation of respiratory infectious diseases in Yunnan Province is stable and under control.
article.articleSummary: As of August 25, 2026, Yunnan Province's surveillance shows the current wave of respiratory infectious diseases is normal seasonal fluctuation, with detected pathogens being known common respiratory agents. No new variant posing major public health risk has been found, and the overall situation is stable and controllable with mild symptoms. The trend aligns with national patterns. The outbreak is dominated by influenza and COVID-19, with rhinovirus and adenovirus entering seasonal activity. Summer mobility and gatherings raise transmission risk; as autumn approaches, flu activity is expected to rise while COVID infections gradually decline and other respiratory pathogens remain at low levels. Personal protection—masking, good hygiene, covering coughs, ventilation—remains key. Vaccination: influenza vaccine is the most effective preventive measure; peak season is September–October. Those 6 months and older can pre-book via the WeChat official accounts of the Yunnan CDC to receive vaccination at local clinics.

triage.headline_ja: 雲南省の呼吸器感染症の流行状況は安定的にコントロールされている
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザ・COVID-19等による通常の変動であり、新規変異株や重大な公衆衛生上のリスクは確認されていない。当局も「安定的にコントロール可能」と明言しており、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は雲南省当局による定例的な疫学報告で、既知の季節性呼吸器病原体（インフル、COVID-19、ライノウイルス、アデノウイルス）の通常の季節変動を述べている。新規変異株や異常な感染拡大の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 여수시, 2026년 하반기 소·염소 구제역 백신 일제접종 실시
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yeosu City to conduct a mass vaccination against foot-and-mouth disease for cattle and goats in the second half of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Yeosu City, South Korea, will conduct a mass vaccination against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) for cattle and goats from September 1–30, 2026, to prevent spread after FMD outbreaks in China and other regions raised the risk. The program targets 272 farms with 3,939 cattle and 153 farms with 4,388 goats. For large-scale farms (cattle ≥50 head; goats ≥300 head), vaccination runs Sept 1–14; farms with veterinary support will be covered Sept 1–30. Temporary deferrals are allowed for animals not yet four weeks post-vaccination or late-pregnant cows (seven months gestation to calving) upon farm request. The city will supply vaccines and deploy city-appointed field veterinarians and ward-level vaccination teams to monitor uptake and prevent omissions. Officials emphasize thorough vaccination and biosecurity, including farm sanitation and control of entry for vehicles and people.

triage.headline_ja: 麗水市、2026年下半期に牛・山羊への口蹄疫ワクチン一斉接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 韓国麗水市における家畜への予防的ワクチン接種計画に関する記事であり、対象国（中国等）における実際の口蹄疫発生状況の詳細は記載されておらず、動物疾病の定期予防措置に留まるため。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国麗水市の家畜ワクチン接種プログラムに関する行政発表であり、人への感染症事例ではない。中国での口蹄疫発生はリスク要因として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生状況の詳細記述がなく、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。韓国は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 能刷医保卡？支持家庭共济？静安新一季流感疫苗接种迎来新变化
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can health insurance cards be swiped? Is family-based mutual aid supported? Jing'an District's new flu vaccination season brings changes.
article.articleSummary: Jing’an District, Shanghai, has launched the 2026–2027 seasonal influenza vaccination program, with September–October identified as the optimal window. Residents can book online via the ‘Shu Shen Ban’ or ‘Health Cloud’ by searching ‘Smart Vaccination’ and selecting ‘Book Vaccination’. The vaccine lineup includes three-valent vaccines: split inactivated, subunit, and a three-valent live attenuated nasal spray for ages 3–17; all options are available to anyone 6 months or older without contraindications, with priority for healthcare workers, adults ≥60, those with chronic diseases, children 6–59 months, school-age children, and pregnant women. The schedule favors 2 doses for 6–35 months (28 days apart); protection develops in 2–4 weeks and lasts 6–8 months. In line with WHO 2026–2027 guidance, vaccines cover A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria; B/Yamagata is not included due to no circulation since 2020. The city plans to include non-immunization vaccines, including influenza, in medical insurance personal accounts and enable family mutual aid once implemented. Vaccination services operate at Jing’an Community Health Centers; schedules vary with supply.

triage.headline_ja: 医療保険カードで支払い可能？家族間の相互扶助に対応？静安区の新シーズンインフルエンザワクチン接種に新たな変化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種プログラムの案内記事であり、異常な感染症イベントの発生を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は上海市静安区の定期季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種プログラムの案内であり、疾病発生や異常事象を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Dengue Season Explodes With 21,620 Cases And 31 Deaths
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 21,620 dengue cases and 31 deaths through Aug 19, 2026, as the seasonal outbreak accelerates. Bangkok records 1,785 cases and four deaths. Data from the Department of Disease Control show Jan 1–Aug 19 totals below last year and the 2026 forecast, but infections keep rising during dengue season. Aedes mosquitoes transmit dengue; breeding occurs in small amounts of stagnant water in household containers. Authorities emphasize surveillance, case investigation, and control of larvae and adults, plus removing potential breeding sites. In Bangkok’s Bang Kapi district, operations identified rubbish and stagnant water; residents assisted with rubbish removal and active screening. Preventive measures include eliminating standing water, keeping homes clean, covering water containers, using repellents, and sleeping under nets. Seek care for fever above 38.5°C lasting >2 days or signs such as headaches, pain behind the eyes, thirst, and small bleeding spots.

triage.headline_ja: タイのデング熱シーズンが急拡大、感染者21,620人・死者31人に
triage.triage_reason: タイの季節性デング熱流行に関する定例的な報告で、死亡者数はあるものの前年・予測値より低い水準であり異常性は低い。ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく蚊媒介の既知の疾患のため国際的拡大リスクは限定的だが、継続的な症例増加は注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はタイにおける毎年の季節性流行であり、今年の症例数は前年及び予測値を下回っている。当局（疾病管理局）が既に監視・防除活動を実施中で、外部支援の必要性を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: ராஜஸ்தான் அமைச்சருக்கு பன்றிக் காய்ச்சல்: அவசர சிகிச்சைப் பிரிவில் அனுமதி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan minister contracts goat fever: admitted to the emergency department.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, Rajasthan's Agriculture Minister, aged 74, has tested positive for goat fever and was admitted to the emergency department. He reportedly developed symptoms in the preceding days, and testing confirmed the infection. Medical authorities cautioned that there is a risk of transmission and advised his family members and party colleagues to refrain from visiting the minister at the hospital. No further clinical details, such as the pathogen subtype, treatment plan, prognosis, or current condition, are provided in the report. The development highlights the occurrence of a high-profile case of goat fever in Rajasthan and the immediate public-health precaution of restricting contact to prevent possible spread.

triage.headline_ja: ラージャスターン州大臣が豚インフルエンザに感染、集中治療室に入院
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）の単発個人症例であり、著名人のケースではあるが公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 見出し原文（タミル語）は豚インフルエンザ（swine flu）を指しているが、Bluedot英訳では誤って'goat fever'と表記されている。単一の著名人（大臣）の症例で、詳細な臨床情報（病原体亜型、予後等）は不明。既知の季節性感染症であり、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: West and Central Africa: Latest Events at a glance (18-24 August 2026) - Guinea-Bissau
article.articleSummary: Guinea-Bissau reports its first mpox outbreak with seven confirmed cases, all adults (six in Bissau, one in Biombo); no deaths; 23 of 46 suspected cases are children under 15, including 16 under five, raising concerns given higher risk. Fragile surveillance and September school reopening may heighten transmission. West and Central Africa: EU allocates €2.3 million to cholera response across Nigeria, Central African Republic, Chad and Cameroon; WHO reports 61,000 cholera cases in Africa in the first five months of 2026. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola persists with more than 5,200 confirmed cases and about 2,500 deaths as of 18 August; response scaled up with safe care, burials, and surveillance; a 1,700-km Congo River corridor is prioritized. WHO has allocated 70,000 Ebola Zaire vaccine doses and is supporting a Bundibugyo-focused trial. On World Humanitarian Day, OCHA urged stronger protection for civilians and aid workers amid ongoing violence.

triage.headline_ja: 西・中央アフリカ：最新イベント概況（2026年8月18日～24日）－ギニアビサウ
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱は5,200例超・死者約2,500人と大規模で継続中であり、国際的な支援（WHOワクチン配給、コンゴ川回廊対策）が必要とされているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はギニアビサウの新規mpox流行、ナイジェリア・中央アフリカ共和国・チャド・カメルーンのコレラ対応、DRCのエボラ出血熱継続状況を含む複合レポート。対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当し、他国（ギニアビサウ、ナイジェリア、CAR、チャド、カメルーン）は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCのエボラ出血熱は既知の継続流行であり『異常/予想外』には該当しないが、規模と死亡率、国際支援の必要性からPICKUPと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 국내 의심환자 3명 모두 음성...유입·전파 위험 '낮음'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: All three suspected Ebola cases in the country tested negative... low risk of importation and transmission.
article.articleSummary: Three suspected Ebola virus disease cases in Korea tested negative, keeping domestic risk low. Since WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in May after Ebola outbreaks in Ituri Province, DR Congo, and in Kampala/Wakiso, Uganda, Congo reported 5,514 cases with 2,642 deaths ( CFR ~48%), Uganda 20 cases with 2 deaths ( CFR ~10%). Korea issued a watch-level alert and formed a crisis team; five countries, including DR Congo and Uganda, were designated high-quarantine management areas, with entrants required to submit a Q-CODE or health status form. Contacts from affected areas were advised 21-day symptom monitoring. Suspected cases: a man in his 60s and two volunteers in their 20s; all tested negative. No domestic cases; six risk assessments conducted; KDCA updates its site; next month will host the 2026 Disaster Preparedness drill. KDCA Director Im Seung-kwan pledged ongoing surveillance and stronger public-private collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国内のエボラ疑い患者3人全員が陰性...流入・伝播リスクは「低い」
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行は致死率約48%と深刻で、韓国への輸入例疑いも発生しており、国際的拡大・渡航制限の観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国国内の疑い例が陰性であったという内容だが、根底にあるDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言した重大な国際公衆衛生事象であり、既存のフルRRA対象として継続監視が必要。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 2026年流感疫苗陆续到货，南昌疾控提醒：早接种早预防
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2026 influenza vaccines are arriving in batches; Nanchang CDC reminds: Vaccinate early for early prevention.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccines for the 2026-2027 season have begun arriving at vaccination clinics in Nanchang, with the Nanchang CDC urging early vaccination for timely protection. Influenza is a highly contagious acute respiratory infection; vaccination remains the most cost-effective prevention, reducing infection risk and severe complications and protecting household contacts. This year’s vaccines are primarily trivalent, updating A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria components while removing B/Yamagata, in line with WHO northern hemispheric recommendations. Immunity develops about 2-4 weeks after vaccination and protection lasts roughly 6-8 months; September-October is typically the peak vaccination period. Vaccines are non-immunization-program vaccines distributed by counties and available to all individuals aged 6 months and older. Before vaccination: bring ID or vaccination record, wear loose clothing, and disclose health status; after vaccination: stay 30 minutes for observation and avoid new or hard-to-digest foods if unwell. As of 2026-08-27, early vaccination is advised to ensure early protection.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年インフルエンザワクチンが順次入荷、南昌市疾病予防管理センターが早期接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチンの入荷・接種案内に関する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、異常な感染症事象や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザワクチンの接種推奨に関する定例広報であり、疾病発生や異常事象の報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: МИД РФ: Россия активно работает с ВОЗ в борьбе против Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian Foreign Ministry: Russia is actively working with the WHO in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 5,656 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 2,715 deaths. Russia has supplied more than 7,500 Ebola diagnostic test systems to the DRC, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda, developed by Rospotrebnadzor in four days, according to Deputy Foreign Minister Alexander Alimov. Russian experts have joined the World Health Organization Emergency Committee, with Moscow coordinating with WHO and bilateral partners. A second committee meeting recommended preserving national-level health emergency measures in the affected states. The test systems can detect Ebola before symptom onset, enabling early isolation to curb transmission. WHO has announced 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine, including 50,000 for frontline healthcare workers in outbreak zones and 20,000 for clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア外務省:ロシアはエボラ対策でWHOと積極的に協力している
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5,656例・死亡2,715例に達し、WHO緊急委員会が関与するなど国際的関心・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの支援活動を主軸に報じているが、主たる感染症イベントはDRCでのエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクである。ウガンダ・コンゴ共和国も言及されるが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれず、コンゴ共和国はDRCとは別国のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Spike in Delhi: H1N1 crosses 2,446 cases as health minister orders emergency hospital upgrades
article.articleSummary: H1N1 swine flu cases in Delhi rise to 2,446, with Influenza-A total at 3,177 after 138 new cases in a single day. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh held a virtual meeting with medical superintendents to assess capacity, isolate vulnerable patients, and secure uninterrupted supplies. Mandatory hospital upgrades include isolation beds: at least five in smaller facilities and ten or more in larger ones; creation of flu screening corners in emergency departments staffed by senior residents; and rostered shifts for continuous service. Focus on protecting children and the elderly, plus immediate clinical examinations. Hospitals must stock Viral Transport Medium (VTM) for swabbing and testing; independent local procurement of medicines to prevent shortages. Public education banners on influenza symptoms and hygiene will be displayed in high-footfall hospital areas. The minister emphasizes no cause for panic; most patients have mild fever and recover quickly, with diagnostics and treatments available across government facilities, while monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで感染急増：H1N1が2,446例を超え、保健大臣が病院の緊急体制強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのH1N1（インフルエンザA）症例が急増し、政府が病院の緊急体制強化を指示するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、続報確認を含めフルRRAへの移行が望ましい。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザであり、多くの患者は軽症で回復傾向にあると報告されているが、症例数増加に伴い政府が病院体制を強化している点から動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Population Mobility Mapping (PMM) Report for Bundibugyo Virus disease (BVD) Preparedness in Lubero Territory and Butembo City, DRC (03 - 05 July 2026)
article.articleSummary: PMM (Population Mobility Mapping) conducted 3–4 July 2026 in Butembo City and Lubero Territory, DRC, with field evaluations on 5 July, identified mobility corridors, congregation points, and formal/informal points of entry to inform BVD preparedness. This follows the 17th Ebola Virus Disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus declared in May 2026 in Ituri, now spreading to North Kivu. As of 24 July 2026 North Kivu reports 299 confirmed BVD cases across 11 health zones, 188 deaths (case fatality rate 62.9%), and over 4,000 contacts under follow-up. Key transmission routes include Bunia, Komanda, Eringeti, Beni, Kasindi, Butembo, and Goma, with air links via Mavivi Airport, highlighting cross-border risk with Uganda along Lake Edward. Butembo and Lubero’s position along major trade, agricultural, and fishing routes connecting Ituri, North Kivu, and Uganda informs targeted public health interventions to curb spread of BVD and related threats.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ブンディブジョウイルス病(BVD)備えのためのルベロ地区・ブテンボ市における人口移動マッピング(PMM)報告書(2026年7月3日～5日)
triage.triage_reason: 第17次エボラ(ブンディブジョウウイルス)流行がイトゥリ州から北キブ州へ拡大し、致死率62.9%・確認299例・死亡188例に達しており、ウガンダとの越境リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにウガンダ・オーストラリアが含まれるが、記事の主題はDRC(イトゥリ州・北キブ州)におけるエボラ(BVD)流行であり、ウガンダは越境リスクとして言及されるのみで対象国リストに含まれないため除外。オーストラリアの地名は明らかな誤付与のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ объявила о завершении вспышки Эболы в Уганде, но в Конго число случаев растёт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda, but in Congo the number of cases is rising.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Uganda has ended with 20 cases and 2 deaths; Uganda was declared Ebola-free on July 28. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the outbreak persists, with more than 5,600 cases and over 2,700 deaths reported by August 25, 2026. Transmission remains highly active in Congo, though the rate of acceleration has slowed and is not yet bent. Laboratory analyses show no mutations detected that would explain rapid spread. WHO is requesting $30 million to sustain counter-epidemic measures, covering logistics, delivery of medical equipment, and personal protective equipment to the most affected districts. The situation presents divergent trajectories: Uganda’s outbreak concluded, while Congo continues with ongoing surveillance, testing, and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはウガンダでのエボラ流行終息を発表したが、コンゴでは感染者数が増加している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,600例超、死亡2,700人超という大規模かつ継続的なエボラ流行があり、WHOが国際支援を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息済みで対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。コンゴの流行が本記事の主題であり、継続的な感染拡大とWHOによる資金要請が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: ВООЗ оголосила про завершення спалаху Еболи в Уганді, але в Конго кількість випадків зростає
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has declared the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda, but in Congo the number of cases is rising.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths from Bundibugyo ebolavirus; the country was declared Ebola-free on July 28 after surveillance to exclude new transmission chains. In contrast, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's outbreak remains uncontrolled, with authorities confirming over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths as of August 25. Transmission remains highly active, though the rate of increase has slowed. Laboratory analyses show no mutations in the Bundibugyo virus to account for rapid spread. To sustain response efforts, the World Health Organization is seeking an additional $30 million to fund logistics, medical equipment delivery, and personal protective equipment to the hardest-hit areas of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはウガンダでのエボラ流行終息を宣言したが、コンゴでは感染者数が増加している
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,600件以上の感染者、2,700人以上の死者を出すエボラ流行が継続しており、WHOが追加資金支援を要請するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的関心が高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にエボラ終息が宣言されており対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。DRCの流行は依然制御不能な状態が継続しており、WHOが3000万ドルの追加資金を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: 100 Hari Wabah Ebola, RD Kongo Perluas Upaya Hentikan Penyebaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 100 Days of the Ebola Outbreak, DR Congo Expands Efforts to Stop Transmission.
article.articleSummary: 100 days into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the World Health Organization warns of accelerating emergency response needs as transmission expands across six provinces. As of Monday, 24 August 2026, the outbreak has 5,515 reported cases and 2,642 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 48%. This makes it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak that killed 2,299. Ituri Province remains the principal transmission hub, responsible for roughly 85% of cases and 79% of deaths. Response efforts face significant obstacles, including clashes between armed groups, population displacement, and food insecurity due to famine. UN News corroborates these circumstances.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行100日目、コンゴ民主共和国が感染拡大阻止に向け対応を拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（5,515例、死亡2,642例、致死率約48%）のエボラ流行が6州に拡大しており、武力衝突や人口移動により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOおよびUN Newsが状況を確認しており、史上最悪の流行規模とされる。武力衝突・住民避難・食料不安が対応の障壁となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 국내 에볼라 의심환자 3명 모두 '음성'...WHO, 우간다 유행 종료 선언 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: All three domestic suspected Ebola cases tested negative... WHO declares end of the Uganda outbreak - ShinA Ilbo
article.articleSummary: Three domestic suspected Ebola virus disease cases in South Korea tested negative, according to the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency on August 27, 2026. The three individuals—one 60-year-old man who traveled for business and two 20-something volunteers—developed fever and were classified as suspected after epidemiological investigation. The outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Uganda has been declared over by the WHO, with Uganda announcing the end on July 28; WHO continues surveillance for any new transmission. Meanwhile, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) still reports ongoing transmission. WHO updates cited 5,514 confirmed cases and 2,642 deaths in six provinces of DRC as of August 24, and Uganda with 20 cases and 2 deaths. Earlier, through the 12th, DRC had 4,665 cases and 2,184 deaths. Korea raised the infection risk alert to 'watch' and formed a response team to monitor import risk; no domestic spread suspected.

triage.headline_ja: 国内エボラ疑い患者3人全員「陰性」…WHO、ウガンダの流行終息を宣言 - 新アイルボ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,514例・2,642人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、韓国での輸入例疑いも発生したことから、IHR基準複数に該当し国際的な監視強化が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行はWHOにより終息宣言済みだが、DRCでは依然として大規模な感染継続中。韓国での疑い例は全て陰性で国内感染の懸念はないが、輸入リスクへの警戒が強化されている。ウガンダ・韓国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Aparecida intensifica combate à dengue com 353 armadilhas para monitoramento do Aedes aegypti - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aparecida steps up the fight against dengue with 353 traps for monitoring Aedes aegypti - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-27, Aparecida de Goiânia expands dengue surveillance by deploying 353 ovitraps to monitor Aedes aegypti, adding 151 new traps to 105 existing ones and planning 97 more by early September. Eight new neighborhoods, including Rosa dos Ventos and Jardim Miramar, are covered to enable regionalized monitoring. Superintendente de Vigilância em Saúde Hérica Leguizamon notes that this approach yields region-specific data to guide targeted interventions, complementing home inspections and breeding-site elimination. Ovitraps lure gravid females; eggs collected are analyzed to gauge local vector activity. Since September 2023, more than 290,000 eggs have been collected in Aparecida’s ovitrap network, signaling transmission risk and guiding interventions. Community participation, emphasized by Edson Fernandes, remains crucial to remove breeding sites and sustain prevention, aiming to curb dengue and Zika outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: アパレシーダ、Aedes aegypti監視のため353個のトラップを設置しデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は日常的なベクター監視・予防活動の報告であり、異常な発生や症例数増加の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱の予防的なベクター監視プログラムの拡大を報じるもので、具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載はない。地方自治体レベルの通常業務報告に近い。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu reports 1,558 H1N1 cases this year, surpassing last year's tally
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu has reported 1,558 H1N1 cases this year, surpassing 1,288 last year, with a shift in seasonality as cases peak May–July this year versus January–April last year. Health Minister KG Arunraj said there is no cause for panic, noting H1N1 (swine flu) is a seasonal influenza and self-limiting, and that higher case counts may reflect increased testing. The department urged residents with persistent fever, cough or throat pain to seek care at the nearest government hospital and avoid self-medication, alongside handwashing and cough/sneeze etiquette, adequate rest and fluids; routine mask use is not considered necessary. Nationally, H1N1 infections are rising, with ICMR Director General Dr Rajiv Bahl stating H1N1 accounts for 98% of influenza detections in India, underscoring the ongoing outbreak context.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州、今年のH1N1感染者数1,558人と昨年の合計を上回る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例増加であり、当局は自己限定的で パニックの必要なしとしているが、季節性の変化と全国的な増加傾向が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性変化（例年1-4月ピークが今年は5-7月）と全国的なH1N1優位（インフルエンザ検出の98%）が指摘されているが、当局は重症化や制御不能とは評価していない。続報で全国的傾向や重症度データを確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: बिहार में H1N1 स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक, पटना में मिले दो मरीज, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Swine Flu Knocks in Bihar, Two Patients Found in Patna, Health Department on Alert!
article.articleSummary: Two H1N1 influenza cases confirmed in Patna, Bihar, after RMRI testing identified H1N1 positivity in patients from Kankarbagh and Agamkuan. Both are out of danger, but in response to rising nationwide cases, Bihar's hospitals have been placed on high alert. Health authorities note increasing H1N1 activity in Kerala, Karnataka, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan, with monsoon-related humidity extending viral survival in the environment and raising transmission risk. No newly detected or mutated strain has been reported; the current outbreak mirrors typical seasonal influenza. Common symptoms include high fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body aches, and fatigue; breathing difficulties, chest heaviness, or fever persisting beyond 4-5 days require immediate medical consultation. Extra caution is advised for children and the elderly, who may exhibit lethargy or rapid breathing. Doctors say the virus spreads easily between people, and recommend standard preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ビハール州でH1N1豚インフルエンザが発生、パトナで2人の患者確認、保健当局が警戒強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの範疇であり新規変異株は報告されていないが、複数州で感染拡大傾向があり動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 患者2名は快復傾向。新規変異株なし。ケララ、カルナタカ、デリー、ウッタルプラデーシュ、ラジャスタン州でも感染増加傾向が報告されているが、いずれも季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内とされている。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تعلن انتهاء تفشي فيروس إيبولا في أوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization announces the end of the Ebola virus outbreak in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization officials declared the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in Uganda over, after Uganda’s government said on 28 July it was free of the virus. Uganda recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths during the outbreak, with WHO monitoring for any undetected transmission chains. In contrast, neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo continues to face a prolonged Ebola outbreak, the second deadliest in the country’s history, with over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths reported as of Tuesday. Dr. Marie Roseline Belizaire, WHO regional emergency preparedness lead for Africa, said transmission remains very active in DR Congo, even though some progress has slowed the spread; the outbreak curve has not yet been broken.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、ウガンダにおけるエボラウイルス流行の終息を発表
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息と対照的に、隣国コンゴ民主共和国では過去2番目に死者数が多いエボラ流行が継続中（5,600例超、死者2,700人超）であり、伝染がなお活発なため深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 見出しはウガンダの流行終息を報じているが、記事の主要な公衆衛生上の懸念はコンゴ民主共和国で継続中の大規模エボラ流行である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 의심 3명, 모두 음성...''위기선언 이후 유입사례 없어''
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three suspected Ebola cases, all negative... No imported cases since the state of emergency was declared.
article.articleSummary: Three suspected Ebola cases in Korea were all negative, with no imported cases since the state of emergency was declared. The infections concern Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda (Kampala). As of 24 August 2026, WHO reported 5,514 DR Congo Ebola cases (2,642 deaths; CFR 48%) across six provinces, and 20 Uganda cases (2 deaths; CFR 10%). Korea's disease control agency raised its crisis alert to the 'watch' level and formed a response task force after the PHEIC declaration. Six risk evaluations have been conducted; domestic importation risk remains low due to limited regional spread and transmission via body fluids. KDCA will continue monitoring with WHO and African authorities and update the public on the website. Im Seung-kwan said there have been no domestic introductions since the PHEIC declaration, and public-private collaboration will be strengthened.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い3例、全員陰性…危機宣言後の輸入例なし
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（PHEIC宣言済み、CFR約48%）に関連し、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はDRC（イトゥリ州）とウガンダ（カンパラ）で進行中のエボラ流行に対する韓国国内の対応状況。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。韓国自体は輸入例なしで対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: Cứu sống sản phụ sốt xuất huyết kèm biến chứng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rescuing a pregnant woman with dengue fever and severe complications.
article.articleSummary: An obstetric dengue case in Ho Chi Minh City: a pregnant woman from Dong Nai at 39 weeks developed dengue in early August and underwent cesarean delivery. Postpartum hemorrhage, severe coagulopathy, fulminant hepatic failure, shock, and multi-organ failure followed. She was admitted to Gia Định People’s Hospital in a comatose state with hypotension and on mechanical ventilation; platelet count was 17 x 10^9/L. Multidisciplinary resuscitation included blood transfusion, respiratory support, plasma exchange, liver failure management and infection control. Due to extensive uterine damage and persistent bleeding, a hysterectomy was performed. Ongoing pelvic hemorrhage prompted angiography and embolization to stop bleeding, avoiding another major operation. After more than 15 days of therapy, she regained consciousness, breathes independently, and can eat and care for herself; the baby is stable. Doctor Trần Quang Huy notes this complex case highlights dengue’s critical phase in pregnancy and the need for vaccination and mosquito avoidance.

triage.headline_ja: 重症合併症を伴うデング熱の妊婦を救命
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の重症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や集団的リスクを示す情報はない。デング熱はベトナムで流行地域病であり単発の重症例報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 個別の臨床ケースレポートであり、集団発生や異常な流行動向を示す情報はない。デング熱はベトナムで既知の流行病であるため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局发布秋季开学传染病防控指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention issues guidelines for the prevention and control of infectious diseases at the start of the autumn school year.
article.articleSummary: Autumn school-year guidelines from China's National Center for Disease Control and Prevention identify three priority infectious disease groups: respiratory infections (COVID-19, influenza, tuberculosis, varicella, pertussis, measles, rubella, mumps) spread mainly by droplets in classrooms and dormitories; enteric infections (hand-foot-mouth disease, norovirus, rotavirus) transmitted via the fecal-oral route, with emphasis on hand hygiene; and vector-borne diseases (dengue, chikungunya, severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, SFTS) controlled through environmental management and personal protection. Schools should reinforce personal hygiene, cough etiquette, and ventilation; remove standing water; ensure food safety; and promote timely vaccination against influenza, varicella, and measles, among others. Institutions must establish prevention mechanisms with the principal as lead, conduct drills, stock disinfectants and thermometers, verify freshmen vaccination records, implement morning health checks, and ensure safe drinking water. In suspected cases, rapid reporting to local CDC and education authorities, followed by investigation, sampling, disinfection, contact tracing, and isolation as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病予防管理局、秋の新学期における感染症予防・管理ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な発生事例ではなく、季節性の一般的な予防指針の発表であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症発生事例の報告ではなく、中国疾病予防管理当局による定期的・予防的な行政指導文書であるため、シグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Latest News Today on August 27th, 2026: H1N1 Surge, AAP Protests & Onion Supply Plan
article.articleSummary: Delhi confirms a notable H1N1 surge on 27 August 2026, with 138 new infections in the last 24 hours and a yearly total of 2,446; Influenza-A cases reach 3,177. In response, the Delhi Government directs hospitals to bolster emergency services, ensuring sufficient isolation beds, testing facilities, medicines, and medical staff to manage rising caseloads. Public health authorities emphasize ongoing surveillance and rapid diagnostics to curb transmission. In the same day, AAP protests outside the Lieutenant Governor’s office over alleged scams, and the ACB widens its probe into a multi-crore STP tender linked to former minister Satyendar Jain. The city also plans an onion supply initiative, the 'Kanda Express', to stabilize prices amid broader civic challenges.

triage.headline_ja: デリー最新ニュース 2026年8月27日：H1N1感染急増、AAPの抗議活動、タマネギ供給計画
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者数増加が報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内とみられ、重症度や国際的拡大の情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デリー政府が病院の対応強化を指示しているが、これは季節性インフルエンザ流行への通常対応の範囲内と考えられる。重症例・死亡例の具体的数値情報が不足しており、続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus infects wildlife farmers in Vietnam: A risk to Southeast Asia
article.articleSummary: Vietnam wildlife farming (6,744 farms, 1.8 million animals across 371 species by 2021) poses hantavirus spillover risk. A 2023–2024 study of 210 farmers in Lao Cai and Dong Nai found nearly 9% IgG positivity and 1.9% active infections; no outbreaks were reported. Antibody tests indicate prior exposure; no viral RNA was detected, and the specific hantavirus variant remains unidentified. Infections may stem from exposure to infected wild rodents outside farms; transmission is via inhalation of dust contaminated with urine, droppings, or saliva. The findings underscore Southeast Asia risk, including Indonesia, and the need for genetic confirmation (RT-PCR/sequencing) and strengthened surveillance. Preventive actions include protective equipment, One Health collaboration, and stricter wildlife farming enforcement. In 2025, Andes hantavirus caused a shipborne outbreak on MV Hondius in South America: 13 infections and 3 deaths, likely started ashore with onward person-to-person spread.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの野生動物農場作業者にハンタウイルス感染：東南アジアへのリスク
triage.triage_reason: 実際のアウトブレイクは報告されておらず、研究調査による抗体陽性率のデータのみ。ウイルス株の特定もされておらず、監視強化の必要性を示す学術的知見に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムでの学術研究（2023-2024年、Lao Cai省とDong Nai省の農場作業者210名対象）に基づく。IgG陽性率9%、活動性感染1.9%だが、アウトブレイクの報告はなく、ウイルス変異株も未特定。インドネシアは東南アジア地域のリスクとして言及されているのみで、実際の感染確認地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。南米でのアンデスハンタウイルス船内感染事例（2025年）は別事象として言及されているが対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: SC já tem dois casos de Febre do Nilo Ocidental e autoridades reforçam alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SC already has two cases of West Nile fever and authorities reinforce the alert.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed human cases of West Nile fever in Santa Catarina, Brazil, as of 27 August 2026. A 56-year-old man in Caçador (Midwest Santa Catarina) developed severe neurological complications, was hospitalized, and has recovered at home with health follow-up; this is the first recorded case in Caçador. A 77-year-old woman in Imbituba died after severe neurological manifestations. No evidence of community transmission yet; authorities are investigating infection sources and intensifying surveillance for viral circulation. West Nile fever is transmitted mainly by Culex mosquitoes; the virus cycles between wild birds and mosquitoes, with humans as incidental hosts and no direct human-to-human transmission. Most infections are asymptomatic or mild; severe cases involve encephalitis or meningitis. Surveillance has been intensified with laboratory, animal, and mosquito monitoring. Prevention emphasizes mosquito control, repellents, protective clothing, screens, and eliminating standing water. Presence of mosquitoes does not imply widespread transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州で西ナイル熱の2例目確認、当局が警戒強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で西ナイル熱による死亡例を含む重症神経症例が確認され、当該地域初の発生地点もあることからIHR基準（重大性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ヒト-ヒト感染はなく媒介蚊（Culex属）による感染。地域社会内での感染拡大の証拠は現時点でなし。ただし死亡例及び新規発生地点があるため経過観察・詳細評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 37% of Delhi's dengue caseload 'untraceable'
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 570 dengue cases in 2026, with 208 (36.5%) untraceable due to incomplete or incorrect addresses, hampering cluster identification and targeted responses under dengue’s notifiable status since 2021. Of the total, 90 cases are infections acquired from other states, leaving 272 traceable within Delhi (47.7%). Geographically, 5 cases from New Delhi, 14 from Delhi Cantonment, 7 from Railways, and 246 from MCD areas; among MCD zones, West 43, Central 34, Shahdara North 27. Vector-control measures (fogging, anti-larval work, spraying, IEC) are to be intensified, as address data quality undermines surveillance. The year also includes 215 malaria cases. Compared with 2025’s 412 dengue cases (351 not traced) and 2024’s 425 (424 not traced), the traceability gap remains a challenge for identifying hot spots.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのデング熱症例の37%が『追跡不能』
triage.triage_reason: デリーの季節性デング熱・マラリア報告であり重症度や異常性の明確な記載はないが、住所データ不備によるサーベイランス上の課題（アドレス追跡不能率36.5%）が指摘されており、媒介動物による感染拡大リスクは否定できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の症例追跡不能率（住所不備）に関するサーベイランス上の課題を主題としており、重症例・死亡例・異常な流行拡大についての記載はない。季節性の endemic disease報告であり、緊急性の高いシグナルとは言えないが媒介動物感染症の継続的リスクとして留意する。

article.articleHeadline: New Delhi: 138 fresh H1N1 cases logged, total at 2.4K
article.articleSummary: New Delhi reported 138 fresh H1N1 cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the year's total to 2,446, while Influenza A total reached 3,177. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh held a virtual meeting with medical directors and superintendents to gauge preparedness for H1N1, seasonal influenza, and other respiratory illnesses. Hospitals were directed to strengthen emergency services and ensure adequate isolation beds—at least five in smaller facilities and ten or more in larger hospitals—as well as continuous doctor and staff availability and testing facilities. Authorities urged hospitals to establish or reinforce dedicated flu corners in emergency departments, deploy senior residents for emergency duties, promptly assess suspected patients, and collect swab samples for testing wherever clinically indicated. The measures are intended to sustain rapid response and testing amid ongoing local transmission.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例増加は例年の流行パターンであり異常性・重症度の明確な証拠はないが、当局が病床確保等の対策を強化しており、継続的な動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1含む)の通常の年次報告・行政対応であり、重症度データ（入院率・死亡率）が示されていないため評価には情報不足がある。デリー州保健当局が病床確保・フルーコーナー設置等の準備対応を指示している段階。

article.articleHeadline: पिंपरीत २२६१ घरांमध्ये डेंग्यूच्या अळ्या; डेंग्यूच्या डंखात वाढ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Pimpri, dengue larvae found in 2,261 homes; rise in dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, Pimpri-Chinchwad’s health department reports intensified vector surveillance post-monsoon. Dengue larvae were found in 2,261 homes, with fines totaling Rs 6.19 lakh collected from residential and commercial properties. Since June, 294,186 homes and 14,52,725 containers have been inspected; 2,261 homes and 2,428 containers harbored larvae. The drive also covered 1,272 tyre and scrap shops and 1,368 construction sites, emptied 3,784 containers, and treated 2,381 containers with larvicides; 2,248 notices were issued. Malaria and dengue totals in the city and surrounding areas are 19 malaria cases and 40 dengue-positive cases. Authorities urge residents to avoid storing water and to observe a dry day weekly; eliminate standing water in pots, fridge trays, tyres, and scrap. Seek medical advice for fever or respiratory symptoms; maintain hygiene and hydration. Fines: homes Rs 1,000; commercial Rs 2,000; malls/hospitals/construction sites Rs 10,000.

triage.headline_ja: ピンプリで2,261軒の家屋からデング熱の幼虫発見；デング熱症例が増加

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Swine Flu News Live: H1N1 Cases Surge Past 2,400, Hospitals On Alert
article.articleSummary: Delhi records 138 fresh H1N1 cases in the last 24 hours, lifting the 2026 Delhi tally to 2,446 as H1N1 and other seasonal influenza activity intensifies across India. Hospitals in Delhi are instructed to maintain dedicated isolation beds and strengthen flu-patient management. The Delhi Medical Association urges masking in crowded places, respiratory hygiene, and avoidance of self-medication. The surge is not limited to Delhi; elevated H1N1 and other seasonal influenza cases are reported in Karnataka, Maharashtra, Kerala, and Gujarat, with clinicians monitoring developments. Officials say there is no evidence of a new H1N1 strain; ICMR confirms infections are caused by circulating seasonal influenza strains, with no reason for panic. Public health measures aim to curb transmission and manage hospital load.

article.articleHeadline: 开学季遇上流感季？疾控专家提醒：做好这件事，孩子开学少生病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-school season meets flu season? Public health experts remind: Do this, and your child will get sick less often when school starts.
article.articleSummary: Influenza season approaches as September school openings raise autumn-winter infectious disease risk in China, with influenza, COVID-19, varicella, norovirus, rhinovirus, and hand-foot-mouth disease highlighted. A National Health Commission briefing urges early influenza vaccination—the most economical prevention—for those 6 months and older, especially older adults, children with chronic diseases, and staff in schools and elder-care facilities; vaccination services are expanding, including weekend and extended-hours clinics starting in September. Since July, China has seen co-circulation of influenza A(H3N2) and B Victoria lineage, with A(H3N2) rising slightly. Global influenza burden is estimated at 3–5 million severe cases and 290,000–650,000 respiratory deaths annually. COVID-19 recently declined after a mid-August peak, with no concerning variants detected. HPV vaccine is now in the National Immunization Program; unvaccinated children can enroll, and those who have received quadrivalent or 9-valent vaccines are considered up to date.

triage.headline_ja: 開学シーズンとインフルエンザシーズンが重なる？疾病対策専門家が注意喚起：これをやれば子供の開学後の発病が減る

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局发布秋季开学传染病防控指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention Releases Guidelines for the Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases for the Autumn Semester Opening
article.articleSummary: China’s National Center for Disease Control and Prevention released autumn semester infectious disease prevention and control guidelines for schools nationwide. Three focus areas: respiratory infections (COVID-19, influenza, tuberculosis, varicella, pertussis, measles, rubella, mumps); gastrointestinal infections (fecal-oral transmission), including hand-foot-mouth disease, norovirus, rotavirus; and vector-borne diseases (dengue, chikungunya, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome). Household guidance emphasizes strict hand hygiene, cough etiquette, regular ventilation (open windows twice daily for at least 30 minutes), removing standing water, food safety, and timely vaccination against influenza, varicella, and measles. If fever, cough, rash, or diarrhea occurs, stay home and seek medical care, reporting travel and contact history. Schools must establish a formal prevention-and-control mechanism with the principal as primary responsible, ensure environmental cleaning and disinfection, ventilation, adequate supplies, verify new students’ vaccination records, implement daily morning checks and contact tracing, and provide health education, with rapid reporting and risk-based adjustments as outbreaks evolve.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局、秋季開学に向けた感染症予防対策ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は特定の異常な感染症発生事例ではなく、中国の学校向け一般的な感染症予防ガイドラインの発表であり、具体的な感染拡大やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の予防指針に関する行政発表であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではないため、地域特定の対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan On Alert As Swine Flu Cases Cross 129; SMS Hospital Reserves ICU Beds For Critical Patients
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, Rajasthan has reported 129 H1N1 swine flu cases this year, prompting heightened statewide surveillance. Sawai Man Singh (SMS) Hospital in Jaipur has been placed on alert with a dedicated ICU for serious swine flu patients to enable immediate treatment. The Indian Medical Association issued a public advisory urging people to seek emergency care if severe warning signs develop. Health Minister Gajendra Singh Khinvsar and the Medical Department's Additional Director Dr Narottam Sharma said officials are formulating an action plan for swine flu prevention and control and will form teams to monitor high-risk areas regularly. Dr Deepak Maheshwari, Principal of Sawai Man Singh Medical College, confirmed the reserved ICU capacity to handle critical cases without delay, as officials review seasonal illnesses during the rains.

article.articleHeadline: Lumpy virus hits Himachal Pradesh, 4 animals dead, 48 cattle infected in Hamirpur
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 27, 2026, Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) has resurfaced in Hamirpur district, Himachal Pradesh, with 48 cases and four deaths in the past four–five days. NadauN area accounts for the most cases (12), with two cases each in Bhoranj and Sujanpur. The Animal Husbandry Department has distributed 13,500 vaccines to veterinary centers to enable timely vaccination in vulnerable pockets; last year about 16,000 animals were vaccinated in the district. Symptoms include weakness, fever, skin nodules, loss of appetite, and reduced milk production; severe cases can be fatal. Authorities are intensifying monitoring and treatment. Dr. Satish urged vigilance, routine cattle inspections, and immediate veterinary care for lumps, fever, or weakness, plus vaccination to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州でランピースキン病が発生、4頭死亡、ハミールプルで48頭の牛が感染
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛の感染症であり人獣共通感染症ではないため、公衆衛生への直接的な影響は限定的。地域的な家畜感染症の再発であり、国際的な人的健康リスクや渡航・貿易制限の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病（LSD）は牛特有のウイルス性疾患であり、ヒトへの感染性はない。動物衛生当局が既にワクチン配布・監視強化を実施しており、地域的な家畜感染症管理の範疇と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: सावधान‍! स्वाइन फ्लू ने दी दस्तक, एक हफ्ते में 140 नए मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caution! Swine flu has made its presence felt, 140 new patients in a week.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu cases in Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, India, have surged, with 140 new infections reported in the past week and 20 more confirmed on Wednesday. So far, no patient has deteriorated; symptoms resemble seasonal influenza and most patients are being treated under supervision of doctors in private hospitals. Health department teams are tracing contacts and monitoring health status. To cope with rising cases, 76 beds have been reserved across the Medical College, District Hospital and Community Health Centers for swine flu and flu-like illnesses. Treatments are based on symptomatology. Officials urged calm and vigilance, especially during the monsoon season, which could raise viral transmission. Vulnerable groups—elderly, children under five, pregnant women, and those with serious illnesses—are advised extra precautions. Swine flu symptoms include high fever, chills, body aches, dry cough, sore throat, fatigue, and sometimes breathing difficulty; seek medical help if shortness of breath.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！豚インフルエンザが猛威、1週間で140人の新規患者
triage.triage_reason: インド・ノイダで季節性の豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）患者が増加しているが、重症例や死亡例はなく、地元医療機関で対応可能な状況。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られないため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（豚インフルエンザ）の地域的増加であり、重症化例なし。モンスーン期の感染拡大に留意しつつ、地元当局が病床確保・接触者追跡等で対応中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は現時点で低いが、患者数の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Đi trước một bước trong phòng dịch sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Staying One Step Ahead in Dengue Fever and Hand-Foot-Mouth Disease Outbreak Prevention
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong province, Vietnam reports rising dengue fever and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD). By end of Week 33, 2026, dengue cases exceed 3,500 (up 1.3% vs 2025) with 87 severe cases and 1 death; HFMD cases approach 3,560 with 2 deaths. Dengue is present in 122 of 124 communes. The rainy season raises Aedes mosquito risk, while HFMD surges as students return to school. Authorities have intensified surveillance, outbreak analysis, and rapid response, plus vector control campaigns to eliminate larval habitats, especially in high-risk areas, and promote the “3 clean” hygiene standard (eat clean, live clean, hands clean). Hospitals are urged to improve early detection, triage, treatment, and ensure medicines and equipment with proper referral pathways. Education sector and communities are mobilized; weekly vector control in outbreak zones and biweekly during peak months. On Aug 26, the provincial government directed stronger dengue and HFMD controls with weekly risk alerts to all localities. Hanoi reports 316 dengue cases across 74 wards with 11 outbreaks from Aug 7–14.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と手足口病の流行防止に一歩先手を
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ラムドン省及びハノイでデング熱と手足口病の季節性流行が報告されているが、いずれも同国で流行している既知の疾患であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はない。ただし死亡例や重症例が続いているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱・手足口病はベトナムで毎年流行する季節性疾患であり、地方政府が既に監視強化・ベクター対策等の対応を実施中。国際的な支援要請や渡航制限の兆候はなく、現時点ではフルリスク評価の必要性は低いが、死亡例・重症例の増加傾向は継続監視の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Health experts press vaccine use as dengue deaths top 300
article.articleSummary: Philippines dengue deaths surpass 300 this year as health experts urge vaccination amid ongoing outbreaks despite a nationwide case decline. From Jan 4 - Aug 1, DOH logged 93,155 dengue cases, down 46% from 174,077 in the same period last year, with 386 deaths (down from 699). Central Luzon reported 16,057 cases; NCR 10,611; Calabarzon 10,320. Thirteen areas breached the epidemic threshold Jul 5 - Aug 1 (Mandaluyong, Lapu-Lapu, Zamboanga; Abra, Agusan del Sur, Albay, Aurora, Camarines Norte, Davao Oriental, La Union, Sulu, Tawi-Tawi, Zamboanga Sibugay); Cebu, Mandaue, and Davao de Oro breached the alert threshold. Takeda's Qdenga (TAK-003) is under review in the Philippines; WHO prequalified and approved in 40+ countries; two doses 3 months apart; recommended for children 6-16 in high-transmission settings. Regulators note lower efficacy in ages 4-5 and potential serotype 3 risk in dengue-naïve recipients. Dengue remains endemic; Gloriani urges vaccination alongside prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱死者300人超、専門家がワクチン接種を強く推奨
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで例年発生する風土病デングであり全国的には前年より件数・死亡者数は減少しているが、一部地域で流行閾値超過や死者300人超という重症度の高さが見られるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デングは毎年フィリピンで発生する風土病であり、全国的な症例数・死亡者数は前年比で減少傾向。ただし13地域で流行閾値を超過し、死者300人超という重症度は注視が必要。ワクチン(Qdenga)導入議論が進行中で公衆衛生上の関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Jaipur Latest News Today on August 27th, 2026: PM Modi's Visit, Swine Flu Alert & Civic Issues
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) prompts a health alert in Rajasthan after Agriculture Minister Dr. Kirori Lal Meena tests positive and is admitted to the ICU at Sawai Man Singh Hospital in Jaipur on August 26. As of August 27, 2026, authorities are heightening vigilance and hospital preparedness for swine flu across Jaipur (and Delhi) to manage potential outbreaks, with a focus on early detection and infection control. No additional case counts are provided in the report. In public health oversight, the WHO India representative reviewed Rajasthan’s cashless health scheme on August 27, reflecting ongoing governance of health initiatives. The incident underscores surveillance, laboratory confirmation (positive H1N1 test), and rapid clinical response within Rajasthan’s capital, with SMS Hospital in Jaipur serving as a central facility in the response.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプールの最新ニュース（2026年8月27日）：モディ首相訪問、豚インフルエンザ警戒、市政問題
triage.triage_reason: 州農業大臣がH1N1陽性でICU入院し当局が警戒を強化しているが、感染者数の詳細や地域的拡大の証拠はなく、季節性インフルエンザとしての通常事例の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 著名な政治家（州農業大臣）の感染により地元メディアでの関心は高いが、症例数や地域拡大に関する情報が不足しており、季節性H1N1の通常範囲内と判断される。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 年轻女子验出HIV抗体 疑非正规处打耳洞感染 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young woman tests positive for HIV antibodies; suspected infection from ear piercing at an unregulated facility - International - Live
article.articleSummary: Anhui Province, China reports a young woman who tested HIV antibody positive during a pre-marital health check. The case raises concern about possible infection linked to ear piercing performed at an unregulated facility in an urban village alley shop. The unnamed woman recalled having her ears pierced in such a setting; clinicians note that piercing can breach the skin and, if needle tools are contaminated or not properly sterilized or replaced, may expose individuals to HIV, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C. However, a positive HIV antibody result alone does not prove the infection source, and no laboratory confirmation of active HIV infection or transmission timeline is provided. Authorities emphasize cautious interpretation and urge safe piercing practices and thorough follow-up testing to determine infection status and potential exposure routes.

triage.headline_ja: 若い女性がHIV抗体陽性、無許可施設での耳ピアスによる感染が疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個別症例報告であり、確定診断もされておらず、公衆衛生上の重大な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個別事例であり、HIV感染の確定診断や感染経路の証明もされていない。無許可施設でのピアス施術における衛生管理の注意喚起的な内容で、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 5 से 6 दिनों तक रहने वाली ये दिक्कतें हो सकती हैं H1N1 का लक्षण, स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय ने कहा इन संकेतों पर रखें नजर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These problems lasting 5 to 6 days may be symptoms of H1N1, the Health Ministry said. Keep an eye on these signs.
article.articleSummary: Across India, Influenza A (H1N1) cases are rising in several states, with 138 new infections reported on August 25–26. H1N1 is a seasonal influenza that typically resolves on its own in healthy adults. Core symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, and fatigue. Authorities highlight warning signs lasting beyond 5–6 days or appearing in young children, older adults, or people with preexisting conditions: extreme fatigue and loss of appetite; cough and sore throat; nausea and vomiting; joint and muscle pain; runny nose; headache; and diarrhea. In the early days, rest, adequate fluids, a balanced diet, and symptomatic medications can ease discomfort, but persistent symptoms or risk factors warrant medical evaluation to avoid complications. Preventive measures emphasized: frequent handwashing, covering mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, staying home when sick, and ensuring rest and hydration.

triage.headline_ja: 5〜6日間続くこれらの症状はH1N1の症状かもしれない、保健省がこれらの兆候に注意するよう発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症状・予防に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1は既知の病原体であり、記事内容は症状・予防に関する啓発情報。感染者数の増加傾向はあるが重症化や異常な流行拡大を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Noida Latest News Today on August 27th, 2026: Major Projects, Swine Flu Alert & Raksha Bandhan Travel Relief
article.articleSummary: 120 swine flu cases reported in Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida), with a public advisory issued on August 26 and a 20-bed ICU kept ready. Noida Authority unveils a ₹4,526 crore Convention & Habitat Centre in Sector 94 and an ₹80-crore six-lane underpass at Parthala Chowk, due in 18 months. Connectivity to the new international airport will improve via a 50-km elevated corridor from Akshardham; a ₹41-crore facelift of a Western UP link road is planned. Raksha Bandhan travel relief offers three days of free e-bus rides for women with a companion; 47 extra Namo Bharat trains will run on the Sarai Kale Khan–Modipuram corridor. NBCC sold 111 Noida flats for ₹416.5 crore. Other items include a teen killed by minors, drownings, narcotics arrests of two foreigners, and a Hathras victim’s relocation order to Noida/Ghaziabad.

triage.headline_ja: ノイダ最新ニュース（2026年8月27日）：大規模プロジェクト、豚インフルエンザ警報、ラクシャー・バンダン旅行緩和措置
triage.triage_reason: ノイダ（インド）で豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）120例が報告され、公衆衛生アドバイザリーとICU準備が行われているが、死亡者数や重症度、感染拡大傾向などの詳細情報が不足しており、季節性インフルエンザとしての範囲内である可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は地域の総合ニュースまとめであり、豚インフルエンザは一項目として簡潔に触れられているのみ。ケース数の増加傾向、重症度、死亡例の有無など追加情報が必要。季節性H1N1はインドで例年発生するため、単発の120例のみでは異常性の判断が困難。
