article.articleHeadline: രാജസ്ഥാനിൽ പന്നിപ്പനി കേസുകൾ 129 കടന്നതിനെ തുടർന്ന് ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പ് ജാഗ്രത ശക്തമാക്കി; ഗുരുതരാവസ്ഥയിലുള്ള രോഗികൾക്കായി ജയ്പൂരിലെ സവായ് മാൻ സിംഗ് ആശുപത്രിയിൽ പ്രത്യേക ഐ.സി.യു ബെഡ്ഡുകൾ സജ്ജീകരിച്ചു, രോഗബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ച മന്ത്രി കിരോഡി ലാൽ മീന ആശുപത്രിയിൽ ചികിത്സയിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu cases in Rajasthan cross 129; health department steps up vigilance; special ICU beds arranged at Sawai Man Singh Hospital in Jaipur for critically ill patients; Minister Kirodi Lal Meena, who tested positive, is undergoing treatment in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports 129 H1N1 influenza cases, prompting heightened vigilance. In Jaipur, Sawai Man Singh Hospital has set up dedicated ICU beds to treat critically ill patients. The health department has intensified surveillance as the outbreak persists. Minister Kirodi Lal Meena, who tested positive for H1N1, is admitted to SMS Hospital’s ICU under a medical team’s care. Authorities warn monsoon-related illnesses and vector-borne diseases such as dengue, malaria, and chikungunya remain concerns and urge precaution. Citizens with fever, cough, cold, sore throat, or breathing difficulties should seek urgent medical help rather than self-treat. Public guidance includes mask-wearing in crowded places and strict personal hygiene. Published 2026-08-27.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州で豚インフルエンザ感染者が129人を超え、保健当局が警戒強化。ジャイプールのサワイ・マンシン病院では重症患者向けに特別ICUベッドを整備。感染が確認された閣僚キロディ・ラール・ミーナ氏は入院加療中。
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の流行だが、閣僚の感染・重症化やICU対応、行政の警戒強化など社会的・行政的関心が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクや持続的な発生も見られるためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年インドで発生するため異常性は低いが、閣僚の感染入院とICU整備という点で社会的関心が高まっている。デング・マラリア・チクングニアも併記されているが、記事の主眼はH1N1流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada! Mpox Muncul Lagi, Kini Menyerang Anak-Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware! Mpox has re-emerged, now affecting children.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (formerly monkeypox) has re-emerged, with Guinea-Bissau reporting its first cases, according to UNICEF data via Guardian. Of 46 suspected cases, 23 are children under 15, most under four years old. This raises concerns that pediatric disease could be more severe in this outbreak. Globally, mpox outbreaks surged in 2022 and 2024, with about 190,000 laboratory-confirmed cases across 145 countries since 2022. The disease begins with flu-like symptoms (fever, chills, myalgia) followed by a distinctive skin rash. Mpox is transmitted by close contact, with earlier 2022 transmission linked to sexual activity; a 2024 Congo Basin variant in the DRC showed higher human-to-human spread. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in August 2024; the status was lifted in September 2025 as cases declined, though it could be reinstated. Pediatric data may be biased by healthcare-seeking patterns in resource-limited settings.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！Mpoxが再流行、今度は子供たちを襲う
triage.triage_reason: ギニアビサウでの初のMpox報告（小児中心、23/46例が15歳未満）に加え、DRCでのヒト-ヒト感染性の高いCongo Basin variantの継続流行が背景にあり、IHR基準で複数該当（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はギニアビサウでの新規小児Mpox症例報告だが、ギニアビサウは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCについては2024年Congo Basin variantによるヒト-ヒト感染拡大が明記されているため対象国として含めた。小児例のバイアス（医療アクセスの偏り）に関する注記あり、続報での検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : des traitements et des vaccins à l'essai face à la pire épidémie de l'histoire de la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: experimental treatments and vaccines in trials as the worst epidemic in the history of the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is in a critical phase as researchers race to evaluate the most promising treatments and vaccines in trials to determine real-world efficacy. About 100 days after the official declaration of the Ebola epidemic, scientists are expediting the assessment of experimental therapies to establish whether they offer tangible benefits. The situation is described as the worst epidemic in the history of the DRC, underscoring the urgency for timely, reliable data. Trials currently involve vaccines and therapeutic candidates, with researchers aiming to generate early results on safety and effectiveness to guide clinical management and public health responses. The article emphasizes speed and rigorous evaluation in parallel as the outbreak continues within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:DRC史上最悪の流行に対し、治療薬とワクチンの試験が進行中
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪とされるエボラ流行であり、IHR基準の複数(重大な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク)に該当し、フルRRAへの移行が適切と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は「DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行」と明言し、100日超の流行継続と実験的治療・ワクチンの臨床試験実施が報じられている。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的な統計データは記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda gets Shs1.87b mobile lab to speed up Ebola detection
article.articleSummary: Uganda received a mobile Biosafety Level-3 laboratory worth $500,000 (about Shs1.87 billion) to speed Ebola detection and other dangerous outbreaks, handed to the Ministry of Health via WHO in Kampala on 27 August 2026. Funded as part of a $1 million African Development Bank package (June 2023–August 2025), the mobile lab brings advanced diagnostics closer to outbreak zones, enabling faster confirmation and more timely public health responses. It will support Uganda’s cross-border Ebola response with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where outbreaks persist in North Kivu, including Aru and Kasenyi, and where additional facilities are under development in Mahagi and Butembo. Uganda recorded 20 confirmed Ebola cases in the outbreak and completed a 42-day monitoring period without new cases, being declared free of the 2026 outbreak on July 28. The device may be deployed to DRC as needed while strengthening border surveillance to curb importation.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ検出迅速化のため18.7億シリングの移動式検査室を導入
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重大な公衆衛生事象であり、DRC北キブ州で流行が継続し国境を越えた対応が行われているため、既存流行の状況確認としてフルRRA相当の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの検査室整備に関するものだが、ウガンダの2026年エボラ流行は7月28日に終息宣言済み。実際に流行が継続しているのはDRC北Kivu州（Aru、Kasenyi等）であり、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: Penyebab 549 Penerima MBG Trenggalek Diare: Nasi Tercemar Bacillus Cereus, Semangka Positif E. Coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cause of diarrhea among 549 MBG recipients in Trenggalek: Rice contaminated with Bacillus cereus, watermelon positive for E. coli.
article.articleSummary: Mass diarrheal outbreak among 549 recipients of the Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program in Trenggalek, East Java, is linked to two contaminated foods: Bacillus cereus in white rice and Escherichia coli in watermelon. Lab results from Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Masyarakat (BBLKM) Surabaya, received August 24, 2026 (document dated August 20, 2026), tested MBG meals from SPPG Tamanan, including white rice, chicken in peanut sauce, spinach-corn stir-fry, tofu, and watermelon; contamination concentrated on two items. Bacillus cereus naturally occurs in soil and environment and can form spores on rice, which survive cooking; risk rises if rice is kept at room temperature for extended periods. E. coli in watermelon is tied to sanitation and hygiene issues in food handlers, water, equipment, cutting, and serving. Findings underscore need for prompt consumption of cooked foods and stringent sanitary controls in MBG food preparation.

triage.headline_ja: トレンゲガレクのMBG(無料栄養食)受給者549人の下痢の原因：米はセレウス菌に汚染、スイカは大腸菌陽性
triage.triage_reason: 単一の給食プログラムにおける食品汚染による集団食中毒事案であり、原因は特定・管理下にあるが、衛生管理体制の問題として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事案は食品汚染による単発の集団食中毒（549名影響）で、原因物質（Bacillus cereus、E. coli）と汚染源（米、スイカ）が特定済み。国家給食プログラム(MBG)の衛生管理問題として社会的関心はあるが、感染症の国際的拡大リスクは低い。重症度（入院・死亡等）の情報は記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: യുഗാണ്ടയിലെ എബോള വ്യാപനം അവസാനിച്ചു; സ്ഥിരീകരണവുമായി ലോകാരോഗ്യ സംഘടന | World Health Organization says Ebola outbreak in Uganda is over
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Uganda has ended, as confirmed by the World Health Organization.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has declared the Ebola outbreak over after the World Health Organization confirmed a 42-day period with no new cases. The government says it was locally contained about a month earlier and urges lifting travel restrictions and restoring freedom of movement. Uganda reports 20 infections and 2 deaths; the last case was on June 21, and the final patient was discharged on July 16, with the outbreak deemed over domestically on July 28. Across the border, the Democratic Republic of Congo still faces a severe Ebola outbreak. As of August 25, Congo has 5,656 cases and 2,715 deaths, with Ituri province the main epicenter, including border districts of Aru and Kasenyi; over 4,700 cases there. With an 877-km frontier with Uganda, Congo’s outbreak poses a regional threat. Uganda is expanding border-area responses, setting up local treatment centers in Aru and Kasenyi and planning two more centers inside Congo, while seeking more support from WHO and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ流行終息、WHOが確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行は終息したが、国境を接するコンゴ民主共和国（イツリ州）では5,656例・2,715人死亡という深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、877kmの国境を通じた地域的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事の見出しはウガンダの流行終息を報じているが、実質的な公衆衛生上の懸念はコンゴ民主共和国（イツリ州、Aru・Kasenyi地区）で継続する大規模なエボラ流行にある。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、DRCのみを対象とした。国境地域での治療センター設置やWHO・Africa CDCへの追加支援要請が報告されており、地域的拡大リスクが高いためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫专家：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情尚未现拐点
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO experts: the Ebola outbreak in Congo (Kinshasa) has not yet reached a turning point.
article.articleSummary: WHO experts say the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) remains highly active and has not yet reached a turning point. As of August 24, cumulative confirmed cases reached 5,656 with 2,715 deaths and 1,245 recoveries (case fatality rate ~48%). Genomic sequencing indicates transmission may have begun as early as February this year, with some anthropological data suggesting cases as far back as December last year. Analyses point to a new animal-origin spillover triggering human-to-human transmission, with no evidence of viral mutation. Uganda’s outbreak ends as its last patient discharged after 42 days, totaling 20 cases, 15 imported from DRC. Despite Uganda’s control, cross-border risk persists; neighboring Central African Republic and South Sudan face higher risk of transmission from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO専門家:コンゴ民主共和国(キンシャサ)のエボラ出血熱流行はまだ転換点に達していない
triage.triage_reason: 累積確認例5,656例、死亡2,715例(致死率約48%)と規模・重症度が高く、WHO専門家が「転換点未達」と警告、ウガンダへの越境やCAR・南スーダンへの拡大リスクも指摘されているため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は収束(最後の患者退院、20例中15例がDRCからの輸入例)だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンへの越境リスクも同様に対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ流行、ＷＨＯがウガンダで終息確認　コンゴなお感染拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO confirms end in Uganda; infection continues to spread in Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO announced that the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in Uganda has ended, after 20 infections and 2 deaths; the Ugandan government declared the outbreak over on July 28, with the WHO monitoring through this week to ensure no transmission chains were missed. By contrast, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak remains uncontrolled, with infections and deaths continuing to rise; as of Aug 25, reported deaths exceed 2,700 and cases exceed 5,600. While some progress in tracing and testing is noted, the transmission curve in DRC has not reversed. Analyses show no signs of mutation in the Bundibugyo virus. A funding shortfall of $30 million for logistics, including delivery of medical supplies and personal protective equipment to the worst-hit regions, remains critical.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、WHOがウガンダで終息確認　コンゴなお感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染が制御不能な状態で拡大しており、死者2700人超・感染者5600人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、資金不足による対応の限界も指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダのエボラ流行はWHOにより終息確認済みのため、現在進行中の感染拡大はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。資金不足（3000万ドル）が対応の障害となっている点は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Virus Zika di Bali, Ini Gejala dan Risikonya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of the Zika virus in Bali: here are the symptoms and risks.
article.articleSummary: Zika risk in Bali prompted a CDC Travel Health Notice Level 2 on 7 August 2026 after a traveler returning from Bali tested positive for Zika. Indonesia’s Ministry of Health says no local Zika cases have been detected. The alert cites an ECDC bulletin (week 16, 11–17 April 2026) noting French and German tourists tested positive after visiting Bali, though specific sites are not disclosed. As of 10 August 2026, 21:00 WIB, Indonesia had not received IHR notifications from France or Germany. Griffith University epidemiologist Dicky Budiman warns infections may be undetected due to asymptomatic or mild illness and nonspecific symptoms. Zika is mosquito-borne; symptoms, when present, include fever under 38.5°C, maculopapular rash, red eyes, joint/muscle pain, headache, and weakness for 2–7 days. Pregnant women are at higher risk for fetal complications; lab testing is required to confirm Zika and distinguish from dengue, chikungunya, or influenza.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島のジカウイルスに注意:症状とリスクについて
triage.triage_reason: バリ島渡航者からのジカウイルス陽性例（仏・独）を受けCDCが渡航健康注意レベル2を発出したが、インドネシア保健省は現地感染例を確認しておらず、検知の遅れ・国際的拡大・渡航制限の要素が複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: フランス・ドイツは渡航後の陽性例であり感染発生地ではないため対象国リストに含めていない。インドネシア保健省は現地感染を否定しているが、無症状・軽症例による検知漏れの可能性が専門家により指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand video news | Thailand opens public consultation on proposed 450-baht tourist fee, Thailand reports more than 21,000 Dengue cases and 31 deaths
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 21,620 dengue infections and 31 deaths Jan 1–Aug 19, with Bangkok accounting for 1,785 cases and 4 deaths; health authorities urge elimination of standing water, container coverage, repellents, and prompt medical care for high fever. The outbreak remains a seasonal rise in mosquito-borne disease, still below last year's totals and earlier projections for 2026. Separately, deadly flash floods along the Nepal–China border kill at least 160 people (Nepal 157; China 3) and leave 403 missing, including 341 foreign nationals from multiple countries; 19 bridges and nearly 40 km of road damaged, plus damage to hydropower facilities and travel routes. Warming in the Hindu Kush Himalaya is linked to increased avalanche and glacial flood risk.

triage.headline_ja: タイ・ニュース動画｜観光税450バーツ導入の公開協議開始、タイでデング熱感染者21,000人超・死者31人
triage.triage_reason: タイのデング熱は例年の季節的な増加であり、昨年の実績や当初予測を下回っている。異常性・重症度の急増・社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はなく、フルRRAの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にタイのデング熱の季節性報告（1月1日〜8月19日累計、前年・予測より低水準）と、別件のネパール・中国国境での洪水被害を並列して報じるニュース動画の要約。ネパールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国は洪水関連であり、デング熱の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR콩고 에볼라 확진 5500명 육박...국내 의심환자 3명 전원 '음성'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Ebola: nearly 5,500 confirmed cases; all three domestic suspected cases tested negative.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) outbreak persists with 5,514 confirmed cases and 2,642 deaths in DR Congo across six provinces; Uganda has 20 cases with 2 deaths; France reports 1 confirmed case. WHO declared PHEIC on May 17. On 2026-08-27, KDCA reported 100-day readiness results, keeping Korea's overall domestic risk as 'low.' Three domestic suspected cases, all negative after Ebola testing, indicate no domestic importation. The outbreak is ongoing in DR Congo with high mortality (CFR ~48% in DR Congo; 10% in Uganda). Korea has strengthened border screening, designating DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, and Ethiopia as priority quarantine regions; travelers from these areas must submit Q-CODE and undergo 21 days of symptom monitoring after visits to DR Congo or Uganda, contacting KDCA if symptoms arise. Cross-ministerial coordination and readiness to isolate and treat any imported cases are maintained.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴ、エボラ確認例が5,500人に迫る…国内疑い例3人は全員『陰性』
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のDRCエボラ流行で、致死率約48%、複数国への拡大（ウガンダ、フランス）が確認されており、IHR基準4項目全てに該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行が主題であり、韓国国内では輸入例は確認されていない（疑い例3人全員陰性）。ウガンダ・フランス・スーダン・エチオピア・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済みで既に国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: गौतमबुद्ध नगर में बढ़ा स्वाइन फ्लू और डेंगू का खतरा, संक्रमित मरीजों की संख्या 140 पहुंची - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of swine flu and dengue has increased in Gautam Buddh Nagar; the number of infected patients has reached 140 - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Gautam Buddh Nagar (Noida, Uttar Pradesh) reports a rise in swine flu (H1N1) infections, with 20 new cases elevating the total to 140. Dengue fever risk is also increasing in the district, linked to post-monsoon conditions and standing water. Swine flu patients mainly present with high fever, dry cough, and sore throat, with fatigue, body aches, and, in some cases, breathing difficulty. Health authorities are offering free rapid antigen testing to quickly identify suspected cases and initiate treatment. Officials urge timely medical consultation for persistent fever and caution against delaying care. Preventive measures include avoiding crowded places, covering mouth and nose while coughing or sneezing, practicing hand hygiene, and eliminating standing water around homes—especially in coolers, planters, rooftops, and other containers—to reduce mosquito breeding and dengue risk.

triage.headline_ja: ガウタムブッダナガルでスワインフルー(H1N1)とデング熱のリスクが増加、感染患者数が140人に到達
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のスワインフル(H1N1)とデング熱の患者数増加が報告されているが、インド国内の一地域における通常規模の季節性流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察が適当。
triage.notes: H1N1とデング熱はインドの一地域(Uttar Pradesh, Noida)で季節的に毎年見られる感染症であり、重症度や死亡者数についての具体的情報が記事にないため不明とした。地方当局が無料検査を提供するなど管理体制は機能している模様。

article.articleHeadline: பன்றிக் காய்ச்சல் கட்டுப்பாட்டில் தான் இருக்கிறது" - பேரவையில் அமைச்சர் அருண்ராஜ் பதில்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Swine fever is under control," says Minister Arunraj in the Assembly!
article.articleSummary: H1N1 swine flu in Tamil Nadu is reportedly under control, according to Health Minister Arunraj in the state Assembly during the budget session. In response to a query about vaccinating elderly and pregnant women to curb H1N1, the minister said the virus is under control and there is no need to panic. He noted that infections were higher in the first four months of last year; this year May–July activity was somewhat higher but still within control, with ongoing surveillance and vaccination if needed, particularly for the elderly and pregnant women. Typically, fever and infectious diseases rise during the monsoon season in Tamil Nadu, but this year the swine flu has begun spreading unusually fast across several parts of the state even before the rains. No case counts were provided.

triage.headline_ja: 「豚インフルエンザは制御下にある」―州議会でアルンラージ大臣が答弁
triage.triage_reason: 季節外れの早い時期からH1N1感染が広がっているとの言及があるが、症例数や重症度など具体的データがなく、当局は制御下にあるとしており社会的関心の高まりも明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 州議会での質疑応答であり、政府は状況を制御下にあると説明。ただし例年より早い時期からの感染拡大が異常と述べられており、続報での症例数・重症度の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gautam Buddh Nagar, the threat of swine flu and dengue has increased, with the number of infected patients reaching 140.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Gautam Buddh Nagar (Noida) reports swine flu cases rising to 140, up 20 since the previous tally, with dengue risk concurrently monitored. Symptoms among swine flu patients include high fever, dry cough, sore throat, and may involve weakness, body pains, and breathing difficulties. Health authorities offer free rapid antigen tests to promptly identify suspected cases. Early diagnosis and treatment are emphasized; avoid dismissing persistent fever or cough as ordinary viral fever. With post-monsoon rainfall, stagnant water increases mosquito breeding; residents are urged to remove standing water from coolers, flower pots, rooftops, and other containers. Public health guidance calls for avoiding crowded places, covering mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, and strict hand hygiene. Seek medical advice if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: ガウタム・ブッダ・ナガル（ノイダ）でスワインフルとデング熱の脅威が増加、感染患者数140人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のスワインフルおよびデング熱の症例増加を報じる地方ニュースであり、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はないが、媒介感染の継続リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性（モンスーン後）の蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱）とインフルエンザ（スワインフル）の症例増加に関する地方報道。地元衛生当局が無料検査や予防指導を実施しており、現時点で国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: हिमाचल में स्वाइन फ्लू की एंट्री, अगर दिखे ये लक्षण तो न करें नजरअंदाज...तुरंत लें डॉक्टरी सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu makes an entry in Himachal Pradesh; if these symptoms appear, don't ignore them... seek medical advice immediately
article.articleSummary: Four cases of swine flu (Influenza A(H1N1)) were confirmed on Wednesday at Dr. Rajendra Prasad Medical College (Tanda) in Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh. Health authorities, under the National Health Mission, intensified surveillance for influenza-like illness and severe respiratory infections, and ordered stockpiles of antiviral drugs, testing kits, PPE including N-95 masks, VTM kits, and ventilators to ensure readiness. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Sanjeev Verma cautioned the public, listing symptoms such as high fever, cough with phlegm, body aches, fatigue, chills, headache, chest heaviness, and shortness of breath, and noted higher risk for children under five, pregnant women, the elderly, and individuals with diabetes or hypertension. Preventive measures include covering coughs/sneezes, handwashing, avoiding touching the face, maintaining at least one meter of distance, and staying home if symptomatic. Una District Magistrate Jatin Lal urged continuous awareness campaigns and timely medical consultation.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州で豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）が確認、これらの症状が見られたら軽視せず直ちに医師に相談を
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの散発例（4例）であり、地域の医療体制による対応が可能とみられるが、当局が監視強化・備蓄対応を取っているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1インフルエンザ（毎年発生する既知の病原体）であり、地域単位（ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州カングラ地区）での限定的な発生。国家保健ミッション下で通常の監視・準備対応が行われている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists Warn That a New Coronavirus Affecting Humans May Emerge from Cambodia Soon!
article.articleSummary: Cambodian bats in Steung Treng province yielded four sarbecovirus groups with potential to cross species barriers. From Aug 2020 to Jun 2023, researchers collected samples from 1,462 bats across nine genera; 146 samples tested positive for at least one coronavirus. Genetic analyses produced 33 complete genomes of previously uncharacterized sarbecoviruses. Recombination was frequent, and Cambodian viruses showed evolutionary links to viruses detected in Vietnam and Thailand, indicating regional movement beyond borders. Notably, spike proteins from groups 2 and 3 had receptor-binding domains with up to 96.8% amino-acid identity to SARS-CoV-2, and pseudovirus experiments demonstrated entry into cells via human ACE2 for a representative group-2 spike. However, isolated viruses were not recovered, so there is no evidence of current human infection or human-to-human spread. Notably, viruses lacked the SARS-CoV-2 polybasic furin cleavage site. Surveillance remains important given high diversity and recombination. The findings were published in Nature Communications.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らが警告：カンボジアから新たなヒト感染性コロナウイルスが出現する可能性
triage.triage_reason: カンボジアのコウモリを対象とした学術研究（Nature Communications掲載）であり、ヒトへの感染例やヒト-ヒト感染の証拠は確認されていない。実際の感染症発生イベントではなく、将来的リスクに関する基礎研究報告である。
triage.notes: 本記事はカンボジアのコウモリから検出されたサルベコウイルス群の遺伝学的解析研究であり、ヒト感染例は確認されていない。タイ・ベトナムのウイルスとの進化的関連が示されているが、これは遺伝学的類似性の指摘であり、両国での実際の発生を示すものではない。将来的なスピルオーバーリスクに関する科学的知見として、継続的なサーベイランスの重要性が指摘されている段階であり、現時点でのRRA実施対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The threat of swine flu and dengue has increased in Gautam Buddh Nagar; the number of infected patients has reached 140.
article.articleSummary: In Gautam Buddh Nagar (Noida), swine flu infections have risen, totaling 140 after 20 new cases, with dengue risk also monitored. Symptoms in swine flu patients include high fever, dry cough, and sore throat, with some reporting weakness, body aches, and breathing difficulties. Early symptoms may resemble a viral fever, underscoring the need for medical evaluation rather than self-medication. Health authorities are offering free swine flu testing via rapid antigen kits to enable timely diagnosis and treatment. Residents are advised to seek prompt medical advice for fever, cough, sore throat, or unusual fatigue, avoid crowded places, cover mouth and nose while coughing or sneezing, and maintain hand hygiene. Post-monsoon rain may cause water stagnation, so officials urge eliminating standing water in coolers, planters, rooftops, and other containers to curb mosquito breeding and dengue risk.

triage.headline_ja: ガウタム・ブッダ・ナガル（ノイダ）でスワインフルとデング熱の脅威が拡大、感染患者数が140人に達した
triage.triage_reason: インド・ノイダ地域での季節性のスワインフルとデング熱の感染増加を報じるローカルニュースであり、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、感染者数の増加傾向があるため継続的な監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 季節性（モンスーン後）のデング熱・スワインフル増加に関する地域保健当局の注意喚起記事。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、無料検査など既存の対応で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во ДР Конго продолжува да се шири, повеќе од 2.700 луѓе починаа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo continues to spread; more than 2,700 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to spread, with more than 2,700 deaths and over 5,600 infections reported by the Congolese government as of 2026-08-26. The Uganda Ebola outbreak is over, but the situation remains unsettled in neighboring DRC, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). WHO confirmed Uganda’s outbreak ended on 2026-07-28, after 20 cases and 2 deaths, and said it had continued monitoring to ensure transmission chains were not broken. Mari Rozelin Belizer, WHO Africa emergencies director, stated at a regional meeting that despite some progress, cases in the DRC are still rising and that the outbreak is the second deadliest in history, posing ongoing challenges to containment. Published 2026-08-27.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ流行は拡大を続け、死者数は2,700人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が拡大を続け、死者2,700人超・感染5,600人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、史上2番目に致死的な流行とされ、国際的な拡大・対応支援の必要性が示唆されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行はWHOにより2026-07-28に終息確認済みのため、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれておらず言及のみ。DRCでの流行が現在も継続・拡大中であることが記事の主題。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: DR Congo Ebola outbreak yet to turn corner despite slowdown
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has not bent its curve despite a slowdown, with 5,656 confirmed cases and 2,715 deaths (case fatality rate ≈48%). Declared in May, it is the largest and deadliest Ebola epidemic in DRC and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Across six provinces, 58 health zones are affected; 1,245 patients have recovered. Sequencing suggests circulation since February, possibly as early as December 2025. Contributing factors include delayed detection, ongoing community transmission, unsafe burials, infection-control breaches, insecurity, and extensive population movement; many deaths occur at home, hindering isolation and contact tracing. Surveillance has strengthened: contact follow-up ~85% (vs ~40%), 21 laboratories with ~3,000 tests/day, and 49 treatment centers with 1,300+ beds (near 1,700 by mid-September). Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) is not licensed for Bundibugyo; 70,000 doses allocated (20,000 for Phase 3 Bundibugyo trial, 50,000 for frontline workers). Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported); CAR and South Sudan remain spillover risks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：DRコンゴのエボラ流行、減速も終息の兆しなし
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの国境を越えた感染拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準に複数該当し即座のフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスーダン、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国、ウガンダも含まれるが、記事の主題はDRコンゴでの流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。CARおよび南スーダンはスピルオーバーリスクとして言及されているが確定発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola outbreak in Uganda over, as cases continue to rise in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda is declared over by the WHO after Uganda reported 20 cases and two fatalities and the country announced itself free on 28 July; the WHO maintained active surveillance through the week to confirm no hidden transmission chains before declaring the end of the outbreak. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola transmission continues to rise despite some progress, with the Congolese government reporting death toll exceeding 2,700 and total cases over 5,600 as of Tuesday. Dr. Marie Roseline Belizaire, Emergency Preparedness Director for the WHO African region, said transmission remains very active; the pace has slowed, but authorities have not yet broken the curve.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはウガンダのエボラ流行終息を宣言、一方コンゴでは感染者数が増加し続ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数（5600人超）・死亡者数（2700人超）が増加し続けており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染の継続が確認されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行はWHOにより終息宣言済みだが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。コンゴでは死亡者数・感染者数ともに増加傾向にあり、WHOアフリカ地域の緊急事態対策責任者が「感染の勢いはまだ抑えられていない」と発言している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola outbreak in Uganda is over, as cases rise in Congo
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is declared over, with the Ugandan government reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths; a July 28 declaration marked the end of transmission in Uganda. In contrast, the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to grapple with the outbreak, described by WHO as the second-deadliest Ebola event in history. As of Tuesday, Congo has recorded more than 5,600 cases and over 2,700 deaths. Transmission remains very active, though the acceleration has slowed and has not yet been bent. Improvements in contact tracing and testing are noted, and analyses of the Bundibugyo virus show no mutation. A critical funding gap of about $30 million is needed for logistics, medical supplies, and personal protective equipment in the worst-hit Congo regions; without rapid investment, momentum risks stalling.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダのエボラ流行終息を発表 一方コンゴでは感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,600例超・死者2,700人超という史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行が継続中であり、資金不足により対応が停滞するリスクがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: " Face à Ebola, il faut multiplier les capacités actuelles de la riposte " : l'appel du directeur de l'OMS dans la lutte contre le virus Bundibugyo en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Facing Ebola, we must scale up the current response capacities": the WHO Director-General's appeal in the fight against the Bundibugyo virus in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-08-27, the WHO Director-General calls to scale up the current response capacities to fight Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo. During a visit to Bunia, northeast DRC, survivors, women, youths, local organizations, healthcare workers, and zone authorities told him the same thing, underscoring a unified demand for stronger response capabilities. The report centers on the imperative to expand and accelerate existing Ebola response efforts in the DRC, grounded in firsthand accounts from affected communities. It situates Bundibugyo virus within the ongoing outbreak response and emphasizes community engagement and coordination as key elements of the appeal.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラに立ち向かうには、現在の対応能力を拡大しなければならない」：コンゴ民主共和国におけるブンディブジョ・ウイルスとの戦いに関するWHO事務局長の訴え
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行に対し、WHO事務局長が対応能力の拡大を訴えており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長のDRC訪問時の発言を基にしており、地域住民・医療従事者・当局が対応能力強化を求めていることが強調されている。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは記事内に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi H1N1 surge: Expert shares swine flu symptoms you shouldn't ignore- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,777 H1N1 cases in the past week, up from 229 year earlier, making H1N1 the leading Influenza A subtype in the capital. ICMR notes no new H1N1 strain; circulating virus is H1N1 pdm09, a seasonal influenza since 2025, with circulating strains well matched to vaccines. Dr Rohit Bharadwaj cautions that not every flu case requires antivirals; only high‑risk or seriously ill patients may need oseltamivir if started early. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Symptoms often include fever and body pain; paracetamol can help with fever/aches, avoiding unnecessary medicines. Hydration is important; monitor fluids and urine output. Oxygen levels can help via a pulse oximeter, but no single reading should guide decisions. Red flags include rapid breathing, difficulty breathing, chest pain, confusion or drowsiness, or sudden worsening. Most seasonal flu is self-limiting, and vaccine strains are well matched.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）が急増：専門家が見逃すべきでない症状を解説－Moneycontrol.com

triage.notes: ICMRにより新規変異株ではなく既知の季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09）と確認されており、ワクチン株との適合性も良好。症例数増加は季節的変動の範囲内と考えられるが、7倍以上の増加は継続的な監視対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Đi trước một bước trong phòng dịch sốt xuất huyết, tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Staying one step ahead in preventing dengue fever and hand-foot-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) are intensifying in Lâm Đồng Province, Vietnam, during the rainy season. By end of Week 33, 2026, dengue cases exceed 3,500 (up 1.3% YoY) across 122 of 124 communes, with 87 severe cases and 1 death. HFMD totals approach 3,560 cases, including 2 deaths. Rain favors Aedes breeding; HFMD risk rises as students return to school. Health authorities expand surveillance, analysis, and outbreak response; extensive larval source reduction campaigns target high-risk areas. For HFMD, coordination with Education strengthens school-based control in kindergartens and preschools, with early detection, triage, and treatment, plus ensured supplies and referral if needed. Community action at communes, villages, and households promotes sanitation and adherence to “3 clean”: eating clean, living clean, and hand cleanliness. On 26 Aug 2026, provincial authorities ordered sustained prevention and weekly risk alerts to all localities, ensuring staffing and materials to curb cases and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・手足口病の予防対策を一歩先に進める
triage.triage_reason: ラムドン省での季節性のデング熱・手足口病の増加を報じる定例的な地方衛生報告であり、国内での通常対応の範囲内だが、死亡例や重症例の発生があり継続的な動向注視が必要。

Experts say these may be complications following a flu-like illness, linked to immune suppression during viral infections. Public health guidance warns against self-medicating with antibiotics and urges timely medical consultation for persistent symptoms. The article highlights recognizing warning signs and seeking professional care rather than self-treatment during this uptick in viral illness in Bhopal.

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Ugandi završena, u Kongu i dalje problematično - 24sata.info
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Uganda has ended, in Congo it remains problematic.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, Uganda formally declared the end of an Ebola outbreak caused by the Sudan virus strain after 42 consecutive days with no new cases. WHO confirmed the outbreak controlled thanks to rapid mobilization, meticulous contact tracing, and restrictive measures in affected areas. The Sudan strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, unlike the Zaire strain. In neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, the situation remains unstable and concerning due to protracted armed conflict, political instability, and population displacement, which hinder surveillance and vaccination efforts. Despite Uganda’s success, WHO warns that the regional risk of re-emergence in Central and East Africa persists, underscoring the need for sustained high alert and continued strengthening of local health systems.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ流行終息、コンゴでは依然問題が続く
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダのエボラ流行は42日間新規感染者なしで終息が正式宣言されたが、DRCでは武力衝突による監視・ワクチン接種の困難さから地域的な再発リスクが指摘されており、新規の確定アウトブレイクではないため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダでのエボラ流行終息宣言。DRCについては武力衝突・政治不安定・人口移動により監視・ワクチン接種活動が阻害されているとの記述のみで、DRC国内での確定エボラ症例の存在は明記されていない。ウガンダおよびモザンビークは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは中央・東アフリカ地域での再発リスクを警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Δυτικού Νείλου: Τεστ-εξπρές από το ΕΚΠΑ με μία σταγόνα αίματος
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus: rapid test by the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens using a single drop of blood.
article.articleSummary: Rapid test being developed by the University of Athens to detect West Nile virus and three other mosquito-borne viruses—Zika, Dengue, and Chikungunya—from a single drop of blood using graphene-based biosensors for point-of-care diagnosis. Part of the SURVIVE-VBD European project funded by EU4Health with a €4 million budget; Greece is among participating countries alongside Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil. Lead researcher Maria Gazouli notes Greece's elevated risk due to climate change, with a surge in West Nile virus cases this summer and Attica, with at least 39 municipalities affected or at risk. Greece has no domestic cases of Zika, Dengue, or Chikungunya; only imported. The project also develops an AI model that combines test results with environmental data to issue risk alerts, enabling preventive measures. Timeline: 36 months; potential rollout via the Health Ministry and EODY with Mobile Health Teams.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス：アテネ国立カポディストリアス大学が一滴の血液で検査できる迅速検査を開発
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャの大学による診断技術（迅速検査）開発に関する記事であり、対象国における実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Health: New mobile lab to cut Uganda's outbreak diagnosis de
article.articleSummary: Uganda received a truck-mounted Biosafety Level 3 mobile laboratory from WHO, funded by the African Development Bank, to cut delays in outbreak testing. The $500,000 unit was handed over on August 26, 2026 and will bring advanced diagnostics closer to remote outbreak hotspots, enabling faster laboratory confirmation for Ebola and other infectious diseases while reducing sample transport times. Health Ministry officials note that some areas previously took up to a week to obtain results during Ebola responses, underscoring the need for on-site testing. WHO Uganda representative Dr Kasonde Mwinga stresses that timely, accurate diagnosis drives surveillance and response, and the mobile lab will also support cross-border work, including in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda reports 42 consecutive days without a new confirmed Ebola case, signaling end of the outbreak, but the facility remains key for preparedness as part of broader health-security investments (AfDB US$500,000; part of a US$1 million package for June 2023–August 2025).

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spreading swine fever - Minister Arunraj explains.

Arunraj noted that last year’s spike occurred January–April, while this year’s activity has increased from May–August; the department will study the situation and, if necessary, implement vaccination. Special emphasis was placed on protecting older adults and pregnant women. Separately, SP Velumani reported a doctor shortage at Coimbatore Government Medical College Hospital. The report records the ongoing public health discussion and vaccination planning, but does not provide specific case counts.

article.articleSummary: TB screening conducted door-to-door in Desa Nungka, Awayan District, Balangan Regency, South Kalimantan, Indonesia, on August 27, 2026. About 100 residents were registered to participate in TB screening and free general health checks at Desa Nungka Posyandu, organized by the Balangan Health Office and facilitated by the local village. Screening included symptom assessment for TB, as well as tests for blood glucose, cholesterol, and uric acid; elders and children among participants. Health workers from Puskesmas Awayan provided examinations and health counseling, highlighting TB transmission and encouraging residents with persistent cough to report to the nearest health center. The initiative, a first-time TB screening in the village, aims to improve access to care by bringing services to the community, reducing the need to travel to Puskesmas, and improving overall village health.

article.articleHeadline: Pune Sees Rise in Swine Flu, Dengue and Unexplained Fever Cases
article.articleSummary: Pune, India, reports a surge in swine flu, dengue, chikungunya and fever of unknown origin (FUO) as monsoon conditions raise mosquito breeding. From January–July 2026, Pune Municipal Corporation’s Metropolitan Surveillance Unit logged 21,512 FUO cases (fever with no immediate clear cause). Swine flu cases rose from 270 Jan–Jul to a sharp uptick in August with 205 cases in 25 days, prompting enhanced influenza-like illness surveillance. Dengue rose to 982 cases in Jan–Jul, while chikungunya accounted for 14. Monsoon-driven water accumulation in containers and construction sites creates breeding sites, contributing to the multi-disease fever burden. Health teams are intensifying surveillance, mosquito-control measures, and early detection of infectious diseases. Officials urge residents to prevent water stagnation around homes and to seek prompt medical attention if fever persists or accompanies other symptoms, as Pune faces concurrent outbreaks.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gautam Buddh Nagar, the threat of swine flu and dengue has increased, with the number of infected patients reaching 140.
article.articleSummary: as of August 27, 2026, in Gautam Buddh Nagar district (Noida), swine influenza (H1N1) cases have surged to 140, up 20 from the previous tally, while dengue risk is also rising. The health department is offering free rapid antigen tests to enable timely diagnosis and treatment. Common symptoms among swine flu patients include high fever, dry cough, and sore throat, with some reporting fatigue, body pains, and shortness of breath. Medical experts warn against dismissing early symptoms as a generic fever and urge prompt medical advice. Concurrent dengue surveillance points to post-monsoon conditions that promote mosquitos, given water accumulation after rains. Preventive measures include avoiding crowded places, covering mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, practicing hand hygiene, and regularly removing standing water from homes, coolers, potted plants, and rooftops.

triage.headline_ja: ガウタム・ブッダ・ナガル（ノイダ）でスワインフルーとデング熱の脅威が増大、感染者数140人に到達
triage.triage_reason: インド・ノイダ地区における季節性のスワインフルー(H1N1)とデング熱の症例増加だが、重症度・死亡等の深刻な影響情報がなく、地域の通常の公衆衛生対応（無料検査提供）で管理されているため、フルRRAには至らないが動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性の疾患（H1N1・デング）の地域的増加であり、モンスーン後の環境要因による蚊媒介感染症リスク増大が背景。死亡例や重症例の詳細情報は記事内になく、深刻度の判断材料が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Pangasinan tops leptospirosis cases in Ilocos Region
article.articleSummary: Pangasinan recorded the highest leptospirosis burden in the Ilocos Region for Jan. 1–Aug. 8, 2026, with 85 cases and 6 deaths (RESU data). Pangasinan accounted for 46 cases, followed by La Union (13), Ilocos Norte (12), Ilocos Sur (6), and Dagupan City (6). This year’s tally is 52% below last year’s 177 cases in the same period. The Department of Health (DOH) warns floodwater exposure remains a major risk as leptospirosis is transmitted via contact with water or soil contaminated with the urine of infected animals, notably rats. Authorities urge avoiding wading or swimming in floodwaters, and, if passage is necessary, wearing protective gear such as waterproof boots. Do not self-medicate with doxycycline; seek medical evaluation if symptoms—fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, vomiting, abdominal pain, red eyes, jaundice—appear days to weeks after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: パンガシナン州、イロコス地方でレプトスピラ症症例数トップ
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・イロコス地方における例年の洪水関連レプトスピラ症で、症例数は前年同期比52%減少しており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年見られる洪水関連の風土病報告であり、今年の症例数は前年より減少傾向。DOHが注意喚起を行っているが、局地的・季節的な公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் குறித்து கவன ஈர்ப்பு தீர்மானம்- அமைச்சர் விளக்கம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: Alert decision — Minister explains.
article.articleSummary: On 27 August 2026, Tamil Nadu officials said a dengue fever review was held two days earlier with all directors and doctors. As the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly session began, department ministers answered members’ questions about the dengue alert. Later, questions arose regarding a special attention appeal resolution concerning Tamils stranded in floods in Nepal, with Minister Rajmohan providing explanations. The report highlights ongoing dengue preparedness discussions at the executive level and a responsive legislature addressing humanitarian concerns tied to the Nepal floods, alongside standard interdepartmental accountability during the assembly.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に関する注意喚起決議 ― 大臣が説明
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する行政レベルの警戒・準備状況の議会報告であり、具体的な患者数や重症度の情報がなく、通常の季節的対応の域を出ないため要経過観察と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州議会でのデング熱警戒に関する行政報告が主題。ネパールの洪水被害者に関する言及はデング熱とは別件であり、ネパールは対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Fifth Ebola Vaccine Candidate Joins Race Against Congo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Fifth Ebola vaccine candidate joins race against Congo outbreak. The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo drives expansion of vaccine development, with an experimental shot developed by Egypt-based Minapharm Group set to advance toward human testing. This is the fifth candidate targeting the Ebola strain responsible for the outbreak. Minapharm Group will receive up to $16.5 million to support the program as it progresses toward human trials. The ongoing outbreak in the DRC remains a critical public health concern as authorities monitor infections and transmission, underscoring the urgency of developing effective vaccines. Details on trial timing and regulatory review are not provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのアウトブレイクに対抗する第5のエボラワクチン候補が登場
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的なワクチン開発支援が動いている重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: エジプトのMinapharm社はワクチン開発企業であり、アウトブレイク発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。アウトブレイクは拡大中とされ、詳細な感染規模・死亡率・国際拡散の有無は記事内で不明。

article.articleHeadline: Immune changes to breathing strain: Expert explains why H1N1 can be more serious during pregnancy
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, H1N1 infection during pregnancy poses higher risk for complications due to immune modulation, reduced lung capacity, and increased cardiac workload, with greatest vulnerability in the second and third trimesters. Hyderabad, India–based obstetric expert Dr Pallavi Chandra Ravula notes the immune system dampens defenses to tolerate the fetus, leaving less resistance to viral infections; WHO recognizes pregnancy as high-risk for severe influenza, and ACOG cites elevated complication risk. Symptoms may resemble ordinary flu but warning signs such as breathlessness, chest pain, persistent fever, dehydration, severe weakness, reduced fetal movements warrant medical evaluation. Early antiviral treatment, typically oseltamivir started within 48 hours of symptom onset, is advised under physician supervision. Prevention emphasizes annual inactivated influenza vaccination, deemed safe in pregnancy. Pregnant women with flu-like symptoms should consult a doctor promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸への負担を伴う免疫変化：専門家が妊娠中にH1N1が重症化しやすい理由を解説
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例数の報告ではなく、妊娠中のH1N1重症化リスクに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性やアウトブレイク発生の情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、H1N1インフルエンザが妊娠中に重症化しやすい医学的理由についての専門家解説記事。感染症イベントとしての新規発生情報は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Busia heightens Ebola watch, warns against frequent travels
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s Busia County intensifies Ebola vigilance amid the DRC/Uganda Bundibugyo virus outbreak. No confirmed Ebola cases detected at Busia and Malaba border points, but authorities warn that heavy cross-border movement (2,500–3,000 trucks daily) raises importation risk. Since Aug 19, 2026, screening has reached 139,026 travellers at Busia OSBP and 74,833 at Malaba OSBP. Public awareness has been scaled up: 19,163 learners and school communities; 15,921 market/public-place visitors; 3,672 church congregants; 248 baraza attendees; 6,107 vulnerable individuals received Ebola prevention messages. Seven suspected cases in Matayos and one each in Teso Central and Butula subcounties tested negative. Port Health at Malaba emphasizes travel restriction to Ebola-affected areas, particularly DRC. Health officials continue border surveillance and community outreach to prevent introduction of Ebola while promoting hygiene, early reporting, and cautious travel.

triage.headline_ja: ブシア県、エボラ警戒を強化し頻繁な渡航を控えるよう警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC/ウガンダでのエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行を背景に、ケニア国境での越境流入リスクが高まっており、IHR基準の複数（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、異常性）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア・ブシア県の国境監視強化であり、ケニア国内での確定例は報告されていない。実際のエボラ流行はDRC/ウガンダで発生しているため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Έρχεται rapid τεστ για τον ιό του Δυτικού Νείλου
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid test for the West Nile virus is coming.
article.articleSummary: By 2026-08-27, a Greek research team at the University of Athens is developing a rapid point-of-care test that detects West Nile virus and three other arboviruses (Zika, Dengue fever, and Chikungunya) from a single drop of blood using graphene biosensors for differential diagnosis, aiming to reduce misdiagnoses. The project SURVIVE-VBD, funded by EU4Health with a 4 million euro budget, includes Greece alongside Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil. Lead Greek investigator is Professor Maria Gazouli. A second component will pair test results with environmental data in an AI model to issue risk area alerts for preventive action. Greece faces a summer surge of West Nile virus activity, centered in Attica with about 39 municipalities at risk; no domestic Zika, Dengue, or Chikungunya cases reported yet, though imported cases exist. If adopted, MOH and EODY could roll out tests via mobile health units within 36 months.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス用の迅速検査が登場
triage.triage_reason: 記事は迅速診断検査の研究開発に関する内容であり、対象国（ブラジル）でのアウトブレイクや症例発生を報じるものではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事はEU4Health資金によるSURVIVE-VBDプロジェクト（迅速検査開発）を報じるもので、ギリシャ・イタリア・スペイン・エストニア・オランダ・ブラジルが共同参加国として挙げられているが、ブラジルでの疾病発生自体を報じる内容ではない。対象国リストにあるブラジルも本記事の主題は研究開発であり、アウトブレイク情報ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемијата на ебола во Уганда заврши, во ДР Конго сè уште трае
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in Uganda has ended, while in DR Congo it is still ongoing.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ebola outbreak has ended, with 20 cases and 2 deaths, according to the Ugandan government on July 28 and later confirmed by the WHO. The WHO monitored to ensure no hidden transmission chains. In neighboring DR Congo, the outbreak remains ongoing and highly active. Government figures show more than 5,600 infections and over 2,700 deaths as of Tuesday. Transmission continues at a high level, though some slowing in growth has been noted. Marie-Roseline Belizer, WHO Regional Director for Emergency Preparedness in Africa, said contact tracing and testing have improved, and analyses of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus show no signs of mutation despite rapid spread. However, a funding shortfall of about $30 million for logistics, including medical and personal protective equipment, threatens operations in the hardest-hit Congo areas. Without investment, momentum could be lost.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：ウガンダのエボラ流行は終息、コンゴ民主共和国では依然拡大中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は5,600人超の感染、2,700人超の死亡と深刻な公衆衛生被害を示し、資金不足により対応が危ぶまれているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息済みで、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。DRCでの継続的な流行と資金不足がリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: A Hundred Days In, Congo's Ebola Outbreak Is Still Getting Bigger
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to 5,656 confirmed cases and 2,715 deaths as of 24 August, the largest Ebola epidemic in DR Congo and the second largest anywhere. In the last day, 72 new confirmed cases and 35 deaths were recorded. Ituri accounts for 4,716 cases and 2,119 deaths; North Kivu 735. The outbreak spans 58 of 151 health zones across six provinces. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; Ervebo against Zaire strain may offer some protection, but evidence is uncertain. About 70,000 doses released: 20,000 for a trial, 50,000 for frontline workers with informed consent. As of 9 August, 155 health workers infected, 45 dead; ~792 in isolation, 1,245 recovered. WHO recommends restricting mass gatherings, road and boat surveillance, and road checkpoints; border closures not advised. Uganda: 20 cases, 2 deaths; outbreak declared over on 28 July.

triage.headline_ja: 100日を経て、コンゴのエボラ流行はさらに拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのBundibugyo型エボラ流行が過去最大規模に拡大し、医療従事者感染や複数州への拡大、国境を越えたウガンダへの伝播歴があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行（20例、2死亡）は既に7月28日に終息宣言されているが、GeoNames対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点、医療従事者の感染率が高い点は特に重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Kota Tangerang Kini Miliki Rumah Sehat Sahabat Paru untuk Tangani TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tangerang City Now Has the Lung Friends Healthy House to Treat TB.
article.articleSummary: Rumah Sehat BAZNAS Sahabat Paru (Lung Friends Healthy House) in Tangerang City, Indonesia, opens to support tuberculosis (TB) patients, particularly those with drug-resistant TB (DR-TB). On August 27, 2026, the facility was inaugurated in a cross-sector collaboration among the Tangerang City Government, BAZNAS Kota Tangerang, and the City Health Office, and is the first program of its kind in Banten Province. The program is funded by BAZNAS, with beneficiary selection and treatment coaching conducted alongside the Health Office. The house offers three rooms for up to six patients, with 14 days of accompaniment and medication per patient. The program aims to improve treatment adherence, cut transmission to families and communities, and help patients return to health and independence, potentially with post-recovery economic support to start small businesses. Staff include public health workers, cadres, primary care professionals, and pulmonary specialists.

triage.headline_ja: タンゲラン市、結核対策のため「肺の友の健康の家」を開設
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの施設開設に関する行政・福祉的な報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核患者支援施設の開設という地域医療福祉活動を報じたものであり、感染症アウトブレイクの兆候ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi H1N1 Alert: 138 New Cases In 24 Hours, Hospitals Told To Stay Fully Prepared
article.articleSummary: Delhi records 138 new H1N1 cases in 24 hours, total 2,446, with Influenza-A reaching 3,177. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh led a virtual review with Medical Directors and Medical Superintendents, supported by the Health Secretary, to bolster Delhi hospital preparedness for a potential surge in influenza and respiratory diseases. Hospitals must maintain five isolation beds each (ten in larger facilities), establish flu corners for emergencies, and enforce round-the-clock duty rosters for staff. Senior residents should cover emergency duties; samples can be collected for testing and there must be adequate viral transport medium (VTM). Maintain sufficient medicine stocks and pursue local procurement to ensure continuity. IEC materials should inform patients about symptoms and treatment. Officials urged vigilance, not panic, emphasizing respiratory hygiene, masks, and prompt medical consultation for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: デリーH1N1警報:24時間で138件の新規感染、病院に万全の準備を指示
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1・インフルエンザAの症例が増加し当局が病院準備を強化しているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報は不明であり、季節性流行対応の域を出ていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デリー保健当局が主体的に対応しており、季節性インフルエンザ/H1N1の国内サーベイランス強化の一環と見られる。重症度・死亡例に関する情報が記事に含まれておらず、続報で確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: राजधानी रांची में बढ़ा स्वाइन फ्लू का खतरा, रिम्स ने बनाई अलग व्यवस्था; अब कॉटेज का ग्राउंड फ्लोर रहेगा रिजर्व - rims ranchi reserves cottage ground floor for swine flu patients
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu threat has increased in Ranchi, the capital; RIMS has created a separate arrangement; now the cottage's ground floor will be reserved
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Ranchi—the capital of Jharkhand—sees rising influenza A (swine flu) activity. At Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS), a dedicated arrangement has been created to treat and prevent spread: the ground floor of cottages housing swine flu patients has been reserved with 10 beds, and beds are also kept in the isolation ward. Currently, no swine flu patient is admitted; if needed, infected individuals will be accommodated at the designated site. Diagnosis, medicines, and other necessary treatments are available at RIMS. The first floor will continue to function as a paying ward to avoid affecting general patients. The aim is to curb transmission to other patients, family members, and health workers. A recent uptick in influenza A cases among children has led to swine flu-like symptoms presenting at the pediatric OPDs of RIMS and Sadar Hospital, prompting prepared treatment arrangements.

triage.headline_ja: 州都ランチーでスワインフルの脅威が増大、RIMSが専用体制を構築；コテージの1階を隔離用に確保
triage.triage_reason: インドのランチーでインフルエンザA(豚インフルエンザ)症例が小児を中心に増加傾向にあるが、現時点で入院患者はゼロであり、重症度や規模に関する情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地域の医療機関が予防的に隔離体制を整えたという内容で、季節性インフルエンザAの地域的増加に対する通常の対応と見られる。現時点で確定患者数や重症例の報告はなく、パンデミックポテンシャルを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, OMS: "La risposta va triplicata"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, WHO: "The response must be tripled."
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, by August 21, 2026, the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak has reached 5,290 cases and 2,516 deaths across 56 health zones, making it the second-largest and fastest Ebola outbreak to date. The WHO and Africa CDC urge a two- to threefold expansion of the response across all pillars: enhanced surveillance, more laboratories and testing, expanded contact tracing, patient care facilities that do not fuel transmission, safer burials, and much deeper community engagement. As of August 20, 158 health workers were infected with 45 fatalities, underscoring the need to protect staff as integral to the response. Local communities must be involved, as they know care-seeking patterns, rumor sources, and contact networks, and can aid case finding and safe burials. Delayed financing costs lives; donors should turn commitments into operational resources and avoid siloed programs. Uganda has halted local transmission in some areas; some Congo zones have too, but after 100 days the virus continues, requiring coordinated, unified action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、WHO「対応は3倍に強化すべき」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上第2位規模・最速のエボラ流行が拡大中で、致死率が高く医療従事者にも多数感染しており、WHOが国際的な対応強化を要請している。IHR基準複数に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文ではウガンダは一部地域で感染拡大が抑制されたとの言及のみで、主題はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行であるため、ウガンダはverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Why Swine Flu Cases Rise During Monsoon Months
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H1N1), commonly known as swine flu, may rise during India’s monsoon months. Rain alone does not spark new infections; instead, the monsoon changes environmental and behavioral conditions that facilitate transmission of respiratory viruses. The article notes that India has repeatedly seen increased influenza activity during parts of the rainy season, driven by factors such as crowded indoor spaces and shifting weather. The central point is that the surge relates to what the monsoon alters around us, not rainfall itself. The piece highlights awareness of monsoon-linked influenza dynamics rather than reporting specific case counts, lab confirmations, or transmission sources. It emphasizes the seasonal nature of swine flu risk during monsoon months and cautions that the observed rise is related to circulating patterns, not a new strain.

triage.notes: 記事は具体的な発生事例ではなく、季節性インフルエンザ（豚インフルエンザ/H1N1）の一般的な健康啓発コンテンツ。新規株や異常な流行拡大の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: खांसने या छींकने से एक व्यक्ति से दूसरे व्यक्ति में फैलता है स्वाइन फ्लू, जानें H1N1 वायरस से जुड़े सवालों के जवाब
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu spreads from one person to another through coughing or sneezing; find out the answers to questions related to the H1N1 virus.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (H1N1) guidance from Indore and Devas in Madhya Pradesh, India emphasizes immune health via daily yoga or exercise and avoiding outside food, urging fresh home-cooked meals. Core symptoms prompting RT-PCR testing include high fever, cough, breathing difficulty, headache, diarrhea, muscle pains, and extreme fatigue. RT-PCR confirms infection; tests cost about Rs 1,000–1,500 with results in roughly six hours, and a positive result requires immediate medical consultation. Severe cases should seek prompt medical care and avoid unproven remedies or quack treatments, with possible hospitalization. Readers’ questions cover when to test and how infection is identified; testing is advised after four to five days of fever with respiratory symptoms, and treatment dosing should follow a doctor’s weight-based guidance. The article stresses consulting healthcare professionals for diagnosis and management rather than self-treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 咳やくしゃみで人から人へ広がる豚インフルエンザ、H1N1ウイルスに関する質問への回答を知る
triage.triage_reason: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）に関する一般的な健康ガイダンス記事であり、異常な流行やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、公衆衛生への新規の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はH1N1（既知の季節性インフルエンザ）の症状・検査・予防に関する一般啓発記事であり、具体的な発生数・アウトブレイク規模の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliches Fieber: Uganda seit 42 Tagen ohne neuen Ebola-Fall - Anstieg im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous Fever: Uganda Has Been Without a New Ebola Case for 42 Days - Rise in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has had no new Ebola cases for 42 days, effectively ending its outbreak after two incubation cycles without infections, according to WHO. In neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak continues to grow, with Congo reporting higher, ongoing cases. The two outbreaks were declared on May 15. In Uganda, 20 confirmed cases were linked to a patient from Congo, with two deaths. In Congo, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus is responsible; cases likely began in February and were initially misclassified as malaria. The Congo outbreak now spans six provinces, with Ituri in the northeast near the Uganda border as the focus. Current figures from public health authorities: 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, with about 770 patients in treatment centers or isolation. This report uses material from dpa.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な熱病：ウガンダはエボラ新規感染なしで42日、コンゴでは増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが拡大中で、確認例5,713人・死亡2,744人と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、国境を越えた感染歴（ウガンダへの拡大）も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、記事内でウガンダのアウトブレイク終息が言及されているものの verified_locations には含めていない。DRCの流行は6州に拡大し、Ituri州が国境近くの焦点となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 大肠菌群数超标 沃尔玛旗下"沃集鲜"品牌三文鱼抽检不合格
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coliform counts exceed standards; Walmart's "Woji Xian" brand salmon fails sampling inspection.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-27, the State Administration for Market Regulation disclosed 45 batches of foods failing quality checks, including Walmart-owned private-label Woji Xian salmon slices. One batch (89 g per box, with a 9 g seasoning packet; production date 2026-05-06) manufactured in Shenzhen by RunKong Foods Co., Ltd. and sold in Guangzhou at Haoyouduo Department Store Plaza had abnormal coliform counts. Five sampled portions yielded 100, 73, 510, 330, and <10 CFU/g; three exceeded the standard. The GB 10136-2015 limit for ready-to-eat/refrigerated aquatic products requires all five samples ≤100 CFU/g, with at most two samples >10 CFU/g. The highest finding, 510 CFU/g (5.1× the limit), signals potential contamination with pathogenic bacteria such as Salmonella, Shigella, or diarrheagenic E. coli, possibly due to production contamination, inadequate disinfection, or improper storage.

triage.headline_ja: 大腸菌群数が基準超過、ウォルマート傘下「沃集鮮」ブランドのサーモンが抜き取り検査で不合格
triage.triage_reason: 単一製品の食品規格違反（大腸菌群数超過）に関する行政発表であり、疾病の発生や患者報告は確認されていない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は食品安全規制当局による抜き取り検査結果の公表であり、実際の感染症患者発生は報告されていない。パラチフス・大腸菌・腸チフスの疾病タグはBluedotの自動分類によるもので、記事内容とは直接の患者事例の関連はない。

article.articleHeadline: 아프리카 에볼라 국제 위기 100일... 질병청 "국내 유입 0건" 발표
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa's Ebola International Crisis Reaches 100 Days... KDCA Announces 0 Imported Ebola Cases in Korea.
article.articleSummary: KDCA announced on 2026-08-27 that Korea has had 100 days with no domestically imported Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) cases. The outbreak began in May with cases in Ituri Province, DRC, and Kampala, Uganda, leading WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO reports 5,514 confirmed cases and 2,642 deaths in six DRC provinces (CFR 48%), and Uganda with 20 cases and 2 deaths (CFR 10%); France has one imported case with no deaths. KDCA activated awareness and rapid-response teams; risk assessments indicate domestic importation risk remains low. Five countries—DRC, Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, and Ethiopia—are high-risk screening zones; travelers must submit a CQ-code or health declaration with enhanced entry surveillance. Three suspected cases in Korea (a 60-year-old man and two women in their 20s) showed fever, headache, and chills and tested negative. September 2026 disaster-response drill planned; 38 national-designated inpatient beds prepared; 24/7 monitoring and public updates will continue.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ国際的危機100日…韓国疾病管理庁「国内流入0件」発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したDRC・ウガンダでの大規模エボラ流行（5,514例、CFR48%）で、フランスへの輸出例も発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行およびフランスへの輸出例、韓国国内での監視状況。ウガンダ・韓国・その他は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのイトゥリ州を含む6州での流行が主要な発生地。

article.articleHeadline: WHO confirms Uganda Ebola-free, as virus continues to spread in DRC
article.articleSummary: WHO confirms Uganda Ebola-free, as virus continues to spread in DRC. Uganda declared it was officially free of Ebola last month, 42 days after the last confirmed patient was discharged, with surveillance confirming no remaining transmission chains. The country reported 20 Ebola cases since May 15, all linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, with the first patients entering Uganda from Congo before diagnosis. Uganda implemented measures to curb spread, including cancelling large events, discouraging handshakes, and suspending cross-border transport. In eastern DRC, the outbreak persists with more than 4,500 cases and over 2,000 deaths across six provinces, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO says neighboring countries face high risk and urges strengthened surveillance, case detection/investigation, prevention and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダのエボラ終息を確認 - コンゴ民主共和国では感染拡大が継続
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,500例以上・死亡2,000人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、ワクチン未承認のブンディブジョ株による拡大で近隣国への感染リスクが高いとWHOが警告しているため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダはエボラ終息が確認されたため対象国リストにも含まれておらず除外。DRCでの流行は6州にわたり継続中で、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブジョ株が原因。近隣国への感染拡大リスクが高いとWHOが明言している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Palghar School Student Death: 30 Students Under Observation As Authorities Launch Health Screening Drive To Trace Possible Infection Source
article.articleSummary: Palghar, Maharashtra, 27 August 2026 — after the death of a Class 1 student at a residential school in Maswan, authorities launched a district-wide health screening. A 7-year-old student who developed high fever on 22 August was taken to a PHC, then to Rural Hospital in Manor where he died. Thirty pupils across the school are under observation with symptoms of cold, cough and fever as the administration reviews hygiene and water arrangements. The school, with 395 resident students out of 449 enrolled, remains the focus of testing: blood, serum and throat swabs from students, plus water samples, were collected and sent for laboratory analysis to identify the infection source. An SIT has been formed to probe the death and assign responsibility; FDA inspected the kitchen. Remaining students are reported stable. Community activists urge government management.

triage.headline_ja: パルガルの学校で生徒死亡：30人の生徒を観察下に置き、当局は感染源特定のため健康検査を開始
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の感染症により学生1名が死亡し、同校で30名が発熱等の症状で観察下にある。ヒトーヒト感染や共通感染源（水・衛生）の可能性があり、原因特定調査が進行中でWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 感染源（水・食品・病原体）は未特定。SIT（特別捜査班）が組織され、当局による調査が進行中。続報でラボ結果や感染経路の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Ouganda libéré, la RDC toujours confrontée à une flambée meurtrière
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda freed, the DRC still facing a deadly outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the end of Uganda's Ebola outbreak after 42 days with no new transmission. The Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus outbreak in Uganda had been declared in May 2026 following imported cases from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). In Uganda, 20 people were infected and 2 died; containment was achieved through contact tracing, strengthened healthcare capacity, and border-area surveillance. Uganda remains vigilant due to proximity to eastern DRC where Ebola remains active. In the DRC, the outbreak continues, centered in Ituri province and spreading to several other provinces; insecurity, population movements, and access challenges hinder response. Official figures indicate thousands of confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths. Cross-border health cooperation between Kampala and Kinshasa aims to limit cross-border transmission and maintain Uganda's recent gains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダは終息宣言、コンゴ民主共和国では致死的な流行が依然継続
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で数千人規模の感染者・2700人超の死者を伴うエボラ流行が継続し、治安悪化や人口移動によりアクセス困難な状況が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息宣言済みだが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行は治安悪化・アクセス困難により拡大継続中で、越境感染リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Lékaři řeší dovolenkové nákazy. Lidé si přivážejí i malárii či horečku dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors are dealing with holiday infections. People are bringing back malaria or dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne diseases dominate summer cases for children at the AGEL Prostějov University Hospital’s new pediatric infectious disease clinic in Olomoucký region. Lyme borreliosis is rising in children, with increases in mycoplasma infections and parvovirus B19; chickenpox remains common and may require hospital collaboration for complex cases. Travel-related infections also appear: hepatitis A contracted by a whole family in Egypt, measles from a trip to Germany, and dengue fever diagnosed in a 16-year-old boy from Šumperk/Sternberk after a trip to southern Vietnam; mild dengue in this age group and vaccination recommended for future travel. The Olomouc area has the highest tick activity. Physicians warn about bat exposures and emphasize hygiene and dehydration risks. The FNOL infectious department has previously hospitalized dengue patients and malaria from sub-Saharan Africa, and even Whipple disease. Autumn COVID wave anticipated; vaccination advised. Clinic hours: Wednesdays 7:30–11:00, Building G; tel 582 315 331.

triage.headline_ja: 医師たちが休暇中の感染症に対応。マラリアやデング熱を持ち帰る人々
triage.triage_reason: チェコの小児感染症クリニックにおける個別の輸入例（デング熱、マラリア、麻疹、A型肝炎）およびダニ媒介感染症の報告であり、対象国での発生ではなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や社会的関心も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はチェコ国内の病院における輸入感染症（ベトナム渡航後のデング熱、エジプト渡航後のA型肝炎、ドイツ渡航後の麻疹など）の個別症例報告であり、ベトナムなど対象国での発生イベントではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ہماچل کے ہمیر پور میں لمپی وائرس کی دستک، 48 مویشی متاثر، چار کی موت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy skin disease outbreak in Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh: 48 cattle affected, four dead.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy skin disease outbreak in Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh, with 48 cattle affected and four deaths. The body of the article, datelined Patna on 27 August 2026 (UNI), reports Union Home Minister Amit Shah speaking with Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary about preparations and precautionary measures for potential floods in Bihar following a calamity in Nepal. The piece emphasizes disaster readiness rather than providing epidemiological details for the cattle outbreak. No laboratory confirmation, transmission route, or progression data for the lumpy skin disease case count is included in the available text. Overall, the article pairs an animal-health outbreak notification with coverage of cross-border flood preparedness, but direct disease-management actions for the outbreak are not elaborated.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州ハミールプルでランピースキン病発生、48頭の牛が感染、4頭死亡
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は牛のウイルス性疾患で人には感染しない動物衛生イベントであり、人の公衆衛生への直接的影響は認められず、社会的関心も洪水対応に関する話題が中心である。
triage.notes: 記事はランピースキン病（牛の疾患、非ズーノーシス）の発生報告と、ネパールの災害を受けたビハール州の洪水対策準備の話題を併記している。人への感染性はなく、疫学的詳細（検査確定、感染経路など）も記載されていないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。ネパールは洪水関連の言及のみで疾病発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Pasca 2 Bocah Kakak Adik di PALI Meninggal Dunia Karena Terjangkit DBD, Ini Kata Kabid Dinkes PALI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two siblings in PALI die after contracting dengue fever, according to the Head of the PALI Health Office.
article.articleSummary: Two siblings, Andika Alam Saputra (9) and Hulya Aliya Felis (7), died in Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir (PALI), South Sumatra, after contracting dengue fever. The PALI Health Office confirmed fatalities linked to dengue diagnoses, noting the distinction between Dengue Fever (DD) and Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DBD); skin rashes are cited as a key sign of DBD. Authorities urge improved environmental cleanliness during the transitional season to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. 3M Plus—emptying water containers, covering receptacles, and recycling or disposing of water-holding scrap—is emphasized alongside prompt health checks for family members with dengue symptoms. Dinkes PALI has conducted focused fogging and socialization efforts in schools and villages deemed DBD-prone to curb transmission and raise awareness about eliminating mosquito habitats. Officials call for active community involvement to prevent further cases and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: PALIで兄弟2人がデング熱感染により死亡、保健局担当者がコメント
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南スマトラの一地域における季節性デング熱による小児2名の死亡事例。地域の風土病的流行であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、重症度と媒介感染継続の観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで季節性に流行する既知の疾病であり、本事例は南スマトラ州PALI地域における局地的な小児死亡例。地方保健局が独自にフォギングや啓発活動を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO xác nhận đợt bùng phát dịch bệnh tại Uganda chấm dứt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO confirms the outbreak in Uganda has ended.
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Ebola outbreak was declared over on 28 July after 42 consecutive days without a new case, with 20 infections and 2 deaths reported. WHO will continue monitoring into the week of 26 August to ensure no transmission chains remain. Uganda’s success illustrates effective detection, contact tracing, and surveillance that can limit community spread. In contrast, the Bundibugyo strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where by 25 August authorities reported over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths. The DRC outbreak, officially declared 15 May, is the 17th Ebola outbreak there since 1976. Despite progress in tracing and testing, transmission remains high in some areas, and analyses show no mutation in Bundibugyo yet. The response faces a roughly $30 million funding gap for logistics, PPE, medicines, and transport to affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：WHOがウガンダでの流行終息を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行は終息したが、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）ではBundibugyo株による流行が継続し、5,600例超・死亡2,700人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、資金不足（約3,000万ドル）による対応の課題も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行終息は良好なニュースだが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。DRCでの継続的なエボラ流行（17回目、Bundibugyo株）が主要な懸念事項であり、資金不足による対応能力の限界が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kakak Beradik Meninggal Diduga DBD, Dinkes PALI Gencarkan Fogging dan Imbauan 3M Plus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Siblings Die Suspected Dengue Fever, PALI Health Office Steps Up Fogging and 3M Plus Advisory

Officials urge environmental cleanliness and sustained 3M Plus measures—drain, cover, and recycle discarded items—to disrupt mosquito breeding, particularly during the transitional season when water accumulates. triage.triage_reason: 南スマトラの一地域におけるデング熱による死亡例で、地域内対応（フォギング・啓発）に留まり、国際的な異常性や拡大リスクは確認できないが、重症例（死亡）と流行性の観点から経過観察が必要。
