Dr. Marie-Roseline Belezier, WHO Africa region emergencies lead, cautioned that transmission remains very active in DRC; progress has slowed, but the outbreak has not yet been brought under control, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行は終息したが、隣国コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)では同株（ブンディブジョ株）による流行が5,600人超の感染・2,700人超の死亡と史上2番目に致死的な規模に達し、伝播が継続している。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダでの終息宣言だが、実質的な公衆衛生上の懸念はDRCでの継続的な大規模流行（史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行）にある。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarampo em SP chega a 26 casos e mobiliza campanha de vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in São Paulo reaches 26 cases and spurs vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, São Paulo state reports 26 measles cases in 2026, including three new in the capital: 23 from São Paulo city, 2 from São Bernardo do Campo, 1 from Guarulhos. Two cases are imported; others linked to importation, infection source not identified. Nineteen patients are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. All three new cases are unvaccinated (two under 1 year). Two vaccination fronts run to 1 September: a Multivaccination campaign for under-15s across 645 municipalities, and a measles-focused effort in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. In these cities, people 6 months–59 years may be vaccinated after health assessment; dose zero for 6–11 months does not replace later doses. Day D on 22 August 2026 saw >600,000 doses administered. Measles symptoms: fever, red rash, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis; travelers or contacts should seek care.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹アウトブレイクが26例に達し、ワクチン接種キャンペーンを動員
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除国であったブラジルでの再興的アウトブレイクであり、未接種者が多数を占め感染拡大の可能性があるため、社会的関心・行政対応（大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーン）も高い。
triage.notes: 26例中19例が未接種または接種不完全であり、輸入例も含まれるが国内感染源不明の例も存在。州レベルで大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 永州疾控发布关于2026年秋季开学传染病防控的温馨提示_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yongzhou CDC issues warm reminders on infectious disease prevention and control for the autumn 2026 back-to-school season.
article.articleSummary: Yongzhou City CDC issues warnings for the autumn 2026 back-to-school season, highlighting dengue fever and chikungunya transmission by Aedes mosquitoes in Yongzhou, with symptoms of high fever, headache, myalgia, and rash. Active mosquitoes require eliminating breeding sites, campus cleanups, overturning containers, cleaning water-holding pots, and covering storage; install screens and nets; deploy insecticidal lamps where feasible; and conduct routine mosquito control and health monitoring with morning/afternoon checks and travel-history reporting. Norovirus poses strong contagion risk, causing vomiting and diarrhea. Prevention emphasizes handwashing with soap and running water (not alcohol); avoiding raw foods and untreated water; proper vomiting cleanups with chlorine disinfectants; and food/water safety in canteens. Respiratory infections: daily health inquiries, home isolation for fever/cough, and ventilation (windows open 2–3 times daily for at least 30 minutes); encourage influenza vaccination; parents should report symptoms and schools must alert local authorities for outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 永州疾病予防管理センター、2026年秋の新学期における感染症予防対策に関する注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の感染症予防に関する定例的な注意喚起であり、異常な流行や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は永州市CDCによる新学期向けの一般的な感染症予防啓発情報であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱・ノロウイルス・インフルエンザに関する通常の予防喚起で、特定のアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Ouganda déclare la fin de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda declares the end of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared the end of the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases, per WHO and Africa CDC. The last treated patient in Uganda, an imported case from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), was discharged on July 16, with no linked cases detected since. Since the outbreak began on May 15, Uganda recorded 20 laboratory-confirmed infections: 15 imported from the DRC and 5 locally acquired among contacts and health workers connected to imported cases. Two deaths occurred and 18 patients recovered. More than 800 contacts were identified and followed. Strengthened measures included case detection, contact tracing, isolation, patient care, infection prevention in facilities, and entry-point surveillance. The end of the outbreak in Uganda comes as transmission continues in the DRC; cross-border movement keeps neighboring countries at risk. WHO advises maintaining surveillance and cross-border cooperation, not closing borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダが流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでは流行終息が宣言されたが、原因国であるDRCでは感染が継続しており、越境リスクが残るためIHR基準の複数該当（重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの流行終息宣言が主題だが、DRCでの感染継続と越境リスクが明記されているため、DRCを対象国として記録。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : appel à une implication des communautés dans la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: A call for the involvement of communities in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-27, Ebola continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with the Ministry of Health reporting 5,514 cases and 2,642 deaths. Activists urge greater community involvement, arguing that communities must be at the heart of outbreak management in Beni Health Zone and surrounding areas. Papy Kasereka, a risk-communication analyst, emphasizes turning communities into allies and demystifying Ebola response by offering guided visits to Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs). Such immersion aims to counter denial and widen awareness of how far the virus circulates. Michel Tosalisana, physician and head of the Beni health zone, warns against targeting intervention teams, noting that resistance undermines youths' futures and that teams protect public health. The current outbreak has already killed seven times more people than the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, which caused over 11,000 deaths—the historic deadliest.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ対策への地域社会の関与を求める呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ流行は5,514例・2,642死亡と報告され、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る規模とされており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にBeni保健区）のみが主題として述べられており、Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれないため除外した。死亡者数の増加率（西アフリカ流行の7倍）は数値的整合性に疑問があるが原文通り記載。

article.articleHeadline: Programa Especial - Responsable de OMS a RFI: "Podemos contolar la epidemia de ébola, pero existe riesgo de propagación"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special Program - A WHO official on RFI: "We can control the Ebola epidemic, but there is a risk of its spread."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with 5,584 confirmed cases and 2,680 deaths as of August 23, 2026, across 57 health zones. WHO Africa Emergencies Director Marie-Roseline Bélizaire explains the epidemic began in February but was only detected in May, allowing months of undetected transmission to relatives, caregivers, and health workers. Contributing factors include late case detection, high community mortality and unsafe burial practices, insecurity and restricted access hindering response teams, and extensive population movement tied to mining. Genomic surveillance shows no mutation, indicating the same Ebola strain. Response efforts involve local authorities and communities, including training families to participate safely. Attacks on aid operations impede access; Bélizaire calls for a ceasefire and greater peace in eastern DRC to enable teams to reach affected communities and curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 特別番組 - WHO担当者がRFIに語る：「エボラ流行は制御可能だが、拡大のリスクは存在する」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例5,584人、死亡2,680人という大規模エボラ流行が57の保健区に拡大しており、治安悪化により対応チームのアクセスが妨げられ、国際的拡大のリスクがWHO当局者により指摘されている。
triage.notes: 2月に発生し5月まで検知されなかったため数か月間未発見の感染拡大が発生。ゲノム監視では変異なしとされているが、治安不安や医療従事者・援助活動への攻撃が対応を著しく困難にしている。WHOはイースタンDRCでの停戦と平和の実現を呼びかけている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: U.S. Donates Experimental Antibody Treatment to Bolster Uganda's Fight Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda receives US donation of MBP134, an experimental antibody treatment for Ebola, to bolster readiness amid Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the nearby Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Uganda currently has no active Ebola cases, but cross-border transmission risk persists with ongoing DRC spread. As of mid-August 2026, the DRC outbreak recorded over 4,500 confirmed cases and more than 2,000 deaths, the largest outbreak outside West Africa. MBP134, developed by Mapp Biopharmaceutical with BARDA support, neutralizes Ebola virus particles and has shown activity against multiple Ebola species in preclinical studies, including Bundibugyo virus. The treatment is for compassionate use and can be deployed rapidly if a case is detected; it is not an approved commercial therapy. The donation, held for immediate use, highlights US support, with more than $619 million committed to regional Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ:米国がエボラ出血熱対策強化のため実験的抗体治療薬をウガンダに提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,500例超・死者2,000人超の大規模エボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行が継続中で、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクがあり、国際的な対応（米国の抗体治療薬提供、6億ドル超の支援）が行われているため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ・アンゴラも含まれるが、記事サマリー上ではウガンダは活動例なしの予防的措置対象国であり、アンゴラは言及なし。対象国リストにウガンダ・アンゴラは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Declares End of Ebola Outbreak in Uganda - Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak has been declared over by the World Health Organization; Uganda recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths, with the government declaring the country free of the disease on 28 July. The WHO continued surveillance through 2026-08-27 to ensure no undetected transmission. In neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, transmission remains active and is described as the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history, with more than 5,600 cases and over 2,700 deaths as of Tuesday, 2026-08-25, as the curve is not yet broken. Dr. Marie-Roseline Bélizaire of WHO warned that progress has slowed but ongoing transmission persists. This juxtaposition shows an end in Uganda alongside a persistent, severe outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダのエボラ流行終息を宣言 ― コンゴ民主共和国では依然拡大中
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでは終息したが、隣国DRCで史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行が継続中で5,600例超・死者2,700人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、越境拡大の実績（ウガンダへの伝播）もあるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Bundibugyo株）は7月28日に終息宣言済みで対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方DRCでは進行中の大規模流行（史上2番目の規模）が主題であり、これを対象として評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo sobem para 26 em São Paulo e vacinação é ampliada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases rise to 26 in São Paulo, and vaccination is expanded.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state rise to 26 as of 27 August 2026, with vaccination expanded until 1 September. Of the 26 cases, 23 are residents of the capital, 2 from São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 from Guarulhos. Three new infections occurred in the capital: two children under 1 year and a woman in her 30s; none had vaccination history. About 19 cases lacked vaccination or had incomplete schedules; two of the new cases were imported, with other importation sources under investigation. The health secretariat maintains two vaccination fronts: a multivaccination campaign across 645 municipalities, targeting children and adolescents under 15; and targeted measles vaccination in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo for ages 6 months to 59 years after health assessment. The Day D vaccination on 22 yielded over 600,000 doses. First-dose coverage 89.35%, second-dose 74.64% in early 2026; goal is 95% for both.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が26件に増加、ワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除国であったブラジル・サンパウロ州で未接種者を中心に症例が増加し、輸入例も確認されるなど流行のポテンシャルがあり、行政が大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンを展開している点から注視が必要。
triage.notes: 症例は全てサンパウロ州内（州都、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ）で発生。死亡や重症例の報告はないが、未接種者が多く輸入例も含まれるため感染拡大リスクがある。行政は複数のワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: अकेले देहरादून में ही क्यों बढ़ा स्वाइन फ्लू का असर? टेंशन में स्वास्थ्य विभाग - dehradun swine flu cases soar 91 of uttarakhands h1n1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why has the swine flu impact increased even in Dehradun alone? Health department tense - Dehradun swine flu cases soar 91 of Uttarakhand's H1N1
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Uttarakhand reports 57 swine flu (H1N1) infections, with 52 cases in Dehradun, 3 in Nainital, and 2 in Haridwar; 10 districts have zero cases. Dehradun accounts for 91.2% of statewide cases. Crowded settings such as schools, offices, public transport, and poorly ventilated spaces are highlighted as transmission risks; Dehradun’s urban hub status and referral hospitals may drive higher detection and reporting. Weather factors may influence flu-like illnesses, though doctors caution against weather as the sole cause. The report raises three questions: sample counts in Dehradun versus other districts; how many of the 52 are local versus travel/contact-linked; and whether zero cases in other districts reflect low transmission or limited testing. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, headache, and fatigue, with lab confirmation needed beyond symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラードゥーンだけで豚インフルエンザの影響が増加したのはなぜか？緊張する保健当局 - デヘラードゥーンの豚インフルエンザ感染例がウッタラーカンド州のH1N1の91%を占める
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の地域的増加であり重篤性・国際拡大の明確な情報はないが、都市部での集中発生とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザの一種であり、毎年一定数の発生が見られる。デヘラードゥーンでの集中は検査体制や紹介病院の集積によるものと記事内でも指摘されており、重症度や死亡例の情報は記載なし。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi H1N1 Surge Eightfold: Standard Flu Shots Protect Elderly Only Half as Much
article.articleSummary: Delhi’s 2026 monsoon season has driven an eightfold surge of H1N1, with 3,000 influenza cases in the city and 2,308 confirmed H1N1 infections as of Aug 25, up from 229 in the same period in 2025. ICMR Director General confirms H1N1 accounts for about 97–98% of circulating Influenza A in Delhi, with scattered Influenza B. Agilus Diagnostics reports a ~30% positivity rate among flu tests in the past week, signaling broad community circulation. An emergency review convened by Chief Minister Rekha Gupta follows the surge; hospitals report available beds and isolation wards. Elderly adults (65+) face disproportionate risk due to immunosenescence: standard-dose vaccines elicit roughly 50% lower antigen-specific antibody titers, and aging innate/adaptive immunity impairs viral control and vaccine response. Additional drivers include reduced respiratory reserve and poor cough reflex, alongside comorbidities such as diabetes, cardiovascular and chronic lung disease, chronic kidney disease, and neurological disorders, which raise risks of pneumonia, respiratory failure, sepsis, and hospitalization during H1N1 infection endemic since 2009.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1が8倍に急増：標準的なインフルエンザワクチンは高齢者には効果が半減
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染が前年比8倍に急増し、地方政府が緊急対応を行うなど社会的・行政的関心が高く、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、感染拡大継続性、流行しやすさ）に該当するため。
triage.notes: H1N1は2009年以降デリーで常在化している既知株であり新興病原体ではないが、今季の感染規模（前年比8倍、陽性率約30%）と高齢者の重症化リスクの高さから注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: La deforestazione, la corsa all'oro e il ritorno dell'ebola - Olivier Monod
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deforestation, the gold rush, and the return of Ebola - Olivier Monod
article.articleSummary: Seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, 2026, spread faster than all outbreaks; as of August 25, there are over 5,656 cases and 2,715 confirmed deaths. The epidemic began in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, in the northeast, a region identified by risk maps as high for Ebola resurgence. Deforestation, mining and population movements linked to informal gold mining near Mongbwalu drive increased human–virus contact. Around a dozen gold mines encircle Mongbwalu; forest clearance facilitates exposure by bats and other wildlife, with direct or indirect spillover via hunted animals. A 2024/2025 assessment by Carson Telford and colleagues linked deforestation, climatic factors and hunting to Ebola emergence; satellite data show 15% forest loss in the region over 25 years, with accelerating deforestation in the last 15 years (Global Forest Watch, IPIS). Surveillance gaps persist: more than 80% of new cases occur outside known contact lists, hindering containment.

triage.headline_ja: 森林破壊、金採掘ブーム、そしてエボラの再来 - オリヴィエ・モノー
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ流行で、既に5,656例・2,715死亡と過去最速のペースで拡大し、新規感染の8割超が既知の接触者リスト外で発生するなど制御が困難な状況にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既に大規模流行が進行中の既知イベントであり、通常のトリアージ判断とは別に既存のWHO/CDC等によるリスク評価・対応が進行している可能性が高い。深刻度と拡大速度の観点から継続的な監視・フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में दोगुना होता है बीमारियों का खतरा, डेंगू- मलेरिया बहुत ज्यादा नॉर्मल, जानिए स्वस्थ रहने के जरूरी हेल्थ टिप्स
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of diseases doubles during the monsoon season; dengue and malaria are much more common; learn the essential health tips to stay healthy.
article.articleSummary: As monsoon season in India drives humidity and temperature fluctuations, infectious-disease risk doubles, with dengue and malaria becoming more common. The New Delhi lifestyle desk notes that immunity can wane, increasing incidences of cold, viral fever, throat infections, and gastrointestinal issues alongside mosquito-borne illnesses. Preventive measures include drinking only boiled or filtered water and avoiding outside water or unsafe beverages; refrain from street food, cut fruits, and open-food items; wash hands with soap before eating. After rain, change wet clothes, bathe, and dry thoroughly; wear dry clothes. Eliminate standing water at home; regularly clean water containers, coolers, flower pots, and old vessels to curb mosquito breeding. Seek medical advice promptly for high fever or extreme weakness, vomiting or diarrhea, or severe throat pain or breathing difficulty. Children and the elderly are especially vulnerable.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期には病気のリスクが倍増、デング熱・マラリアが非常に一般的に―健康を保つための必須ヘルスケアのヒント
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報じるものではなく、モンスーン季節の一般的な健康注意喚起・予防啓発記事であるため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は毎年恒例のモンスーン季節における感染症予防の一般的な健康アドバイス記事であり、具体的な発生数・アウトブレイク・異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatite: Dados da saúde expõem alerta que exige ação antes do diagnóstico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis: Health Data Reveal a Warning That Requires Action Before Diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B remains a pressing public health issue in Rondônia, Brazil, where 2025 data show 406 new HBV cases and a rate of 23.2 per 100,000—well above the national average (5.2) and second only to Acre. Hepatitis C accounted for 201 cases (11.5/100,000), with Porto Velho among capitals with higher incidence. The report links current transmission to Amazonian sanitation history, vertical transmission, and older medical practices, noting many patients were likely infected decades ago. Yet prevention and care are within reach: rapid tests at Basic Health Units yield results in about 15 minutes; the hepatitis B vaccine is free for all ages; medicines are available through SUS. In 2025, 16 HBV cases were reported among pregnant women (0.7 per 1,000 live births; national 0.3), underscoring the need for prenatal testing and vaccination. Actions: expand active case finding, testing, vaccination, prenatal care, and continuous treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 肝炎:医療データが示す警鐘、診断前の対策が急務
triage.triage_reason: 慢性的な公衆衛生課題としてのB型・C型肝炎の統計報告であり、急性の異常事象や国際的拡大リスクはなく、既存の医療体制（SUS）で対応可能とされている。
triage.notes: 地域的な慢性肝炎の疫学データ報告であり、突発的な感染症イベントではないため通常のRRA対象外。ヒト-ヒト感染の急性拡大要因（アウトブレイク）ではなく、長年の医療歴史的要因による罹患率の高さを示す統計記事。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆本土登革熱「家庭群聚」！岡山區一家六口3人確診住院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports a local dengue fever outbreak; three members of a six-member family in Gangshan District diagnosed and hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Three more locally acquired dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung's Gangshan District mark a family cluster. A man in his 60s developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia, and nausea on August 26 and tested positive for dengue virus serotype 2; two of the five cohabitants were also diagnosed with serotype 2, with three hospitalized. Taiwan CDC reports 145 dengue cases nationwide this year, with 10 acquired cases all in Kaohsiung; 135 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam, Indonesia and the Maldives. Deputy Director Lin Ming-cheng said the local cases had no overseas travel history; authorities expanded epidemiological investigations and implemented emergency vector-control measures around residences, intensified mosquito-density surveys, source reduction, and health education. Public should cooperate, especially after heavy rains that create breeding sites. Prevention outdoors includes light-colored long sleeves and approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR3535). Seek prompt medical care for fever symptoms and inform travel history; TOCC and NS1 testing aid early diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で本土デング熱「家族内クラスター」発生！岡山区の一家6人中3人が確診・入院
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における局地的なデング熱家族内クラスターであり、既知の媒介蚊感染症で重症度・国際的拡大リスクは限定的だが、地域内感染継続の可能性から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（Kaohsiung）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。輸入例の由来国（Vietnam, Indonesia, Maldives）は記事の主題ではなく実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆本土登革熱家庭群聚　岡山區一家六口「已3人確診」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports a local dengue fever household cluster; in Gangshan District, a family of six has three confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Three new local dengue cases in a six-member family cluster in Gangshan District, Kaohsiung City. Index patient is a man in his 60s with fever, myalgia, arthralgia, and nausea on 26 August, dengue virus type 2 confirmed. Two cohabitants also infected; all three hospitalized. No overseas travel history. Expanded community investigations and vector-control measures—mosquito-density surveys, breeding-site removal, health education—are underway. Nationally, Taiwan has 145 dengue cases in 2026, 10 local (all in Kaohsiung) and 135 imported, mainly from Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Maldives. Guidance: post-rain inspections, use approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535), wear light clothing, seek prompt care for fever with TOCC assessment; NS1 rapid testing may aid diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で本土感染デング熱の家族クラスターが発生、岡山区の一家6人中3人が確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市で家族内の本土感染デング熱クラスター（3例確定）が発生しているが、渡航歴なしの限定的事例であり、全国的にも地方性の10例のみで国際的拡大の証拠はない。対象国リストに台湾が含まれないため主要な地域検証は該当なし。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（高雄市岡山区）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。インドネシア・ベトナム・モルディブは輸入例の感染源として言及されているのみで、現地での発生事例ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: The Flu Season Explained: H3N2 vs H1N1, Why Cases Are Spreading And How To Stay Safe
article.articleSummary: H3N2 and H1N1 influenza are circulating this season in Mumbai, causing fever, dry cough, sore throat, body aches and fatigue. Self-diagnosis is unreliable; clinicians emphasize seeking medical advice and testing when flu-like symptoms appear. The article explains why influenza spreads, identifies groups at higher risk, and highlights when testing matters and how to stay protected. Dr. Manish Shetty, Consultant Physician and Diabetologist at S.L. Raheja Hospital in Mumbai, notes an uptick in patients presenting with fever, cough, sore throat, body ache, and fatigue. While exact case counts are not provided, the piece stresses that influenza is circulating and urges appropriate care and testing rather than guessing the strain.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザシーズン解説：H3N2とH1N1、感染拡大の理由と予防法
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H3N2・H1N1）に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、異常な流行や重症化、国際的拡大の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事で、具体的な症例数や異常な流行パターンの報告はない。ムンバイでの患者増加の言及があるが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄雨後爆發登革熱家庭群聚！ 岡山一家六口3確診、全住院中
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak after rain in Kaohsiung — family cluster! In Gangshan District, a family of six: three confirmed, all hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, centers on a family cluster in Gangshan District. As of 2026-08-27, three of six residents in a single household are confirmed dengue virus serotype 2 infections and hospitalized; no travel history among cases. The index patient, a man in his 60s, developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia, and nausea on August 26 and was diagnosed after hospital testing; two additional household members were also confirmed with DENV-2. At least three local breeding sources were found at the residence (flower pots, pot bases, and a shrine-room vase). Nationally, 145 dengue cases this year include 10 locally transmitted, all in Kaohsiung, and 135 imported cases mainly from Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Maldives—lower than 2025. Public health actions include expanded contact tracing, emergency vector Control around the home, larval-source reduction, and education. Heavy rains and standing water necessitate home inspections and the “patrol, drain, clean, brush” measures after rainfall to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で雨後にデング熱の家庭内クラスター発生！岡山地区の一家六人中3人確診、全員入院中
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国リスト外）で発生した局所的な家族内デング熱クラスターであり、国内対応（媒介制御・接触者調査）で管理可能。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 発生国は台湾であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれないため verified_locations は空。インドネシア・ベトナムは輸入例の由来国として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄雨後爆發登革熱家庭群聚！ 岡山一家六口3確診、全住院中 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever family cluster outbreak after rainfall in Kaohsiung! Three of six family members diagnosed, all hospitalized in Gangshan.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, centers on a family cluster in Gangshan District. Six residents were exposed; three members have tested positive for dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2). The index case, a man in his 60s, developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia and nausea on August 26 and was confirmed with dengue; two additional household members also tested positive for DENV-2. Nationally this year, Taiwan has 145 confirmed dengue cases, including 10 local transmissions—all in Kaohsiung—and 135 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), and the Maldives (16). Health authorities expanded epidemiological investigations around the residence, implemented emergency vector control, conducted density surveys, eliminated breeding sources, and intensified health education. Residents are urged to cooperate; after heavy rainfall, follow the four-step measure: inspect, drain, clean, and scrub, and re-check post-rain to reduce mosquito density.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で豪雨後にデング熱の家族内集団感染が発生！岡山地区の一家6人中3人が確診、全員入院中
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・高雄市における家族内デング熱クラスターであり、局地的発生で当局が媒介制御を実施済み。対象国（Zambia等）には該当せず、国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（対象国リスト外）。ベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入例の感染源国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。局地的な家族内感染で、当局により媒介制御・疫学調査が実施されており管理可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Falta de centros e rastreamento dificulta resposta à Ébola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lack of health centers and surveillance hampers the Ebola response in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists with 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths (case fatality ~48%). Surveillance is hampered by insufficient contact tracing (84.6% vs 85% target) and a lack of treatment centers in several health zones, alongside demotivated, unpaid staff at entry points. Authorities warn of weak contact follow-up, especially in Bas-Uélé (North). Transmission remains in Ituri (east, epicenter) and is spreading to Tshopo (center-north), Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, and South Kivu (east), with South Kivu more than 80 days without new cases. The country received 16,520 Ervebo vaccines; designed for Zaire ebolavirus, they show animal-derived signals of potential protection against Bundibugyo, the variant driving the current outbreak. No Bundibugyo-specific treatments exist; two other vaccines in Phase 1 trials have shown safety. Uganda reported 20 infections (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths, amid cross-border transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、医療施設不足と接触者追跡の遅れがエボラ対応を困難に
triage.triage_reason: 確定患者5,713人、死亡2,744人（致死率約48%）に達し、ウガンダへの国境を越えた感染拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大（20例、うち15例がDRCからの輸入例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株に対する既存ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性が限定的である点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: un dispositif pour renforcer les contrôles le long du fleuve Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a system to strengthen checks along the Congo River.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) authorities, with support from the International Organization for Migration (IOM), are strengthening health surveillance along the Congo River by establishing 40 strategic points to screen travelers, manage alerts, and temporarily isolate suspected Ebola cases. The move follows the Yingfeng 2 incident in Kinshasa, where passengers were screened but no Ebola cases detected onboard. Over 7,000 travelers have been screened in two weeks at the Bende-Bende port near Kinshasa. Previously, by mid-July, IOM supported 27 entry points and 76 checkpoints, with more than 1.6 million screenings and 74 alerts (61 verified). The Congo River spans about 4,700 km, with 100–150 ports. The new points will bolster screening, alert transfer, and isolation spaces, PPE, and frontline training. Kinshasa screening corridors and handwashing stations are under construction at Ndolo and Beach Onatra; Kisangani facilities are being evaluated. The project aims to improve information exchange and cross-border coordination along the river corridor.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：コンゴ川沿いの検査体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で重大な公衆衛生リスクとされ、国際機関(IOM)の支援を受けた大規模な水上検疫体制強化が進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ出血熱の新規発生報告ではなく、既存の対応（Yingfeng 2号事案を受けたコンゴ川沿いの検疫強化）に関するものだが、感染拡大リスク管理の観点から重要な動向として注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : en Ituri, le PAM a remis une base logistique au CTE de Lita pour appuyer la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In Ituri, WFP handed over a logistics base to the Lita Ebola Treatment Center to support the response.
article.articleSummary: On August 26, 2026, the World Food Programme handed over a new logistics base to the Lita Ebola Treatment Center in Ituri province, DR Congo, funded at $200,000. The facility, described as the first logistics base, includes laboratories, offices, dormitories, and mobile storage depots to boost logistics and community-facing response efforts, bringing operations closer to affected communities. Dr. Patience Lokengama, health zone chief, said the base enhances lab capacity and continuity of care, while Steve Ahuka, incident manager, highlighted infrastructure support and food distribution as tools to improve community adherence and contact tracing. The event was attended by WHO emergencies chief Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu. Food distribution targets families of patients and vulnerable people to strengthen acceptance and follow-up of contacts. The Lita health zone reports 9 confirmed Ebola cases and 3 suspected; WFP also facilitated an ambulance transfer from Lubumbashi to Bunia to bolster logistics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：イツリ州でWFPがリタ・エボラ治療センターに対応支援のための物流基地を引き渡し
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で確認9例・疑い3例のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であり、WHO・WFPが国際支援を行っている。Ebolaは公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事象であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規発生の報告ではなく、既知のエボラアウトブレイクに対する国際支援（WFPによる物流基地引き渡し）に関する内容。フルRRAでは既存アウトブレイクの進行状況・拡大リスクを確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: La Russie se joint aux efforts de l'OMS pour lutter contre Ebola, en fournissant des tests et en développant un vaccin, dit un haut diplomate russe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia joins WHO efforts to fight Ebola, by providing tests and developing a vaccine, says a senior Russian diplomat.
article.articleSummary: Russia joins WHO Ebola response by supplying diagnostic tests and pursuing a vaccine, as a Russian delegation led by Deputy Health Minister Oleg Saglaï attends the 76th WHO Regional Committee for Africa in Addis Ababa. Russia has sent 7,500 Ebola test kits to the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Republic of the Congo, and Uganda. The test, developed in four days, detects the virus before symptoms, enabling earlier isolation. Russian scientists are testing a vaccine against the new Bundibugyo strain; clinical trials are underway. Russia already has GamEvac, a vaccine for the Zaire strain (1976 outbreak in West Africa 2014–2016), which could be potentially effective against Bundibugyo, according to Gamaleya. The vaccine could be produced, stocked, and delivered within 24 hours; Ginzburg says politics is the only barrier. By Aug 23, the DRC reported 2,680 deaths from Bundibugyo, with 5,584 cases and 1,215 recoveries across six provinces; CFR 48%.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア高官、WHOのエボラ対策に協力へ ― 検査キット提供とワクチン開発を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行は死者2,680人・CFR48%に達し、国際機関やロシアが支援に動くなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い事例であるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行への国際支援。エチオピア（アディスアベバ）はWHO会議開催地であり発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダ・コンゴ共和国は検査キット配布先として言及されているが、発生の主体はDRCであり対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WP: новая вспышка Эболы рискует побить исторический рекорд по масштабу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WP: A new Ebola outbreak risks breaking the historical record for scale.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding at an unprecedented pace and could become the largest on record. U.S. CDC data show that since the first case was identified on May 15, the country has reported at least 5,605 infections and 2,683 deaths as of Tuesday, far surpassing the 2018–2022 outbreak total of about 2,200 deaths. At a comparable early stage in 2014 West Africa, roughly 100 days after the first case there were about 759 cases, less than 15% of the Congo figures. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission in Congo with a trajectory that could exceed prior outbreaks, highlighting the urgent need for intensified public health response.

triage.headline_ja: WP：新たなエボラ出血熱の流行、規模で歴史的記録を破る恐れ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が過去最大規模を超える可能性があり、感染者5,605人・死者2,683人に達しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題として言及されているためAngolaは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆本土登革熱「家庭群聚」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports local dengue fever 'household clusters'.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City, Taiwan reports local dengue fever clusters in Gangshan District. Three confirmed local cases: a man in his 60s developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia, and nausea on Aug 26 and tested positive for dengue virus serotype 2; two cohabitants also test positive for DENV-2, with three hospitalized. All three had no recent international travel; investigations found active mosquito breeding sources at homes (flower pots, bases, temple vases). Public health teams expanded surveillance and intensified vector control and community education to curb spread. Nationwide dengue total this year is 145, with 10 locally acquired cases all in Kaohsiung; 135 imported, mainly from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), and the Maldives (16). Recommendations: after heavy rains, eliminate standing water via patrol, overturn, clean, and brush; wear light-colored clothing; use approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535); seek prompt medical care for dengue-like symptoms and report travel history; labs may use NS1 rapid tests and TOCC screening.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で本土発生の登革熱「家庭内クラスター」が拡大
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄で登革熱の家庭内クラスターが発生し入院例もあるが、渡航歴なしの局地的事例で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、社会的関心の高さも記事からは確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台湾は評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。記事中で言及されるベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入例の出身国であり、発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, UNMISS and partners strengthen Ebola preparedness in Ezo
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, Ebola preparedness is being strengthened at the DRC-South Sudan border town of Ezo in Western Equatoria. A WHO team, supported by UNMISS, conducted a 10-day mission from Yambio to assess readiness, strengthen screening, and bolster frontline health workers as Ebola cases are reported in the DRC. Cross-border screening exists at the main crossing, but monitoring is limited to a single entry point linking Ezo to Nabiapai, with two other routes into Congo not yet screened. Health workers are trained to identify suspected cases, protect staff, isolate patients, and ensure timely referrals; PPE and sample-collection materials have been provided. UNMISS security assessments aim to safeguard screening centers and the safe movement of health teams. The effort centers on protecting livelihoods while preventing Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、UNMISS及び関係機関、エゾにおけるエボラ対策準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ症例が報告されており、DRC-南スーダン国境地域での越境拡大リスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ症例発生を受けた、DRC-南スーダン国境地域（Ezo）での予防的対応強化に関するもの。南スーダン及び日本（北海道）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。国境での監視体制の不備（未検査の経路2つ）が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: मुर्गी पालन करने वाले बरसात में रहें सावधान, ये बीमारी फैलते ही बर्बादी शुरू
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Poultry farmers, stay vigilant during the monsoon; once these diseases spread, devastation begins.
article.articleSummary: During the monsoon in Gonda, India, poultry farming faces rapid spread of diseases unless cleanliness and vaccination are maintained. Dr. Rakesh Kumar Tiwari notes coccidiosis, Ranikhet disease (Newcastle disease), CRD (chronic respiratory disease), E. coli infection, and diarrhea spread quickly as humidity rises, dirty water and litter. Symptoms: coccidiosis with blood in droppings; Ranikhet with respiratory distress and green diarrhoea; diarrhea from contaminated water. Preventive measures: keep litter dry and bedding; ensure shed ventilation to prevent humidity and gas buildup; keep feed and water uncontaminated; clean water daily; do not place feed bags on ground to avoid dampness and mold; isolate sick birds promptly; vaccinate on schedule; consult a veterinarian at first signs. Emphasis on proactive prevention to limit losses.

triage.headline_ja: 養鶏農家の皆さん、雨季は要注意。この病気が広がると被害が拡大します。
triage.triage_reason: 家禽の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響や異常な流行拡大は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドGonda地域の養鶏農家向けの季節的な家禽病予防に関する一般的な指導記事であり、具体的な発生事例やヒトへの感染リスクの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de SP chega a 26 casos de sarampo em 2026 - 27/08/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo reaches 26 measles cases in 2026 - 27 August 2026
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state reach 26 in 2026, with three new cases in the capital: two children under one year and a woman in her 30s; none had vaccination history. Of the total, 23 are in the city of São Paulo, two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one in Guarulhos; 19 patients were unvaccinated or incompletely immunized. Two cases are imported; the rest are linked to importation. A mass vaccination drive for measles for people aged 6 months to 59 years runs until 1 September in São Paulo, São Bernardo do Campo, and Guarulhos, as part of the National Multivaccination Campaign. Preliminary 2026 coverage is 89.35% for the first dose and 74.64% for the second; targets are 95% for both. Measles is highly contagious and airborne; symptoms include fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a red rash 7–14 days post-exposure. Routine: first dose at 12 months (MMR), second at 15 months (MMRV involving varicella); adults 30–59 should have at least one dose; healthcare workers require two doses.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の麻疹症例が26件に達する - 2026年8月27日
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン未接種者を中心とした麻疹症例の増加（26件）が報告されているが、死亡や重症例の報告はなく、国際的拡大の兆候も見られないため、現時点ではフルRRAより経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州（サンパウロ市、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ、グアルーリョス）で麻疹症例が発生。ワクチン接種率が目標の95%に届いておらず（1回目89.35%、2回目74.64%）、輸入関連の伝播が継続中。州当局が集団予防接種キャンペーンを実施中で、国内対応で管理可能な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Tiga Jenis Bakteri Ditemukan dalam Sampel Menu MBG di Rembang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Types of Bacteria Found in MBG Menu Samples in Rembang
article.articleSummary: Rembang, Central Java, Indonesia — laboratory results confirm bacterial contamination in MBG (Gratis Makanan Bergizi) menu samples served to students and teachers at SMPN 5 Rembang on August 4, 2026. Nasi liwet samples contained Salmonella, Streptococcus faecalis, and Bacillus cereus; telur balado samples contained Streptococcus faecalis and Bacillus cereus. Hundreds of students from SMPN 5 Rembang and SMP Annawawiyah Tasiksagung reported diarrhea the day after consumption; several teachers were affected as well. Testing was conducted by Balai Laboratorium Kesehatan Masyarakat dan Pengujian Alat Kesehatan Provinsi Jawa Tengah, with results received on August 27, 2026. The MBG program for SMPN 5 Rembang originated from SPPG 3 Mondoteko and was halted on August 6, 2026. Ali Syofi'i, head of the Rembang Health Office, notes that some detected bacteria can cause digestive disturbances.

triage.headline_ja: レンバンのMBGメニュー検体から3種類の細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 特定地域の学校給食による単発の食中毒事案であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限の可能性は低く、既に給食提供が停止されるなど管理下にある。
triage.notes: 食中毒（Salmonella, Streptococcus faecalis, Bacillus cereus）による下痢症例が学校給食プログラムで発生。地方保健当局が調査・対応済みで、給食提供元は既に停止されている。ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく食品汚染由来の単発事案。

article.articleHeadline: اشتباه بظهور إصابات بالحمى القلاعية في العسة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected cases of foot-and-mouth disease in Al-A'sa.
article.articleSummary: Suspected foot-and-mouth disease among sheep in the Al-A’sa border area with Tunisia. The Western Plain veterinary police branch conducted a field visit, collected samples, and sent them for laboratory testing, while implementing biosecurity measures in the affected pens. Official data show 20 outbreaks of foot-and-mouth disease across Libya, with spread into western and southern regions; the eastern region reports foci in six municipalities: Benghazi, Qaminis, Suluk, Tukrah, Marj, and Al Bayda. Hatim Al-Maslati, head of the National Center for Veterinary Health Surveillance and Rapid Response, says reports are rising but the disease remains under control and not at epidemic level, urging breeders and traders to strictly follow biosecurity. The first cases were reported on May 5, 2026 in Tajoura; since then further cases have appeared in Tajoura, Ain Zara, Misrata, Msallata, and Zawiya, with ongoing sampling and routine spraying/disinfection of affected stalls.

triage.headline_ja: アル・アサ地区で口蹄疫の疑い症例
triage.triage_reason: 本事案はリビア国内の羊における口蹄疫（動物疾病）であり、対象国（フィリピン等）は発生地域リストに含まれるものの記事本文では言及されておらず、対象国での発生は確認できない。
triage.notes: 本疾患は動物（羊）における口蹄疫であり、ヒトへの直接感染性はない。発生国はリビアであり、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンが発生地域データに含まれているが記事本文には一切登場せず、Bluedotの地域付与誤りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie pourrait devenir la pire jamais enregistrée, alerte le Washington Post - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak could become the worst ever recorded, the Washington Post warns - Cameroun24.net news updates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo since mid-May could become the worst on record. As of 27 August 2026, the Congolese Ministry of Health reports 5,584 confirmed cases and 2,680 deaths, though health workers say the true toll may be higher due to limited access in remote areas. The surge is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, first identified in 2007 in western Uganda; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, unlike the Zaire strain. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids; early symptoms include fever, vomiting, headaches and sore throat, with progression to kidney and liver damage and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. Recovery efforts are hampered by cuts to international funding and fatigue toward precautions, as weddings, large gatherings and crowded churches fuel spread. WHO rules automatically designate an epicenter when a single case is detected in a country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:流行は史上最悪になる可能性があるとワシントン・ポストが警告
triage.triage_reason: 5,584例・2,680人死亡（致死率約48%）と非常に深刻で、ワクチンのないBundibugyo株による異例の大規模流行であり、国際的な資金不足や社会的拡大要因（集会・教会）から国際支援が必要とされるため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: ウガンダは2007年にBundibugyo株が初めて特定された地として言及されているのみで、現在の流行地はDRC東部であるため、ウガンダはverified_locationsに含めていない（対象国リストにも含まれない）。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱又來了！一家3人確診 今年本土病例全在這
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is back! A family of three diagnosed. All of this year's locally transmitted cases are here.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Kaohsiung: a family cluster of three in Gangshan District, all locally transmitted this year. The index case, a man in his 60s, developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia and nausea on Aug 26 and tested positive for dengue virus serotype 2; two co-residents also diagnosed with dengue type 2. All three are hospitalized. None had international travel history; infections centered around the home, prompting expanded epidemiological investigations and intensified vector control around the neighborhood, including density surveys and elimination of breeding sites. Nationally, Taiwan has 145 confirmed dengue cases this year, with 10 local cases—all in Kaohsiung—while 135 are imported. Most imported infections come from Vietnam (28), followed by Indonesia (27) and the Maldives (16). Public health guidance emphasizes eliminating standing water, routine surveillance after heavy rains, wearing light-colored long-sleeved clothing, and using repellents containing DEET, picaridin, or IR3535.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱また発生！家族3人が確診 今年の本土病例はすべてここに
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄における登革熱の家族内クラスター（国内感染）であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれず、ベトナム・インドネシアは輸入例の感染源として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、対象国での発生とは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾（高雄市岡山区）における登革熱の家族内クラスター報告。ベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入感染例の感染源国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないため対象国に含めない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。

article.articleHeadline: Manipur Fever Outbreak: Dengue, Typhoid and Scrub Typhus Cases Surge Among Children
article.articleSummary: In Manipur, dengue, typhoid and scrub typhus cases among children are surging, placing hospitals under pressure. Government hospitals in the town report a rising number of pediatric admissions, with the District Hospital’s children’s ward unable to accommodate all requiring admission. To cope, authorities are considering using other wards, including orthopaedic and surgical, to treat fever- and illness-affected children. The report highlights an ongoing outbreak pattern among youngsters but does not specify case counts or fatalities. There is no information on laboratory confirmation or infection sources in the article. The development underscores acute strain on public health facilities and the need for rapid triage and resource reallocation as of 27 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: マニプールでの発熱アウトブレイク：子どもたちの間でデング熱、腸チフス、ツツガムシ病が急増
triage.triage_reason: インド・マニプール州で小児を中心にデング熱・腸チフス・ツツガムシ病が同時に急増し、病院の収容能力を圧迫している。重症度・流行しやすさの観点でWPRO基準に複数該当し、政府機関（病院）の対応強化検討という関心の高まりも見られるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 3つの熱性疾患（デング熱、腸チフス、ツツガムシ病）が同時流行しており、症例数・死亡者数・検査確定状況は不明。季節性の媒介動物感染症/水系感染症の重複流行と考えられ、国際的拡大リスクは低いが地域医療体制への負荷が懸念される。続報でのケース数・重症度データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: What Makes H1N1 Flu In 2025 Different? Unique Symptoms Of Swine Flu And How Long The Infection Lasts
article.articleSummary: Swine flu, H1N1, resurging in 2026 with India reporting over 2,400 cases as of August 26, 2026. The virus is not new; seasonal influenza dynamics, crowded indoor environments, and poor ventilation drive spread. No single symptom confirms H1N1; symptoms resemble other influenza and include fever with chills, dry cough, sore throat, headaches, muscle aches, fatigue, runny or blocked nose, with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea in children. Cases can appear abruptly; diagnosis requires clinical assessment and testing. Recovery typically begins within a few days for healthy individuals, but cough and fatigue may linger for weeks, prolonging recovery. Higher risk groups include older adults, young children, pregnant women, and those with underlying conditions. Emphasize early evaluation and testing for persistent or severe illness; awareness reflects seasonal activity, not a new virus.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年のH1N1インフルエンザが違う理由とは？豚インフルエンザの特徴的な症状と感染期間について
triage.triage_reason: インドでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例が2400件超と報告されているが、記事自体は症状解説を目的とした一般啓発記事であり、異常性や重篤性の明確な記述がなく、社会的関心の高まりも不明であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性H1N1インフルエンザの症状解説を目的とした啓発記事であり、新規性のあるアウトブレイクではないと明記されている。インドでの症例数（2400件超）は言及されているが、重症度や医療体制への影響、社会的関心度についての詳細情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi H1N1 surge: 166 new cases push swine flu tally to 2,612
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (swine flu) surge in Delhi, India: the capital’s H1N1 tally rose to 2,612 after 166 fresh cases in the last 24 hours, while total Influenza-A infections climbed to 3,300. The daily rise follows 138 new H1N1 cases and 3,177 Influenza-A total on the previous day. Health minister Pankaj Kumar Singh visited Indira Gandhi Hospital to review flu-management arrangements, including isolation beds, emergency services, testing infrastructure, medicines, and staffing. A dedicated flu clinic and isolation beds have been established at the hospital; ministers ordered hospitals to maintain at least five isolation beds, with larger facilities keeping 10 or more, and to run shift-wise duty rosters with 24/7 staffing. Experts note H1N1 now dominates over H3N2 in Delhi, likely aided by monsoon humidity and increased fever-clinic footfall. Individuals with high fever lasting >2–3 days, breathlessness, chest pain, or persistent cough should get tested; avoid self-medication.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi's H1N1 tally hits 2,612 with 166 new cases as minister reviews hospital readiness
article.articleSummary: Delhi reported 166 fresh H1N1 cases in the last 24 hours, taking the cumulative swine flu tally to 2,612, while Influenza-A cases rose to 3,300. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh visited Indira Gandhi Hospital to review flu readiness, including isolation facilities, emergency services, testing infrastructure, medicines, and staffing. A dedicated flu clinic has been made operational, with isolated beds for influenza patients. The government directed hospitals to maintain at least five isolation beds, with larger hospitals keeping 10 or more, plus shift-wise rosters and round-the-clock staffing. Dr Mohit Bhardwaj said H1N1 is now the dominant influenza strain, with monsoon humidity aiding transmission and overlapping symptoms with dengue, COVID-19, and the common cold, requiring testing for differentiation. People with high fever lasting more than two to three days, breathlessness, chest pain, or persistent cough should get tested promptly. As of 27 August 2026, Delhi continues to face rising influenza activity during the monsoon.

triage.triage_reason: デリーでのH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例数増加は例年のモンスーン期に見られる傾向であり、異常性や重篤性の明確な報告はないが、症例数増加と医療体制強化の動きがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の症例増加報道であり、モンスーン期の例年パターンに合致。重症例・死亡例の具体的データはなく、政府が病院の隔離病床整備等で対応中のため管理可能と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : neuf patients guéris quittent le Centre de traitement Ebola de Rwankole - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Nine recovered patients leave the Ebola Treatment Center in Rwankole - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola survivors have left the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) in Rwankole, Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the National Institute of Public Health. The nine recovered patients, part of the response to the 17th Ebola outbreak, underscore the importance of early, appropriate care. The discharge comes eighteen days after the center's inauguration to strengthen regional medical management. Incident Manager Prof. Steve Ahuka and Dr. Cagod Inkale praised the survivors and urged rapid care-seeking for suspected cases. Upon discharge, the nine recipients received dignity kits—mattresses, blankets, suitcases, fabrics, and hydroalcoholic gel—to support reintegration. The announcements reflect ongoing surveillance, community outreach, and continued case management as Ituri intensifies its Ebola response in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：回復した患者9名がルワンコレのエボラ治療センターを退所 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱流行に関する続報であり、エボラという疾患自体が国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性・渡航制限リスクを内包するため、IHR基準を複数満たすと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事内容自体は治癒退院という良好な進展を報じているが、背景にある第17次エボラ流行そのものはIHR基準を満たす重大イベントであり、継続的なモニタリング・RRA対象として扱うべきと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Kwango : l'eau potable, solution pour éliminer définitivement le choléra à Popokabaka (médecin chef de zone) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwango: Drinking water, a solution to permanently eliminate cholera in Popokabaka (zone medical officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Popokabaka Health Zone, Kwango, Democratic Republic of Congo, is being contained largely through safe drinking water. Dr. Alain Mboko, zone medical chief, says eliminating cholera requires providing potable water, noting the epidemic stems from use of unsafe water due to the absence of a clean-water production unit. He appeals to the central government, provincial authorities, and international partners to rehabilitate the water production point that formerly served Popokabaka. MSF support has improved patient management and community education, with local staff trained for structured care. Since the outset, 864 patients have been treated in Popokabaka, with cure rate about 97% and case-fatality down from 18.7% in June (week 27) to 2%. Innocent Burundi of MSF describes faults at the Nkoti river intake—deviation, sand in the decanter, and a corroded galvanized steel main—recommending polyethylene piping, cleaning intake boxes, and protection; work will take time but will restore water access.

triage.headline_ja: クワンゴ州：飲料水はポポカバカのコレラを完全に排除する解決策（ゾーン医療責任者）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCコンゴのポポカバカ地区で継続中のコレラ流行に関する続報。致死率は18.7%から2%へ改善しMSF支援下で管理されつつあるが、水インフラ問題が未解決で曝露継続のリスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクであり新規性は低いが、安全な水インフラの欠如という構造的リスク要因が残存しており、国際支援要請（水生産設備の復旧）も明記されている。致死率改善という好材料もあるため、フルRRAではなく続報監視が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 又是高雄！登革熱再增3本土病例 岡山1家3口群聚感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Again! Dengue Fever Adds 3 More Local Cases; One Gangshan Family of Three Infected in a Cluster
article.articleSummary: Three locally acquired dengue cases in Kaohsiung City, forming a family cluster in Gangshan District. The index case—a man in his 60s—developed fever, muscle and joint pains and nausea; dengue virus type 2 confirmed. Five residents in the same home; two additional infections confirmed, also type 2. All three cases are hospitalized with no overseas travel history; exposure linked to residence area. Nationally in 2026, 145 dengue cases to date: 10 locally transmitted, all in Kaohsiung; 135 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27) and the Maldives (16). Authorities expanded epidemiological investigation and emergency vector control around the residence, intensified mosquito density surveillance, breeding-source cleanup, and health education; residents urged to follow 'patrol, drain, clean, scrub' and re-inspect after rain to lower vector density. Guidance: wear light-colored long sleeves and use approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535). Seek care for fever and tell travel history.

triage.headline_ja: またも高雄！デング熱さらに3例の本土病例、岡山区で1家族3人がクラスター感染
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市におけるデング熱の家族内クラスター発生であり、本土感染例が拡大しているが、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生ではないため直接のPICKUP対象外。ベトナム・インドネシア等からの輸入例言及があるが主題は台湾国内感染。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（高雄市）における国内デング熱クラスター発生。ベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入例の出身国として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため対象国リストからは除外。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sobe para 26 o número de casos de sarampo confirmados em SP | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed measles cases in São Paulo rises to 26 | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 27, 2026, the São Paulo State Health Secretariat reports 26 confirmed measles cases in 2026, with 23 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Three new cases were recorded on Aug 26 in the capital: a boy and a girl under 1 year old, and a 30-year-old woman; health status of patients not disclosed. Nineteen patients were unvaccinated or incompletely immunized. Vaccination coverage is being expanded across 645 municipalities through Sept 1 to update vaccination records for children and adolescents up to 15 years. In the three most affected cities, vaccination is reinforced for people 6 months to 59 years. A zero-dose is available for 6–11 months but does not replace the first dose at 12 months or the second at 15 months. Symptoms include red rash and fever >38.5°C, plus cough, red eyes, and malaise, appearing 3–5 days after infection. Measles is airborne, potentially infecting up to 90% of close, unvaccinated contacts.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹確定患者数が26人に増加 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン未接種者を中心にサンパウロ州で麻疹の感染が継続しており、行政による大規模な予防接種強化策とメディアの報道が確認されるため、経過を精査する必要がある。
triage.notes: 26例中19例が未接種または不完全接種であり、感染力の高い麻疹の地域内拡大が懸念される。州衛生局が645自治体でワクチン接種記録の更新を実施中。重症度や国際的拡大に関する情報は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza cases surge among Chennai schoolchildren
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases are surging among schoolchildren in Chennai, with July–August seeing a substantial rise and transmission spreading from children to other family members. Doctors report more cases this year than last, with infections typically peaking from September through March, but this year beginning in July. Clinicians note high fever (103–104°F), severe headache, body pains, fatigue, cough, and respiratory symptoms; influenza can progress to viral pneumonia requiring hospitalization in severe cases, unlike the milder common cold. Vulnerable groups include infants under one year and children with heart disease, asthma, or other respiratory conditions. Mild cases may not be tested; emphasis on monitoring fever, malaise, respiratory symptoms, and oxygen saturation if breathing difficulty develops. Preventive measures include annual flu vaccination; children up to nine may need two doses in the first year, followed by yearly doses. When ill, children should stay home and families should avoid sharing food or drinks.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイの学童でインフルエンザ症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行時期の前倒し・増加が報告されているが、重篤性や国際的拡大の懸念は限定的で、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 通常9月〜3月に流行するインフルエンザが今年は7月から早期に増加している点が異常だが、重症度・死亡例の報告はなく、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内。続報で重症化や地域拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: নেপালে হড়পা বানের পর নতুন বিপদ! দূষিত জলে বাড়ছে সংক্রমণের আশঙ্কা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New danger after Nepal's flash floods! Risk of infection rising in polluted water.
article.articleSummary: Nepal faces rising infection risk after a devastating flood on the Nepal–Tibet border triggered by a Himalayan glacier burst, inundating large areas, destroying homes and infrastructure. Floodwaters carry human and animal waste, sewage, contaminants, chemicals, and debris, threatening drinking water and sanitation systems and heightening risk of diarrheal diseases, vomiting, abdominal pain, typhoid, and hepatitis A, plus skin infections. Leptospirosis can arise from contaminated floodwater and animal urine; tetanus risk exists with injuries, especially if vaccination is not current. Preventive measures include avoiding floodwater, wearing waterproof boots and protective clothing, and shielding children. Use safe drinking water—bottled, boiled, or properly treated—for drinking, cooking, and brushing teeth; avoid contaminated foods. Clean wounds with soap and water and seek medical care for redness, swelling, pain, or pus. Maintain hand hygiene; ensure tetanus vaccination. Even after waters recede, safe water and sanitation remain critical.

triage.headline_ja: ネパールで鉄砲水後の新たな危険！汚染水により感染症のリスクが高まる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はネパール・チベット国境での氷河決壊による洪水後の感染症リスクに関する予防的注意喚起であり、実際の患者発生報告はなく、対象国（中国等）が主題となっていないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はネパールにおける洪水後の感染症リスク（腸チフス、A型肝炎、レプトスピラ症、破傷風）に関する予防的アドバイスであり、実際の感染症発生事例は報告されていない。チベット自治区（中国）は洪水発生地点として言及されているのみで、感染症リスクの主題国はネパールであり、対象国リストには含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Poplavljene ulice su izvor 3 opake bolesti: Prljava voda može da napravi haos u organizmu, ovo je bitno uraditi da bi se sprečila zaraza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flooded streets are the source of three deadly diseases: dirty water can wreak havoc in the body; this is what you should do to prevent infection.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 27, 2026, floods in Nepal and China have claimed hundreds of lives and left streets, homes, and vehicles inundated. Contaminated floodwater often contains fecal waste, increasing risk of gastrointestinal infections and other diseases. Prolonged contact with polluted water elevates the risk of leptospirosis, causing fever, headache, muscle and back pain, and sometimes jaundice or bleeding; symptoms can appear days to weeks after exposure, especially with skin breaks. Floodwaters also promote mosquito breeding, enabling West Nile fever transmission; symptoms typically arise 3–14 days after an infected bite and can include fever, headache, nausea, swollen lymph nodes, rash, and, in rare cases, neurological signs. Flooding can raise hepatitis A risk via fecal-oral transmission; most patients recover fully as this virus does not become chronic. Prevention: avoid touching the face with dirty hands, wash hands after returning home, shower, and disinfect items and footwear that contacted floodwater.

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱家庭群聚！ 高雄岡山60多歲男先發病 同住者再揪出2例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever family cluster! In Gangshan District, Kaohsiung, a man in his 60s was the first to fall ill, and two more cases were identified among cohabitants.
article.articleSummary: Three locally acquired dengue fever cases in Gangshan District, Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, form a family cluster: a man in his 60s was the index case, with two cohabitants also infected; all three have dengue virus type 2 and are hospitalized. No travel abroad was reported. Nationwide, Taiwan has 145 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 to date, including 10 indigenous cases all in Kaohsiung, and 135 imported cases from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), and the Maldives (16). Transmission is likely boosted by heavy rainfall creating mosquito breeding sites around homes, such as flowerpot trays, discarded containers, canvas, and drainage. Health authorities are conducting community investigations, vector-density surveys, and emergency control around affected residences. Preventive measures include wearing light clothing, using approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535), eliminating standing water, and seeking prompt medical care for fever, headache, muscle or joint pain, or rash, with travel history noted.

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान: 'मंत्री बाहर, करीबी अंदर'... किरोड़ीलाल मीणा को स्वाइन फ्लू, SMS अस्पताल में हेल्थ मिनिस्टर को मिलने से रोका
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan: 'Minister out, close aide in'... Kirodilal Meena contracted swine flu, blocked from meeting the Health Minister at SMS Hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Rajasthan reports more than 129 swine flu (H1N1 influenza) cases, with Sawai Man Singh Hospital in Jaipur on alert. Cabinet minister Kiroridal Meena has tested positive and is hospitalised at SMS Hospital; doctors warn visitors about infection risk. Controversy follows after some close aides were reportedly allowed inside the hospital to meet Meena and take photos, prompting scrutiny of swine flu protocols. When Medical Minister Gajendra Singh Khimsar arrived to check on him, doctors refused entry due to infection risk. Health officials, including Additional Director Dr. Narottam Sharma, said meeting a swine flu patient is not allowed and that any breach constitutes protocol violation; he did not know who authorized interior access. SMS Hospital Superintendent Dr. Mrunal Joshi did not comment. The hospital has reserved ICU beds for severe cases and is monitoring another swine flu patient besides Meena.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州：『大臣は外、近しい者は中へ』…キロリラル・ミーナ氏が豚インフルエンザに感染、SMS病院で保健大臣の面会が阻止される

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : malgré Ebola, la rentrée scolaire du 1er septembre est maintenue, les écoles passent en mode prévention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: despite Ebola, the start of the school year on September 1 is maintained, schools switch to prevention mode.
article.articleSummary: Despite the ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Bunia and surrounding areas will open the 2026-2027 school year on September 1, 2026, with reinforced prevention measures. Schools will serve as frontline prevention centers, backed by the Ebola response Incident Management unit and STAR-RDC support. Over two days, 50 inspectors, education officials and representatives from private and parent groups were trained, bringing the total to about 150 trainers to be deployed across Ituri 2 and Ituri 3 divisions. The program aims to equip headteachers, teachers, and parent committees to identify risky behaviors, implement handwashing and barrier measures, and deliver school-based prevention messaging to students and families. ANAPECO and ASONEPA members are included in the initiative. The objective is to maintain education continuity while strengthening public health protection and outbreak vigilance as the province remains concerned about Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：エボラ流行下でも9月1日の新学期は維持、学校は予防モードへ移行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行に関する記事であり、エボラは致死率が高く国際的関心の高い疾患であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: La rentrée scolaire maintenue au 1er septembre malgré l'épidémie d'Ebola en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The school year begins on September 1 despite the Ebola outbreak in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ituri province will begin the 2026-2027 school year on September 1, 2026, despite the persistent Ebola virus disease outbreak. The decision was confirmed August 26 in Kinshasa by Yvon Muke Abwasele, director of Ituri I education province. To mitigate transmission risks, provincial education authorities have mobilized prevention and distance-learning measures: staff training sessions, awareness campaigns, barrier measures in schools, and ready-to-use kits and exercise books for remote instruction, which can be activated in a school experiencing a resurgence. Parents on the ground express financial constraints and fears of pupil exposure, urging authorities to bolster sanitary arrangements across all schools to ensure protection from day one. This article is dated 2026-08-27.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：イツリ州のエボラ流行下でも新学期は9月1日に開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、学校再開という社会的関心の高い事象と結びついている。IHR基準の複数該当が想定されフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイツリ州における既存のエボラ流行と学校再開に関する行政対応を報じている。感染者数や死亡者数など疫学的詳細は本文に記載なく、流行の規模・拡大状況は不明。既存流行のフォローアップとしてRRA更新が望まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Egyptian pharmaceutical firm developing Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak continues to expand, with over 5,600 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Minapharm, an Egyptian firm, in collaboration with ProBioGen, designs a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine and will receive up to $16.5 million from CEPI to push it from laboratory stages into a Phase 1 trial in Africa. The candidate uses the MVA platform and aims to induce both B- and T-cell responses for durable protection. CEPI is funding four other Bundibugyo vaccines—Moderna (mRNA), Oxford/Serum Institute (ChAdOx), Hilleman, and Public Health Vaccines (both rVSV)—in addition to Minapharm’s, seeking at least two that could reach WHO prequalification. The WHO has called for a full-scale human trial of Ervebo (Zaire strain) to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo. There are no specific vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo yet.

triage.headline_ja: エジプトの製薬会社がエボラワクチンを開発中
triage.triage_reason: 背景として言及されているDRCのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が5,600例以上・死亡2,700例以上に達し拡大継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事本文はエジプト企業によるワクチン開発に関する内容だが、背景として述べられているDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が本質的なシグナル。エジプトは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。死亡率約48%と非常に高く、CEPIやWHOなど国際的な支援・関与が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda declares Ebola outbreak over after 42 days without new case
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak ended after 42 consecutive days without a new confirmed case, following the discharge of the last patient on July 16, 2026. Declared May 15, 2026, the outbreak involved 20 confirmed cases - 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 5 locally acquired among contacts and health workers linked to imported cases. Eighteen patients recovered; two deaths were recorded. More than 800 contacts were identified and monitored. The end of local transmission was declared on July 28, with an additional 42-day monitoring period completed to rule out missed transmission chains. Africa CDC and WHO praised Uganda's rapid response, stressing decisive leadership and strong surveillance, while warning that imported cases remain risks due to cross-border movement. No travel restrictions advised; continued joint readiness with DRC remains a priority.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、42日間新規感染者なしでエボラ出血熱の流行終息を宣言

triage.notes: 本記事はウガンダでのエボラ流行終息を報告するもので、DRCは輸入例の起源として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での現在の発生を示す記述はないためverified_locationsには含めない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS declara Uganda livre de Ebola, mas casos avançam na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Uganda Ebola-Free, but Cases Rise in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in Uganda over after a 42-day period with no new transmissions. Uganda recorded 20 infections and 2 deaths; the last confirmed case was June 21, and the final patient exited the Mulago National Isolation Centre on July 16. Uganda’s Ministry of Health declared the local end of the emergency on July 28. The WHO signaled closure after the 42-day monitoring window, though the Ugandan government had already considered transmission halted on July 28. The article also notes ongoing regional concern, with Ebola cases rising in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

article.articleHeadline: 高雄雨後爆發登革熱家庭群聚！ 岡山一家六口3確診、全住院中 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak in a family cluster after rain in Kaohsiung! In Gangshan District, a family of six, three diagnosed, all hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: On 27 August 2026, Kaohsiung City’s Gangshan District reports a locally transmitted dengue fever outbreak in a six-person household, with three members diagnosed and hospitalized. Contact tracing shows no recent international travel among the cases, indicating domestic transmission near the residence. Public health workers expanded investigations and conducted emergency vector control around the home after identifying three mosquito breeding sources in the premises—flower pots, pot stands, and a shrine vase—harboring larvae. Nationally this year, Taiwan has 145 confirmed dengue cases, including 10 local cases all in Kaohsiung, with 135 imported cases from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), Maldives (16), and others. Authorities urge residents to follow the “inspect, dump, clean, scrub” measures and re-inspect after rain to reduce mosquito density.

article.articleHeadline: Regional External Update #39 West and Central Africa Region - Eastern DRC Situation - July 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues within a broader displacement crisis driven by persistent conflict. Internal displacement remains high, with cross-border movements accumulating to more than 16,400 Congolese arrivals since January 2026. The outbreak has so far recorded over 5,600 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths, more than three months after the outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern. Uganda declared itself Ebola-free on 28 July 2026, but cross-border preparedness remains critical. UNHCR continues supporting the Government-led response in displacement settings despite significant funding challenges. The situation highlights the overlap of insecurity, displacement, and weak basic services, which complicates outbreak response and health service delivery in the region.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cluster erupts in a Kaohsiung family of three; fined NT$6,000 for breeding mosquitoes at home, alert zone revealed.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 27, 2026, Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, reports a dengue fever cluster in Gangshan District involving three household members, all infected with Dengue Virus Type 2. The 65-year-old index patient developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia, and nausea; NS1 rapid test was positive at presentation, and subsequent testing confirmed Type 2 in all three cases, who are hospitalized. Investigations found three domestic breeding sources at home—flower pot saucers and a shrine vase—with standing water containing larvae, resulting in a NT$6,000 fine. A 400-meter protection zone around Bi-Hong Li and Zhu-wei Li was established, with intensified inspection, larval source reduction, indoor spraying, and expanded testing. National data show 145 dengue cases in 2026, including 10 locally acquired cases all in Kaohsiung; 135 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), and Maldives (16).

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la rentrée scolaire maintenue avec le renforcement des mesures barrières contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Back-to-school kept on track with strengthened barrier measures against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: 27 August 2026 — Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, back-to-school continues with strengthened barrier measures against Ebola. ACP notes schools remain open while enhanced health controls are implemented as part of Ebola preparedness in the region. The report emphasizes ongoing public health protections to safeguard education during the Ebola context and highlights the DRC's commitment to preventing transmission in school settings. The article also provides background on ACP: founded in 1960 as the national press agency, later renamed Agence Zaïre Presse (AZAP) during the Zaïre era, and dedicated to reliable, rapid reporting and to fighting misinformation via its fact-checking service. No Ebola case counts or outbreak details are given in the piece.

article.articleHeadline: WHO Nyatakan Wabah Ebola Uganda Resmi Berakhir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola Outbreak in Uganda Officially Over
article.articleSummary: As of August 26, 2026, the World Health Organization officially declared the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in Uganda to be over, following weeks of intensive surveillance and monitoring in the affected region. The report does not provide specific case or death counts or laboratory confirmation details within Uganda. While the immediate threat in Uganda has subsided, neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo is reportedly experiencing a surge in severe infections, prompting renewed concern about regional transmission. International authorities emphasize the need for reinforced cross-border containment, surveillance cooperation, and risk communication to prevent further spread across borders. The update highlights sustained public health vigilance and coordination but does not include additional information on infection sources, imported or exported cases, or vaccination-related measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行の終息を正式に宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行終息は朗報だが、隣国コンゴ民主共和国（対象国）で重症感染例が急増しているとの報告があり、越境拡大への懸念が高まっているためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: CEPI backs Minapharm's experimental Ebola vaccine with up to $16.5 million funding
article.articleSummary: CEPI will provide up to $16.5 million to Egypt-based Minapharm Group to advance an experimental Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine into human trials in Africa, targeting the Democratic Republic of Congo's outbreak, described as the country’s largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak. The funding supports laboratory work and an early-stage clinical trial to assess safety and immune response. The candidate, designed by Minapharm’s Berlin-based unit ProBioGen, uses its MVA-CR19 platform—a weakened virus that cannot replicate in human cells—to induce antibody production and activate cytotoxic immune cells. CEPI aims to advance at least two Bundibugyo vaccines toward emergency authorization and WHO approval. ProBioGen will manufacture the active ingredient in Germany, with Minapharm handling fill-and-finish in Cairo; the plan is to move the entire process to Egypt. If the initial trial succeeds, larger studies and emergency authorization would follow.

article.articleHeadline: Distan Mataram vaksinasi 87 ekor anjing untuk cegah rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mataram Department of Agriculture vaccinates 87 dogs to prevent rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Mataram City, West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia targets semi-wild dogs to curb zoonotic transmission. By August 27, 2026, the city’s Department of Agriculture vaccinated 87 dogs across three neighborhoods: Mataram Barat (32), Karang Taliwang (24), and Cilinaya (31). Vaccination began August 25, with plans to vaccinate in Cakra Timur on September 1; vaccinations on August 28 and August 31 were canceled to prepare for the city’s 33rd anniversary on August 31. About 12 personnel, including veterinarians, medical staff, and field workers, are involved. Doses are prepared as needed with no reported refusals, and community support has been positive. The program targets 100 dogs across four kelurahan; current count may exceed. No dog bites were reported January–July 2026, and Mataram currently has zero rabies cases, underscoring ongoing vigilance.

article.articleHeadline: 166 Fresh H1N1 Cases, Tally Rises To 2,612 in Delhi
article.articleSummary: 166 fresh H1N1 cases in Delhi in the last 24 hours raise the cumulative swine flu tally to 2,612, with Influenza-A at 3,300 (from 3,177). Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh visited Indira Gandhi Hospital to review preparedness for rising H1N1 and seasonal influenza, examining isolation facilities, emergency services, testing infrastructure, medicines, and staff deployment. A dedicated flu clinic has been made operational at the hospital, with isolated beds for influenza patients. The visit followed directives to strengthen emergency services and ensure adequate isolation beds, doctors, testing facilities, medicines, and other essential resources across Delhi government hospitals to manage the surge.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1新規感染166件、累計2,612件に増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例数増加と行政対応が報告されているが、重症度や死亡者数など深刻性を示す情報が不足しており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクも認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デリーでの季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例増加に対し、保健当局が病院の対応能力（隔離病床、検査体制等）を強化する動きが報告されている。毎年発生する季節性の流行である可能性が高く、重症度・死亡者数等の具体的な深刻性を示す情報は記事内に含まれていない。
