article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Hospitals Report Rise In Viral Fevers Amid Monsoon; Doctors Warn Against Self-Medicating With Antibiotics
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad: Kamineni Hospitals report a rise in outpatient visits for viral fevers, influenza-like illnesses (ILI) and acute febrile conditions at LB Nagar and King Koti amid monsoon humidity. Clinicians warn against indiscriminate antibiotic use and urge laboratory testing for fevers lasting beyond 72 hours. In Hyderabad, dengue numbers have declined: 266 dengue cases (including 127 laboratory-confirmed) from January to mid-July 2026, versus 570 in 2025 and 821 in 2024. National trends remain concerning, with more than 33,000 dengue cases and over 9,000 H1N1 cases reported across India so far in 2026, and influenza cases up 11% compared with July 2025. Dr. M. Swamy, Head of Department at Kamineni, cautions that lower local dengue should not breed complacency, as seasonal fevers, H1N1 and dengue can present similarly in the first 48 hours. Fever lasting more than three days warrants blood tests.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードの病院がモンスーン時期にウイルス性発熱の増加を報告；医師は抗生物質の自己判断使用に警告
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季節に典型的な発熱性疾患（デング熱、インフルエンザ様疾患）の増加を報じる定例的な医療アドバイザリー記事であり、ハイデラバードでのデング熱は前年比で減少している。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はハイデラバードで前年・前々年より減少傾向。国全体ではデング熱・H1N1・インフルエンザの季節的増加が見られるが、これは例年のモンスーン時期の典型的パターンであり、特異な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo receives more than 16,000 doses of Ebola vaccine as it grapples with unprecedented outbreak - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's current Ebola outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with 5,290 confirmed cases and 2,516 deaths reported as of Friday. N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa received 16,250 vaccine doses, part of 70,000 doses expected from WHO and partners this week; more doses are expected early next week. The Ervebo vaccine, licensed to treat Ebola and effective in past outbreaks, may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, though no specific approved vaccine or treatment exists for this strain. The outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented rate and is on track to surpass the deadliest West Africa outbreak (2014–2016), which killed over 11,000. Africa CDC data suggest transmission could reach three times its current rate. Containment is hampered by armed conflict with rebel groups, attacks on medical personnel and facilities, a transient labor population, displacement, and weak infrastructure in the region, complicating response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、前例のない規模のエボラ流行に対応するためエボラワクチン16,000回分以上を受領
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例5,290、死者2,516名という前例のない規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、武力衝突により対応が難航しており、国際的な支援（WHOからのワクチン供給）が行われている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー上ではDRCのみが流行地として言及されているため除外した。武力衝突・医療従事者への攻撃・人口移動により拡大リスクが高く、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Balangan Sasar 31 Lokus untuk Skrining Tuberkulosis, Upaya Putus Rantai Penularan Hingga Desa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balangan Health Office Targets 31 Locations for Tuberculosis Screening, An Effort to Break the Transmission Chain Down to the Village Level.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis screening campaign in Balangan Regency, South Kalimantan, Indonesia targets 31 locations, with 100 residents per locus, under the national Health Ministry program funded by APBN. Selection prioritizes areas with a history of TB; participants include household and close contacts of TB patients and high-risk individuals such as those with diabetes, the elderly, children, and smokers. The activity, conducted in Desa Nungka (Awayan District) on 27 August 2026, is integrated with free health checks. Sputum testing using Molecule Rapid Test (TCM) is available at all Balangan Puskesmas; one TB case has been confirmed and started on intensive treatment. If results are negative but symptoms persist, patients are referred for X-ray. Officials hope comprehensive screening and preventive therapy will help Balangan reach TB elimination by 2030 and interrupt transmission at the village level.

triage.headline_ja: バランガン保健局、結核スクリーニングで31拠点を対象に、村レベルまで感染連鎖を断つ取り組み
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラム（スクリーニング・予防治療）の実施報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 国家プログラムによる定期的な結核スクリーニング活動の報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: English news channels have Rahul Gandhi. Hindi media has onions, schools and swine flu
article.articleSummary: Swine flu spreading to six states and an eightfold rise in Delhi dominate Hindi media, with Amar Ujala warning of spread and Hindustan reporting on swine-flu wards in Delhi government hospitals. Hindi newspapers foreground education and local concerns—Hindustan’s front page on 'We expected more from government schools' and Rajasthan Patrika's Gen Z Jantar Mantar moments across Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, Maharashtra, Karnataka; Barwani, Madhya Pradesh, schools where pupils walked 15 km to the district collector. Dainik Jagran highlights onion prices at Rs 50–60 per kilogram. On TV, News18 India and NDTV India cover local issues; English channels chase national/international stories, including Rahul Gandhi, Kangana Ranaut, and Delhi protests, with minimal attention to price spikes. The piece notes this disparity: Hindi media emphasizes local issues and public services, while English media pursues broader political narratives for urban audiences. Published 2026-08-27.

triage.triage_reason: インドで豚インフルエンザが6州に拡大しデリーで8倍増という情報があるが、記事はメディア報道の比較論評が主題であり、症例数・重症度・対応状況等の具体的な疫学情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドのメディア報道傾向を分析する論評記事であり、豚インフルエンザの拡大（6州、デリーで8倍増）は言及されているものの、症例数・死亡者数・重症度等の直接的な疫学データは記載されていない。続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू से निपटने के लिए डीडीयू अस्पताल तैयार, 24 घंटे फीवर क्लिनिक शुरू; जानें बचाव के उपाय - ddu hospital alert on swine flu 247 fever clinic in delhi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Hospital ready to tackle swine flu, 24-hour fever clinic starts in Delhi; learn the preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: West Delhi's Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Hospital in Hari Nagar has set up a 24-hour fever clinic with 10 beds to address rising swine flu (H1N1) cases. The facility is fully equipped with ventilators, patient monitors, blood pressure machines, oxygen cylinders, and a stock of H1N1 medications. Only patients with severe symptoms—fever, cough, and breathing difficulty—are tested for H1N1; those with ordinary fever or cold receive standard treatment. A recent swine flu patient who was admitted elsewhere was referred to DDU Hospital and discharged after successful treatment. Preventive guidance during seasonal changes includes handwashing for at least 20 seconds, wearing masks in crowded places, covering the nose and mouth when coughing or sneezing, staying hydrated, rest, and consulting a doctor promptly for fever, cough, or sore throat.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（既知の疾患）への通常の医療対応であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報もない。

article.articleHeadline: Zone de santé de Pinga : après deux reports, la campagne de vaccination contre la polio, la rougeole et la rubéole enfin lancée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pinga Health Zone: after two postponements, the vaccination campaign against polio, measles, and rubella finally launched.
article.articleSummary: Polio, measles, and rubella vaccination campaign launched on 27 August 2026 in Pinga Health Zone, Walikale Territory, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after two postponements due to logistical constraints. Vaccination supplies, previously blocked at Walikale-centre, arrived in Pinga, enabling the campaign. Interim Health Zone Chief Dr Théophile Muka notes that more than 45,000 children aged 0–14 are targeted. Over five days, vaccination teams will operate to protect children against these three vaccine-preventable diseases. Dr Muka appeals to parents and guardians to seize the opportunity and have their children vaccinated. The campaign occurs amid ongoing health-service access challenges in Walikale, driven by difficulties in delivering medical products and inputs.

triage.headline_ja: ピンガ保健圏:2度の延期を経て、ポリオ・麻疹・風疹予防接種キャンペーンがついに開始
triage.triage_reason: 予防接種キャンペーンの開始という対応活動の報告であり、新規感染症発生や患者増加を示す情報はないが、紛争地域における医療アクセス課題を背景としたワクチン接種可能疾患のリスクは経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、具体的な感染症の発生・症例数の情報は含まれていない。物流問題によりキャンペーンが2度延期されたことは、当地域における医療アクセスの脆弱性を示しており、ポリオ・麻疹・風疹の流行リスクという観点から今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Université de Bunia bascule vers la visioconférence pour limiter les contaminations - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Bunia University shifts to videoconferencing to limit transmissions - ACP
article.articleSummary: During an Ebola outbreak in Ituri's Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Bunia University (UNIBU) suspended in-person lectures for cohorts larger than 50 students and shifted to videoconferencing to limit close contacts and reduce transmission risk on campus. Rector Prof. Jean-Faustin Simba announced the measure on 27 August 2026. The policy affects faculties with high student populations; practical instruction for medical students is suspended due to heightened exposure in health facilities. A parallel training program, developed with the outbreak response team, will prepare future physicians to resume clinical rotations with appropriate knowledge and personal protective equipment kits. The university emphasizes protecting students and staff while awaiting strengthened capacities in the surrounding health system. No casualty figures are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブニア大学、感染拡大を防ぐためビデオ会議形式に切替 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアでエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、大学が対面授業を停止するなど地域社会への影響が拡大している。IHR基準に複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cebu City steps up meat checks, ASF controls
article.articleSummary: Cebu City intensified meat-safety enforcement and African swine fever (ASF) controls in July 2026. The Department of Veterinary Medicine and Fisheries condemned 1,151.75 kg and confiscated 711.755 kg of meat and animal products for violations (ante-mortem 593 kg, post-mortem 558.75 kg). Inspections covered 11,371 hogs and 139,209 chickens; two citation tickets and three warnings issued. Fish and marine products inspections totaled about 2.2 million kg with 73,374 containers, and 254,435.5 kg were re-inspected, monitoring 137 fish vendors; regulatory fees amounted to about P146,748. Total July collections reached about P2.45 million, with January–July 2026 at about P16.83 million (P107,050 in licensing, P31,000 in penalties). ASF-border controls were coordinated with the Bureau of Animal Industry Quarantine Office 7 and Cebu Port Authority; biosecurity campaigns and intensified vaccination were conducted in barangays including Inayawan, Quiot, Cogon Pardo and adjacent rural areas. Rabies-control vaccinations totaled 2,184 in July, with vaccination and welfare activities ongoing across the city.

article.articleHeadline: Distan Mataram perketat pengawasan kesehatan hewan ternak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mataram City Department of Agriculture Tightens Livestock Health Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Mataram City’s Agriculture Department tightens livestock health surveillance to curb foot-and-mouth disease (PMK) in cattle. With Maulid Nabi SAW 1448 Hijriah boosting demand to 50–60 head per day (up from 30–40), imports from outside Lombok (notably Sumbawa) are inspected more rigorously. Entry of livestock must include vaccination proof, a PCR testing certificate, and other administrative documents to ensure health compliance. Domestic trade within Lombok markets remains monitored, though concern is lower; two veterinarians are stationed at the animal market to conduct regular health checks. Ongoing farmer education, periodic vaccination programs, and improved pen cleanliness are promoted as preventive measures. Officials report that, to date, livestock in Mataram are declared free of PMK.

triage.headline_ja: マタラム市農業局、家畜の健康監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾病であり人への健康影響はなく、現時点でマタラム市の家畜は口蹄疫フリーと報告されている。予防的な監視強化の記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物のみに感染する疾病で人獣共通感染症ではないため、ヒトの公衆衛生上のリスクは想定されない。記事はロンボク島マタラム市における予防的な家畜検疫強化の内容であり、現状では感染確認事例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Japanese army uses own soldiers in mosquito-borne disease experiments during WWII: study
article.articleSummary: Malaria-focused human experiments by the Japanese Imperial Army during WWII involved two units—Unit 731 in Harbin, Heilongjiang, and Unit 1855 in Beijing—conducting insect-based bacteriological weapons research using malaria-infected mosquitoes, fleas, and flies. Live experiments infected Chinese soldiers with malaria, then allowed the insects to bite 10 Japanese soldiers hospitalized with mental illness at a Chiba Prefecture military hospital, producing fevers over 40°C, headaches, and loss of appetite. Conducted May–August 1940; documentation published January 10, 1943 in a Japanese Army Medical Corps journal. Records from the Exhibition Hall of Evidences of Crime Committed by Unit 731 indicate cross-institutional collaboration and that experiments extended to the Japanese mainland, with mosquitoes serving as the infection source and Chinese soldiers as initial hosts. The report also mentions research on fleas for plague and flies for cholera.

triage.headline_ja: 旧日本軍が第二次世界大戦中、蚊媒介性疾患実験に自国兵士を使用していたとの研究
triage.triage_reason: 第二次世界大戦中（1940年）の歴史的な人体実験に関する研究記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は歴史的研究（731部隊・1855部隊による戦時人体実験）に関する内容であり、現在の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: La settimana di Papa Leone XIV - Per le vittime di Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pope Leo XIV's Week - For the Ebola Victims.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, has spread to six provinces and caused more than 2,500 deaths. The toll in just three months surpasses the eastern-DRC outbreak of 2018–2020, previously the deadliest in the country’s history. Pope Leo XIV, after the Angelus on Sunday, August 23 in St. Peter’s Square, expressed solidarity with Congo and urged a robust international response that also involves local communities in prevention to save lives. The appeal emphasizes coordinated global support and preventive action to curb transmission across affected areas. The report does not provide laboratory confirmation details, symptom descriptions, or infection-source data, focusing instead on the human cost and the need for international assistance.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱が6州に拡大し、3か月で2500人以上が死亡と、過去最悪だった2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模となっており、IHR基準に複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Minapharm recebe verba para vacina contra ebola - 27/08/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minapharm receives funding for an Ebola vaccine - 27/08/2026
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-27, Minapharm, an Egyptian pharmaceutical group, announced CEPI funding of up to $16.5 million to advance a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola vaccine. The candidate, developed by ProBioGen (Minapharm’s Berlin subsidiary), uses an MVA platform and aims to elicit both B- and T-cell responses for durable immunity. Funding covers laboratory development through a first-in-human Phase 1 trial to be conducted in Africa. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is experiencing the largest Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak to date, with more than 5,600 confirmed cases and over 2,700 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. CEPI supports five Bundibugyo vaccines; other contenders include Moderna (mRNA), Oxford/Serum Institute (ChAdOx), and Hilleman/Public Health Vaccines (rVSV). WHO authorization would follow successful trials. The WHO also urged a large-scale Ervebo trial in the DRC to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo, given Ervebo’s Zaire protection. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ミナファーム、エボラワクチン開発のための資金を受領 - 2026年8月27日
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン資金提供が主題だが、DRCで史上最大規模のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（確認例5,600超、死亡2,700超）が継続していることが明記されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文自体はエジプト企業ミナファーム（ベルリン子会社ProBioGen）へのCEPIによるブンディブギョ型エボラワクチン開発資金提供に関する内容だが、DRCでの大規模流行状況（史上最大のブンディブギョ流行、5,600例超、死亡2,700例超、2026年5月15日発生宣言）が記事内で報告されている。エジプト・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行自体は既知情報である可能性があり、続報で新規性・拡大リスクを確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Case in Chhattisgarh: After malaria, the risk of swine flu in the state; patients are steadily increasing in this district, and the health department has geared up.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu cases in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, have risen to 10, with two patients in serious condition receiving treatment at Apollo Hospital. A 30-year-old man has travel history to Raipur; a 75-year-old woman has no travel history. Medical teams are closely monitoring the patients, and authorities have tightened surveillance at Chhattisgarh Institute of Medical Sciences (CIMS) and the district hospital, as well as at primary health centers (PHCs) and community health centers (CHCs). With cases increasing, the health department has placed the district on alert and intensified monitoring for new infections. Residents are urged to stay vigilant and seek prompt medical advice if swine flu-like symptoms appear, as authorities continue to track the outbreak in Bilaspur.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフル(H1N1)ケース チャッティースガル州：マラリアに続き州内でスワインフルの危険性、この地区で患者が増加中、保健当局が対応強化
triage.triage_reason: チャッティースガル州ビラースプル県で季節性のH1N1（スワインフル）患者が10名に増加し、重症者も出ているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されておらず、地域内の保健当局による監視強化で対応中である。

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia chia sẻ giải pháp bảo vệ trẻ nhũ nhi trước tác động của RSV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert shares solutions to protect infants from the effects of RSV.
article.articleSummary: RSV remains a leading cause of hospitalization for bronchiolitis and pneumonia in infants under 1 year in Vietnam, with severe cases requiring ICU care and mechanical ventilation. Infants’ immature immunity and small airways predispose to lower respiratory tract injury; more than 60% of ICU/ventilator RSV cases occur in otherwise healthy full-term infants. While some infections resolve spontaneously, many progress to hospitalization or death. Long-term effects may include recurrent wheeze and higher asthma risk before age 6. A Vietnamese RSV prevention symposium organized by the Vietnamese Pediatric Association in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, funded by Sanofi-Aventis Vietnam, drew nearly 1,000 healthcare workers. Strategies discussed include maternal vaccination and the monoclonal antibody Nirsevimab, approved by the Ministry of Health in 2025 for all children under 1 year. The association also released 'Nirsevimab in Clinical Practice—FAQs (2026)' for clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がRSVの影響から乳児を守るための対策を共有
triage.triage_reason: RSVはベトナムで既知の季節性・地域流行性の呼吸器感染症であり、記事は予防策の啓発・学術シンポジウムに関する内容であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はRSV予防に関する医療従事者向けシンポジウムと新薬（Nirsevimab）の紹介が主旨であり、アウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 26 casos de sarampo e amplia imunização em três cidades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 26 measles cases and expands immunization in three cities.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise to 26 in São Paulo state as of 27 August 2026. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat reports three new infections in the capital, two imported and the remainder linked to importation. Of the total, 23 cases are in the city of São Paulo, two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one in Guarulhos; most affected are children under 2. Nineteen patients had no vaccination or incomplete vaccination; the three new cases had no vaccination history—two under 1 year (a boy and a girl) and a woman in her 30s. Immunization campaigns now target residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo; dose zero for 6–11 months, without altering the standard 12- and 15-month schedule. Day D on 22 August saw over 600,000 doses administered. Preliminary 2026 coverage: 89.35% first dose, 74.64% second dose; goal 95% two-dose coverage. Symptoms: fever, red rash, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis. Vaccines are free via SUS; seek care for symptoms and report travel history; suspect cases must be notified and isolated. Vacina 100 Dúvidas for questions.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹26例確認、3都市でワクチン接種拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（麻疹排除国）でのワクチン未接種者を中心とした輸入関連の麻疹クラスターが拡大しており、大規模予防接種対応が行われているため、フルリスク評価への移行が適切と判断。
triage.notes: 感染例の大半が2歳未満の未接種児童で、輸入例が起点。サンパウロ州保健局が大規模予防接種(Day D)を実施し、対象年齢を拡大している。麻疹排除国であるブラジルでの再流行リスクとして継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: खैरागढ़ जिले में स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक, 4 वर्षीय बालक H1N1 पॉजिटिव; स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने संभाला मोर्चा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu hits Khairagarh district, 4-year-old boy tests positive for H1N1; health department takes charge.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) confirmed in Khairagarh district, India: a 4-year-old boy, Kanhaiya Chandrakar, tested positive and is receiving treatment at Sanjeevani Hospital in Rajnandgaon. Health authorities, led by Block Medical Officer Dr. Manish Baghel, have launched door-to-door surveys in Ward No. 9 and nearby areas, collecting samples from the patient’s family. Surveillance focuses on symptoms such as fever, cold, cough, sore throat and breathing difficulties, with referrals for medical care as needed. Family members’ samples were also collected to curb potential spread. Officials urge vigilance over panic, advising prompt medical evaluation at local health centers or hospitals for high fever, cough, sore throat, cold, or breathing trouble. Monitoring continues for contacts and suspected cases; no further cases reported at this time.

triage.headline_ja: カイラーガル県でスワインフル発生、4歳男児がH1N1陽性；保健当局が対応開始
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の単発小児例で、地域保健当局が通常のサーベイランス対応を実施中。異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知であり、単発の小児例で家族への調査が実施されている程度。現時点で追加患者の報告はなく、地域の医療体制内で対応可能な事例。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ подтвердили завершение вспышки Эболы в Уганде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO confirmed the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirmed the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus after Uganda declared the outbreak over last month, following 42 days without a new case since the last patient’s discharge, with continued surveillance for undetected transmission. In contrast, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) outbreak persists, reporting 5,656 confirmed cases and 2,715 deaths as of Monday; the largest and most deadly Ebola outbreak in DRC history, with transmission still highly active despite some slowing. The response has made progress in contact tracing and testing, but funding remains urgently needed—about $30 million—to sustain logistics and PPE delivery to the hardest-hit areas, with shortages potentially hampering containment. The risk of cross-border spread remains high, especially to neighboring countries. There are no approved medicines or vaccines for this Bundibugyo outbreak, which began in May in the DRC (Ituri region).

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダでのエボラ流行終息を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでは終息が確認されたが、DRCでは史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、死者2,715人・確定患者5,656人、ワクチン未承認、国境を越えた拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息が確認されたが、記事の主題はDRCで継続中の大規模流行であり、資金不足・ワクチン未承認・越境拡大リスクが強調されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：流感活动强度近期有所波动，新冠阳性率呈下降趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: Influenza activity has fluctuated recently, and the COVID-19 positivity rate has shown a downward trend.
article.articleSummary: On 27 August 2026, China CDC reports weekly sentinel surveillance for 8–23 August showing influenza activity fluctuating, with B(Victoria) lineage and A(H3N2) predominating; the share of A(H3N2) infections is rising. Southern provinces show mid-level activity while northern provinces are in inter-epidemic periods. COVID-19 positivity rate has declined and remains at a mid-level prevalence, with the NB.1.8.1 variant lineage still circulating; higher positivity is seen in the 0–4 and 15–59 age groups. Other respiratory pathogens detected are at low levels. Since COVID-19 management was reclassified to Category B, annual waves occur 1–2 times, with this rise following a similar intensity to the prior two years and now declining since week 32. Most infections are mild; elderly and those with chronic diseases remain high-risk. No significant public health risks or disruptive variants detected. As schools reopen, emphasis on health monitoring to detect clusters.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センター：インフルエンザ活動の強度は最近変動し、新型コロナの陽性率は減少傾向
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性サーベイランス報告であり、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念や異常な事象は認められず、新型コロナ陽性率も低下傾向にある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザとCOVID-19の定期サーベイランス報告。重症例増加や新規変異株による異常事態の報告なし。学校再開に伴うクラスター監視の強化が言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: CDC AS Keluarkan Travel Notice Virus Zika di Bali : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. CDC Issues Zika Virus Travel Notice in Bali: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Zika virus Travel Health Notice issued by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention for Bali, Indonesia, on August 7, 2026 (Level 2: Practice Enhanced Precautions) after reports of Zika in travelers returning from Bali. Zika is primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, and can also spread from pregnant women to fetuses and via sexual contact. The notice emphasizes heightened vigilance, urging travelers to Bali to implement mosquito bite prevention and safe-sex practices during travel and after return. Pregnant women are advised to avoid travel to Bali; if the trip cannot be postponed, they should strictly apply protective measures against mosquito bites and sexual transmission. The alert frames cases as imported/exported through travelers, highlighting the need for ongoing surveillance and cautious travel planning for individuals visiting Bali.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、バリ島でのジカウイルスに関する渡航健康注意情報を発出
triage.triage_reason: 米CDCがバリ島（インドネシア）に対しジカウイルスの渡航健康注意（レベル2）を発出し、渡航者を介した国際的な感染拡大と渡航制限的措置が確認されるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 米国CDCが渡航者の帰国後の症例報告を受けてバリ島に渡航注意を発出した事例。インドネシア国内での症例数・重症度等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में स्वाइन फ्लू का प्रकोप: 24 घंटे में आए 138 नए मामले, स्वास्थ्य मंत्री पंकज कुमार बोले-घबराने की जरूरत नहीं
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu outbreak in Delhi: 138 new cases in 24 hours, Health Minister Pankaj Kumar said there is no need to panic.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a swine flu (H1N1) outbreak with 138 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing 2026 Delhi H1N1 total to 2,446; seasonal monsoon-induced increase; influenza A cases total 3,177. Most patients present with fever and flu-like symptoms and are discharged within 1–2 days after initial treatment. Health Minister Dr. Pankaj Kumar Singh stated there is no need to panic and that the situation is under control. Hospitals have established dedicated isolation rooms; all facilities instructed to maintain at least five isolation beds, with larger hospitals providing 10 or more for influenza and vector-borne diseases. Emergency departments have flu corners; senior resident doctors deployed; suspected cases to be tested promptly with swabs as needed. Free testing is available; Tamiflu stock is ample; authorities urged ongoing stock monitoring and local procurement if required; focus on children and elderly.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでスワインフル（H1N1）が流行：24時間で138人の新規感染、保健大臣パンカジ・クマールは「パニックになる必要はない」と発言
triage.triage_reason: 季節性モンスーンに伴うH1N1感染者数の増加（24時間で138人、累計2,446人）が報告されているが、症状は軽度で医療体制も対応可能とされており、異常性・国際的拡大の明確な証拠はない。感染者数の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）のモンスーン期増加であり、保健当局は「状況は管理下にある」と発表。重症例や死亡例の報告はなく、タミフル在庫も十分とされる。感染者数の推移（前年比・週次トレンド）を継続的に確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu hits Chhattisgarh... 4-year-old child tests positive for H1N1, Health Department on alert, door-to-door survey begins.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (H1N1) detected in Kondrapara, Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh, with a 4-year-old boy testing positive and hospitalised at Sanjeevani Hospital, Rajnandgaon. The case prompted an immediate mobilization by the health department under BMO Dr. Manish Baghel. A special field team, including lab technician Akhil Verma and supervisor Rohit Sahu, visited the patient's home to collect samples from family members and assess transmission risk. To curb spread, authorities launched a door-to-door survey across the Kondrapara ward and surrounding areas, recording reports of cold, cough, and fever, and providing health education on swine flu prevention. The boy's treatment is ongoing, and routine testing and monitoring are being conducted to identify potential further cases and ensure containment.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州で豚インフルエンザが確認…4歳児がH1N1陽性、保健当局が警戒、家庭訪問調査を開始
triage.triage_reason: H1N1(豚インフルエンザ)はインドで季節性・地域流行的に発生する疾患であり、単発の小児例に対する地域保健当局の通常の対応（家庭訪問調査等）であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda declara el fin del brote de ébola por virus Bundibugyo tras 42 días sin nuevos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda declares the end of the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus after 42 days with no new cases.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has declared the end of the Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases. The final 42-day period followed the discharge of the last patient, an imported case, on 16 July 2026, and local transmission had already been halted on 28 July 2026. From 15 May 2026, Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases: 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 5 locally acquired among contacts and healthcare workers linked to imported cases. There were 18 recoveries and 2 deaths, with more than 800 contacts identified and monitored. Africa CDC and WHO credit rapid case detection, contact tracing, isolation, clinical care, infection prevention and control, and community engagement for interrupting transmission. The DRC outbreak remains a top regional risk, with no travel or border restrictions advised, but continued cross-border preparedness emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、42日間新規感染者なしでブンディブジョ株エボラウイルス病の流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行自体は終息宣言されたが、DRCからの輸入例による国境を越えた感染拡大が実際に発生しており、DRC国内の流行は地域的リスクとして継続しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息が確認されたが、感染源であるDRC国内の流行は『地域における最大のリスク』として継続中とされており、越境再燃の可能性から監視継続が必要。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : 9 patients guéris d'Ebola sortent du CTE de Rwankole - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: 9 patients recovered from Ebola leave the Rwankole Ebola Treatment Center.
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola survivors left the Rwankole Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 18 days after the facility's inauguration, signaling progress in the 17th Ebola outbreak response. The patients were declared cured as part of ongoing containment efforts for Ebola virus disease in the DRC. Dr. Cagod Inkale, Incident Manager representative for the 17th outbreak, and Prof. Steve Ahuka stressed that rapid detection and timely access to specialized care are crucial to prevent complications. They urged residents with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding to seek care promptly and alert community health workers. At discharge, the nine survivors received dignity kits with mattresses, blankets, suitcases, cloths, and other essentials, plus hydroalcoholic gel. The event underscores the ongoing emphasis on early detection, appropriate care, and community involvement to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ：ルワンコレ・エボラ治療センターからエボラ治癒患者9名が退院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する続報であり、患者の治癒・退院という進捗報告に留まる。新たな拡大や重症化の兆候はなく、既存のアウトブレイク監視の一環として経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の第17次エボラ流行（DRC・イツリ州）における治癒患者の退院を報じる進捗報告であり、新規感染拡大や重症化の情報は含まれない。既存の流行管理体制下での続報として監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hubballi H1N1 fear: number of patients has increased at KIMS; doctors say there is no need to panic.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, Hubballi, Karnataka, reports rising H1N1 infections. At KIMS hospital, 14 cases were confirmed in the last two months: 5 of 29 July samples positive and 9 of 39 August samples positive. No patients with comorbidities; all treated and recovering. Common symptoms are fever, cold, cough, and body aches. The infection spreads person-to-person and is not as severe as COVID-19, but precautions are essential. Monsoon months (July–September) see seasonal spikes, and transmission continues this season. Public-health guidance: wear masks in public, practice frequent handwashing, and seek medical evaluation if fever, body aches, or persistent cold lasts beyond four days. Do not panic; basic precautions suffice. Karnataka-wide and national increases are being monitored.

triage.headline_ja: フバッリでH1N1への懸念:KIMS病院で患者数が増加、医師は「パニックにならないで」と発言
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の増加が報告されているが、重症例やクラスター拡大の兆候はなく、医師も「パニック不要」としているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性(モンスーン期)のH1N1増加であり、重症例・合併症例は報告なし。全患者が回復中。地域内での監視は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda razglasila konec izbruha ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda declared the end of the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared the end of its Ebola outbreak on 27 August 2026 after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases, since the last imported case was discharged on 16 July. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, involved 20 cases: 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo and 5 locally acquired among contacts and health workers linked to imported cases. Eighteen recovered and two died; more than 800 contacts were monitored. The 42-day period matches twice the longest Ebola incubation and is the international criterion for declaring transmission over. Uganda, with domestic and international support, rapidly interrupted local transmission through case finding, contact tracing, isolation, patient care, infection prevention, and strengthened surveillance. The Democratic Republic of Congo continues to report Ebola, with 5,584 cases and 2,680 deaths as of 23 August 2026; approximately 48% case fatality among confirmed cases, and ongoing risk to neighboring countries, though travel restrictions are not advised by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱の流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行は終息したが、感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）では5,584例・2,680死亡（致死率約48%）の大規模流行が継続中であり、周辺国への感染拡大リスクが残るため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダの流行終息宣言だが、感染源であるDRCでは大規模流行が継続中（致死率約48%）であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは対象国のため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda declara el final del brote de ébola tras 42 días sin...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda declares the end of the Ebola outbreak after 42 days without...
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Uganda declared the Ebola outbreak over after 42 days without new cases following the discharge of the last patient. The outbreak began in May in Uganda in connection with a flare in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda recorded 20 Ebola cases — 15 imported from DRC and 5 from local transmission among contacts and health workers — with 18 recoveries and 2 deaths. The DRC tally reached 5,656 confirmed cases since the May 15 declaration, with 2,715 deaths, marking the deadliest outbreak in its history and raising projections that it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths). WHO Director-General Tedros and CDC Africa Director Jean Kaseya lauded decisive action, preparedness, and cross-border measures, emphasizing rapid public health response to protect populations and sustain this achievement, especially in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、42日間新規感染者なしでエボラ流行の終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行は終息したが、発端であるDRCでは感染者5,656人・死者2,715人に達し史上最悪の流行となっており、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える恐れがあるため、IHR基準を複数満たす重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息宣言だが、対象国リストに含まれないウガンダは除外。発端であり現在も深刻な流行が続くDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれず、記事本文でも言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: No need to panic over H1N1, says Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine
article.articleSummary: Chennai faces a surge in H1N1 cases, prompting the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine to intensify statewide surveillance and preventive measures. Influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) are monitored year-round; district health officers and rapid response teams will act on unusual rises or clusters. Government hospitals and primary health centres continue testing and treating patients with fever and respiratory symptoms. Oseltamivir stocks and other essential medicines are being monitored. Pregnant women, young children, seniors, and people with comorbidities such as diabetes, heart disease, and chronic respiratory illnesses receive special watch. Severe cases may begin antiviral treatment without waiting for laboratory confirmation, on medical advice. Public advisory urges early medical attention for fever, cough, or sore throat, along with hand hygiene, cough etiquette, rest, and fluids; avoid self-medication and seek doctor's guidance.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1について過剰反応の必要なし、公衆衛生予防医学局が発表
triage.triage_reason: H1N1(季節性インフルエンザ)の症例増加に対する行政の通常の監視・対応強化が報じられているが、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候は確認できない。
triage.notes: H1N1はすでに季節性インフルエンザとして定着している病原体であり、記事も『パニックの必要なし』とのメッセージが主旨。チェンナイ/タミルナードゥ州における通常の監視体制強化の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Delivers Experimental Ebola Antibody Therapy to Uganda
article.articleSummary: Uganda receives an experimental Ebola antibody therapy from the United States as the region faces the largest Ebola outbreak outside West Africa, though Uganda currently has no active cases. Cross-border transmission risk remains elevated due to rising cases in neighboring DR Congo. U.S. Chargé d'Affaires Mikael Cleverley said the donation aims to enable Uganda to respond quickly if the virus crosses the border. Antibody therapies provide immediate immune protection or help treat active infections, in contrast to vaccines that primarily prevent infection. The move emphasizes preparedness for possible spillover from DR Congo, with Uganda positioned to act fast if needed. The aid underscores the role of antibody therapies in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ウガンダに実験的エボラ抗体療法を提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで西アフリカ外最大規模とされるエボラ流行が進行中であり、越境感染リスクからウガンダへ抗体療法が提供された。IHR基準複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行とウガンダへの越境リスク対応。ウガンダ・米国・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダ国内には現在活動例なしと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织宣布乌干达埃博拉疫情结束-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares the Ebola outbreak in Uganda over - International Online
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ebola outbreak, centered in Bundibugyo, has been declared over by Africa CDC and the World Health Organization (WHO) in a joint statement dated 27 August 2026. The last patient, an imported case, was discharged on 16 July 2026, and Uganda has completed a 42-day period with no new confirmed cases, exceeding the Ebola incubation window. On 28 July 2026, Uganda announced interruption of local transmission after 42 days without locally acquired infections; surveillance and control measures continue. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the outbreak demonstrated that decisive action can rapidly contain Ebola. However, Ebola remains active in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with ongoing cross-border risk due to socio-economic links and trade. WHO and Africa CDC will continue supporting Uganda and DR Congo until transmission is terminated in the region as a priority.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息は発表されたが、隣接するDRCでエボラが依然活動的であり、越境リスクが明記されているためIHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク）を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダの流行終息宣言だが、DRCで進行中のエボラ流行と越境リスクが明記されており、DRCを対象国として抽出した。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC declare end of Ebola outbreak in Uganda
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Ebola outbreak is declared over after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases since the last patient was discharged, announced on 2026-08-27 by WHO Africa and Africa CDC. The 42-day window—twice Ebola’s upper incubation limit—confirms transmission interruption. Uganda reported 20 confirmed Ebola cases and 2 deaths since May 15, with 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 5 locally acquired among contacts and health workers linked to imported cases. End-of-outbreak progress followed decisive government leadership and measures including case detection and confirmation, contact tracing, isolation, clinical care, and strengthened entry-point controls. While this marks a milestone for Uganda, the DRC continues to battle Ebola, and cross-border movement sustains risk for neighboring countries. Support under a continental preparedness and response plan will continue to help sustain gains and prevent transmission elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、ウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク終息宣言（良好な結果）が主題であり新規シグナルとは言えないが、対象国であるDRCで感染が継続しており、越境リスクへの言及があるため、DRCの状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのアウトブレイク終息宣言だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは継続的なエボラ流行地として言及されているため含めたが、詳細なDRC国内の新規データは記事に無く情報不足のためWATCHと判断。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo chega a 26 casos de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 26 measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, São Paulo State Health Secretariat confirms 26 measles cases in 2026, with three new infections in the capital on the morning of that date. The affected individuals include a boy and a girl under one year old and a 30-year-old woman; nationwide, 23 cases are in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos (all in the Greater São Paulo region). Nineteen cases occurred in individuals who were not vaccinated or had incomplete vaccination. A measles vaccination campaign runs until September 1, offering free immunization for people aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. Vaccinations are provided at Basic Health Units regardless of prior vaccination history.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の麻疹確定患者数が26人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の限定的な集積(26例)で重症例報告はないが、未接種者中心の感染拡大が見られ、ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施中であり続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 州保健当局が積極的にワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施しており、地域内での対応が進んでいる。未接種者中心の感染拡大は今後の増加リスクを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu to examine H1N1 vaccination for elderly, pregnant women: Health minister Arunraj
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu health minister K G Arunraj said H1N1 infections are under control and vaccination for vulnerable groups, including elderly and pregnant women, will be examined. The state monitors fever, dengue, and H1N1 trends; Delhi and Karnataka have reported H1N1 spikes. H1N1, an influenza A subtype with fever, cough, and sore throat, can be severe in vulnerable populations. In 2025, infections were higher in early months, with cases peaking May–August this year. Mosquito breeding sites are being eliminated and adults controlled; fever surveillance spans 5,805 government and private hospitals. Dengue has reached 12,856 cases and seven deaths in Tamil Nadu, with Chennai bearing the highest burden and high counts in Coimbatore, Tiruvallur, Salem, Chengalpet, Pudukkottai, Tirupur, Krishnagiri, Ranipet, and Villupuram. House-to-house fever surveillance guides testing; doctors should treat dengue-like symptoms even if tests are negative. Dengue spreads via day-biting Aedes mosquitoes in stagnant water; residents should prevent water accumulation.

triage.headline_ja: タミルナードゥ州、高齢者・妊婦へのH1N1ワクチン接種を検討：アルンラージ保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: タミルナードゥ州で季節性のH1N1とデング熱が流行しているが、当局は「制御下にある」と説明しており、深刻度・異常性・国際拡大のいずれも明確な該当基準がない。継続的なベクター媒介感染とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため経過観察が望ましい。
triage.notes: デリー・カルナータカ州でもH1N1増加の報告があるが、記事の主題はタミルナードゥ州の状況であり、他州は参考情報として言及されているのみ。デング熱は季節性流行で死亡7例・感染12,856例、H1N1は「制御下」との当局発言あり。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: UP: Moradabad reports first H1N1 case; health department steps up surveillance
article.articleSummary: Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, reports its first H1N1 case on Aug 27, 2026, a 42-year-old woman who tested positive after returning from Ghaziabad. She developed high fever, sore throat and body ache and is stable under care at Asian Vivekanand Hospital. In response, the district hospital reserves a 10-bed special ward for H1N1 patients, with at least five beds at each community health centre. An adequate stock of H1N1 treatment drugs is maintained at the district hospital. Chief Medical Officer Dr Kuldeep Singh urged mandatory masking for health staff and advised residents with fever, sore throat or body ache to seek medical testing. Officials stressed there is no need to panic and asked the public to disregard rumours while vigilance is stepped up for potential spread in Moradabad.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州:モラダバードで初のH1N1症例確認、保健当局が監視強化
triage.triage_reason: 単一の安定した症例で、季節性・地域流行のあるH1N1インフルエンザの通常の症例報告であり、地元当局の日常的な対応（病床確保・監視強化）で管理可能なレベル。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 患者は安定しており、地元病院で治療中。H1N1はインドで季節性に発生する既知の疾患であり、今回の事例は特筆すべき異常性を示していない。地方保健当局による予防的な監視強化のための通常対応。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola fait 2 744 morts, affirme le ministère de la Communication
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak has killed 2,744, according to the Ministry of Communication.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) totals 5,713 confirmed cases, with 2,744 deaths and 1,269 recoveries. The response covers six provinces and 58 health zones, with 770 patients currently in isolation or hospitalized. The case fatality rate stands at 48%. Surveillance of suspected cases continues in affected areas: 390 suspected cases have been investigated, and 204 people have been transferred to treatment or isolation centers. Health authorities reiterate ongoing detection and care for those likely infected. A free helpline is available for suspected cases at 151. The report emphasizes sustained control measures and monitoring across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行により2,744人が死亡、コミュニケーション省が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中で、死亡者数2,744人・致死率48%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数州・複数保健区に拡大しているため、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 累計症例5,713人、死亡2,744人、致死率48%と非常に深刻。6州58保健区に拡大しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: மதுரையில் இதுவரை 70 பேருக்கு டெங்கு பாதிப்பு - பாதுகாப்பு நடவடிக்கைகள் தீவிரம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Madurai, dengue has affected 70 people so far — precautionary measures intensified.
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections have been reported in Madurai district, Tamil Nadu, totaling 70 cases so far this year, with 20 cases in the current month. The rise aligns with heat intensification as the northeast monsoon recedes, with post-monsoon weather and rainfall contributing to the spread of seasonal fever. Health officials have intensified precautionary measures to curb dengue transmission in the district. The district administration and health department are conducting vector-control activities, public awareness campaigns, and sanitation efforts to reduce mosquito breeding sites. The report notes ongoing monitoring and response to dengue amid the seasonal climate shift, urging residents to take preventive steps and seek medical care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: マドゥライで、これまでにデング熱感染者70人 — 予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱発生であり、地域限定的かつ通常想定される規模のため即時のフルRRAは不要だが、状況の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱発生で、地方自治体が既にベクター対策を実施中。重症度や死亡例の情報はなく、国際的懸念や渡航制限の要素も見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda declara el final del brote de ébola tras 42 días sin contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda declares the end of the Ebola outbreak after 42 days without new infections.
article.articleSummary: Uganda ends the Ebola outbreak after 42 days without new infections. WHO Director‑General Tedros Ghebreyesus praised decisive actions, and CDC Africa Chief Jean Kaseya noted rapid health‑system response and community trust as key. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 5 local among contacts/health workers); 18 recovered and 2 died. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities record 5,656 confirmed Ebola cases since May 15 and 2,715 deaths, making it the deadliest outbreak there, with projections to surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) which totaled 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths. The DRC, with extensive Ebola experience since 1976 in Yambuku near the Ebola River, also notes the Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025. Emphasis remains on preparedness, enhanced surveillance in health facilities and communities, and careful management of entry points to keep movement safe while protecting health.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、新規感染なしの42日間を経てエボラ流行の終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息は朗報だが、記事本文の主眼はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における致死的かつ拡大中のエボラ流行（確定5,656例、死亡2,715例、2014-16年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性）であり、既にウガンダへの越境感染例も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）は流行終息を宣言したが、記事の主題であるDRCの大規模流行（史上最悪規模）が継続中であり、これを主眼にverified_locationsを設定した。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-16年流行の歴史的比較のみで現状発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Αιγυπτιακή εταιρεία αναπτύσσει εμβόλιο κατά στελέχους του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Egyptian company develops a vaccine against an Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: An Egyptian pharmaceutical company is developing a candidate vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, which is driving the major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The information comes from an announcement issued on Thursday, with no further technical details released. The effort focuses on the Bundibugyo lineage associated with the ongoing DRC outbreak. The publication provides no data on trial progress, timelines, or efficacy. This vaccination effort underscores continued responses to the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of August 27, 2026. Details on target population, delivery platform, or funding were not disclosed. Notwithstanding, the announcement signals ongoing vaccine development efforts to address Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エジプト企業がエボラ株に対するワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中の大規模エボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）流行に関連する情報であり、IHR基準（重大性・異常性）を満たすため継続的なリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエジプトの製薬企業によるワクチン開発発表であり、実際の感染発生地はDRC。エジプトは開発拠点に過ぎず、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。新規の症例データや流行拡大情報はなく、既存のDRCエボラ流行への対応活動の一環として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days with no new cases
article.articleSummary: Uganda was declared Ebola-free by the WHO after 42 days with no new cases, marking the end of its outbreak. The last imported case was discharged on 16 July 2026; no onward transmission was documented. Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases, almost all among travellers from neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with two deaths. The DRC continues to face the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, with more than 5,600 confirmed cases and over 2,700 deaths. Uganda, which shares an 877-km border with the DRC, had travel restrictions during the outbreak; WHO praised containment efforts and urged lifting restrictions. Uganda also announced plans to open two more Ebola treatment centres in the DRC, bringing the total to four. The DRC outbreak was declared on 15 May, with ongoing regional public health implications.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、42日間新規感染者なしでウガンダのエボラ終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの終息は朗報だが、記事はDRCで史上最速拡大中のエボラ流行（5600例超、2700人超死亡）が継続中であることを報告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が存在する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCでのアウトブレイクは史上最速拡大とされ、越境例も発生しており地域的な公衆衛生上の重大リスクが継続している点に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: سازمان جهانی بهداشت اوگاندا را پس از ۴۲ روز بدون مورد جدید عاری از ابولا اعلام کرد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization declared Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days with no new cases.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declares Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days with no new cases, ending the outbreak there. Uganda, bordering the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for 877 km, recorded 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths, with nearly all patients traveling from the DRC. The 42-day period started after the last laboratory-confirmed imported Ebola case was discharged on 16 July 2026, with no secondary transmissions detected. WHO praised the Ugandan government, health workers, and partners for aggressive containment. Diana Atwine, Uganda’s Ministry of Health Permanent Secretary, said risk assessments and transmission dynamics showed the country was Ebola-free, pending formal WHO confirmation, and urged lifting travel restrictions imposed during the outbreak. Uganda plans to open two additional Ebola treatment centers in the DRC, bringing the total to four. Since the outbreak began on 15 May, the DRC has reported over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths, the fastest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、42日間新規感染者なしでウガンダのエボラ終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでは終息宣言がなされたが、記事内でコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における進行中のエボラ流行が「史上最速の流行」として言及され、5600人以上の感染、2700人以上の死亡という深刻な状況が続いているため、フルRRAでの継続評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのエボラ終息宣言（対象国リスト外）だが、感染源であるDRCでの流行が「史上最速」規模で継続中であり、越境感染の実態を含むため、DRCを対象国として抽出した。ウガンダはDRCとの国境地帯からの感染例のみで、対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلن انتهاء تفشي فيروس إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda declares the end of the Ebola outbreak - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Uganda, with the Africa CDC and WHO, declared the end of the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Uganda. After 42 consecutive days without a new confirmed case since the last patient (an imported case) left hospital on 16 July 2026, local transmission was declared ended on 28 July 2026. In total, Uganda reported 20 laboratory-confirmed cases: 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo and 5 linked to local transmission among contacts and health workers; 18 people recovered and 2 died. Over 800 contacts were identified and monitored. The declaration comes amid ongoing Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo, underscoring cross-border risks to neighboring countries. WHO and Africa CDC urged continued surveillance, infection prevention, and safe entry points, and advised against travel or trade restrictions. Officials emphasized sustaining preparedness and cross-border collaboration with DRC under continental strategies to prevent future spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラウイルスの流行終息を宣言 - 第七の日
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウガンダでのエボラ流行終息宣言に関するもので新規脅威ではないが、隣接するDRCで感染が継続しており越境リスクが指摘されているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのエボラ流行終息宣言だが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの継続的な感染拡大が明記されているため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में 48 घंटे में स्वाइन फ्लू के 304 नए मामले, अब तक 2,612 केस दर्ज; ICMR ने दिया नया अपडेट - delhi swine flu cases surge 304 new in 48 hrs total 2612
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 304 new swine flu cases in Delhi in 48 hours, 2,612 cases registered so far; ICMR has issued a new update.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza A) is accelerating in Delhi with 304 new cases in the past 48 hours, including 166 in the last 24 hours, taking the season’s tally to 2,612. Influenza A cases have crossed 3,300; on August 20, swine flu was 1,777 and influenza A 2,392 (H1N1: 114). Officials say the circulating virus is not a new strain and most cases are mild. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body pains, headache, and fatigue; the infection can occasionally affect the lungs and cause severe respiratory illness. Flu vaccination can reduce infection risk and severe disease, but is not universally recommended; high-risk groups (65+, immunocompromised, with chronic illnesses) may consider vaccination after doctor’s advice. Hospitals in Delhi are urged to maintain isolation beds, oxygen, staff, medications, and testing capacity; authorities cite monsoon humidity and crowded indoor spaces as drivers, with schoolchildren and dense neighborhoods at higher risk.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで48時間に304件の新規豚インフルエンザ症例、累計2,612件に到達；ICMRが新たな最新情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は該当しないが、WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、メディアおよび保健当局の関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの増加であり、当局は新規株ではなく大半が軽症と説明。ただし監視モンスーン期の人口密集地域での感染拡大リスクとICMRの発表により関心が高まっている。

article.articleSummary: Uganda declared Ebola-free after 42 days with no new cases. The country, which borders the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) by about 877 kilometers, reported 20 Ebola cases and two deaths, largely among people who had entered from DRC. The World Health Organization confirmed on 2026-08-27 that Uganda had completed 42 days since the last confirmed imported Ebola case was discharged on 16 July 2026, with no further transmissions documented. Officials analyzed transmission chains and infection sources; Uganda’s government praised health workers and partners and urged lifting travel restrictions imposed during the outbreak. Uganda plans to open two additional Ebola treatment centers in DRC, bringing the total to four. In DR Congo, where the outbreak began on 15 May, more than 5,600 cases and over 2,700 deaths have been reported, making it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue no Ceará dispara em 2026: casos confirmados sobem 172,7%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Ceará surges in 2026: confirmed cases rise by 172.7%.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Ceará, Brazil, surged in 2026 with by early August 36,393 notifications and over 11,000 confirmed cases, up from 25,000 notifications and 4,856 confirmations in the same period of 2025 (91.7% and 172.7% increases). Virus transmission now reaches 176 of Ceará’s 184 municipalities, and 34 cities are in high or very high incidence. The Interior, especially the Northern region, bears the majority, with Sobral, Vale do Jaguaribe, Cariri, and parts of Fortaleza affected. The Ceará Health Secretariat classifies the situation as epidemic-risk and is intensifying prevention and vector control. So far in 2026 there have been 18 dengue deaths, with five more under investigation; 376 cases show warning signs and 19 are severe. Guidance emphasizes early care for fever, vaccination via SUS for 10–14-year-olds, and eliminating standing water to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州でデング熱が2026年に急増：確定患者数が172.7％増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でデング熱の症例数が前年比172.7％増加し、死亡18例・重症19例を含む深刻な公衆衛生影響が見られ、州当局が「疫病リスク」と位置づける異常な増加であるため、フルリスク評価への移行が適切。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで例年流行する感染症だが、2026年は前年比で著しい増加率（172.7%）を示し、184市町村中176市町村に感染が拡大、死亡例・重症例も報告されているため注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは記事内で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Daily Mail: Европе грозит эпидемия "дождевой гнили", передающейся половым путем
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Daily Mail: Europe faces an epidemic of 'rain rot' transmitted sexually.
article.articleSummary: Rain rot (Dermatophilus congolensis), historically an animal disease, has caused human infections across several European countries, with cases in the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Spain, and others by mid-2026. The outbreak features human-to-human transmission via close contact, as some patients had no livestock exposure. Skin lesions present as rashes, pustules, and crusting, potentially in the groin, face, trunk, and limbs. Most cases respond to antibiotics and rarely result in severe outcomes. Experts caution that shifting transmission pathways may be driving the rise; clinicians should consider rain rot in patients with unusual dermal lesions. Overall population risk remains low, but cross-country surveillance continues. Separately, in mid-August 2025, three UK residents were diagnosed with Oropouche virus, known as ‘sloth fever,’ a tropical disease usually found in Brazil, underscoring concurrent tropical disease concerns.

triage.headline_ja: Daily Mail:ヨーロッパで性行為感染する『レインロット』の流行の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来感染症であるレインロット(Dermatophilus congolensis)が複数の欧州国でヒト-ヒト感染を伴い拡大しており、異常性と国際的拡大の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主軸は英国・フランス・ドイツ・スペインでの『レインロット』ヒト感染拡大であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。Oropouche virus（スロース熱）はブラジル起源だが、実際の感染例は英国居住者であり、ブラジル国内での発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ объявила Уганду свободной от Эболы после 42 дней без новых случаев
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Uganda Ebola-Free After 42 Days Without New Cases.
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases, ending an outbreak linked mainly to travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda borders the DRC for 877 kilometers. The Ugandan outbreak recorded only 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths, with most infections among individuals arriving from DRC. The last confirmed imported case was discharged on July 16, 2026, and no onward transmission was detected for 42 days, enabling the WHO to declare Uganda Ebola-free on August 27, 2026. Authorities praised government action, clinicians, and partners, and urged lifting travel restrictions imposed during the outbreak. Uganda also plans to open two additional Ebola treatment centers in the DRC, bringing total to four. Since the DRC outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths, making it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、42日間新規感染なしでウガンダのエボラ終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行は終息したが、感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の流行は5,600例超・死者2,700人超と史上最速の拡大を見せており、国際的拡大・渡航制限等のIHR基準に複数該当するため継続的な監視・評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの流行終息を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれないウガンダは除外。主要な感染源であるDRCの流行は依然として深刻かつ拡大中であり、継続的なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Oms dichiara l'Uganda libera dall'Ebola dopo 42 giorni senza nuovi casi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the World Health Organization declared Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days with no new cases, ending an outbreak linked to the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Uganda, which shares a long border with the DRC, reported 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths, mostly among travelers from the DRC. The last imported case was discharged on 16 July 2026, with no subsequent transmission documented. The WHO praised Uganda's containment measures and urged lifting travel restrictions imposed during the outbreak. Uganda plans to open two additional Ebola treatment centers in the DRC, bringing the total to four. Since the outbreak was declared in the DRC on 15 May 2026, the DRC has recorded over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths, marking the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダのエボラ終息を宣言、新規感染なしで42日経過
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでは終息したが、背景にあるDRCのエボラ流行は史上最速規模（5,600例超、死亡2,700人超）で継続中であり、IHR基準複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAの対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ終息宣言だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでの大規模流行（史上最速、5,600例超・死者2,700人超）が継続中であり、地域的・国際的リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: OMS declara país livre de Ébola após 42 dias sem novos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: WHO declares the country Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the World Health Organization declared Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases, with the last imported case discharged on 16 July 2026. Uganda recorded 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths, mostly among travelers from neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The country shares an 877-kilometer border with the DRC, where the outbreak has surpassed 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths, making it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. Ugandan authorities praised the response and urged lifting travel restrictions where appropriate. Uganda also plans to open two additional Ebola treatment centers in the DRC, bringing the total to four. The surge began on 15 May 2026, with confirmed cases largely linked to cross-border movement from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：WHOが新規感染42日間なしを受けエボラ終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 記事はウガンダの終息宣言を報じているが、その背景にあるDRCのエボラ流行は5,600例超・死亡2,700人超と史上最速の拡大規模であり、国境を越えた感染拡大が継続中であるためフルRRAでの継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Surto Termina no Uganda, Mas Casos Continuam a Subir na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Outbreak Ends in Uganda, but Cases Continue to Rise in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Bundibugyo variant outbreak ended in Uganda, but cases continue to rise in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda's government declared the country free of the disease on July 28 after 20 cases and 2 deaths. The World Health Organization said the Uganda end was confirmed during a regional briefing on Aug 26, 2026. In the DRC, transmission remains very active and the outbreak is the second-deadliest in history, advancing faster than containment efforts. Across the DRC, government figures as of Aug 26, 2026 tally more than 2,700 deaths and over 5,600 cases. Improvements in contact tracing and testing have occurred, and virus analyses show no signs of mutation. The WHO warns for immediate funding of $30 million to sustain logistics, PPE, and medical equipment in the Congo’s hardest-hit areas to maintain momentum.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダでは流行終息、しかしコンゴ民主共和国では感染者数増加続く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に死亡者数の多いエボラ流行が拡大継続中であり、死者2,700人超・感染者5,600人超と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的な資金支援要請も出ているためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでの流行は封じ込め努力を上回るペースで拡大中であり、WHOは3000万ドルの緊急資金支援を要請している。ウイルスの変異は確認されていないが、感染規模は史上2番目に深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Ugandan Ebola teams safe, to open more DRC treatment
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo: Ugandan health teams deployed to Ituri Province and North Kivu's Butembo remain safe and actively treating patients and testing samples as part of the bilateral outbreak response. Uganda's permanent secretary Dr Diana Atwine, speaking August 26, 2026, said teams are operating safely, treating patients, testing, and conducting public-health education to shift community attitudes that previously questioned Ebola and care-seeking. Uganda plans to expand treatment capacity with a third centre in Ituri and another in Butembo, bringing to four the number of Ugandan-supported facilities in DRC, per President Museveni's directive. The expansion comes as Uganda's own Ebola outbreak has officially ended after a 42‑day period with no new confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 保健:ウガンダのエボラ対応チームは安全に活動中、コンゴ民主共和国での治療施設をさらに開設へ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での進行中のエボラ出血熱流行に対し、ウガンダが越境支援を行っており、既に自国でも流行が発生した経緯があるため、重篤性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境的な対応活動が行われている点は評価に反映した。

article.articleHeadline: Pacientes temem contrair dengue dentro de unidade médica em Goiânia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients fear contracting dengue fever inside a medical facility in Goiânia.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever concerns in Goiânia, Brazil, center on the Ville de France Health Center in the Parque Atheneu area, where a large accumulation of debris—branches, dry leaves, and trash—in the internal parking area may foster Aedes aegypti breeding. The report notes ongoing municipal efforts to intensify vector control for Aedes aegypti in the capital, but candidates with suspected dengue could be exposed at the facility due to waste buildup near the building. No specific outbreak or case counts are provided; the piece emphasizes risk at the site and the need for improved cleaning and waste management to prevent mosquito breeding and protect patients and staff. Location: Goiânia, Goiás. Source: Nota Zero. Published 2026-08-27.

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 26

Authorities urge people aged 6 months to 59 years in the capital, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo to vaccinate. Vaccination coverage for 2026 first-dose MMR is 89.35% and second-dose 74.64%, both below the 95% target (2025: 94.2% and 84.5%). article.articleHeadline: Uganda vence al ébola tras 42 días sin contagios pero el brote continúa en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Beats Ebola After 42 Days Without Infections, but the Outbreak Continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Uganda was declared Ebola-free by the WHO after 42 days with no new infections, marking the end of the Ugandan cluster. The last confirmed case, an imported infection, was discharged July 16, 2026; Uganda recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths, with most cases linked to cross-border travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The DRC continues to fight the outbreak that began May 15, with over 5,600 lab-confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths, the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. Ituri province remains the epicenter, with spread into North Kivu. Attacks on humanitarian workers in Ituri, Alto Uele, and Beni have injured 12 volunteers and damaged ambulances and equipment across 11 incidents, hindering containment. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of symptomatic individuals; current case fatality rate is about 55–60%. Imported cases remain possible; community engagement and rapid response are essential.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、42日間感染なしでエボラを制圧するも、コンゴ民主共和国では流行が継続
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が継続し、致死率55-60%、死者2,700人超、人道支援者への攻撃により対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHOによりエボラ終息宣言が出されたが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでは流行が継続中であり、国境を越えた感染例（ウガンダへの輸出）も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS declara fin brote ébola Uganda tras días sin nuevos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda after days with no new cases.
article.articleSummary: Uganda is declared Ebola-free by the World Health Organization after 42 days without any new confirmed cases, marking the end of an outbreak that began May 15, 2026. The Uganda outbreak totaled 20 Ebola cases, with two deaths, largely among travelers from neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The last imported patient was discharged July 16, 2026, with no transmission linked to that case. Across the border, DRC has reported over 5,600 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths, described as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date. The WHO credited Uganda's government, healthcare workers, and partners for robust containment measures to prevent wider spread. Ebola transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、新規感染者ゼロが続いたウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 見出しはウガンダの流行終息宣言だが、記事本文では隣国DRCで5,600人超の感染者・2,700人超の死者を出す「史上最速拡大」のエボラ流行が継続中であることが判明し、IHR基準を複数満たす重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にはウガンダも含まれるが、ウガンダの流行はWHOにより終息宣言済みであり、対象国リストにも含まれない。一方DRCは対象国であり、記事内で5,600人超の感染・2,700人超の死亡という深刻かつ継続中の流行として明記されているため、DRCを主対象としてPICKUP判定とした。
