article.articleHeadline: Kolkata Doctors Treat Rare H1N1-Induced Acute Pancreatitis In 6-Year-Old Jharkhand Girl
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old girl from Jharkhand with influenza A(H1N1) infection developed rare extrapulmonary complications: acute pancreatitis and macrophage activation syndrome (MAS). After about two weeks of unresolved high fever in Jharkhand, she was transferred to Kolkata's Peerless Hospital on July 31 in critical condition with abdominal pain and mild respiratory distress. Laboratory and clinical assessment linked H1N1 to pancreatic inflammation and MAS, a dangerous hyperinflammatory state. Treatment included high-flow nasal cannula for five days, oral oseltamivir, high-dose intravenous immunoglobulin for two days, hydration, and early enteral feeding to prevent bacterial translocation. Fever resolved and inflammatory markers improved; after 12 days in the PICU she was discharged to return home to Jharkhand. This case underscores that influenza may cause rare complications like pancreatitis and MAS in children, beyond respiratory illness, in India.

triage.headline_ja: コルカタの医師ら、6歳のジャールカンド州出身の女児に稀なH1N1誘発性急性膵炎を確認・治療
triage.triage_reason: 単一患児の臨床症例報告であり、H1N1インフルエンザの稀な合併症（膵炎・MAS）に関する医学的知見にとどまる。アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一小児患者のH1N1に伴う稀な合併症（急性膵炎・マクロファージ活性化症候群）に関する臨床報告であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。severityはこの患児個人の重症度を反映したもので、集団的な公衆衛生シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: número de casos sobe para 26 em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: number of cases rises to 26 in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state reach 26 for 2026, with 23 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Three new capital cases involve unvaccinated individuals: two children under 1 and a woman in her 30s. Of 26, 19 are in people without vaccination or with incomplete schedules. The health department notes two imported cases and 24 linked to them. State vaccination coverage for the measles-containing vaccine is 89.35% (first dose) and 74.64% (second dose); the 95% target for each dose remains unmet. PAHO records the Americas' largest measles outbreak in two decades: 51,027 cases and 55 deaths through Aug 24. Free vaccination is offered in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo for ages 6 months–59 years, with dosing: Dose zero for 6–11 months; D1 at 12 months; D2 at 15 months (MMR or MMR+Varicella); 5–29 and 30–59-year groups follow two-dose schedules with 30 days between doses.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロ州で症例数が26人に増加
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で未接種者を中心に麻疹症例が拡大しており、南米全体で過去20年最大の麻疹流行（5万人超・死亡55人）の一部を成す。ワクチン接種率が目標未達であり社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州の麻疹症例増加に関するもので、PAHOによる米州地域全体の大規模流行（5万人超、死亡55人）の文脈でも言及されている。輸入症例2件が報告され国際的な感染源との関連が示唆されるが、重症度（死亡・入院）の詳細は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Vitória realiza ação integrada de prevenção e combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Vitória carries out an integrated prevention and control action against Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Integrated action in Santa Vitória, Minas Gerais, on 2026-08-27 united Municipal Health Surveillance, Endemic Disease Control Center, Public Works, Social Development Secretariat, CRAS, and CAPS to promote cleaning, guidance, and preventive health care at a local property. The goal is to eradicate Aedes aegypti breeding sites and curb transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. The effort highlights proper property maintenance and active population participation in vector control. Municipal Health Surveillance continues to operate across the municipality and accepts reports of health risks. This cross-sector collaboration aims to broaden prevention, safeguard spaces, and protect community health through integrated public health actions. No case counts are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: サンタ・ヴィトーリアがネッタイシマカ対策の統合的な予防・駆除活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング・チクングニア・ジカ熱の予防を目的とした通常の蚊媒介対策活動であり、症例数の報告や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政による日常的な蚊対策活動の報告であり、症例数や異常発生に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: CEPI backs push to bring Egyptian biotech's Ebola vaccine into clinic to curb fast-growing outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-27, CEPI committed up to $16.5 million to advance Minapharm's Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine candidate into the clinic to curb the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, which has caused more than 2,700 deaths, mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Egyptian company, via Berlin-based ProBioGen, is developing a vaccine based on the Modified Vaccinia Ankara platform; a similar approach has shown long-term immunity against Zaire ebolavirus. CEPI funds support preclinical work and an early-stage trial in Africa to assess safety and immunogenicity. Minapharm's candidate is the fifth Bundibugyo-specific vaccine backed by CEPI. Other backed approaches include viral vectors (VSV and ChAdOx) and Moderna's mRNA effort. CEPI aims to secure Africa-based phase 1 trial capacity to bolster regional participation and address past site-reliance.

triage.headline_ja: CEPIがエジプトのバイオ企業によるエボラワクチンの臨床試験入りを支援、急速拡大するアウトブレイクの抑制を目指す
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブジョ株エボラのアウトブレイクが既に2,700人以上の死者を出しており、DRCで進行中の深刻な公衆衛生上の危機であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発支援に関するものだが、その背景にあるブンディブジョエボラのアウトブレイク自体が2,700人以上の死者を出す大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、DRCが主要発生地。エジプト・ドイツは企業拠点であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Grupul farmaceutic egiptean Minapharm va dezvolta un vaccin-candidat împotriva virusului Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Egyptian pharmaceutical group Minapharm will develop a candidate vaccine against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-27, Egyptian drug maker Minapharm announced plans to develop a candidate vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The vaccine, designed by ProBioGen in Berlin and part of Minapharm, will receive up to $16.5 million from CEPI to advance preclinical work and launch a Phase 1 trial to assess safety and immunogenicity in Africa. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15 and spreading to six provinces, has surpassed 5,650 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo. CEPI backs other candidates using mRNA (Moderna), ChAdOx (Oxford/Serum Institute of India), and rVSV (Hilleman Labs/Public Health Vaccines). The WHO has recommended a Phase 3 trial of Ervebo for Zaire Ebola, though its efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven.

triage.headline_ja: エジプトの製薬グループMinapharm、エボラウイルスに対する候補ワクチンを開発へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行は確定例5,650件超、死亡者2,700人超と規模が大きく、6州に拡大し公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性を示しており、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行に対するワクチン開発（CEPI資金支援、Minapharm/ProBioGen）に関するもの。ドイツ（ベルリン）・エジプトはワクチン開発拠点であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 26 - Tribuna do Norte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms three new measles cases; total reaches 26.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 27, 2026, São Paulo state reports three new measles cases in the capital, bringing 2026 total to 26. Cases involve two infants under 1 (a boy and a girl) and a woman in her 30s, none with vaccination histories. Of the 26, 23 are residents of São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Two cases are imported; others are linked to importation, though infection sources are unknown for some. Nineteen patients had no vaccination or incomplete vaccination. First-dose MMR coverage in the state is 89.35%; second-dose 74.64%, both below the 95% target. In 2025, first-dose coverage was 94.2% and second 84.5%. A Multivaccination Campaign runs in 645 municipalities through Sept 1 to update vaccination records for under-15s. On Dia D (Sat 22), preliminary CVE-SP data show over 600,000 vaccine doses administered statewide.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹3例増、累計26例に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹のワクチン接種率低下による国内発生が継続しているが、重症例・死亡・国際的拡大の報告はなく、州政府による対応（多回接種キャンペーン）が既に進行中であるため、フルRRAへの即時移行は不要と判断。今後の拡大傾向を注視する。
triage.notes: ワクチン接種率が目標(95%)を下回り(1回目89.35%、2回目74.64%)、輸入例を含む麻疹症例が継続増加中。州が多回接種キャンペーンを実施し600,000回超の接種を実施済みで、既に対応が進んでいる。死亡・重症例の報告はなく、国際的拡大の兆候もないため現時点ではWATCHとする。

article.articleHeadline: نداء عاجل من الأمم المتحدة لمواجهة أكبر وباء للإيبولا، وتحذير من لامبالاة المجتمع الدولي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An urgent appeal from the United Nations to confront the world's largest Ebola outbreak, and a warning against the international community's indifference.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is described as the fastest-growing in history, with 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths reported by August 25, and about 500 new infections weekly, spreading across large areas and disproportionately affecting women and children. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres issued an urgent funding appeal, launching a 2.13 billion USD response plan. About 80 million USD has been allocated to UN partners, with the United States as a major contributor, yet current resources could run out within weeks without more funding; a request for 1.1 billion USD to fully finance the plan was made. The UN has appointed a high-level Ebola coordinator and focuses on five priorities: expand community engagement to build trust; strengthen surveillance and rapid case finding; increase treatment and care capacity; expand safe and dignified burials; and curb transmission. The outbreak is occurring amid conflict in Ituri, with 12 million people needing humanitarian assistance and protection, underscoring fragile health systems in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、史上最大規模のエボラ流行への対応を緊急要請 国際社会の無関心に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、致死率の高い大規模アウトブレイクで国際的な資金支援要請も出ており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 米国は資金提供国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。コンゴ・イトゥリ州での紛争下でのアウトブレイクであり、医療インフラの脆弱性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Mayotte: visite de la ministre de la Santé au centre hospitalier, où on se prépare à d'éventuels cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mayotte: Health Minister's visit to the hospital center, where preparations are underway for potential Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Mayotte has no Ebola cases yet, but Mamoudzou's hospital center is preparing for potential cases. A negative-pressure isolation room enables confinement of symptomatic patients. Anyone returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing, is screened by a questionnaire. If the answer is 'yes' and the exposure is within 21 days, an alert chain activates: patients wear masks, are isolated, and undergo a full interview, in their native language if needed; a blood sample is sent to Lyon for testing while confinement continues. Initial capacity allows three patients, with plans to expand to thirty. Health Minister Stéphanie Rist welcomes the steps, noting the WHO still classifies the risk as very low but mentions preventive treatment under an international study; vaccine effectiveness remains under study. Infectious disease expert Mamadou Niang says the center is prepared to admit a suspected Ebola patient.

triage.headline_ja: マヨット：健康大臣が病院を視察、エボラ出血熱の潜在的な症例に備える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関連し、フランス領マヨットで疑い患者受け入れ体制が整備されており、保健大臣が視察するなど政府の関心が高い。国際的拡大への警戒事案としてフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: マヨット自体には症例なし。実際のエボラ発生地はDRCであり、記事はマヨット（フランス領）での帰国者スクリーニングと病院準備体制について報じている。マヨット・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOはリスクを『非常に低い』と評価している旨も記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: 42天未有新病例 世卫宣布乌干达伊波拉疫情结束
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Uganda's Ebola outbreak over after 42 days with no new cases.
article.articleSummary: WHO declares Uganda's Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak over after 42 days with no new laboratory-confirmed cases. The outbreak began May 15 in Uganda and involved 20 laboratory-confirmed cases, including 15 imported from eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and 5 local transmissions, with 2 deaths. The last patient completed treatment on July 16, and Uganda then recorded 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases, a period twice the Ebola incubation window, enabling the end-of-outbreak declaration. Uganda, with international partners, implemented strong government leadership and measures: case finding and diagnosis, contact tracing, isolation and clinical care, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and enhanced surveillance at health facilities and border entry points. The imported cases underscore cross-border transmission; containment was achieved domestically through rapid response and coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 42日間新規感染者なし、WHOがウガンダのエボラ流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行は既に終息宣言済みであり、新規感染者もなく公衆衛生上の脅威は解消されているため、新規シグナルとしての対応は不要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのエボラ流行終息宣言に関するもの。DRC東部からの輸入例が言及されているが、DRC国内でのアウトブレイク発生を主題としていないため対象外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情快速扩散 古特雷斯呼吁加大应对力度
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads rapidly; Guterres calls for stepping up the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, described by UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres as the fastest-growing and largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history. As of August 24, 2026, 5,656 Ebola cases and 2,715 deaths have been confirmed, with roughly 500 new cases weekly. The outbreak persists in a highly fragile context; in Ituri Province, three decades of conflict have displaced about 1 million people and severely limited access to food, health care, and other services. The region now has more than 12 million people in need of humanitarian assistance and protection. Frontline health workers face high risks, with over 40 killed and others infected; treatment centers and ambulances have been attacked. The UN humanitarian appeal totals $2.13 billion, with only 48% funded; about $1.1 billion remains to expand health services, surveillance, logistics, and protective actions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大、グテーレス事務総長が対応強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大・最速拡大のエボラ出血熱流行であり、死者2,715人・症例5,656人、週約500人の新規感染が確認され、国際的な人道支援要請も出ているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 紛争・避難民問題による医療アクセス制限、医療従事者への攻撃（40人以上死亡）など複合的危機。人道支援必要額21.3億ドルのうち48%のみ資金確保済み。国際的な渡航制限の有無は記事内に明示なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo avança em São Paulo com 26 casos confirmados e governo amplia vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles spreads in São Paulo with 26 confirmed cases and the government expands vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, São Paulo state reports 26 confirmed measles cases in 2026, with 23 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. The affected include two children under one year and a 30-year-old woman; 19 patients had no vaccination or incomplete immunization history. In response, the state government expanded a free vaccination campaign through September 1, focusing on the capital, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, targeting people aged 6 months to 59 years regardless of prior vaccination. Vaccines are available at all Basic Health Units. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, and lasting sequelae; vaccination remains the sole effective prevention. Authorities stress improving vaccination coverage to curb transmission in the densely populated metropolitan area.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで麻疹が拡大、確定26例に達し政府がワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹の確定例が26件に拡大し、未接種者が多いことから流行しやすさが高く、政府がワクチン接種を強化するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州内の複数都市（サンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ）で麻疹の確定例が拡大しており、ワクチン未接種者が多いことが感染拡大の主因とされる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: Feevale promove I Congresso de Virologia Animal e Doenças Infecciosas - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feevale hosts the 1st Congress of Animal Virology and Infectious Diseases - O Sul Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Feevale hosts the first Congress of Animal Virology and Infectious Diseases on September 11–12, 2026, at the Salão de Atos, Campus II, Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Registration is free at feev.as/108d6f1, with a donation of 1 kg of animal feed requested to emphasize the event's community focus. The gathering will bring researchers, professionals, and students to discuss advances and challenges in infectious diseases of animal origin under the One Health framework. Program highlights include: Day 1—viral vaccines, viral diversity in wild felids, Senecavirus A in pigs, swine influenza challenges, diagnostic platforms for new viruses, and diseases in free-living animals; followed by a One Health–biodiversity and bats roundtable. Day 2—viruses in foods (FAO), viral surveillance and next-generation sequencing, animal papillomatosis, and metagenomic virus markers of fecal contamination in Brazilian watersheds. Organized by Proppex and Feevale's Virology master's program, with Fapergs, Capes, and CNPq support; contact Gisele Flores.

triage.headline_ja: Feevaleが第1回動物ウイルス学・感染症会議を開催 - オ・スル紙
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、学術会議（動物ウイルス学に関する学会イベント）の告知記事であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の豚インフルエンザ発生事例を報じたものではなく、学会（動物ウイルス学・感染症会議）の開催告知であるため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo chega a 26 casos de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 26 measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo state reaches 26 cases in 2026, including a boy and a girl under one year old and a 30-year-old woman. Of all measles cases in the state, 23 were registered in the capital, two in São Bernardo do Campo, and one in Guarulhos, all in the Greater São Paulo area. Nineteen infected individuals had no vaccination or an incomplete immunization schedule. A vaccination campaign runs through September 1 to curb transmission. In the capital city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, vaccination is offered to people aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history. The update highlights ongoing measles transmission linked to gaps in vaccination coverage within metropolitan clusters, prompting public health campaign efforts to close immunity gaps and protect vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の麻疹感染者が26人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の散発的な集積が予防接種率の低さと関連して継続しているが、症例数は限定的で国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生危機を示す情報はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州大都市圏（州都、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルドドカンポ）での麻疹クラスターで、未接種者が多数。地方自治体主導のワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施中であり、現時点では管理可能な規模と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo chega a 26 casos confirmados em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 26 confirmed cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state reaches 26 confirmed cases in 2026 as of Aug 27, with 3 new infections in the city of São Paulo, all unvaccinated. The latest cases include two children under one year (a boy and a girl) and a 30-year-old woman. São Paulo city accounts for 23 cases; the Metropolitana region has two in São Bernardo do Campo and one in Guarulhos. A majority (19) of the infected had not received vaccination or had incomplete immunization. Authorities launched an extraordinary vaccination campaign through Sept 1, offering free measles vaccine to individuals 6 months to 59 years old in the capital, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, irrespective of prior doses. People in the target group should visit the nearest Basic Health Unit to protect themselves and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の確定患者が26例に到達
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生が確認され未接種者中心に拡大しているが、規模は限定的で国際的拡大の兆候はなく、続報の注視が適切。
triage.notes: 当局が緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施しており、地域内での対応が進行中。未接種者による感染拡大が継続するリスクがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: राजधानी में बढ़ने लगे डेंगू के मामले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases on the rise in the capital.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, dengue cases are rising in Patna, the capital, with four new infections confirmed in the last 24 hours, bringing the total to 156. Government hospitals: 76 cases; private hospitals: 62; laboratories: 18. In response, the health department urges intensified surveillance and vector control, with the Patna Civil Surgeon directing hospitals to flag fever cases and upload confirmed dengue on the central portal, while nearby areas undergo mosquito-control measures. Anti-larvae spraying, fogging, and breeding-site identification proceed in waterlogged zones by health officials and the municipal teams. Key drivers include post-monsoon rainfall and stagnant water in coolers, planters, tires, and debris, especially in dense areas. Dr Govind Kumar of IGIMS notes four dengue serotypes; infection with a different serotype raises risks of severe dengue. Aedes aegypti bites predominantly by day; prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, wearing long sleeves, and using repellents.

triage.headline_ja: 州都で増加するデング熱の症例
triage.triage_reason: インドのビハール州パトナで季節性デング熱の症例が増加しているが、規模は限定的で例年の流行パターンの範囲内とみられ、当局が対応中であることから継続監視とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はモンスーン後にインドで季節的に流行する疾病であり、今回の156例という規模は地域内で対応可能とみられる。重症例・死亡例の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू को लेकर रिम्स अलर्ट, कॉटेज ग्राउंड फ्लोर मरीजों के लिए रिजर्व rims on alert regarding swine flu ground floor of the cottage block reserved fo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RIMS on alert regarding swine flu; ground floor of the Cottage Block reserved for patients.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the ground floor of the Cottage Block at Ranchi's Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) is reserved for swine flu patients, with 10 beds and additional beds in the isolation ward. No swine flu patient is admitted currently; infected patients will be admitted to the designated area if needed. Testing, medicines, and other essential treatments are available at RIMS. The ground-floor reservation will not affect the first-floor paying ward. The primary aim is to prevent transmission to other patients, relatives, and health workers, with monitoring and treatment provided as needed. Recently, children in the capital have shown increased Influenza A (swine flu)–like symptoms; pediatric OPDs at RIMS and Sadar Hospital are reporting such cases, prompting preemptive preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザに関してRIMSが警戒態勢、コテージ棟の1階を患者用に確保
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で豚インフルエンザ患者の入院はなく予防的準備の段階だが、小児における季節性インフルエンザA様症状の増加が報告されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はランチーの病院（RIMS）が季節性の豚インフルエンザ（Influenza A）流行に備えた予防的措置を報じたもの。現時点で確定患者はゼロであり、小児のインフルエンザ様症状増加についても詳細（症例数・重症度）は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Έρχεται rapid test για τον ιό του Δυτικού Νείλου - Νέα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rapid test for the West Nile virus is coming — new cases.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus remains in active transmission in Greece, with the Athenian Attica region bearing a particularly high burden. From the start of 2026 through 26 August, Greece has diagnosed 232 cases, 165 with central nervous system involvement (encephalitis, meningitis, or acute flaccid paralysis) and 67 with milder or no CNS symptoms. In the past week alone, 75 new cases were reported. There have been 19 deaths in patients aged over 65 during 2026 up to 26 August. A Greek-led team from EKPA Medical School is developing a rapid diagnostic test to detect West Nile virus from one drop of blood in under an hour; expected results within about two years. The project involves Greece, Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil, with University of Athens’ Professor Maria Gazouli leading the Greek effort.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルスの迅速検査が登場へ ― 新規感染例
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャで西ナイルウイルスの活発な流行が続き、232例中165例が中枢神経系症状を伴い、19例の死亡が報告されている。重症度と継続的な媒介動物への曝露があり、メディアの関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本イベントはギリシャ（Attica地域）を中心とした西ナイルウイルスの季節的流行であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。Brazilは迅速診断キット開発の国際共同研究チームの一員として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Agosto Verde-Claro alerta para prevenção da leishmaniose - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Light Green August Alerts for Leishmaniasis Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis (VL) and cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL) remain public health concerns in Brazil, with Araguaína reporting 6 VL and 5 CL cases from January through July. Transmission is via sandflies, which can bite dogs and transmit parasites to humans. Prevention emphasizes vector control and animal health: keep domestic yards clean to reduce sandfly presence and ensure canine health to prevent exposure. Clinicians should seek prompt evaluation for prolonged fever, weight loss, and pallor consistent with VL, and early diagnosis and treatment. For CL, avoid wooded areas when possible; if exposure is necessary, apply repellent and wear long sleeves and pants. Skin lesions that heal slowly may indicate CL. The Agosto Verde-Claro (Light Green August) campaign aims to heighten awareness of transmission, prevention, and the importance of early diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 「ライトグリーン8月」キャンペーン、リーシュマニア症予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アラグアイナ市における例年の啓発キャンペーン記事であり、症例数（VL6件、CL5件）は特段の異常増加を示さず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 風媒介（サシチョウバエ）を介した地域流行性疾患の予防啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。地方保健当局による通常の季節的注意喚起の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Nepal Flood Survivors Face a Second Health Emergency as Damaged Water Systems Raise Waterborne Disease Risk
article.articleSummary: Flash flood from the Bhotekoshi River on Aug 26, around 9 a.m., swept Timure and Syabrubesi in Nepal’s Rasuwa district, downstream toward the Trishuli, triggering alerts in Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Chitwan. Bridges, markets and hydropower were damaged; power and communications collapsed, hampering water treatment and sanitation and raising risk of waterborne illnesses. Contaminated drinking water can cause diarrhea, cholera, typhoid, and other GI infections; dehydration is a major threat for children and older adults. Standing water may boost dengue later; leptospirosis and skin/wound infections are risks; crowded shelters raise respiratory infections. Routine care interrupted for TB, HIV, diabetes, hypertension; dialysis and insulin-dependent patients face danger; pregnant women risk delivery disruption. Casualty counts vary: Nepal at least 95 dead; Chinese media 3 on the Tibetan side; CNN >160 across both countries; at least 384 missing. No outbreak confirmed yet; cause under investigation. Relief emphasizes shelter and hygiene; access remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: ネパール洪水被災者、水系統の損壊により水系感染症リスクという第二の健康危機に直面
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による水・衛生システム損壊で水系感染症（コレラ・腸チフス等）や既往症患者への影響リスクが指摘されているが、現時点でアウトブレイクは未確認であり続報を要する。
triage.notes: 主要被災地はネパール（対象国リストに含まれず）だが、中国メディアによりチベット自治区側でも死者3名が報告されており、洪水影響が中国側にも及んでいるためChinaのみ記載。感染症アウトブレイクは未確認で、水系感染症・呼吸器感染症・慢性疾患管理の中断リスクが懸念される段階。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda declares end to Ebola outbreak after 42 days without a new case
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared the end of its Ebola outbreak after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed case. The last patient was discharged on 16 July 2026, with local transmission interrupted on 28 July after 42 days without a locally acquired case. Uganda reported 20 confirmed Ebola cases caused by the Bundibugyo virus: 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 5 locally acquired among contacts and health workers linked to imported cases. Eighteen people recovered and two died; more than 800 contacts were identified and monitored. Containment resulted from case detection, confirmation, contact tracing, isolation and clinical care, along with strengthened infection prevention and control, community engagement, and surveillance at facilities and entry points. WHO and Africa CDC praised the response; ongoing outbreak in DRC keeps cross-border risk. No travel restrictions; emphasis on surveillance, preparedness, and cross-border collaboration under a joint continental plan.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、42日間新規感染者なしでエボラ流行の終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行は終息したが、感染源であるDRCでの流行が継続中であり越境リスクが残るため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ流行終息宣言だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。輸入元であり継続流行中のDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。渡航制限はなく、WHO/Africa CDCも対応を評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Крупнейшая в истории Конго вспышка лихорадки Эбола продолжает набирать обороты
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The largest Ebola outbreak in Congo's history continues to gain momentum.
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus shows no new cases since 21 June 2026. The last patient was discharged 16 July after two negative tests, with a mandatory 42-day enhanced surveillance ending 27 August to determine official completion. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the epidemic persists: as of 25 August, 5,656 confirmed cases and 2,715 deaths; 792 patients in hospital isolation. Between 24–25 August, 72 new cases and 35 deaths were reported. Ituri province is hardest hit (4,716 cases, 2,119 deaths) across 28 of 36 health zones; 1,245 recovered and 80.9% of contacts under surveillance. This is the largest outbreak in Congo’s history; therapies exist only for Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo. Earlier, imported cases reached the U.S., Germany, and France via evacuated humanitarian workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ史上最大のエボラ出血熱流行が拡大を続けている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、致死率も高く、既に米・独・仏へ輸入例が発生しており国際的拡大リスクが高いため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダのブンディブジョ株流行は新規例なく終息傾向。コンゴの流行が本記事の主題であり、史上最大規模・高致死率・国際輸入例（米・独・仏）を伴う点で緊急性が高い。米・独・仏・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: UPDATED: Egypt's Minapharm gets up to $16.5 mln to develop Ebola vaccine - Health - Egypt
article.articleSummary: Egypt-based Minapharm Group secured up to $16.5 million from CEPI to advance an experimental Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine, advancing from preclinical work to a Phase 1 trial in Africa. The Berlin-based ProBioGen MVA-CR19 platform uses a weakened vaccinia vector to deliver Ebola antigens and elicit B-cell and T-cell responses; if safe and immunogenic, CEPI may support larger trials for emergency-use authorization and licensing. The program coincides with the Democratic Republic of Congo’s largest Bundibugyo virus outbreak on record; WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in May as cases expanded from Ituri to five provinces and dozens of health zones. By 30 July, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths; by late August deaths exceed 2,500. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; care is supportive. Active substance produced in Germany, then sent to Cairo, with potential full manufacturing in Egypt. CEPI aims to advance at least two Bundibugyo vaccines to authorization.

triage.headline_ja: 更新：エジプトのMinapharm社、エボラワクチン開発のため最大1650万ドルを獲得 - 保健 - エジプト
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン開発ニュースだが、背景としてDRCで史上最大規模のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行（確定例3,605、死者2,500人超）とWHOによるPHEIC宣言に言及しており、進行中の重大な公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: 記事本文の主題はエジプトMinapharm社によるエボラワクチン開発資金獲得だが、その背景としてDRCで進行中の史上最大規模のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行（WHOがPHEICを宣言済み、死者2,500人超）が述べられている。既にPHEIC宣言済みの既知イベントである可能性が高いが、続報や関連動向として注視すべき。エジプト・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Two Airport Workers Die Of Malaria In Frankfurt, Germany, After Mosquito Stows Away On Aircraft
article.articleSummary: Two Frankfurt Airport workers have died of Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Germany, linked to an Anopheles mosquito that stowed away on an aircraft. The four workers fell ill between July 4–6, and authorities identify an imported, aircraft-transported mosquito as the most likely source; all involved had no recent travel to malaria-endemic areas. This remains a rare instance of “airport malaria” in non-endemic settings. Malaria can be deadly if untreated, and early symptoms (fever, headache, chills) can delay diagnosis when travel history is absent. The public risk is deemed very low; blood analyses are underway to determine whether one or multiple bites occurred. Past Frankfurt cases (2022–2023) and a 2024 Eurosurveillance study suggesting Ghana as a parasite origin emphasize imported disease risks. Globally, malaria kills hundreds of thousands annually, but is preventable and curable with rapid treatment.

triage.headline_ja: フランクフルト空港職員2名、航空機に紛れ込んだ蚊によるマラリアで死亡（ドイツ）
triage.triage_reason: 事象はドイツ・フランクフルトで発生した稀な『空港マラリア』事例であり、対象国（ガーナ含む）での発生ではない。ガーナは寄生虫起源の推定として言及されたのみで、実際の発生地ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 発生国はドイツ（対象国リスト外）。ガーナは2024年の研究で寄生虫起源として言及されているだけで、実際の発症・感染発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。公衆リスクは低いとされ、人-人感染の可能性もないため対象国での監視対象としての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : au Nord-Kivu, près de sept malades sur dix meurent, et MSF ouvre un centre à Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: in North Kivu, nearly seven out of ten patients die, and MSF opens a center in Beni.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in North Kivu, DRC, reports 714 confirmed cases and 490 deaths as of 22 August (case-fatality ~68.6%). Nationally, MSF counts 5,514 confirmed cases and 2,642 deaths across six provinces (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, South-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo), describing the largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in the country. In Nord-Kivu, Beni and Butembo concentrate many infections; MSF and the Health Ministry opened a new Ebola treatment center in Beni to speed diagnosis, strengthen contact tracing, and support authorities. Albert Stern emphasizes that every hour counts; early diagnosis and treatment improve survival and reduce transmission. Attacks on health facilities (12 incidents per WHO) complicate response. MSF also notes non-Ebola health impacts, as fear and rumors deter care for malaria and maternal health. In Beni, four health centers operate with 18 isolation rooms (Kasabinyole expansion under construction). Bed capacity and case distribution within Nord-Kivu remain undetermined.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:北キヴュ州で患者の約7割が死亡、MSFがベニに治療センターを開設
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大・最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率約68.6%、全国で5,514例・2,642死亡という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数州への拡大や医療施設への攻撃など国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（北キヴュ、イトゥリ、南キヴュ、オート・ウエレ、バ・ウエレ、チョポ州）における進行中のエボラ流行を主題としており、対象国リストの中で該当するのはDRCのみ。マラリアへの間接的影響（恐怖・忌避による受診控え）も言及されているが、主要イベントはエボラ流行。

article.articleSummary: Ebola response shifts to Congo river network as of 2026-08-27. The excerpt provided does not include case or death counts, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or details for imported/exported cases. Background notes identify the author, Ben, based in South Africa and part of The Telegraph's Global Health Security team, with prior reporting in Kabul, London, and Islamabad. The article highlights logistical and strategic considerations for deploying responders via river routes in the Congo, but no specific outbreak data or timelines are included in the available text.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCでの継続的アウトブレイク対応の戦略転換（河川ルートでの遠隔地アクセス）はWPRO基準の複数項目（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当し、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo chega a 26 casos de sarampo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 26 measles cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, São Paulo State Health Secretariat confirms 26 measles cases in 2026. Three new infections reported in the capital, affecting a boy and a girl under one year, and a 30-year-old woman. Overall, 23 cases in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Nineteen of the infections involved individuals with no vaccination or incomplete vaccination. To curb transmission, a vaccination campaign runs until September 1, targeting residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, regardless of vaccination history. Vaccination is free at basic health units (UBSs).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年の麻疹症例が26件に
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン未接種者を中心とした麻疹の散発的増加が見られるが、重篤例や国際拡大の兆候はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: サンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポで発生。ワクチン未接種または接種不完全な人が19例と多く、地元保健当局によるワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施中。死亡・重症化の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Uasin Gishu strengthens Ebola preparedness amid high population movement
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-27, Uasin Gishu County conducted a training for health workers to strengthen preparedness against possible Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreaks. The exercise covers surveillance, infection prevention and control, case investigation, and coordination, with emphasis on swift, coordinated response. Public Health Emergency Operations Center Manager Jude Oduor highlighted the Incident Management System (IMS) for coordinating Ebola readiness, calling for clearly defined roles and effective communication to ensure suspected cases are identified, reported and managed promptly to prevent transmission. Officials noted Uasin Gishu's strategic position and high mobility: Eldoret hosts health facilities and serves as hub; the county's petroleum hub and Eldoret Central Market link to North Rift and to the Democratic Republic of Congo, increasing movement of patients, traders, and transporters. This mobility underscores the need for robust surveillance, early detection, and rapid response to minimize Ebola importation. The exercise is part of capacity-building for public health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: ワシンギシュ、人口移動の多さを受けてエボラ対策準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はケニア・ワシンギシュ郡における予防的なエボラ対策訓練の実施を報じるものであり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。対象国での確定・疑い症例の報告もない。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・ワシンギシュ郡の準備訓練に関する内容で、DRCとの人的移動リスクへの言及はあるが、DRCでの実際のエボラ発生を報告するものではない。対象国リストにケニアは含まれず、DRCについても実発生の記述がないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU pide USD 1.100 millones para combatir el ébola en RD Congo Ensegundos República Dominicana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN requests USD 1.1 billion to combat Ebola in DR Congo Ensegundos Dominican Republic
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres, on August 27, 2026, appealed for $1.1 billion to fund a response plan for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The plan costs $2.1 billion and has received a significant US contribution, but without additional funding vital operations will run out as the response expands. The program is 48% funded; current resources will last weeks, not months. The UN chief urged the remaining $1.1 billion, noting that further funding will be needed in the future. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been more than 5,600 confirmed Ebola cases in the DR Congo, with over 2,700 deaths. The epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no vaccines or treatments, marking the largest outbreak in DR Congo’s history.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策に11億ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、5600人超感染・2700人超死亡）が継続し、資金不足による対応縮小のリスクがあり、国際的関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による、DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行。資金不足により対応活動の継続が危ぶまれている。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle em aves de duas ilhas dos Açores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease in birds on two Azores islands.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease virus detected in wild birds on the Azores' Graciosa and Terceira islands, with laboratory confirmation as of 26 August 2026. Wild-bird mortality had been reported on Graciosa, Terceira, Pico, São Miguel, Santa Maria, and Faial, but current testing confirms the virus only on Graciosa and Terceira. Affected species are rock pigeons and turtle doves; other Faial samples tested negative to date. The disease poses a low risk to humans but warrants precautions. Following detection, the Azores regional government banned pigeon hunting and bird fairs; the ban on hunting the rock pigeon took effect on the subsequent Friday and remains in place indefinitely across all islands. No human cases reported, and no infection source or imported/exported cases are described.

triage.headline_ja: アゾレス諸島の2つの島の鳥にニューカッスル病
triage.triage_reason: ポルトガル領アゾレス諸島の野鳥におけるニューカッスル病であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）に該当しない。人への感染例もなく低リスク。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil（Santa Maria, Rio Grande do Sul）が含まれるが、これはアゾレス諸島の地名（Santa Maria島）との誤マッチと考えられ、記事の主題はポルトガル領アゾレス諸島の野鳥感染であり、ブラジルでの発生ではない。対象国リストに該当なしのためverified_locationsは空配列とした。人への感染例なし、疾病は野鳥（岩バト、キジバト）に限定され、動物衛生上の事案。

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Scare: Delhi Records 304 New Cases In 48 Hours, 835 In Last 7 Days, Total Cases Rise To 2,612
article.articleSummary: On 27 August 2026, Delhi reports 304 new swine flu (Influenza A) cases in 48 hours, with 166 in the last 24 hours, taking total swine flu cases to 2,612 and influenza-A cases to over 3,300. From 1,777 swine flu cases by 20 August, there is an uptick of 835 in seven days. Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) states the circulating virus is not a new strain and most infections are mild, urging vigilance rather than panic. The update indicates ongoing transmission within Delhi, though no fatalities are noted in this brief. The data highlight a rising trend in influenza-A infections, including H1N1, in the capital, underscoring the need for continued public health vigilance."}{
