article.articleHeadline: L'ONU demande plus d'un milliard de dollars d'aide pour lutter contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN seeks more than $1 billion in aid to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres appealed for $1.1 billion to complete the humanitarian response plan for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), bringing the total plan to $2.13 billion, 48% funded, largely by the United States. The outbreak, declared May 15 and now spreading across six provinces, has caused 2,744 deaths as of August 25. Ebola is transmitted via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this surge, though clinical trials are ongoing; about 70,000 doses of the Zaïre-strain vaccine Ervebo have been sent to the DRC to assess its impact against Bundibugyo. The UN warns resources will run out in weeks without more funding, and emphasizes both the health emergency and the 'virus of indifference' undermining the response. Over 12 million people need humanitarian aid.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス対策のため10億ドル超の追加支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6州に拡大するエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、死者2,744人、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、IHR基準複数・WPRO基準複数に該当し社会的関心も非常に高い。
triage.notes: 米国はワクチン供給・資金提供国として記載されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、既存のザイール株ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性評価が進行中である点が異常性・重症度の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Нас можуть вбити віруси, яким сотні тисяч років: вчені б'ють на сполох
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We can be killed by viruses that are hundreds of thousands of years old: scientists are sounding the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Ancient pathogens thawed from ice pose infection and biodiversity risks. Researchers cite revived bacteria from a Qinghai-Tibet Plateau ice core aged over 750,000 years (2003) and the giant Siberian permafrost virus Pithovirus sibericum (2014); a 2016 Western Siberia outbreak of Bacillus anthracis spores killed thousands of reindeer and sickened dozens of people. In digital risk modeling, Cory Bradshaw (Flinders University) and Giovanni Strona (Helsinki University) used the Avida software to simulate invasion of one ancient virus into modern host bacterial communities. Results: about 3% of simulations showed the ancient pathogen adapting and becoming dominant; worst-case scenarios reduced modern host populations by roughly 30% versus controls. With around four sextillion micro-organisms released from ice each year, even a tiny fraction of aggressive pathogens could trigger local or global crises, threatening biodiversity and potentially humanity. Most dangerous viruses, including SARS-CoV-2, Ebola, and HIV, reached humans via wildlife contact.

triage.headline_ja: 数十万年前のウイルスに殺される可能性がある：科学者が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は永久凍土から解放される古代病原体に関する理論的・シミュレーション研究の紹介であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、トリアージ対象としない。
triage.notes: 記事は2016年の西シベリア炭疽菌アウトブレイクや古代ウイルスに関する研究成果の紹介であり、現在進行中の感染症発生イベントではない。対象国（Bluedotが付与したオーストラリア、ロシア、フィンランド、中国）はいずれも本記事の主題国ではなく、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Нас могут убить вирусы, которым сотни тысяч лет: ученые бьют тревогу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viruses that are hundreds of thousands of years old could kill us: scientists warn.
article.articleSummary: Ancient pathogens thawed from ice pose ecological threats. In 2003, scientists revived bacteria from a Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau ice core older than 750,000 years; in 2014, the giant virus Pithovirus sibericum was recovered from Siberian permafrost, 30,000 years old; in 2016 thaw in Western Siberia triggered an anthrax outbreak (Bacillus anthracis), killing thousands of reindeer and infecting dozens of people. In a digital risk assessment, professors Corey Bradshaw (Flinders University) and Giovanni Strona (Helsinki University) used the Avida software to simulate the invasion of an ancient virus into modern bacterial host communities. About 3% of simulations showed successful adaptation and dominance; worst-case scenarios reduced host populations by up to 30%. Ice annually releases about four sextillion microorganisms; even small fractions could provoke crises, threatening humanity. The study did not assess human risk, but notes pathogens have entered humans via animals; a thawed virus could cross species barriers while retaining virulence.

triage.headline_ja: 私たちを殺しかねない数十万年前のウイルス：科学者が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代病原体の理論的・仮説的リスクに関する学術シミュレーション研究の紹介であり、現在進行中の実際の感染症発生事例を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2016年のシベリアでの炭疽菌流行歴史的事例や学術シミュレーション研究を紹介する科学解説記事であり、ロシアや中国で現在発生している感染症イベントではない。発生地域として付与されているRussian Federation・Chinaは対象国リストに含まれない（Chinaは対象国だが実際の発生事例ではないため除外）。現時点でのトリアージ対象としての緊急性はなく、DISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: مجموعة "مينافارم" الصيدلانية المصرية تطور لقاحا تجريبيا لسلالة بونديبوغيو من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minapharm Pharmaceutical Group develops an experimental vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Minapharm Pharmaceutical Group, an Egyptian firm, announced development of an experimental Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, in response to the Congo outbreak. The candidate vaccine, developed by ProBioGen (Minapharm’s Berlin-based unit), will receive about $16.5 million from CEPI to advance preclinical work and launch a Phase I trial to assess safety and immunogenicity, with the human study to be conducted in Africa. The Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, first declared May 15 and affecting six provinces, has reported over 2,700 deaths among more than 5,650 confirmed cases. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola yet. CEPI backs four other experimental vaccines against this strain. WHO has recommended a Phase III trial with Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) while Bundibugyo-focused vaccines await results. It remains unclear if the Minapharm candidate will protect humans; animal studies show partial protection. Africa CDC lauded the African-developed vaccine effort.

triage.headline_ja: エジプトの製薬会社ミナファーム、エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の実験的ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は6州に拡大し死者2,700人超・症例5,650人超と極めて重篤で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はワクチン開発だが、背景としてDRCで進行中の重篤なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が報告されている。エジプト・ドイツはワクチン開発企業の所在地であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Dans l'ombre d'Ebola, la flambée des cas de choléra inquiète l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: In the shadow of Ebola, the surge in cholera cases worries the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) eclipses the Ebola response with about 39,500 suspected cases and 1,173 deaths in 2026 (weeks 1–32), CFR 2.97%. Endemic provinces—North Kivu, South Kivu, Tanganyika, Haut-Katanga, Haut-Lomami—now report spread to non-endemic areas, where mortality is more than sixfold higher. In the week of Aug 3–9, 2026, 1,528 suspected cases and 29 deaths occurred across 70 health zones in 16 of 26 provinces. Over the last four weeks, non-endemic areas account for 2,012 cases and 162 deaths (CFR 8.05%), versus endemic areas with 3,442 cases and 45 deaths (CFR 1.31%). CFR is highest among children under 5 in non-endemic zones (8.49%). Hotspots include Sud-Kivu and Nord-Kivu; transmission also in Kwango, Mai-Ndombe, Sud-Ubangi, and Équateur. Re-emergence in Isangi (Tshopo) and Nyunzu (Tanganyika). Stockouts of Ringer’s lactate and rapid tests; fragile treatment centers, including a deteriorating center in Lubumbashi. OMS priorities: functional treatment facilities, enhanced surveillance, supply chains, water chlorination, disinfecting, and community outreach; conflict further hampers response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラの陰でコレラ症例の急増がWHOを懸念させる
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なコレラ流行(約39,500疑い例、死亡1,173例)が非流行地域へ拡大し致死率が急上昇しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラの急増がエボラ対応の陰で深刻化していることを主題としている。エクアドル(Ecuador)は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく除外。DRC国内の複数州（北・南キブ、タンガニカ、ハウトカタンガ、ハウトロマミ、クワンゴ、マインドンベ、南ウバンギ、エクアトゥール）で流行拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue ganha reforço com a instalação das EDLs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against dengue gets a boost with the installation of the EDLs.
article.articleSummary: Sixty Estações Disseminadoras de Larvicida (EDLs) are being installed in Lucas do Rio Verde, Mato Grosso, Brazil to combat Aedes aegypti. Initial deployment targets high-risk sites such as tire shops and scrap yards, designated as Strategic Points due to dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya risk. Each unit holds water and a larvicide-treated screen; the female mosquito spreads the chemical to other breeding sites, inhibiting egg development. The city was chosen based on ovitrampa data identifying hotspots. Last health bulletin (2–8 August) records 1,288 notifications this year, with 249 confirmed dengue and 132 pending results. A citywide cleanup has been under way since 7 August in Jardim Primaveras, Rio Verde, Veneza and Vida Nova, with plans to move to Fujii, Américas, Araras and Amazônia. Authorities emphasize community participation and care for the devices.

triage.headline_ja: EDL（幼虫殺虫剤拡散装置）の設置でデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地域における通常のデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱媒介蚊対策活動の報告であり、異常な増加や重篤化、国際的拡大の兆候は見られない定例的な公衆衛生活動。
triage.notes: 記事はMato Grosso州Lucas do Rio Verdeにおける蚊媒介感染症対策（幼虫殺虫剤拡散装置の設置）の日常的な取り組みを報じたものであり、症例数249件確定は通年発生数の範囲内で特筆すべき異常性は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: UN Chief Warns of Rapidly Growing Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is growing at an unprecedented rate, outpacing containment as of 27 August 2026. The DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, is mainly spreading in the north and east where weak health systems and ongoing armed conflict challenge response. Funding gaps hamper efforts, with more than USD 80 million allocated to UN response partners and a USD 2.13 billion UN response plan launched. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged greater international attention, political commitment and resources, stating the outbreak can be contained and lives saved. The statement highlights the humanitarian toll on families and communities in one of the world's most vulnerable settings.

triage.headline_ja: 国連事務総長、コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行に警告
triage.triage_reason: 国連事務総長が国際的な注意喚起を行うほど深刻化・拡大しているエボラ出血熱の流行であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行がDRC北部・東部で拡大中。武力衝突と医療体制の脆弱性により対応が困難。資金不足も深刻で、国連が20億ドル超の対応計画を発表。国際的な注目度・支援ニーズが高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Caravana da Malária: cinema móvel leva informações e prevenção da doença para escolas públicas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Caravan: Mobile Cinema Brings Information and Disease Prevention to Public Schools
article.articleSummary: Malaria Caravan operates a climate-controlled mobile cinema in public and municipal schools in Boa Vista, Brazil, to educate children and adolescents about malaria prevention. Each session screens a ~22-minute documentary in a classroom-sized vehicle with capacity for 40 students, covering the malaria mosquito, transmission, prevention, symptoms, and guidance on when to seek health care. The documentary clarifies that the malaria mosquito is not the same as the dengue mosquito, and emphasizes how to recognize symptoms and protect families and the community. Coordinated by Sharonn Mendes, the initiative offers an engaging, school-based approach that also distributes snacks (popcorn and soda) and is aligned with the academic calendar. Activities are documented and shared on social media. The program aims to raise awareness and knowledge among students, teachers, and the broader community.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア・キャラバン：移動映画館が公立学校で情報提供と病気予防を実施
triage.triage_reason: これは学校向けのマラリア予防教育キャンペーンに関する広報記事であり、実際の感染症発生や症例増加を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア予防の教育啓発活動（移動映画館プログラム）に関する内容であり、疫学的なアウトブレイク情報を含まない。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός του Δυτικού Νείλου: Rapid test ερευνά το Πανεπιστήμιο Αθηνών -Τι είπε στο iefimerida η καθ. Μαρία Γαζούλη
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus: Rapid test under investigation by the University of Athens — What Prof. Maria Gazouli told iefimerida.
article.articleSummary: Rapid test under investigation for West Nile virus in Greece as part of SURVIVE-VBD, a European Union EU4Health-funded project involving the University of Athens' Medical School led by Professor Maria Gazouli. The initiative follows rising West Nile virus activity in Greece and broader mosquito-borne threats in Europe, shaped by climate change and vectors. SURVIVE-VBD, starting 1 October 2026 and spanning three years, targets four mosquito-borne infections: West Nile virus, dengue fever, Zika, and chikungunya. It aims to develop a near-patient diagnostic platform using graphene-based biosensors to deliver results in under one hour from a small blood sample, combining direct viral detection with immune-response assessment. A parallel epidemiological surveillance component will integrate environmental, climate, and vector data with cases, using AI to identify high-risk areas and potential outbreaks. The Athens team will design the sensor, lead multicenter clinical studies, and evaluate about 400 clinical samples across Greece, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, Estonia, and Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス：アテネ大学が迅速検査を研究中 ― マリア・ガズーリ教授がiefimeridaに語る
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はEU資金による診断技術開発プロジェクト（SURVIVE-VBD）の紹介であり、具体的な感染症の発生・アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究開発（診断プラットフォーム開発）に関するニュースであり、疾病発生報告ではない。ブラジルは臨床サンプル評価対象国として言及されているが、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الأمين العام للأمم المتحدة يحذر من تسارع تفشي وباء إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Secretary-General Warns of Accelerating Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned on August 27, 2026, that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the fastest-growing in history, with spread intensifying. He cautioned that every funding gap makes containment harder, noting over $80 million has been allocated to UN partners and a comprehensive response plan costs $2.13 billion. The UN has launched this plan to meet needs and contain transmission, stating that while Ebola can be contained and lives saved, the “virus of indifference”—insufficient international attention and resources—remains a major obstacle. The DRC declared the seventeenth Ebola outbreak on May 15, though infections likely began weeks earlier. The focus is in the northern and eastern regions, areas with weak state presence, deteriorating health services, and ongoing armed conflict, which exacerbate the humanitarian crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 国連事務総長、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行の急速拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 国連事務総長が『史上最速の拡大』と警告するエボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスク・大規模な国際支援の必要性が明確であるためIHR基準複数該当と判断。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行（2026年5月15日宣言）で、北部・東部の武力紛争地域における脆弱な医療体制と資金不足が拡大要因とされる。国連は21.3億ドル規模の対応計画を発表しているが資金不足が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi: Health Minister reviews preparedness to deal with rising cases of H1N1
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Delhi reported 166 H1N1 cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the total in the national capital to 2,612. Delhi Health Minister Dr Pankaj Kumar Singh reviewed hospital and Health Department preparedness to manage rising H1N1 activity. He inspected the dedicated H1N1 isolation ward and evaluated arrangements for treatment and patient care, including bed availability, oxygen supply, medicines, fluids, testing capacity, and other essential medical infrastructure. During the visit, he interacted with doctors, healthcare workers, and patients and took stock of existing resources. The Minister emphasized close monitoring of preparedness across Delhi Government hospitals and underscored that all necessary measures are being implemented to handle the surge.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : L'ONU demande plus d'un milliard de dollars d'aide pour lutter contre le virus en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The UN requests more than one billion dollars in aid to fight the virus in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts UN Secretary-General António Guterres to seek $1.1 billion to complete the humanitarian response. The broader plan totals $2.13 billion and is 48% funded, with a major contribution from the United States. Declared on May 15, the outbreak has spread to six provinces and caused 2,744 deaths as of August 25, 2026, having already surpassed the death toll of the 2018-2020 eastern DRC outbreak within three months. Ebola is transmitted by contact with bodily fluids and causes a hemorrhagic fever. Without additional funding, essential operations will run short in weeks rather than months, the UN leader warned. The appeal aims to fully mobilize the remaining $1.1 billion to fund the response plan, with the expectation that further resources will be needed later.

article.articleHeadline: जयपुर में स्वाइन फ्लू को लेकर अलर्ट;बुखार-खांसी वालों के लिए विभाग की एडवाइजरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu alert in Jaipur; department advisory for those with fever and cough.
article.articleSummary: Jaipur reports rising Swine Flu (Influenza) cases, prompting a health department advisory. The guidance urges people with fever, cough, or sore throat to avoid crowded places, wear masks when needed, and cover the mouth and nose with a tissue, handkerchief, or elbow while coughing or sneezing. Frequent handwashing with soap and water is recommended; hand sanitizer can be used if necessary. Those with flu-like symptoms should stay away from crowds and maintain distance; mask use is advised when appropriate. Rest and adequate fluids are encouraged; seek medical advice and follow prescribed treatment, avoiding self-medication with antibiotics or antivirals. Vulnerable groups—children, elderly, pregnant women, and seriously ill individuals—face higher risk, and urgent care should be sought for breathing difficulties, persistent high fever, or severe weakness. Avoiding schools, offices, and other crowded places during illness helps limit spread.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性のスワインフル（H1N1）増加に対する自治体の予防的注意喚起であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報は不足しているが、動向は継続観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में H1N1 के 166 नए मामले आए, कुल संख्या 2,612 हुई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 166 new H1N1 cases reported in Delhi, total rises to 2,612.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 27, 2026, 166 new H1N1 (Swine Flu) cases were confirmed in Delhi in the last 24 hours, raising total H1N1 to 2,612 and Influenza A to 3,300 (up from 3,177). He urged residents not to panic and said doctors, nurses, lab technicians, and other staff are vigilant and treating patients. Senior health officials were instructed to ensure preparedness and rapid action if cases rise. Symptoms resemble seasonal flu; 138 H1N1 cases were reported in Delhi on Wednesday.

article.articleHeadline: ONU pide US$ 1.100 millones para combatir epidemia de ébola en República del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN appeals for US$1.1 billion to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on 27 August 2026 appealed for US$1.1 billion to fund the Ebola response plan in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The international program totals US$2.1 billion and is currently about 48% funded. Guterres warned that, without new contributions, resources could last only weeks, not months, risking the ability to expand operations. The outbreak, declared on 15 May, has recorded more than 5,600 confirmed cases and over 2,700 deaths in the DRC. It is linked to the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there are no vaccines or specific treatments at present, making it the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history. Additional funding aims to sustain and broaden measures to stop transmission and meet emergency needs, with US$1.1 billion covering immediate requirements; further funds may be needed as the epidemic evolves.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対策に11億米ドルの資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定患者5,600人超、死者2,700人超）が続き、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブジョ株が原因。国連が緊急資金11億ドルを要請しており、公衆衛生・社会的関心の両面で重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 史上最大のDRCエボラ流行で、資金不足が数週間以内に対応能力の限界を招く恐れがあると国連が警告。国際的拡大リスクは明記されていないが、規模・治療法の欠如から高リスクと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в ДР Конго: Генсек ООН призвал мир преодолеть "вирус безразличия"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: UN Secretary-General called on the world to overcome the 'virus of indifference'.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces its largest Ebola outbreak, the fastest-growing on record. By 25 August 2026, 5,713 cases and 2,744 deaths had been confirmed, with about 500 new cases weekly. Women and children are hardest hit; conflict in Ituri has driven displacement and strained health services. Over 40 health workers have been killed and facilities attacked. The response is led by the DRC government with WHO and partners; the UN has created a senior Ebola coordinator and is expanding cross-border readiness with South Sudan and the Central African Republic. A batch of Ebola-Zaire vaccines arrived to test efficacy against Bundibugyo virus. About $80 million has been spent of a $2.13 billion humanitarian plan (48%), with $1.1 billion more sought. Guterres called to overcome the 'virus of indifference' and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴで拡大：国連事務総長が「無関心のウイルス」を克服するよう世界に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで過去最大・最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率も高く、周辺国への越境拡大リスクや医療従事者襲撃等の管理困難要因が複数確認されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンは越境準備の文脈で言及されているが、実際の発生国はDRコンゴのみ。両国は対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Έρχεται rapid test για τον ιό του Δυτικού Νείλου
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rapid test for West Nile virus is coming
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus is surging across Europe, with Greece experiencing a notable 2026 burden. An international rapid diagnostic test is being developed by a Greek-led team at the University of Athens, headed by Professor Maria Gazouli, to detect West Nile virus from a single drop of blood in under one hour, using nanotechnology to target mosquito-borne infections. Participating countries include Greece, Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil. In Attica, 75 new cases were diagnosed in the last week; Greece has recorded 232 cases between the start of 2026 and August 26, with 165 CNS-related illnesses (encephalitis, meningitis, or acute flaccid paralysis) and 67 milder/non-CNS cases. There have been 19 deaths in 2026 among patients over 65 up to August 26. The test aims for results within two years and availability about three years from today.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイル熱ウイルスの迅速検査が開発中
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャで西ナイル熱の症例が急増し（2026年に232例、うち165例が中枢神経系疾患、19例死亡）、季節性ながら重症度が高く社会的関心も高いため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心ありとしてピックアップ対象とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントはギリシャ（アッティカ地方）を中心とした西ナイル熱の季節性流行であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）はいずれも発生地ではない。ブラジルは迅速診断キット開発への参加国として挙げられているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: بعد 20 إصابة ووفاتين.. أوغندا تعلن انتهاء تفشي إيبولا - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After 20 cases and two deaths... Uganda declares the end of the Ebola outbreak - The Week
article.articleSummary: Uganda declares the end of the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak after 42 consecutive days without a new confirmed case. From May 2026, the outbreak produced 20 confirmed infections and 2 deaths, with 18 recoveries. Fifteen cases were imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, while five were locally acquired among contacts and health workers linked to imported cases. The last patient was discharged on 16 July 2026, triggering a 42-day post-outbreak surveillance period. More than 800 contacts were monitored as part of case finding, contact tracing, isolation, and infection-prevention measures. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC praised Uganda’s rapid response and expanded surveillance. Although Uganda is Ebola-free, the Democratic Republic of Congo remains a source of concern, underscoring cross-border importation risk. No travel or trade restrictions were advised; emphasis remains on surveillance, diagnostics, border coordination, and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 20人の感染と2人の死亡後...ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の流行終息を宣言 - The Week
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの3項目に該当し、DRCからの越境輸入例が確認されているため、DRCにおける継続的リスクとしてフルリスク評価が推奨される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行終息が主題だが、感染源であるDRCでの継続的な感染リスクが強調されているため、DRCを発生国として記録。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UN seeks fresh $1.1bn to fight Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: UN appeals for an additional $1.1 billion to bolster the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing the overall plan to $2.1 billion. The outbreak, declared May 15, has recorded more than 5,600 confirmed cases and over 2,700 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak ever in the DRC. It is caused by the Bundibugyo species, for which there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments. Only about 48% of the $2.1 billion funding target has been funded, leaving a $1.1 billion gap that could run out in weeks and threaten critical operations. Challenges include community resistance and refusals to undergo testing, hampering surveillance. WHO and Africa CDC are intensifying containment, while the EU announced €2.5 million ($2.9 million) in testing kits. The 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC killed 2,299 people of 3,381 cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策に新たに11億ドルの追加資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最多の死者数（2,700人超）を記録する過去最悪規模のエボラ出血熱流行が継続し、資金不足により対応活動が危機的状況にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo種による流行であり、コミュニティの抵抗・検査拒否により監視活動が困難。資金ギャップ（11億ドル）が数週間で枯渇する恐れがあり、対応活動継続に重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: 古特雷斯：此次疫情是有记录以来蔓延速度最快的埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guterres: This Ebola outbreak is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, is the fastest-spreading on record. As of August 25, 2026, 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths have been reported, with about 500 new weekly cases. The crisis fuels a humanitarian toll: 1 million displaced in Ituri amid 30 years of conflict, and over 12 million in need of aid and protection. Health systems are overwhelmed; more than 40 health workers have died, and treatment centers and ambulances have been attacked. The United Nations, led by WHO, coordinates a response around five priorities: expand community engagement and trust; strengthen surveillance and rapid isolation; scale up treatment and care; widen safe and dignified burials; and halt transmission. Cross-border coordination with South Sudan and Central African Republic is intensified; $1.11 billion of a $2.13 billion plan remains unfunded, with 48% funded, including $80 million from Central Emergency Response Fund.

triage.headline_ja: グテーレス氏：この疫病は記録上最も速く拡大しているエボラ出血熱の流行である
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で史上最速拡大とされる大規模エボラ流行が進行中で、死者2,744人・確認例5,713人、国際的な人道危機・資金不足・国境を越えた拡大リスクを伴うため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンは越境協力の文脈で言及されているが、実際の感染発生地としては明記されておらず対象国リストにも南スーダンは含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外。中央アフリカ共和国も対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Genomic analysis of Echinococcus granulosus sensu stricto: genetic diversity and population structure
article.articleSummary: Genomic analysis of Echinococcus granulosus sensu stricto characterizes genetic diversity and population structure of the parasite. The work leverages genomic data to assess diversity across global populations. A multinational collaboration includes institutions in Australia, Estonia, China, Italy, Chile, Iran, Spain, Türkiye, Algeria, Brazil, Argentina, Armenia, Saudi Arabia, Slovakia, and other countries, reflecting broad geographic sampling. By focusing on genetic diversity and population structure within E. granulosus sensu stricto, the study provides baseline insight into geographic patterns of variation in this parasite and informs understanding of its evolutionary dynamics. The affiliations span Melbourne, Tartu, Shenzhen, Rome, Valdivia, Tehran, Isfahan, Gorgan, Madrid, Elazig, Algiers, Santa Maria, Neuquén, Yerevan, and more. Published 2026-08-27.

triage.headline_ja: 単包条虫(Echinococcus granulosus sensu stricto)のゲノム解析：遺伝的多様性と集団構造
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は多国間共同の学術的ゲノム研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術的な遺伝子解析研究であり、特定の国での実際の感染事例やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。中国（Shenzhen, Guangdong）は研究機関の所在地として挙げられているが、発生地域としての言及ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: مينافارم المصرية تطور لقاحاً تجريبياً لسلالة بونديبوغيو من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Egyptian Minapharm Develops an Experimental Vaccine for the Bundibugyo Strain of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Egyptian Minapharm, through its Berlin-based ProBioGen unit, announced development of an experimental vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. The project is funded with about $16.5 million by CEPI (Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations) to advance preclinical work and initiate a first-in-human Phase I trial to assess safety and immunogenicity, with the study to be conducted in Africa. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo began May 15 and has spread across six provinces, claiming more than 2,700 lives among over 5,650 confirmed cases in three months, surpassing the 2018–2020 eastern DRC wave. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; CEPI backs four other vaccines against this strain. WHO has urged a Phase III trial with Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus) while awaiting Bundibugyo-specific data; animal studies show partial protection, but human efficacy remains unproven.

triage.headline_ja: エジプトのミナファームがエボラ・ブンディブギョ株向け実験的ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: 記事本文で言及されているDRCのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行は、3ヵ月で6州に拡大し死者2700人超・感染者5650人超と2018-2020年流行を上回る規模であり、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態としてIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエジプト企業（ベルリン拠点子会社経由）によるブンディブギョ株エボラ向け実験的ワクチン開発（CEPI資金約1650万ドル）だが、背景として言及されているDRCの実際の流行状況（6州拡大、死者2700人超、感染者5650人超、過去最大規模を上回る）が重大なシグナルである。ワクチン開発企業拠点（エジプト・ドイツ）は発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: OSN naliehavo žiada ďalšiu miliardu dolárov na boj s epidémiou eboly v Konžskej republike
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN urgently appeals for another billion dollars to fight the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the United Nations warns that humanitarian operations battling Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) risk collapse without new funds and appeals for an additional $1.1 billion to fully finance the aid plan. The plan totals $2.1 billion, with the United States having made a major contribution; however, current resources cover only about 48% of needs and would last weeks, not months. Since the outbreak's declaration on 15 May, authorities have confirmed over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The appeal aims to sustain life-saving operations and expand response capacity amid what AFP reports as the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC's history.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対策のためさらに10億ドルの緊急支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行（感染者5,600人超、死者2,700人超）で、承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株が原因。資金不足により人道支援活動が崩壊する危機にあり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国は資金提供国として言及されているのみで、感染発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による過去最大規模の流行であり、資金危機が支援活動の存続を左右する重大な局面。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Symptoms Appear Suddenly: A Complete Timeline From First Signs To Recovery
article.articleSummary: India faces a sharp H1N1 (swine flu) surge, with Delhi reporting 2,612 cases this year; Bengaluru, Mumbai, and others are spiking as well. Authorities say the circulating strain is not a new mutation and remains well-matched to the seasonal flu vaccine. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, headaches, chills, fatigue, nasal congestion, and diarrhea/vomiting (more common in children). Incubation is 1–3 days, with contagiousness beginning before symptoms. Timeline: days 1–3 asymptomatic; days 4–5 sudden high fever and chills; days 6–8 peak with worsened sore throat, dry cough, and fatigue; days 9–11 fever subsides; day 12+ recovery, though cough and fatigue may persist for 2 weeks or more. Oseltamivir is most effective if started within 48 hours of the peak phase. Rest, fluids, prescribed medications, hydration, nutrition, and hygiene help recovery and prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1の症状は突然現れる：初期症状から回復までの完全なタイムライン
triage.triage_reason: インドの複数都市でH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）症例数の増加が報告されているが、変異株ではなくワクチンとも適合しており、重症度や国際的拡大に関する具体的情報がないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はH1N1症状のタイムラインを解説する健康情報記事であり、デリー（年間2,612例）、ベンガルール、ムンバイでの症例増加を報告しているが、既知の株でワクチンと適合しているため新規性・異常性は低い。重症度・死亡例に関する具体的データが不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan reports 146 swine flu cases since January, health alert issued
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports 146 swine flu (H1N1) cases from January to August 2026, with August highest at 55 cases. Monthly totals: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 20, Apr 22, May 25, Jun 14, Jul 5, Aug 55. Jaipur reports the figure and the health department has issued an alert to ensure screening, treatment and referral readiness across facilities. Principal Secretary Gayatri Rathore, citing ICMR, states no new or more virulent strain; the circulating virus is the same as previously seen. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body aches and fatigue. High-risk groups: young children, older adults, pregnant women, and those with underlying conditions. Preventive measures: cover coughs, wash hands, wear a mask when needed, avoid crowds while unwell, and seek timely medical advice—do not self-medicate. Ongoing statewide monitoring and adherence to hygiene practices are urged.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州、1月以降の豚インフルエンザ症例146件を報告、健康警戒発令
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の症例増加であり、当局も新規株や重症化の兆候はないとしているが、8月の症例数増加は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达没新增病例　世卫宣布当地伊波拉疫情结束
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda reports no new cases; WHO declares local Ebola outbreak over.
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Ebola outbreak is declared over by the World Health Organization on August 27, 2026. The WHO noted 42 days passed after the last confirmed imported Ebola case was discharged on July 16, 2026, with no subsequent transmission detected. Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths, with most patients having visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Since May 15, 2026, when the DRC declared an Ebola outbreak, the DRC has logged over 5,600 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths. The Ugandan outbreak consisted of imported infections from the DRC; authorities and partners implemented strong containment to prevent further spread. The WHO commended Uganda’s government, healthcare workers, and collaborators for the response and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新規感染者なし　WHOが現地のエボラ流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行終息宣言自体はポジティブなニュースだが、感染源であるDRCでは5,600例超・死者2,700人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、国際的拡大が既に実証されているためフルRRAでの継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主要な公衆衛生上の懸念はDRCの継続中の大規模エボラ流行（5,600例超、死者2,700人超）であり、ウガンダの終息はDRCからの輸入例の結果である。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Δυτικού Νείλου: Έρχεται rapid test για τον ιό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus: a rapid test for the virus is coming.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus remains highly active in Greece: by August 26, 2026, 232 confirmed cases and 19 deaths (all above 65). A 13-year-old developed CNS symptoms and was hospitalized; 75 cases were recorded in the prior week. Overall, 73 patients are hospitalized, 26 in ICU (MΕΘ) and one in a MAΦ unit. The outbreak spans 61 municipalities across 18 regional units in five regions, with Attica worst-affected (37 municipalities). Other transmission hotspots include Central Macedonia (12), Thessaly (9), Central Greece (2), and the Peloponnese (1). Six additional high-risk municipalities have been identified: Heraklion, Attica; Nea Smyrni; Nea Filadelfeia–Nea Chalkidona; Dafni–Ymittos; Amphipoli/Amphipolis; Serres; Thassos. Parallelly, an EKPA-led international team, headed by Prof. Maria Gazouli, is developing a rapid diagnostic test for West Nile virus and other mosquito-borne pathogens using nanotechnology, aiming for results within an hour from a single drop of blood; hopeful two-year research horizon and market-ready after 36 months, with international partners from Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil (Zika).

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス：迅速検査キットが登場へ
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはギリシャで発生している西ナイルウイルス感染拡大に関するものであり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）のいずれにも該当しないため、モニタリング対象外と判断。ブラジルは迅速診断キット開発の国際共同研究パートナーとして言及されているのみで、発生地域ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はギリシャにおける西ナイルウイルス流行（232例確認、19名死亡、73名入院、26名ICU）および新しい迅速診断キット開発の話題。ブラジルはZika関連の国際研究協力パートナーとして名前が出ているだけで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。対象国リストに該当する国での発生がないため、本SOPの監視スコープ外としてDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: OMS declară sfârşitul epidemiei de Ebola în Uganda: În RD Congo, bilanțul a depășit 2.700 de morți
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda: In DR Congo, the death toll has surpassed 2,700.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC declared the Ebola outbreak over in Uganda after 42 days without a new infection following the discharge of the last patient. Uganda reported 20 infections and 2 deaths; the remaining patients recovered, with the final patient leaving hospital on July 16, triggering the 42-day waiting period that confirms ending the outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak began on May 15 in the eastern provinces bordering Uganda, the situation remains dire: the epidemic has spread to six provinces, with over 5,650 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths, becoming the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history. The UN warned on August 21 that Congo's outbreak is spreading exceptionally fast. The joint statement urged accelerating response in DRC to end transmission everywhere; the Uganda outbreak was controlled, but vigilance remains.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダでのエボラ流行終息を宣言：コンゴ民主共和国では死者数が2,700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続し、6州に拡大、死者2,700人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響および国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din Congo a provocat peste 2.700 de decese
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused over 2,700 deaths.
article.articleSummary: By 27 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 2,700 people and logged more than 5,600 confirmed cases. Declared on 15 May, it is the deadliest Ebola epidemic recorded in the DRC to date. The response is hindered by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment, complicating control efforts. The United Nations warns that existing funds could cover only a few weeks of operations, prompting a rapid fundraising appeal. The response plan costs about $2.1 billion and is funded at roughly 48%. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres is appealing for an additional $1.1 billion to sustain and expand critical intervention activities in affected areas, warning that resources could run out if more money is not secured.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で死者2,700人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（死者2,700人超、症例5,600件超）が発生し、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ型により制圧が困難で、国際的な資金不足が国連から警告されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たし社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ変異株による流行で、資金不足が深刻化しており、続報での資金状況・感染拡大範囲の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Airport Malaria' Kills 2 in Europe, Sickens 4 More
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Zika virus infections linked to Bali, Indonesia, prompted the CDC to issue a Level 2 Travel Health Notice for Indonesia. Infections have been reported among travelers returning from Bali, while Bali officials report no locally detected Zika cases to date. The warning emphasizes enhanced precautions for travelers, particularly against mosquito bites and sexual transmission of Zika. For pregnant travelers, Bali should be avoided, and if travel cannot be postponed, strict adherence to prevention measures is advised. Those planning pregnancy should wait the CDC-recommended interval after returning from Bali before attempting conception. The guidance highlights the risk of Zika-related birth defects during pregnancy. The notice reflects imported/exported cases rather than sustained local transmission on the island. Visitors are urged to protect themselves similarly to dengue prevention."}

triage.headline_ja: 「機内感染マラリア」が欧州で2人死亡、4人が発症（記事タイトルと内容の不一致：本文はバリ島ジカウイルスに関するCDC渡航健康情報）
triage.triage_reason: CDCがインドネシア（バリ島）に対しジカウイルス関連のレベル2渡航健康情報を発出し、旅行者への注意喚起がなされている。局地的な持続感染は未確認だが、渡航制限勧告と公衆の関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事見出しは欧州での『機内感染マラリア』に関するものだが、サマリー本文はバリ島（インドネシア）でのジカウイルス感染とCDCの渡航健康情報に関する内容であり、見出しと本文内容が一致していない。トリアージはサマリー内容（ジカ/バリ島）に基づいて実施。バリ当局は地域内感染例なしと報告しており、輸入例のみの状況。

article.articleHeadline: Paracatu registra redução de 95% nos casos de dengue entre 2024 e 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paracatu records a 95% reduction in dengue cases between 2024 and 2026.
article.articleSummary: Paracatu, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports a 95% drop in dengue cases from 2024 to 2026, attributed to sustained Aedes aegypti control and health investments. The municipal Epidemiological Surveillance program conducts about 190,000 house visits annually, delivering guidance to residents, identifying potential breeding sites, and promoting prevention of mosquito-borne diseases. Home visits foster community engagement and emphasize eliminating water-collecting containers inside and around properties. In parallel, the city allocated over 84 million Brazilian reais to health, strengthening infrastructure and service delivery. The reduction is credited to ongoing prevention actions, proactive health teams, and community participation. With continued measures, Paracatu aims to maintain gains and broaden arbovirus protection strategies against Aedes aegypti–transmitted illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: パラカトゥ市、2024年から2026年にかけてデング熱症例が95%減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例が大幅に減少したことを報じる内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念事項ではなく、対策の成功を示すポジティブなニュースであるため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱症例の減少（成功事例）を報じており、感染拡大や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、内容が減少報告であるためシグナルとしては不適切。

article.articleHeadline: "مينافارم" المصرية تطور لقاحا تجريبيا لسلالة "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Egypt's Minapharm develops an experimental vaccine for an Ebola strain in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Egyptian drugmaker Minapharm, via its Berlin-based subsidiary ProBioGen, announced development of an experimental vaccine candidate against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola currently circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo. CEPI will provide about $16.5 million to advance preclinical work and launch a first-in-human, Phase 1 trial to assess safety and immunogenicity; the study will be conducted in Africa. The project forms part of CEPI’s multi-vaccine push; in addition to Minapharm’s project, four other experimental vaccines against Bundibugyo are supported. While the vaccine’s efficacy against Bundibugyo remains unproven in humans, animal studies have shown partial protection. WHO has advised considering a Phase 3 trial with the Ervebo vaccine targeting the Zaire ebolavirus lineage. As of the report, the Congo outbreak has killed over 2,700 people among more than 5,650 confirmed cases, marking a particularly deadly phase of the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エジプトのミナファームがコンゴのエボラ株に対する実験的ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行は死者2,700人超・確定患者5,650人超に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響を及ぼしている進行中の重大イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はワクチン開発（CEPI支援、Minapharm/ProBioGenによるBundibugyo株対応の実験的ワクチン）だが、背景として言及されているDRCのエボラ流行自体が高致死率・大規模の進行中アウトブレイクであるため、公衆衛生上重要なシグナルとして評価した。エジプト・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan Reports 146 Swine Flu Cases Since Jan, Health Dept Issues Alert
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports 146 Influenza A H1N1 (swine flu) cases since January 2026, with August contributing 55—the highest monthly tally. The Rajasthan Medical and Health Department issued an alert, boosting screening, treatment, and referral pathways across medical facilities. Monthly counts were 2 (Jan), 3 (Feb), 20 (Mar), 22 (Apr), 25 (May), 14 (Jun), 5 (Jul), and 55 (Aug). No new or more virulent H1N1 strain has been confirmed; ICMR states the circulating virus is the same as previously seen. Delhi and other parts of the country are reporting rising swine flu activity. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue; most recover with appropriate care, while young children, older adults, pregnant women, and those with underlying conditions face higher risk. Public guidance emphasizes masks, hand hygiene, avoiding crowds when unwell, rest, fluids, and seeking medical advice—no self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州、1月以降の豚インフルエンザ症例146件を報告—保健局が警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: 既知のH1N1株による季節性の増加であり新規性・重篤性の明確な証拠はないが、8月に症例数が急増し保健当局が警戒を発令しているため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ICMRは既存株と同一であり新規/より病原性の高い株は確認されていないと明言。デリーなど他地域でも増加傾向が報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス範囲内とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Educadores y padres en el Congo solicitan posponer el inicio de clases por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Educators and parents in the Congo call for the postponement of the start of classes due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province around Bunia, has reached 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, the fastest-growing outbreak in the disease’s history. The Bundibugyo virus lacks approved vaccines or treatments, though clinical trials are underway in the region. Declared mid-May, with transmission thought to have begun in February, it has spread to nearly 60 health zones, with most cases and deaths occurring in communities outside formal surveillance. Public health measures—gathering restrictions, social distancing, and airport closures—have disrupted life across six provinces amid insecurity, displacement, and a health worker strike. WHO warns the outbreak is out of control and could exceed the 2014–2016 toll of over 11,000 deaths. In Ituri, educators and parents call postponing September 1 school reopening to protect children; the case-fatality rate for children under 4 is around 60%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（民主共和国）の教育関係者と保護者、エボラ流行を理由に新学期開始の延期を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、WHOが「制御不能」と警告する史上最速拡大のエボラ流行（症例5,713件、死亡2,744人）であり、渡航制限（空港閉鎖）や社会的関心（休校要請）も確認されるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyoウイルス株による流行で、60の保健区・6州に拡大。医療従事者のストライキや治安悪化が対応を阻害しており、2014-2016年流行（死者11,000人超）を上回る可能性がWHOにより指摘されている重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : des journalistes formés au rôle des médias en situation d'urgence - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: journalists trained in the media's role during emergencies - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 27 August 2026, Ebola response activities in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompted training for Bunia-based online journalists on the role and practice of media in emergencies. The session, part of the Ebola response efforts, stressed that journalists must do more than report facts: they should help protect communities by delivering reliable, verified, and responsible information, prevent rumors, raise awareness, and support the response. Facilitator Immaculée Vay urged prioritizing accuracy over speed, urging careful verification before publication. The capacity-building aims to enhance professional practices in crisis reporting, emphasizing fact-checking, editorial accountability, rumor control, and dissemination of public-protection messages. The training, organized by CORACOPI (Collective of Community and Proximity Radios of Ituri) and funded by the Swiss Directorate for Development and Cooperation, reinforces the media’s role as a critical link between responders and communities during the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ対応：記者らが緊急事態時のメディアの役割について研修を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRC・イツリ州で継続中のエボラ対応活動の一環としての記者研修に関する内容であり、新規感染拡大や症例数増加等の直接的な疫学情報は含まれていないが、進行中のエボラ流行の存在を示唆するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行下でのメディア対応能力強化研修に関する内容で、新規症例・重症度・拡大状況等の疫学的情報は記載されていない。DRCで既存のエボラ流行対応が継続中であることが背景として示唆されるが、詳細不明のため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São José mobiliza escolas sobre método wolbachia contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São José mobilizes schools about the Wolbachia method against dengue.
article.articleSummary: Wolbachia method against dengue promoted in São José municipal schools. The Secretary of Education, with the Secretary of Health, launched informational materials about the Wolbachia method in São José’s public schools to educate educators, students, and families on releasing Wolbachia-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes (Wolbitos) to reduce transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The approach is non-genetic and considered safe for people and animals, with a self-sustaining cycle as offspring inherit the bacterium. The Fiocruz, in collaboration with the Ministry of Health, leads the project, with local operations by Wolbito do Brasil, aiming to reach more than 143,700 residents in eight neighborhoods: Areias, Barreiros, Campinas, Forquilhinha, Ipiranga, Jardim Cidade de Florianópolis, Kobrasol, and Serraria. Training covers Municipal Educational Centers (CEMs) and Early Childhood Education Centers (CEIs); directors will guide professionals to relay quality information to children and families, including visual materials for G4 and G5 groups.

triage.headline_ja: サンジョゼ市、デング熱対策としてワクバキア法について学校を動員
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱対策としてのワクバキア法の教育啓発活動を報じるものであり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊対策としてのワクバキア法普及活動を報じる予防的・教育的な内容であり、感染症の発生や流行の急増を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : la vaccination du chien, une nécessité pour éviter les maladies transmissibles (un vétérinaire) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: Dog vaccination, a necessity to prevent transmissible diseases (a veterinarian) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 27, 2026, Kinshasa veterinarians urged dog vaccination as essential to prevent transmissible diseases between dogs and humans during World Dog Day, celebrated Aug 26 annually. Dr. Alain Furaha, head of the Rabies Vaccination and Control Office (OVCR), emphasized rabies vaccination as critical given its high fatality in humans once symptoms appear. The WHO cites dog vaccination as a key strategy to interrupt rabies transmission at its source. Vaccination programs should cover all pets in Kinshasa, with age-tailored schedules and a regular deworming cadence—no more than three months between dewormings in DRC. Beyond vaccines, he stressed animal and environmental hygiene, including daily cleaning of the dog's feeding bowl. He warned about dog meat consumption risks and advised veterinary health checks before consumption. The OVCR oversees vaccination status, legalization/registration of vaccines in Kinshasa, and handling dog bite cases citywide.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ:犬の予防接種は感染症を防ぐために必要(獣医師)-ACP
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、世界犬の日に合わせた獣医師による狂犬病予防接種の啓発記事であり、緊急の公衆衛生イベントに該当しない。
triage.notes: 具体的な狂犬病発生・感染者数の報告はなく、予防啓発キャンペーンの記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique Centrale: L'Ouganda déclare officiellement la fin de son épidémie d'Ebola après 42 jours sans nouveau cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa: Uganda officially declares the end of its Ebola outbreak after 42 days without a new case.
article.articleSummary: Uganda officially declared the end of its Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus on 27 August 2026 after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases. From 15 May 2026 to 27 August 2026, the outbreak involved 20 people and caused 2 deaths. Of the cases, 15 were linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and 5 were locally acquired among contacts and healthcare workers linked to imported patients. Eighteen patients recovered; two deaths were recorded. More than 800 contacts were identified and monitored. The countdown to termination began after the last patient discharged on 16 July 2026 (an imported case); local transmission had already ceased by 28 July 2026. WHO and Africa CDC praised Uganda’s rapid response and emphasized sustained cross-border vigilance with DRC; no travel or trade restrictions were advised.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ：ウガンダが新規感染者ゼロ42日後に、正式にエボラ出血熱の流行終了を宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上「異常」かつコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており、国際的拡大リスク基準を満たすため、終息宣言後もクロスボーダーの監視継続の観点からフルRRAでの確認が望まれる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息宣言だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。20例中15例がDRCと関連（輸入例）とされ、DRCが感染源として明示的に関与しているためDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。既に流行終息が宣言され渡航・貿易制限は勧告されていないが、越境感染歴があるため継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan Sounds Swine Flu Alert After August Spike | Jaipur News
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports 146 H1N1 cases from January to August 2026, with August alone recording 55 swine flu cases—the highest monthly rise this year. The Jaipur health department issued an alert and is increasing testing, treatment, and referrals across medical facilities. No new or more dangerous H1N1 strain has been confirmed; circulating virus remains an active strain per ICMR. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body aches and fatigue; preventive measures include coughing etiquette, hand hygiene, sanitiser, masking in crowds, and avoiding self-medication with antibiotics or antivirals. Agriculture minister Kirori Lal Meena and another patient are in intensive care after testing positive; Meena’s lungs are infiltrated but improving with isolation and treatment. A dedicated ICU for swine flu has been earmarked in anticipation of rising cases.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州、8月の急増を受けて豚インフルエンザ警戒を発令 | ジャイプール ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（既知株）の症例増加であり新規株や国際的拡大の証拠はないが、閣僚の重症化や専用ICU設置など注視すべき動きがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性H1N1株であり新変異株は確認されていない。ただし農業大臣を含む重症例（ICU入院）があり、地元行政が警戒・対応強化中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dibea de Florianópolis promove Evento de Adoção com foco em cães portadores de Leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dibea from Florianópolis Promotes an Adoption Event Focusing on Dogs with Leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Dibea, Florianópolis's Department of Animal Welfare, via the Municipal Veterinary Hospital, hosts an adoption event on Saturday, August 29, from 1:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., at Rodovia SC-401, 114, Itacorubi, as part of Agosto Verde. The event promotes adoption of dogs diagnosed with Canine Visceral Leishmaniasis. Twelve dogs with the condition, rehabilitated at the municipal shelter, are available for adoption. Leishmaniasis is not spread by direct contact; with medication and repellent collars, affected dogs can lead normal, healthy lives. The city provides free treatment, medications, and lifetime veterinary follow-up at the Municipal Veterinary Hospital for all adopted dogs. Adopters gain access to ongoing veterinary care, including consultations, exams, surgeries, hospitalization, and 24-hour on-call service. About 200 animals await homes in Florianópolis' kennel and cattery; some dogs have waited 7–9 years.

triage.headline_ja: フロリアノーポリス市のディベアが、リーシュマニア症を持つ犬に焦点を当てた譴養イベントを実施
triage.triage_reason: 犬の内臓リーシュマニア症に関する動物譴養イベントの案内記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や人への感染拡大リスクを示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物福祉・譴養イベントの広報記事であり、感染症サーベイランスや公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての価値は低い。犬のリーシュマニア症症例数の増加や新規発生地域の拡大等の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: ONU ALERTA POR RÁPIDO AVANCE DEL ÉBOLA EN RDC Y PIDE MÁS RECURSOS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN warns of rapid spread of Ebola in the DRC and calls for more resources.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of 25 August, the outbreak has 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, with about 500 new infections weekly. Women and children are among the most affected. Decades of conflict, strained health systems, and weak infrastructure hinder access to affected communities, and health workers’ safety is at risk, with over 40 healthcare workers dead and treatment centers and ambulances attacked. The Congolese government leads the response with UN, WHO, and international partners to strengthen surveillance, expand patient care, involve communities, and prevent further transmission. UN has allocated over $80 million from common funds; the humanitarian plan requires about $2.13 billion and is 48% funded, leaving roughly $1.1 billion unfunded. Time is critical to prevent continued expansion, with current resources supporting operations for weeks, not months."}{

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大に警告、追加支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、致死率も高く、国際社会の資金・人員支援が急務であることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当する重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%、週500人規模の新規感染、医療従事者40名以上死亡、資金不足（人道支援計画の48%のみ充足）と、既に大規模な公衆衛生危機として国際的関与が進んでいる状況。フルRRAへの移行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, l'Oms va in Sud Sudan per provare a scongiurare il contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO heads to South Sudan to try to avert the contagion
article.articleSummary: Ebola has crossed from the Democratic Republic of the Congo into South Sudan, prompting urgent containment efforts. The Congo’s outbreak has already caused about 2,900 deaths. WHO health teams, supported by a United Nations mission, have travelled to Ezo, the area deemed at the highest immediate risk, to implement preventive measures and prevent the virus from causing further fatalities. Authorities warn the epidemic could widen if not contained and that South Sudan remains at risk of spillover. The deployment highlights intensified international coordination to avert a larger catastrophe, with ongoing cross-border concerns between Congo and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOが感染拡大阻止のため南スーダンへ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約2900人の死者を出しているエボラ出血熱が南スーダンへ越境し、WHOが緊急対応チームを派遣する等、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事案であるためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国発のエボラ出血熱が南スーダンへ越境した事案。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。日本・北海道はBluedotの誤タグと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uele : fermeture momentanée d'un centre de santé touché par l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: temporary closure of a health center affected by the outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Haut-Uele, Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Tely Health Center’s activities have been temporarily suspended after the death of a pregnant woman presenting Ebola symptoms and three healthcare workers tested positive for Ebola. The three infected clinicians are receiving treatment at the Ebola Treatment Center at Isiro General Reference Hospital. All services at Tely are halted to allow disinfection and to prevent further transmission; staff are not to report to the center until further notice. The Tely center is Catholic-run, under the Diocese of Isiro-Niangara. Date: 27 August 2026. The report confirms healthcare worker infections linked to Ebola, but provides no additional details on the infection source or broader outbreak dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ：流行の影響を受けた保健センターが一時閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オー・ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、医療従事者3名の感染と妊婦の死亡が確認された。院内感染の可能性が示唆され、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象としてIHR基準を2つ以上満たすためPICKUP判定とする。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ治療センターが存在することから、これは既知の流行の継続的な報告と推測される。医療従事者の感染は院内感染対策の不備を示唆し、さらなる拡大リスクに注意が必要。感染源や流行規模の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RDC crece 'exponencialmente': ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is growing 'exponentially': UN.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is growing exponentially, with over 5,000 infections and more than 2,500 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola event in DRC history and the largest in the region since 2016. The UN warns current field capacity will last only a few weeks, stressing the urgent need for international aid to contain the virus. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne, but severely ill patients often cannot travel. The WHO and partners deem overall travel risk to Americans and Europeans as low for now, while cross-border spread remains likely; Kampala, Uganda, is facing a Bundibugyo variant outbreak, which is spreading faster and lacks a vaccine. The surge is aided by this variant, per MSF expert Marcella Kraaij. By July, three imported cases were detected outside Africa (two Americans, one French), the latest treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、国連が「指数関数的に拡大」と警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（感染5000人超、死亡2500人超）が指数関数的に拡大し、国際的な輸入例も複数発生しており、IHR基準を全て満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（カンパラ）でも別変異株（Bundibugyo）による流行が発生しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ドイツでの輸入例も同様に対象外。DRCの流行が本記事の主題であり、国際的拡大・支援必要性が明確に記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: MCD asks schools to step up dengue, malaria prevention measures | Delhi News
article.articleSummary: Delhi's Municipal Corporation (MCD) has issued an advisory to government and private schools to intensify prevention and control of dengue, malaria, and chikungunya as the mosquito-borne transmission season begins. With monsoon and post-monsoon conditions favoring mosquito breeding, the advisory notes that transmission has already started and has formed zone-level task forces to monitor preventive measures. Schools should designate nodal teachers or supervisory staff to coordinate with malaria field teams and other personnel. They are urged to spread awareness through online and offline classes, and to prevent stagnant water on premises; if found, a small amount of oil should be added. To raise awareness, schools should organize quizzes, drawings, and rallies. Students should wear full-sleeved uniforms during Aug–Nov, use mosquito repellents, and install wire mesh on doors and windows to reduce bites.

triage.headline_ja: MCD、学校にデング熱・マラリア予防対策の強化を要請 | デリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期に伴う例年の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・マラリア・チクングニア）予防に関する行政通達であり、異常な発生状況や重症化・拡大の情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 季節性の蚊媒介感染症予防に関する行政的な事前対策の通達であり、具体的な感染者数や重症例、異常な流行拡大に関する記載はない。例年の予防措置として扱われるべき情報。

article.articleHeadline: 166 new H1N1 cases; hosps step up bandobast | Delhi News
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, New Delhi reported 166 fresh H1N1 cases in the past 24 hours, taking the year's total to 2,612, with Influenza A cases crossing 3,300. Health authorities stepped up hospital preparedness and surveillance, including an H1N1 isolation ward, testing facilities, medicines, oxygen, and beds at Indira Gandhi Hospital in Dwarka. The hospital has established an H1N1 clinic for preliminary examination and testing; positives are to be shifted to the isolation ward. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh asserted there is no panic and that adequate arrangements exist to prevent gaps in patient care; officials will monitor and inspect hospitals to maintain preparedness. Essential medicines, specialists, nursing staff, and laboratory technicians are available, with capacity to be strengthened as needed across Delhi govt hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1新規166例、デリー市内病院が対応強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1/インフルエンザA感染者数増加に伴い病院が準備を強化しているが、当局は「パニックはない」としており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。ヒト-ヒト感染性はあるため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1/インフルエンザAの年間感染者数（2,612例）が報告されており、デリー市当局が病院の受け入れ体制（隔離病棟・検査施設）を強化している。重症度や死亡者数についての具体的情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Cuatro zonas afectadas por ébola en RDC entran en "fase de control", según Unión Africana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Ebola-affected areas in the DRC enter the 'control phase,' according to the African Union.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo moves toward containment: four of 58 health zones—Mitwaba (74 days), Kambala (51), Gomana (51), and Rabunga (43)—have entered the 'control phase' after no new cases for longer than the 42-day incubation. Regions Rutu, Rukula, Mahagi, Aru and Rungu are in 'observation' with 21–42 days without new cases. Ituri remains the epicenter, with Bas-Uele, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, and South Kivu affected; South Kivu has had no new cases for over 80 days. As of August 25, 2026, the outbreak totals 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, per the RDC National Public Health Institute. Community deaths accounted for 63% in the last two weeks, and 47% occurred in Ebola Treatment Centers. Africa CDC is deploying a village-based response, while Bunia-area communities commit to early detection and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合によると、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の影響を受けた4地域が「管理段階」に入った
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは、確定患者5,713人・死者2,744人という重大な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数州にわたる拡大とヒト-ヒト感染継続の可能性があるため、フルリスク評価対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の進行中アウトブレイクの経過報告（一部地域が管理段階入り）だが、全体としては大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行であり、地域（Ituri, South Kivu等）はいずれもDRC国内のためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Efforts intensified for tuberculosis-free Kangra target - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Kangra district in Himachal Pradesh is advancing toward TB elimination under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) and TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2.0. A district review by Chief Medical Officer Dr Omesh Bharti reported 99% TB elimination achievement in 2026 and 97% of presumptive TB testing targets met. Blocks Indora, Thural, Dadasiba, Nagrota Surian and Shahpur performed at or above targets. Under TB Mukt Bharat 2.0, 62,585 vulnerable individuals and new TB episodes have been enrolled, with 46,136 undergoing X-ray examination. The district identified 969 high-risk villages and recorded an 83% treatment success rate, aiming to exceed 90% with regular follow-up and outcome monitoring. Of 1,729 registered TB patients, 1,304 have ABHA IDs and face authentication. Ninety-five percent of consented Nikshay Mitra beneficiaries have received nutritional support, with 15 nutrition kits provided in Shahpur. The TB Mukt Bharat app is used for planning and reporting; Ayushman Arogya camps are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 結核撲滅を目指すカングラ地区での取り組みが強化
triage.triage_reason: 既存のTB撲滅プログラムの進捗報告であり、異常な事象や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 既存の国家プログラム（NTEP/TB Mukt Bharat 2.0）の進捗報告記事であり、新規アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Febre do Nilo Ocidental: Caçador registra primeiro caso em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile fever: Hunter records first case in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Two human West Nile fever cases have been confirmed in Santa Catarina, Brazil, as of 27 August 2026: a 56-year-old man from Caçador in the Midwest with neurological symptoms who was hospitalized and has been discharged, currently recovering at home; and a 77-year-old woman in Imbituba in the southern part of the state who died from the infection. Transmission occurs via bites from infected mosquitoes, predominantly Culex species; there is no person-to-person transmission. Authorities emphasize prevention and surveillance to monitor and control vectors. The cases underscore ongoing vector-borne disease risk in Santa Catarina and the need for public health measures to reduce mosquito breeding sites and protect residents.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイル熱：カサドールでサンタカタリーナ州初の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: サンタカタリーナ州で西ナイル熱による死亡例を含む2症例が確認され、公衆衛生への影響が深刻かつ当該地域では異常な事象であるため、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 蚊媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、死亡例を含む重症症例が発生しており州レベルでの監視強化が必要。当該地域における西ナイル熱の初発例として異例性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda é declarado livre do ebola após 42 dias sem novos casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda is declared Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases
article.articleSummary: Uganda is declared Ebola-free after 42 days with no new cases or transmission, counted from the last hospital discharge, marking the end of the outbreak in the country. Uganda registered 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths in 2026, largely among people who had traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Despite the declaration, the WHO cautions ongoing surveillance due to cross-border circulation with DRC and the risk of new imported cases. Uganda plans to open two additional Ebola treatment centers in Congolese territory, where two units already operate. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or tissues of infected humans or animals, including after death. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, has surpassed 5,600 cases and 2,700 deaths, sustaining regional risk.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、新規感染42日間確認されずエボラ終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダは終息宣言されたが、発端であるDRCのエボラ流行は5,600例超・死者2,700人超と大規模で継続中であり、国境を越えた感染リスクが指摘されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのエボラ終息宣言だが、感染源であるDRCの流行は依然大規模で継続中であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当（ウガンダは対象国リスト外）。WHOは国境地域での監視継続を推奨している。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Ο ιός εξαπλώνεται σε νέες χώρες - Πώς μπορεί να περιοριστεί η νέα έξαρση - tempo24.news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: The virus is spreading to new countries - How the new outbreak can be contained
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) resurges, spreading to new countries, with Guinea-Bissau reporting its first outbreak. Of 46 suspected cases, 23 are under 15, most under 4, signaling pediatric vulnerability. Since 2022, nearly 190,000 mpox cases have been reported in 145 countries, showing a shift from endemic regions. Two clades exist: Clade I (Congo Basin) and Clade II (West Africa); Clade II drove the 2022 global surge, while a 2024 Clade I lineage in DRC raised concern. WHO declared a PHEIC in Aug 2024, lifted in Sept 2025 as cases declined. Transmission is via close contact and crowded settings. In Guinea-Bissau, cases do not appear linked, implying broader community circulation. WHO recommends two vaccines for high-risk individuals or contacts; vaccine access remains unequal, with new stockpiles planned to speed distribution. Vaccination must be complemented by early detection, contact tracing, supportive care, and strong surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：ウイルスが新たな国々に拡大 - 新たな流行はどのように抑制できるか
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxが複数の新規国に拡大し、ギニアビサウでは症例間の関連性が不明でコミュニティ内伝播が疑われる。IHR基準を複数満たし、WHOのPHEIC歴もあることからフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はギニアビサウでの初発流行と世界的なMpox拡大の文脈を主軸としているが、DRCはClade Iの起源地であり2024年の系統が懸念材料として明示的に言及されているため対象国として含めた。ギニアビサウ、アンゴラ、コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Is Out of Control In Congo
article.articleSummary: By August 25, 2026, Congo’s Ebola outbreak reached 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths—the largest in the country’s history—spanning six provinces and 58 of 151 health zones. The Bundibugyo strain has circulated for months before its May declaration. Early estimates place the reproduction number around 1.9, with transmission largely limited to visibly ill patients, leaving no vaccine effective against Bundibugyo; Ervebo is not recommended outside research settings, and Inmazeb/Ebanga target Zaire ebolavirus. Response relies on beds, patient care, contact tracing, and isolation; treatment centers have been overwhelmed, with Nizi at 278% capacity in early August. Ituri accounts for about 83% of cases; capacity rose from ~690 to 978 beds. Under-reporting is likely. Daily cases declined late July–late August (109 to ~70), but deaths remained high. Health workers infections around 151–160, with 29% deaths vs 48% overall.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで史上最大規模のエボラ流行(5,713例、死亡2,744例)が6州58保健地帯に拡大し、有効なワクチンがなく医療体制が崩壊している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対する有効なワクチンが存在せず、医療従事者感染や治療センターの過負荷（Nizi 278%）が報告されている。致死率は約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Fifth Ebola vaccine candidate joins race against Congo outbreak
article.articleSummary: Egypt-based Minapharm Group will receive up to $16.5 million from the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) to advance its Bundibugyo Ebola virus vaccine from preclinical development into an early-stage clinical trial, with the trial expected to take place in Africa. This marks the fifth Bundibugyo-specific vaccine candidate CEPI has backed since the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak began. There is currently no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, a less common Ebola species. CEPI's funding accompanies a broader push to accelerate vaccines against Bundibugyo, with the goal of advancing at least two candidates to emergency use authorization and World Health Organization prequalification for use in the current outbreak and for future Bundibugyo epidemics.

triage.headline_ja: 5番目のエボラワクチン候補がコンゴのアウトブレイク対策競争に参加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のブンディブギョ種エボラウイルス流行に関する続報であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的な対応（CEPI資金提供、ワクチン開発）が継続していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のブンディブギョ種エボラアウトブレイクに対するワクチン開発（Minapharm社、CEPI資金提供）に関する報道。Egyptは資金受給企業の拠点国であり実際の発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。アウトブレイク自体は既知の進行中事案であり、本記事は続報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: تحذير أممي من تسارع تفشي وباء إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN warns of an accelerating Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-growing in history, with its spread outpacing containment. He highlighted funding gaps that hinder the response, despite more than $80 million allocated to UN partners and a detailed plan totaling $2.13 billion to meet urgent needs. The UN emphasizes that it knows how to contain Ebola and stop transmission but warns against a “virus of indifference” as international attention, political focus, and resources remain far below ground realities. The outbreak was declared on May 15 as the seventeenth Ebola outbreak, with transmission concentrated in northern and eastern DRC—regions afflicted by weak governance, deteriorating health services, and ongoing armed conflict. The situation is described as a humanitarian catastrophe affecting families and communities in one of the world's most fragile settings.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大に警告
triage.triage_reason: 国連事務総長が史上最速の拡大と表現するエボラ流行であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行がDRC北部・東部で拡大中。武力衝突下の脆弱な医療体制と資金不足が対応を阻害しており、国連は資金・国際的関心の不足を警告している。続報でのケース数・致死率・地理的拡大の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 İçin Yeni Alarm: ABD ve Çin'de Yüz Binlerce Vaka Bildirildi, Bazı Okullar Kapatıldı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Alarm for COVID-19: Hundreds of Thousands of Cases Reported in the United States and China, Some Schools Closed.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases have risen in the United States and China, with reports of hundreds of thousands of infections and some schools closing as a precaution. The article characterizes these increases as regional and seasonal upticks rather than a new global pandemic wave. The World Health Organization indicates that global SARS-CoV-2 activity remains at low levels as of 2026-08-27. The findings underscore the continued circulation of the virus and the necessity for ongoing surveillance and public health vigilance, even as overall global activity stays subdued. No broader global surge is reported; the focus is on localized transmission dynamics in the US and China.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19に新たな警戒：米国と中国で数十万人の感染者が報告され、一部の学校が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 米国・中国で感染者数増加と一部学校閉鎖が報告されているが、記事自体がこれを季節的・地域的な増加と位置づけ、WHOも世界的な活動レベルは低いとしており、深刻性や異常性を示す明確な根拠は乏しい。継続的な監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事は季節的な増加であり新たな世界的流行波ではないと明言しており、WHOも世界の活動レベルは低いと評価している。severityや政府の関心度については記事に記載がなく不明。
