article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan reports 55 cases of H1N1 in August, highest monthly count so far
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan recorded 55 positive cases of H1N1 in August—the highest monthly total so far this year—bringing the January–August tally to 146. Health and Family Welfare Minister Gajendra Singh Khimsar said authorities are closely monitoring the situation, with medical institutions directed to ensure preparedness in light of rising cases in some states, notably Delhi. Principal Secretary Gayatri Rathore listed monthly counts: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 20, Apr 22, May 25, Jun 14, Jul 5, Aug 55. There is no confirmed spread of a new or more virulent H1N1 strain; ICMR says the circulating virus is active and there is no need for panic. H1N1 (swine flu) is a respiratory infection with fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body aches and fatigue. Most patients recover with proper care, though young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with serious illness are at higher risk.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州で8月にH1N1が55例、これまでで最多の月間件数を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の症例増加が報告されているが、新規株や重症化拡大の確証はなく、当局は「パニック不要」と発表しているため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の通常の増加パターンとみられ、ICMRも新規株の確証なしとコメント。重症度や死亡者数についての具体的記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Esquistossomose ou meningite? O que o caramujo do quintal tem a ver com isso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Schistosomiasis or meningitis? What does the backyard snail have to do with it.
article.articleSummary: Backyard Achatina fulica does not transmit schistosomiasis (Schistosoma mansoni), which requires freshwater Biomphalaria snails. However, this terrestrial snail can harbor Angiostrongylus cantonensis, causing eosinophilic meningitis, and Angiostrongylus costaricensis, causing abdominal eosinophilic enteritis, when ingested. In Brazil, A. cantonensis has been found in terrestrial mollusks; Fiocruz (2025) identified it in 26 of 46 Rio de Janeiro municipalities, including Achatina fulica. Meningitis presents with intense headache, neck stiffness, nausea, vomiting, and other neurological signs; abdominal angiostrongyliasis involves eosinophilic inflammation of the intestine. Prevention: wear gloves to collect snails and eggs; crush them and soak in a 1:3 bleach-to-water solution for 24 hours, then discard; break shells to prevent mosquito breeding; remove yard debris and sanitize produce. If exposure occurs and neurological symptoms develop, seek medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 住血吸虫症か髄膜炎か？裏庭のカタツムリとの関係とは
triage.triage_reason: 教育・啓発的な内容で、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報ではなく、既知の環境調査結果（Fiocruz2025）に基づく予防啓発記事である。
triage.notes: 記事は住血吸虫症とAngiostrongyliasis（広東住血線虫症）の違いを説明する啓発記事で、新規の症例集積やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。カタツムリ(Achatina fulica)におけるA. cantonensisの存在確認はリオデジャネイロの複数自治体で報告されているが、ヒト感染症例数の急増等の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença do caramujo: quais são e como proteger o quintal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Snail-borne diseases: what they are and how to protect your yard
article.articleSummary: Schistosomiasis, Brazil’s best-known snail-borne disease, is caused by Schistosoma mansoni and contracted via freshwater contact; transmission requires Biomphalaria snails, so the terrestrial Achatina fulica does not spread schistosomiasis. The African snail can carry Angiostrongylus cantonensis, which causes eosinophilic meningitis after ingestion of contaminated snails or produce, and Angiostrongylus costaricensis, causing eosinophilic enteritis. In Brazil, A. cantonensis has been found in terrestrial mollusks; a 2025 Fiocruz study identified the parasite in 26 of 46 Rio de Janeiro municipalities, including A. fulica. Control measures include not handling snails bare-handed; collect eggs; submerge snails in a 1:3 bleach solution for 24 hours and dispose; crush shells; avoid salt; keep yards clean and vegetation managed. In gardens, wash produce well. Seek medical care for severe headache, neck stiffness, nausea, vomiting, or neurologic signs after suspected exposure and report snail contact.

triage.headline_ja: カタツムリが媒介する病気：その種類と庭の防護方法
triage.triage_reason: 一般向けの予防啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の寄生虫感染症（住血吸虫症、広東住血線虫症など）の予防・管理に関する一般啓発記事で、2025年のFiocruz研究結果を引用しているが、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Febre do Nilo Ocidental não tem antiviral específico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile fever has no specific antiviral.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever has four confirmed human cases in Brazil in 2026: two in São Paulo state (a 34-year-old woman from Ribeirão Preto who recovered after travel to the Amazon region; an 18-year-old girl in São José do Rio Preto still hospitalized) and two in Santa Catarina (one fatal). A probable case was under monitoring in Piauí as of August 27, 2026. There is no approved antiviral or vaccine for humans in the country; infection is transmitted primarily by Culex mosquitoes. Most infections are asymptomatic; about 20% develop clinical illness. When symptomatic, typical features include fever, malaise, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, headache, myalgia, rash, and lymphadenopathy, with potential progression to central nervous system involvement (encephalitis or meningitis) requiring ICU care in severe cases. Management is supportive. Public health measures focus on vector control, repellents, screens, and eliminating standing water, with SUS coordinating case identification and infection-source investigation to distinguish local transmission from imported exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイル熱に特異的な抗ウイルス薬はない
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州（サンパウロ州、サンタカタリーナ州）で西ナイル熱の確定症例が発生し、1名が死亡・1名がICU相当の重症化を示すなど公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準のうち重大性・異常性の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 西ナイル熱はブラジルでは稀な感染症であり、複数州での同時発生・死亡例・重症化例が確認されているため注視が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、蚊媒介性のため国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les artistes montent au front
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Artists Take to the Front Lines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) escalates: as of August 25, 2026, 5,713 confirmed cases, 2,744 deaths, and 1,269 recoveries (case fatality ~48%). The outbreak spans 58 health zones across six provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter, driven by the Bundibugyo strain and now surpassing 2018–2020 in deaths. Public health messaging is amplified beyond clinicians: Lokua Kanza, UNICEF ambassador, calls for early symptom recognition, immediate care, and avoidance of risky contacts; Wedy (Sarah and Musa) and Drigo Eboma have released preventive songs; Bana Saint Jean Foundation produced music; 15 influencers with >100,000 followers promote awareness. Community outreach includes ~50 religious leaders in Aru and targeted messaging for motorbike riders engaged in transport of patients and deceased. International attention follows: Pope Léon XIV urged intensified mobilization (Aug 23); presidents of DRC, Uganda, Central African Republic, and Burundi pressed for faster, traceable funding to speed the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:アーティストたちが最前線に立つ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例5,713人・死者2,744人（致死率約48%）と2018-2020流行を上回る規模に拡大し、6州58保健区に及ぶ深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、法王や周辺国首脳が国際的対応を呼びかけている。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC国内（特にイツリ州）の状況を報じており、ウガンダ・中央アフリカ・ブルンジは近隣国として資金調達等の外交的言及のみで、実際の発生国としての記載はない。対象国リストにはこれらは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Is Out of Control In Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu; six provinces, 58 of 151 health zones) has reached 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths as of August 25, 2026, the largest in the country’s history. Declared in May, transmission has outpaced control. Early R0 ≈ 1.9 with a two-week generation time; recent Rt remains around 1, implying persistence without clear containment. The strain is Bundibugyo; vaccines for Zaire ebolavirus (Ervebo) and treatments like Inmazeb/Ebanga are not expected to help this strain, and no cross-protection is confirmed. CEPIs funds four cross-protection studies, none reporting during this outbreak. Contact tracing reached 84.6% of listed contacts; isolation wards have been overwhelmed at times (Nizi center 278% capacity), though overall bed capacity in Ituri rose to 978. Health workers total infections ~160 with ~44 deaths (29% CFR vs 48% overall). Daily cases declined from ~109 to ~70 in late July–late August, but under-reporting is estimated at 8,600–10,300 infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定5,713例、死亡2,744例、CFR約48%）で、既存ワクチン・治療薬が対象としないブンディブギョ株が原因であり、複数州に拡大し制御が困難な状況が続いているため。
triage.notes: 既存のZaire ebolavirus用ワクチン（Ervebo）や治療薬（Inmazeb/Ebanga）が本流行の株（Bundibugyo）に有効かは未確認であり、CEPI資金による交差防御研究の結果も未報告。過小報告（推定8,600～10,300例）の可能性が指摘されており、実態はさらに深刻な可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies claims five lives in the Western and Western North regions
article.articleSummary: Five people have died of rabies in Ghana's Western and Western North regions in 2026, with August 27 reporting fatalities across Wassa East (2), Jomoro (1), Amenfi East (1), and a Diaso case linked to Bibiani in the Central Region. A suspected rabid stray dog in a Sekondi suburb attacked nine people, including children. Vaccination coverage in the two regions stands below five per cent, far below the 70 per cent threshold needed to interrupt transmission; the combined dog/cat population is about 166,000. Between 2015–2021, dog-bite rates averaged roughly 78 per 100,000 in Western and 73 per 100,000 in Western North. Kola nuts are not a cure. Donor support for vaccination drives is urgently needed; authorities urge dog vaccination, registration, and stricter controls on stray and free-roaming dogs to prevent further deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 西部および西部北部地域で狂犬病により5人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ西部・西部北部地域で狂犬病による死亡が続発し、ワクチン接種率が著しく低く感染拡大リスクが高い。国際的な支援要請もあり、WPRO基準複数該当と社会的関心の高まりからフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はガーナで既知の地域流行病であり「異常/予想外」には該当しないが、ワクチン接種率の低さ（5%未満、必要閾値70%）と継続的な人的被害、ドナー支援の必要性からPICKUPと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : les journalistes encouragés à sensibiliser la population sur la maladie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: Journalists Encouraged to Raise Awareness Among the Population About the Disease - ACP
article.articleSummary: Raising awareness in Butembo, Nord-Kivu, DRC: Ebola virus disease (EVD) briefing for journalists to serve as community messengers. On 27 August 2026, in Butembo, health authorities from Katwa health zone, with support from the World Health Organization, urged local reporters to counter infodemic and misinformation about Ebola, promote prevention measures, and drive behavioral change to interrupt transmission. Journalists pledged to produce informative programming highlighting EVD risks and the importance of barrier measures, including safe burial practices, handwashing, and infection prevention and control. The session included practical training on dignified and safe burial (EDS), IPC, and surveillance, plus simulation exercises. A key message from participants emphasized using media reach to alert communities that Ebola exists and to respect preventive measures to end the outbreak in their area.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ出血熱：ジャーナリストに住民への病気に関する啓発活動が奨励される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ブテンボ/カトワ地域でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大阻止に向けWHO支援下で活動が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はジャーナリスト向け啓発活動に関する内容だが、WHO支援下でのエボラ感染阻止活動が続いていることから、ブテンボ/カトワ地域で活動性のあるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であることが示唆される。新規感染者数や死亡者数など詳細な疫学情報は記事内に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas tem 26 bairros em alerta para alta transmissão de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas has 26 neighborhoods on alert for high dengue transmission.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil reports 26 neighborhoods at high risk for dengue transmission as of the 35th Arboviroses Alert of 2026, issued on August 27. The alert spans the East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South, and Southeast regions, with examples such as Taquaral, Cidade Satélite Íris IV, Jardim São Marcos, Vila Palácios, Jardim Campo Belo II, and Vila Industrial identified for reinforced control. The Campinas Health Department aims to stimulate residents to identify and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites; alert criteria include incidence, new transmission, access gaps, population density, and direct resident communication. From Jan 1 to Aug 24, 2026, 3,753 dengue cases were confirmed. Public health teams conducted 1,138,441 home visits and 53,382 backpack mistings. About 80% of breeding sites are indoors; preventive measures include removing standing water, cleaning plant saucer pots every two days, sealing water tanks, and keeping toilets closed when not in use.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス市、26地区でデング熱の高い感染警戒レベル
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナス市における季節性のデング熱流行に関する定例的な公衆衛生アラートであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性は低く、国際的な関心も見られない。
triage.notes: ブラジルではデング熱は毎年季節的に発生する疾患であり、本記事は地方自治体の通常のベクター対策・警戒情報の一環。重症例や死亡者数の記載はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応（家庭訪問、噴霧作業等）で管理されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान: जनवरी से अब तक स्वाइन फ्लू के 146 मामले सामने आए, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी किया अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan: 146 swine flu cases reported so far since January; health department has issued an alert.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H1N1) swine flu has caused 146 positive cases in Rajasthan, including Jaipur, from January to August 2026, with August recording the highest count (55). An alert was issued after rising cases, including in Delhi. The Health Department directed medical facilities to screen, treat, and refer suspected cases. Monthly totals: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 20, Apr 22, May 25, Jun 14, Jul 5, Aug 55. No new or more dangerous strain is detected; ICMR confirms the circulating virus remains the same as earlier. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue; most patients recover with proper care. High-risk groups: children, elderly, pregnant women, and individuals with comorbidities. Public guidance emphasizes masking when needed, hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, seeking medical care, and avoiding self-medication; surveillance across Rajasthan continues.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州:1月から現在までにスワインフル146例が確認、保健当局が警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの通常の増加であり、新規/危険な変異株は検出されていないが、8月に症例数が急増している点は継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして毎年インドで発生しており、ICMRも既知株であることを確認。重症度・異常性に関する情報は限定的で、致死率や入院率のデータは記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à la Tshopo : lancement de la campagne de vaccination des prestataires de soins à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: launch of the vaccination campaign for healthcare workers in Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccination campaign launched in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, Democratic Republic of the Congo, targeting frontline healthcare workers with Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) to protect staff and contacts amid a Bund ibugyo strain outbreak. Authorities note potential cross-protection from the Zaïre Ebola vaccine, with studies ongoing to define protection levels. Over 50,000 doses have been received; initial vaccination focuses on provinces around Ituri, then expands to other high-risk groups as data evolves. In Tshopo, 17 confirmed cases have been recorded since the outbreak began. Remdesivir shows encouraging early results in high-risk contacts treated post-exposure. The government and provincial authorities pledge sustained logistical and sanitary support and urge healthcare workers to vaccinate to safeguard themselves and reduce transmission to communities.

triage.headline_ja: ツォポ州でのエボラ出血熱：キサンガニで医療従事者向けワクチン接種キャンペーン開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCツォポ州でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中で、既に17例の確定例が報告されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCツォポ州（キサンガニ）及びイトゥリ州周辺でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）アウトブレイクに関するワクチン接種キャンペーンの報告。5万本以上のワクチン供与、レムデシビルの早期使用結果も言及されており、既存のアウトブレイク対応の一部と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान: जनवरी से अब तक स्वाइन फ्लू के 146 मामले सामने आए, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी किया अलर्ट - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan: 146 swine flu cases have been reported so far since January; the Health Department has issued an alert - Punjab Kesari.
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan Health Department has issued an alert after rising H1N1 swine flu cases in parts of India, notably Delhi, with 146 positive cases reported statewide from January through August 2026. Monthly counts: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 20, Apr 22, May 25, Jun 14, Jul 5, Aug 55—the latter the highest. Officials say no new or more dangerous strain has been detected; ICMR notes the circulating virus is the same as earlier. The government directed medical facilities to enhance screening, treatment, and referrals. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, headaches, body aches, and fatigue. Authorities urge calm, seek doctor advice, and avoid self-medication with antibiotics or antivirals; cover coughs or sneezes, wash hands, wear masks in crowds, rest, and stay hydrated. Avoid close contact with infected individuals and limit exposure; surveillance continues statewide.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州:1月から現在までにスワインフルー146例が確認、保健局がアラートを発出
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（スワインフル―）症例数増加だが、ICMRは新規株・より危険な株ではないと確認しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。政府のアラート発出はあるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の株による季節性インフルエンザの増加であり、新規変異株の検出はない。ラジャスタン州保健局が医療機関にスクリーニング強化を指示しており、8月の症例数が最多（55例）である点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Δυτικού Νείλου / Έρχεται rapid test - Αύξηση των κρουσμάτων στην Ελλάδα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus / Rapid test arrives - Increase in cases in Greece
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus cases in Greece rise to 232 with 19 deaths, with Attica at the epidemic’s epicenter. In under a week, 75 new infections were recorded, signaling rapid spread; older adults, particularly men over 65, are most at risk for severe disease. A 13-year-old boy was hospitalized with severe symptoms and very high fever; he has been discharged, the first pediatric case documented this year. An EKPA-led Greek research team participates in an international program to develop a rapid West Nile virus test that can detect infection from a single drop of blood in under one hour. The consortium includes Greece, Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil; Greek leadership is Maria Gazouli, with results expected in about two years. Vector-control measures intensify in Attica: Pallini, Filothei-Psychiko, and the Antonis Tritsis park, plus digital risk mapping and traps for female mosquitoes to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス／迅速検査キット開発へ－ギリシャで感染例増加
triage.triage_reason: 西ナイルウイルスの感染拡大はギリシャで発生しており、対象国（監視対象の11カ国）には該当しない。Brazilは国際共同研究プログラムの参加国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はギリシャ（Attica地方）における西ナイルウイルス感染拡大。Brazilはウイルス検査法開発の国際共同研究の参加国として名前が挙がっているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Focarul de Ebola din Uganda s-a încheiat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Uganda has ended.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak ended after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases, the last imported patient discharged on 16 July 2026. Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; 15 were imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and 5 were locally acquired among contacts and healthcare workers. Eighteen patients recovered; over 800 contacts were identified and monitored. The Congo outbreak persists, keeping regional risk high due to proximity, cross-border trade, and population movement, with potential for additional imported cases. WHO and Africa CDC caution against travel or trade restrictions, urging continued surveillance, testing, rapid case investigation, and infection prevention in hospitals and communities. Ending transmission in Congo remains a regional priority.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ流行が終息
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行自体は終息したが、感染源であるDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）での流行は継続中であり、越境流入による地域的リスクが高いままであるため、フルRRAでの継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息（対象国リスト外のため除外）だが、感染源であるDRCでの流行継続と地域リスクの高さが強調されており、DRCを対象国として記録。WHO/Africa CDCは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: "صحة الغربية" تستقبل وفدا صينيا لبحث تبادل الخبرات في مكافحة الأمراض المتوطنة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gharbia Health Directorate welcomes a Chinese delegation to discuss exchanging expertise in combating endemic diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-27, the Gharbia Health Directorate in Egypt hosted a joint delegation from the Ministry of Health and Population and research teams from Theodor Bilharz Institute and Jiangsu Institute, China, to exchange expertise on endemic diseases and advance diagnostic and preventive methods. Led by Dr. Amani El-Habashi, Egyptian and Chinese counterparts conducted a field inspection of a waterway to study surveillance and control of endemic diseases, followed by a training workshop at the Said Medical Center malaria training facility. The workshop reviewed modern diagnostic approaches for schistosomiasis and intestinal parasites, including hands-on microscopy. Dr. Rasha Khodr emphasized ongoing training and scientific collaboration as essential to strengthening surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, and management of endemic diseases, enhancing preventive and diagnostic services for the public. The program underscores integrating field operations with research to bolster the health system’s response to infectious and endemic diseases.

triage.headline_ja: 「ガルビーヤ保健局」が中国代表団を迎え、風土病対策における経験交流を協議
triage.triage_reason: エジプトと中国の研究協力・トレーニングワークショップに関する外交的・技術交流の記事であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエジプト・ガルビーヤ州における住血吸虫症・マラリア対策の研修・協力活動を報じるものであり、対象国（中国等）における実際の感染症発生事例ではない。中国は技術協力の相手国として登場するのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Seasonal influenza may rise, health authorities issue advisory
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza, including Influenza A/H1N1, is likely to rise in Jammu and Kashmir during the monsoon and winter. An advisory from SMVDIME, Kakryal, Reasi, urges infection-control measures to protect patients and healthcare workers. Most influenza cases are mild, but early recognition of symptoms—fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body ache, fatigue, vomiting or diarrhoea—is important, especially for vulnerable patients. Anyone with respiratory symptoms should wear a well-fitting mask in hospitals, inform staff, practice hand hygiene, and avoid unnecessary movement between ward areas. Attendants should limit presence to essential care and avoid visiting vulnerable patients when acutely ill. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics; influenza is viral. Antibiotics should be used only by clinicians. Hospitals should ensure ventilation, regular cleaning, PPE, triage/isolation, and visitor cohorting. Vaccination is encouraged for healthcare workers and at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザの増加が見込まれ、保健当局が注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する通常の注意喚起であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。ヒト-ヒト感染は既知の季節性パターンであり、特別な社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1含む）の増加予測に基づく病院向け感染対策アドバイザリーであり、通常の季節的公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur on swine flu alert amid Delhi cases | Kanpur News
article.articleSummary: Kanpur's city health department has issued an alert for swine flu (H1N1) as Delhi experiences a rise in cases. CMO Dr Haridatt Nemi directed all hospitals to remain vigilant. Special wards have been set up: five beds per community health centre; Kanshiram Chikitsalaya and KPM Hospital allotted 10 beds each; Ursala Hospital 20 beds; Lala Lajpat Rai Hospital 30 beds. About 200 doses of swine flu vaccine were secured as a precaution and will be given to seriously ill patients. Swine flu typically affects the nose, throat and lungs; while usually mild in healthy individuals, the elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with diabetes, heart disease, lung conditions, or other serious ailments are at higher risk. No laboratory confirmation details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: カーンプルでスワインフル(H1N1)警戒、デリーでの感染拡大を受けて
triage.triage_reason: デリーでの季節性H1N1（スワインフル）症例増加を受けカーンプルが警戒態勢を敷いたという内容だが、確定検査データや重症例数の詳細がなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限に至る要素は見られない。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとしてインドで既知の疾患であり、デリーでの症例増加に対しカーンプルが予防的措置（病床・ワクチン確保）を講じた段階。検査確定例数や死亡者数などの詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 226 inmates across 31 Assam jails test positive for HIV in four months | Guwahati News
article.articleSummary: 226 HIV-positive inmates were detected from April to July across 31 Assam jails, with injecting drug use linked to about 95% of cases. Of these inmates, 202 are on antiretroviral therapy (ART). ART teams visit jails due to security constraints preventing full in-custody treatment, and cases are identified through the Prison Intervention program for HIV/AIDS; officials say transmission within prisons cannot be confirmed, as IDU behavior occurs outside prisons and is detected via routine screening. Preventive measures include HIV screening, awareness programs, and testing for TB, sexually transmitted infections, and hepatitis B and C, along with treatment for infected inmates and opioid substitution therapy in some facilities. Health Minister Ashok Singhal notes Assam has about 33,000 active HIV/AIDS patients and emphasizes compassion, awareness, and stigma reduction, warning that intensified testing could reveal higher numbers.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州の31刑務所で過去4か月間に226人の受刑者がHIV陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患であるHIVについて、既存の刑務所内スクリーニングプログラムによる通常の検出結果報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれも明確に該当せず、新規アウトブレイクや異常事象とは言えない。
triage.notes: 注射薬物使用（IDU）を主な感染経路とする既知のHIV感染で、刑務所内での既存の介入プログラム（Prison Intervention program）による定期検出結果。保健当局は刑務所内での二次感染は確認されていないとしている。新興感染症や異常な公衆衛生事象ではなく、通常の疾病管理報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Face à Ebola, le vaccin Ervebo pour potéger les soignants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing Ebola, the Ervebo vaccine to protect healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: WHO has dispatched 70,000 doses of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, effective against the Zaïre strain, to the Democratic Republic of Congo as part of the outbreak response. Uganda has declared the Ebola outbreak over, with no new cases 42 days after the last patient recovered. Because no vaccine is licensed against the Bundibugyo strain, response efforts rely on Ervebo; Bundibugyo vaccines are under evaluation, and Minapharm has announced plans for trials. Frontline healthcare workers are prioritized for vaccination to protect health facilities and maintain outbreak response capacity; doses have not yet arrived in Bunia but are expected soon. In Kisangani, the government launched an Ervebo vaccination campaign, with 2,000 doses allocated to Tshopo and Bas-Uele provinces. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres issued a call for about $1.1 billion to bolster the Ebola response in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策として、医療従事者を保護するためのエルベボワクチン
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ザイール株）のDRCでの継続的な発生に対し、WHOがワクチン70,000回分を投入し、国連事務総長が11億ドルの支援を要請するなど、重大性・国際的関与・拡大リスクが確認されるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは42日間新規患者なしでアウトブレイク終了を宣言済みだが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC国内（Tshopo、Bunia等）でのワクチン接種活動が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Morcego infectado com raiva foi localizado em Jundiaí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Rabies-infected bat found in Jundiaí.
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected in a bat in Jundiaí, Brazil. Vigilância em Saúde Ambiental (VISAM) of the Municipal Secretariat of Health Promotion identified an Artibeus bat infected with the rabies virus on a rural property in the Pinheirinho district. The animal, found alive outdoors, was collected by VISAM after a resident request. Laboratory confirmation was issued by the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses de São Paulo (CCZ-SP) on August 26, 2026. There was no known contact between the bat and people or other animals. Following notification, VISAM initiated surveillance protocols, including epidemiological investigation, site assessment, and guidance to residents to mitigate risk. No additional cases are described in the report; public health authorities continue monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: JJ: 狂犬病に感染したコウモリがジュンジアイで発見される
triage.triage_reason: 単一のコウモリでの狂犬病確認事例であり、ヒトや他動物への感染は確認されていない。異常性や公衆衛生への深刻な影響は認められず、通常の動物監視の範疇である。
triage.notes: ヒトや他動物との接触は確認されておらず、地域の動物衛生監視当局（VISAM/CCZ-SP）が通常の対応を実施している段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Δυτικού Νείλου: Ερχονται rapid tests με μια σταγόνα αίματος - Ξεκινούν νυχτερινοί ψεκασμοί μετά την έξαρση κρουσμάτων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus: Rapid tests using a single drop of blood — night-time spraying begins after the surge in cases.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus is surging in Greece, with Attica at the epicenter. By 26 August, 232 cases have been recorded, including 75 in the past week, with 19 deaths (all in people over 65) and 73 hospitalizations, 26 in intensive care and one in a high-dependency unit. A notable case is a 13-year-old with central nervous system symptoms, the first minor requiring hospital care this season. Concurrently, an EKPA-led international research team (Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, Brazil) is pursuing a rapid diagnostic test for West Nile and other mosquito-borne diseases using one drop of blood, delivering results in under an hour; expected availability within 36 months. An emergency ground spraying operation covers about 10,000 stremata in eastern Attica (Artemida outskirts and along Arionos Street) and the Spata area near Athens International Airport, to run 11 p.m.–5 a.m. under ULV biocides, with area closures and beehives removed or covered; joint briefing by Attica Region, EODY, and local authorities led by Nikos Hardalias.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイル熱：一滴の血液で結果が出る迅速検査が登場 — 感染急増を受けて夜間消毒が開始
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャで西ナイル熱の感染者・死者数が急増し(232例、19死亡、73入院)、公衆衛生上深刻な影響が出ているため、IHR基準の2項目以上（深刻な影響・異常な増加）を満たす。
triage.notes: 本イベントはギリシャ（アッティカ地方）で発生している西ナイル熱の感染拡大に関するもので、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中のイタリア・スペイン・エストニア・オランダ・ブラジルは国際研究チームの参加国であり、発生地域ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : lancement de la campagne vaccination avec plus de 50 000 doses d'Ervebo | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: launch of the vaccination campaign with more than 50,000 doses of Ervebo | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launched an Ebola vaccination campaign in Kisangani, Tshopo, with over 50,000 Ervebo doses, prioritizing healthcare workers and people exposed to patients. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said the campaign aims to strengthen the response to an outbreak that remains deadly in several provinces. The outbreak is caused by Ebola virus species Bundibugyo. As of 24 August, authorities reported 5,514 cases and 2,642 deaths (case fatality 47.9%), with Ituri as the epicenter (4,750 cases, 2,133 deaths); North Kivu had 753 cases and 512 deaths; cases also in Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Sud-Kivu. In Tshopo, 15 cases and 8 deaths were recorded. Ervebo is approved for Zaïre ebolavirus, though the current strain is Bundibugyo; WHO says it may offer some protection and plans trials to assess efficacy against this strain. Vaccination complements surveillance, patient care, infection prevention/control, and community mobilization amid displacement and security challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：エルベボ5万回分以上によるワクチン接種キャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率47.9%に達する大規模なエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行が継続しており、複数州に拡大、ワクチン株不一致という異常性も認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 現行株（Bundibugyo）はErvebo（Zaïre株用ワクチン）の適応外であり、WHOが有効性評価の臨床試験を計画中。避難民や治安不安が対応を複雑化させている点も注視が必要。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान जनवरी से अब तक स्वाइन फ्लू के 146 मामले सामने आए, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी किया अलर्ट | Rajasthan reports 146 swine flu cases since Jan, health dept issues alert (Photo: IANS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan reports 146 swine flu cases since Jan, health dept issues alert (Photo: IANS).
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports 146 laboratory-confirmed H1N1 influenza (swine flu) cases since January 2026, prompting an alert from the Rajasthan Medical and Health Department. Following upticks in Delhi, the state health minister Gajendra Singh Khimsar said August 2026 saw 55 new cases; January–August totals break down as: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 20, Apr 22, May 25, Jun 14, Jul 5, Aug 55. No new or more dangerous H1N1 strain has been detected; IC(M)R information says the circulating virus remains the same. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, body aches, fatigue. Public health measures include screening, treatment, and referrals; avoid self-medication with antibiotics/ antivirals; minimize exposure by staying away from crowded places when symptomatic and wearing a mask as needed. Emphasize respiratory hygiene, rest, and fluids; seek immediate care for breathing difficulty, high fever, or severe weakness. Surveillance continues statewide; authorities urge calm and vigilance rather than panic.

triage.headline_ja: ラージャスターン州、1月以降のスワインフル（H1N1）症例が146件に、保健局が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の症例増加が報告されているが、新株の検出はなく当局も既知のウイルスとして冷静な対応を呼びかけている。重篤性や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、症例数の推移（特に8月の急増）は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 8月の新規症例数（55件）が1〜7月の月次数を上回っており増加傾向が見られるが、既知株であり重症度・死亡に関する情報はない。デリーでの増加も言及されているが本記事の主題はラージャスターン州。続報でのトレンド変化に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UN appeals for $1.1bn to tackle fast-growing Ebola outbreak in DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with Ituri province as the epicenter. More than 5,600 cases have been confirmed and at least 2,715 deaths since the outbreak began. The UN warns funds could run out within weeks unless an additional $1.1 billion is secured to fully fund the Ebola response, bringing total humanitarian needs and response to about $2.3 billion. Current funding is only 48% funded, with the United States a major contributor. The remaining funds would scale up health services, surveillance, logistics, community engagement, emergency staffing, and safe burial operations. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing and largest Ebola epidemic in DRC history, with around 500 new cases weekly and wide geographic spread. Ituri’s displacement of about 1 million people and regional vulnerability (South Sudan, CAR, Rwanda, Burundi) complicate control. Date: 2026-08-27.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、DRCで急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行対策に11億ドルの追加支援を訴え
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大かつ最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行で、死者2,715人・確認例5,600人超、資金不足により対応が危機的状況にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUS、Sudan、CAR、Rwanda、Burundiが含まれるが、これらは資金提供国や地域的リスク要因として言及されているのみで、実際の流行発生国はDRC（Ituri州）のみ。近隣国への拡大リスクは懸念事項として記載されているが、現時点で確定的な発生報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Padres y maestros en el Congo piden retrasar regreso a clases mientras brote de ébola se agrava
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parents and teachers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo urge delaying the return to classes as the Ebola outbreak worsens.
article.articleSummary: Worsening Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province drives 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak, the fastest-growing in history, has spread from three health zones to nearly 60, with most cases and deaths occurring in communities outside monitored contact tracing. Schools were to reopen on Sept 1, but parents and Ituri teachers urge delaying return to reduce risk; children aged 4 and under face about a 60% fatality rate. The UN Secretary-General seeks $1.1 billion in additional funding for the response, with the plan only 48% funded, largely due to US contributions. WHO warns the outbreak remains out of control and may surpass Africa’s 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Public health measures include limiting gatherings, social distancing, and airport closures; there are no approved vaccines or treatments yet for Bundibugyo virus, though regional trials are underway. Community trust and safe school reopening are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の親と教師、エボラ流行悪化の中で学校再開の延期を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で急速拡大し死者2,744名、史上最速の流行拡大とWHOが警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生上の懸念事項。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、感染拡大が監視外のコミュニティで進行中。資金不足（48%のみ確保）も深刻な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: UN chief condemns "indifference" as Ebola cases mount in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has over 5,600 cases and 2,700 deaths across six provinces since mid-May. WHO says transmission slowed but not reversed; about 500 new weekly cases. Funding is only 48% of requirements, with resources likely lasting weeks, prompting UN Secretary-General to seek an extra $1.1 billion. Ituri remains epicentre, with around one million displaced and more than 12 million in need region-wide; insecurity has killed more than 40 healthcare workers and attacked treatment centres and ambulances. Burundi is preparing for spillover; Uganda’s Bundibugyo outbreak is declared over after 42 days with no new cases (20 cases, 2 deaths). UN expands response with burial and community teams, 2,500+ volunteers; WHO has 260 experts and 330+ tonnes of supplies; nearly 30,000 prevention posters distributed in Kirundi, Swahili and French; Burundi labs strengthened; IOM launches a regional preparedness plan.

triage.headline_ja: 国連事務総長、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染拡大に「無関心」を非難
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,600例超、死亡2,700人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続し、複数国への拡大リスク・資金不足・治安悪化を伴う重大な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダのブンディブジョ流行は42日間新規例なしで終息宣言済み。ブルンジは拡大警戒中だが確定例の記載はないため対象国リストに含めず。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Febre do Nilo Ocidental: infecção rara já soma quatro casos e um óbito no Brasil em 2026 - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile Fever: a rare infection has now reached four cases and one death in Brazil in 2026 - Conexão Tocantins - News Portal
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever has reached Brazil in 2026 with four confirmed cases and one death. Cases are in São Paulo (two) and Santa Catarina (two), including a 77-year-old woman who died. The virus is transmitted by Culex mosquitoes after birds harbor it, with most infections asymptomatic or mild; when symptoms occur, they include sudden fever, malaise, vomiting, body aches, eye and head pain, and rash. Severe neuroinvasive disease can occur, presenting as encephalitis, meningitis, or acute flaccid paralysis. Diagnostic confirmation is via antibody tests: serum antibodies after five days of illness, or cerebrospinal fluid antibodies after eight days for neuroinvasive cases. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral for humans; prevention relies on vector control, personal repellents, protective barriers, and eliminating standing water. Health authorities emphasize surveillance and formal protocols if cases rise further.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイル熱：ブラジルで2026年に稀な感染症が4例、死亡1例に達する
triage.triage_reason: 希少な西ナイル熱がブラジル国内で複数州にわたり報告され死亡例もあるが、症例数は少なく国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 西ナイル熱はブラジルでは稀な疾病であり、複数州（サンパウロ、サンタカタリーナ）での発生と死亡例が確認されているため注視が必要。今後の症例増加や地理的拡大の有無を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Oti Region records four Mpox cases; all patients recover
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Oti Region, Ghana: four confirmed mpox cases in the first half of 2026, with all patients fully recovered after treatment. Suspected Cerebrospinal Meningitis cases were negative on laboratory tests. Dr Kofi Amo-Kodieh, Oti Regional Director of Health Services, announced at the 2026 Mid-Year Performance Review in Worawora, Biakoye District. Early detection, prompt treatment and robust disease surveillance underpinned the favorable outcome. Authorities call for sustained surveillance, community reporting, and continued public education on prevention and prompt care. Efforts to strengthen disease surveillance, laboratory testing and response mechanisms will continue, with emphasis on adequate resources, logistics and personnel to support hard-to-reach communities and guide the second half of 2026 toward timely, equitable healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: オティ地域で4件のMpox感染例を記録、全患者回復
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ・オティ地域での少数例（4例）のMpoxで、全例が治療により回復。既知の疾病で深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、定期保健報告の一部として言及された内容。
triage.notes: 記事は地域保健当局による定期的な半期業績レビューでの報告であり、既に収束した少数例の事例。追加の異常性や重症例の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo: As Ebola spreads, partners expand capacity for safe, dignified burials
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts rapid expansion of safe and dignified burial capacity, as the virus remains highly contagious after death. Partners are deploying 35 mobile burial teams and 286 community-based teams across Ituri, North Kivu and Tshopo, with coverage extending to Haut-Uélé and Bas-Uélé. The scale-up, led by the IFRC, the DRC Red Cross and FHI 360, mobilizes more than 2,500 volunteers and civil protection personnel to respond to alerts, conduct burials, and support disease surveillance, community engagement and psychosocial assistance. WHO notes 60% of deaths occur in communities, underscoring the need for strict burial protocols. As of Tuesday, authorities reported 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths, with nearly half of infections resulting in death. The effort aims to prevent further transmission as the outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ拡大に伴い、パートナーが安全かつ尊厳ある埋葬のための対応能力を拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定5,713例、死亡2,744例（致死率約48%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際機関(WHO/IFRC)が対応している重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: Ituri、North Kivu、Tshopo、Haut-Uélé、Bas-UéléはいずれもDRC国内の地域であり、DRCとして集約した。致死率約48%と非常に高く、既に大規模な国際支援(IFRC、DRC赤十字、FHI 360、WHO)が展開されている進行中の重大アウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ объявила Уганду свободной от Эболы после 42 дней без новых случаев
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declared Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days without a new case, following the discharge of the last confirmed imported Ebola case on July 16, 2026, and no further transmission linked to that case. Uganda reported a total of 20 Ebola cases and two deaths, with most infections among people who had arrived from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. WHO and Ugandan authorities stated the transmission chain was contained and the country was free of Ebola, though WHO adhered to protocol. Uganda urged countries that imposed travel restrictions during the outbreak to lift them. Uganda plans to open two additional Ebola treatment centers in the DRC, bringing the total to four. Since the outbreak started on May 15 in the DRC, the country has recorded over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths, the fastest-spreading outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダのエボラ終息を宣言、新規感染ゼロが42日間続く
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患であり、記事内で言及されているDRCでの流行は史上最速拡大とされ5,600例超・死者2,700人超という深刻な規模。ウガンダは終息宣言だが、根本流行地DRCは対象国であり継続中の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのエボラ終息宣言だが、感染源であるDRCでは史上最速拡大の流行が継続中（5,600例超、死者2,700人超）と記載されており、DRCは対象国として含めた。ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: लखनऊ में स्वाइन फ्लू से महिला की मौत: बलरामपुर में चल रहा था इलाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman dies of swine flu in Lucknow; treatment was underway in Balrampur.
article.articleSummary: In Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, a 50-year-old woman from Indiranagar died during treatment for swine flu, marking the capital’s first death this season. She developed fever, cold symptoms and breathlessness after a few days of illness and had treatment at a private hospital before being admitted to Balrampur Hospital on 25 August, where swine influenza was laboratory-confirmed. Her respiratory distress worsened; she required oxygen support and life-support measures and died around 2:30 pm on 27 August. The health department is investigating travel history and exposure, and monitoring the patient’s contacts; family members are being isolated and given medicines and precautions. Symptoms to watch for include fever, cough, sore throat, body pains and fatigue, with urgent care advised for breathing difficulties. This death has prompted heightened surveillance for swine flu in Lucknow.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウでスワインフル（豚インフルエンザ）により女性死亡：バルランプル病院で治療中
triage.triage_reason: 季節性豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）による単発の死亡例であり、インドでは既知の流行病であるため異常性は低いが、監視強化の動きがあるため今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本件はラクナウ（ウッタル・プラデーシュ州）における今季初の豚インフルエンザ死亡例。単発事例であり、現時点で大規模な流行や国際的拡大の兆候は見られないが、保健当局が接触者調査・監視を強化しているため続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is back and the IMF's relief fund is empty
article.articleSummary: Ebola is back in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 2,000 deaths confirmed this week and the UNDP warning the outbreak could push nearly 1 million people into poverty. The IMF’s Catastrophe Containment and Relief Trust (CCRT) now has about $120 million available, while DRC faces roughly $300 million in debt service next year and carries over $3 billion in IMF debt. The article recalls Ebola’s 2014 toll in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone and notes that the CCRT was created to redirect resources to health emergencies, but donor replenishment remains episodic (COVID-era pledges: UK $185 million, Japan $100 million). A proposal: sell some of IMF’s gold — about 90.5 million ounces, priced around $4,000/oz — to seed a permanent endowment funding subsidies, avoiding a political logjam of an 85% supermajority. This highlights the need for durable automatic relief.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が再燃、IMFの緊急援助基金は空になっている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で今週2,000人以上の死亡が確認されるエボラ出血熱の大規模再燃が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）に複数該当し、国際的な資金支援の必要性も明確であるためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は主にIMFの資金枯渇問題を論じており、疫学的詳細（症例定義、地域分布、感染経路等）は限定的。ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ・日本・英国は資金援助や2014年流行の文脈で言及されており、現在の発生地域としては確認できないため verified_locations から除外した。「今週2,000人死亡」という数字は異常に高く、記事の記述精度に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma três novos casos de sarampo e total de infectados no estado sobe para 26
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms three new measles cases and the total number of people infected in the state rises to 26.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in São Paulo state, Brazil: three new infections confirmed in the capital, increasing the 2026 total to 26. The new cases involve a boy and a girl under one year old and a 30-year-old woman; none had vaccination history. The capital now accounts for 23 of the 26 cases, with São Bernardo do Campo recording two and Guarulhos one. Of the 26 infections, 19 were unvaccinated or had incomplete immunization. In response, the state government continues a vaccination intensification campaign through September 1. In the three affected cities, vaccines are available at all Basic Health Units (UBSs) for people aged 6 months to 59 years, free of charge, regardless of prior doses.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹新規3例を確認、州内感染者total26人に増加
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州内で麻疹の散発的な増加が続いているが、重症例・死亡報告はなく、国際的拡大の兆候もないため、現時点ではフルリスク評価より継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 感染者の多くが未接種・接種不完全であり、州政府はワクチン強化キャンペーンを実施中。ブラジルは過去に麻疹排除認定を取り消されており、再興の継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | четверг: Ливан, Эбола, Непал, Ратко Младич
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top news of the day | Thursday: Lebanon, Ebola, Nepal, Ratko Mladić
article.articleSummary: Escalating fighting in southern Lebanon endangers civilians as UN officials report destruction of homes and infrastructure. The UN Interim Force in Lebanon calls for restraint and renewed negotiations after Hezbollah drone attacks and Israeli strikes, with continued airspace violations and notable ground activity by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest in history and the fastest-growing on record, with Secretary-General António Guterres warning that international attention and funding are far short of needs; the humanitarian plan is only about 48% funded, though substantial U.S. contributions are noted and resources would last only weeks. In Nepal, floods on 26 August across the Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading districts have killed more than 350 and left hundreds missing; UNICEF says at least 17,000 children require urgent aid, with $2 million released from the Central Emergency Response Fund. Ratko Mladić, former Bosnian Serb Army commander, has died; the Secretary-General condemns genocide denial and the glorification of war criminals.

triage.headline_ja: その日の主要ニュース｜木曜日：レバノン、エボラ、ネパール、ラトコ・ムラディッチ
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が史上最大・最速拡大と国連事務総長が警告し、資金不足により対応リソースが数週間しか持たないとされるなど、深刻性・異常性・管理可能性の観点で複数のWPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 元記事は国連ニュースの日刊まとめであり、レバノン情勢・ネパール洪水・ムラディッチ死去など複数トピックを含む。対象国基準に合致するのはDRCのエボラ流行のみ。レバノン、ネパール、ボスニア・ヘルツェゴビナ、イスラエル、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UN chief appeals for $1bn in Ebola aid for DR Congo
article.articleSummary: UN secretary-general Antonio Guterres on Aug 27, 2026 appealed for $1.1 billion to complete funding for a $2.1 billion Ebola response plan in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The U.S. has made a major contribution, but without additional funds vital operations will run out in weeks; the plan is 48% funded. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been more than 5,600 confirmed Ebola cases and over 2,700 deaths in the DRC, driven by the Bundibugyo species of the virus, for which there are no vaccines or treatments. The 2018–2020 outbreak killed 2,299 of 3,381 confirmed cases, according to WHO-based Congolese data. Testing refusals and community resistance hinder surveillance and control. WHO says efforts to ramp up are underway, and the EU is sending testing kits worth 2.5 million euros.

triage.headline_ja: 国連事務総長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応に10億ドルの支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: 5,600人超の確定患者、2,700人超の死者を伴う大規模エボラ流行（ワクチン・治療法なきブンディブジョ種）が進行中で、国際的な資金・支援要請がなされており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が明確に認められる。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブジョ種エボラウイルスによる大規模流行で、資金不足により対応活動が停止するリスクがある。地域拡大の可能性やコミュニティの検査拒否による監視・制御の困難さも報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: la JICA remet un lot d'intrants à la DSE pour renforcer la riposte contre Ebola en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: JICA hands over a batch of inputs to the DSE to strengthen the Ebola response in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: On 27 August 2026, JICA handed infection prevention and control inputs to the DSE to bolster the Ebola response in Ituri, DRC. The PPE includes masks, gloves, gowns, handwashing stations, waste bins, medical waste sorting kits, and disinfection products to protect health workers and improve patient care. JICA representative Keiichi Okitsu said the assistance supports the government's Ebola fight. The aid follows June's US$3 million package and the installation of 50 Starlink antennas to improve connectivity for epidemiological data transmission to Bunia and Kinshasa. DSE Director Dr Alphonsine Betau praised the partnership, noting the kit delivery emphasizes surveillance and also supports Ituri with WASH supplies and community surveillance training. WHO, 100 days after the outbreak declaration, says this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in DRC, with about 90 confirmed cases daily in the first three months, higher than prior West Africa and DRC outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:JICAがイトゥリ州のエボラ対応強化のためDSEに物資を引き渡す
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行はWHOにより「DRC史上最速拡大」と評価されており、1日約90例の確定例という高い感染速度と重症度を示している。国際支援（JICA、Starlink導入等）も継続的に行われており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はJICAの支援物資提供に関する報道だが、WHOが100日時点で『DRC史上最速拡大のエボラ流行』と評価している点が重要な新情報。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文で言及がないため除外。国際的拡大の有無は記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: PMC standing committee orders daily anti-mosquito drives amid dengue & chikungunya fears, seeks quick deployment of 265 employees
article.articleSummary: Pune's PMC standing committee ordered daily anti-mosquito drives as dengue and chikungunya fears mount; health dept and 15 ward offices to conduct spraying and fogging at vulnerable sites; inspectors to visit housing societies and open plots to eliminate stagnant water. The committee pushed for rapid deployment of 265 contracted mosquito-control workers; 150 permanent posts already filled, but recruitment of the remaining 265 is pending, with officials asked to explain delays. Residents reported fever and other health issues; activists urged awareness campaigns and faster action. Irregularities in spraying were flagged; repairs of damaged drainage lines prioritized. Authorities noted ongoing rainfall and August heat contributing to a spike in vector-borne risk; drain water contamination concerns were raised. So far this year PMC issued 1,708 notices and collected Rs 2.65 lakh as fines for mosquito-breeding violations.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市standing委員会、デング熱・チクングニヤ熱への懸念を受け毎日の防蚊活動を指示、265人の職員の早期配置を要請
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニヤ熱は南アジアで季節性に発生する既知の疾患であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、住民の発熱報告や当局の対応強化からWPRO基準（持続的暴露・流行しやすさ）に一部該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はプネー市（マハーラーシュトラ州）における行政の防蚊対策強化に関する内容で、感染者数・重症度・死亡者数などの具体的疫学データは記載されていない。季節性の雨季による蚊媒介感染症リスク増大への通常の行政対応と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Complex interactions between ecological and host factors drive continental patterns of avian influenza outbreak risk in Eurasia and Africa
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza viruses (AIV) outbreaks across Eurasia and Africa from 2004–2025, exceeding 50,000 reports, were analyzed to reveal continental patterns and cross-subset differences among highly pathogenic (HPAI), low-pathogenic (LPAI), domestic, and wild-bird groups. Using a multi-algorithm machine learning framework with 27 ecological features, the study achieved predictive accuracies ≥84% and found strong non-linear, strata-specific risk drivers. For all-AIV and wild-bird cohorts, vegetation indices and wetland proximity were the top spatial predictors. In contrast, domestic duck and chicken densities dominated predictions for LPAI and domestic poultry subsystems, while proximity to LPAI outbreaks was the strongest driver of HPAI risk. Underreporting in wildlife and developing regions limits data quality, but the framework offers a flexible tool for risk-based surveillance and targeted interventions at regional and global scales.

triage.headline_ja: 生態学的要因と宿主要因の複雑な相互作用がユーラシア・アフリカ大陸における鳥インフルエンザ発生リスクの大陸パターンを駆動する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2004〜2025年の鳥インフルエンザ発生データを用いた生態学的リスク予測モデルに関する学術研究であり、特定の現在進行中の発生イベントを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature Scientific Reports掲載の学術論文であり、機械学習を用いた鳥インフルエンザ発生リスクの生態学的解析研究。特定の国での現在の発生事例を報じるものではなく、ユーラシア・アフリカ全域の過去データを対象とした統計モデリング研究のため、対象国での実際の発生イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Demand for vaccines surges as H1N1, other influenza cases see a sharp rise
article.articleSummary: In India, demand for flu vaccines and rapid testing surges as H1N1 and other influenza strains spread during the monsoon. Flu vaccine sales are roughly three times higher than last year, with at-home vaccination services launched by Tata 1mg, Apollo Homecare and PharmEasy, and the 2026-27 vaccine updated per WHO guidance driving uptake. H1N1 infections this monsoon are more than six-fold higher than previous years, prompting increased demand from individuals and corporates, amid supply constraints in several cities. Rapid molecular diagnostics for influenza A, B and subtypes such as H3 are rising across North India and other regions, including tier-2 and tier-3 locations. Overlapping symptoms with dengue and typhoid complicate diagnosis; same-visit testing aids timely treatment decisions. ICMR emphasizes no panic, noting seasonal influenza is generally mild but vaccination and protective measures are advised for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1やその他のインフルエンザ症例の急増でワクチン需要が急増
triage.triage_reason: H1N1感染者数が例年の6倍以上に急増し、複数都市でワクチン供給不足が生じるなど社会的関心が高まっているため、WPRO基準（異常性・持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）と社会的関心の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: ICMRは季節性インフルエンザは概ね軽症であり『パニックにならないように』と発表しているため、重症度は低いと判断。ただし感染者数の急増とワクチン供給不足は続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose dispara em Londrina: saiba identificar os sinais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis Surges in Londrina: Learn to Identify the Signs.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Sporotrichosis surges in Londrina, Brazil, with cases more than doubling versus 2025. The fungal infection can spread from animals to humans. In cats, signs include non-healing skin wounds, especially on the face, paws, and ears; transmission to people occurs via contact with infected animals, particularly scratches, bites, or contact with lesions. For suspected cases, avoid direct contact and seek veterinary guidance. In humans, infection can cause skin lesions and requires medical evaluation for diagnosis and treatment. Prevention centers on proper animal care, monitoring for signs, and veterinary follow-up when suspicions arise. Early identification helps protect both cats and humans living with them. Insights are provided by veterinarian Flavia Navas and dermatologist Rodrigo Pita on recognizing signs and managing care."}

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナでスポロトリコーシスが急増：症状の見分け方
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州ロンドリーナ市でスポロトリコーシス（真菌感染症）の症例が前年比で倍増しているが、既知の動物由来感染症であり重症度・国際拡大のリスクは低いため、フルRRAには至らず経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスは猫由来の人獣共通感染症で、ブラジルでは既知の地域的流行パターンがある。本記事はロンドリーナ市の地域ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、症例増加傾向は継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: غوتيريش يدعو لتوفير 1.1 مليار دولار لتمويل خطة الاستجابة لفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guterres calls for $1.1 billion to fund the Ebola response plan.
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on August 27, 2026, urged $1.1 billion to fund the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, warning that current resources will run out in weeks. The outbreak in the DRC is described as the fastest-growing in history, spreading faster than containment capacity, with more than 5,600 confirmed cases and over 2,700 deaths since the May 15 declaration. The UN has launched a response plan totaling $2.13 billion; without additional funding, expansion of vital operations will be jeopardized. About $80 million has already been allocated to UN partners supporting the response. Guterres emphasized overcoming a “virus of indifference” amid dwindling international attention. Separately, the WHO announced the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda after 42 days without a new case.

triage.headline_ja: グテーレス事務総長、エボラ対応計画の資金確保に11億ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速とされるエボラ流行が継続中で、感染者5600人超・死者2700人超、国連が資金不足による対応崩壊を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのエボラ流行は42日間新規感染者なしで終息が発表されたが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行が主題であり継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu cases spike to 33 in city, many down with flu-like illness
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) cases spike in Nagpur, India. As of August 2026, 33 new H1N1 cases were reported this month, bringing the city’s cumulative tally to 66 since January. A surge in influenza-like illnesses is observed across public and private hospitals, with patients presenting cold, cough, fever, and vomiting. Doctors attribute the rise to seasonal weather changes, crowding during recent religious festivals, and travel-related exposure; Nagpur’s weather has shifted from humid warmth to rainy, cooler conditions. Most H1N1 patients recover within five to seven days, aided by antiviral therapy and supportive care. Experts say there is no evidence of a new strain; cases remain sporadic and seasonal. Emphasis is placed on simple hygiene measures to reduce transmission and on early diagnosis and treatment, especially for the elderly and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: ナグプール市でH1N1(豚インフルエンザ)感染者が33人に急増、多くの人がインフルエンザ様症状で受診
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1インフルエンザの通常範囲内の増加であり、専門家も新型株の証拠はなく散発的・季節的と評価している。国際的拡大や重症化、社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加を報告しており、専門家は新規株ではなく散発的・季節的な感染拡大と説明。重症例も多くなく、抗ウイルス薬と支持療法で5〜7日で回復すると記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS déclare la fin de l'épidémie d'Ebola en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares the end of the Ebola outbreak in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC declare the Uganda Ebola outbreak over after 42 days without a new case, following the last patient's discharge on July 16. Uganda recorded 20 infections and 2 deaths; the others recovered. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), near Uganda, and has since spread to six DRC provinces, with more than 2,700 deaths and over 5,650 confirmed cases, the deadliest outbreak in the country's history. The Bundibugyo strain was involved in Uganda. The 42-day period, two incubation cycles, indicates no ongoing transmission from the last imported case, per WHO and Africa CDC. The UN appealed for $1.1 billion to complete the 2.13-billion humanitarian plan; funding is about 48% secured, with the United States a major contributor. Without more funds, essential operations risk being scaled back in weeks.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダでのエボラ流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行終息は朗報だが、記事はDRCでの史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（死亡2,700人以上、6州に拡大）が継続中であり、人道支援資金の48%しか確保されていないため対応縮小のリスクがあることを報告しており、継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息宣言だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCでの流行は同一のエボラアウトブレイクの起源であり史上最悪規模（死亡2,700人超）で継続中とされ、資金不足による対応縮小リスクが指摘されているため、DRCを含めPICKUPと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Himachal: Four test positive for swine flu at Tanda - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Four swine flu cases (influenza A(H1N1)) detected at Dr Rajendra Prasad Government Medical College, Tanda, in Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh. Four positives were found out of eight samples tested. Patients include two children (7 months and 1 year) from Kangra and two elderly men (72 and 85) from Chamba district, all presenting with cold, cough and fever. They were shifted to separate facilities for monitoring. Laboratory confirmation followed sample testing. Kangra Chief Medical Officer Dr Omesh Kumar Bharati issued an advisory to health institutions to identify flu-like symptoms, admit suspected cases for assessment and testing, and to wear masks. Swine flu spreads mainly via respiratory droplets and presents like seasonal influenza; most patients recover without serious complications, though risk is higher for young children, the elderly, and those with underlying conditions.

article.articleHeadline: نیمی از افراد مبتلا به ابولا در کنگو جان باخته اند
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Half of those infected with Ebola in Congo have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 5,713 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 2,744 deaths. The outbreak is active across six provinces and 58 health zones, with 770 patients in isolation or hospitalized and ongoing surveillance of suspected cases. Since its resurgence in April 2026, this marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted mainly by direct contact with body fluids of an infected person, causing severe fever, internal bleeding, and organ failure. The response continues with field operations, case management, and monitoring as authorities work to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染した人の半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,713例・2,744死亡（致死率約48%）の大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが6州58保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 2026年4月に再燃した2026年のDRCエボラアウトブレイクで、1976年以来17回目の発生。症例数・死者数が非常に多く、複数州にまたがる大規模流行であるため緊急性が高い。

No operational or clinical details are provided in the excerpt. triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患に関する報道だが、記事本文が欠落しており症例数・発生状況等の疫学情報が全くないため、フルRRAに進むための十分な根拠が不明。国境監視強化という政策的動向のみ確認できる。
