article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarampo em São Paulo alerta Curitiba para necessidade da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in São Paulo alerts Curitiba to the need for vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state prompts vaccination alert for Curitiba. As of 2026-08-27, Brazil reports 24 confirmed measles cases in 2026, 23 in São Paulo, with no cases in Paraná or Curitiba. Measles is highly contagious and spreads via respiratory droplets and airborne particles; early symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, followed by a spreading reddish rash. Officials urge maintaining vaccination. Brazil’s program prescribes two measles-containing doses: first at 12 months and a second at 15 months. For ages 15 months to 29 years, two doses in life; ages 30 to 59 years, at least one dose; health professionals, two doses. In Curitiba, check vaccination status via Imuniza Já Curitiba, Saúde Já app, or Central Saúde Já Curitiba (3350-9000). Vaccines may appear as SR (double viral), VTV/SCR/MMR (triple viral), or SCRV (tetra-viral).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹の集団発生、クリチバでもワクチン接種の必要性を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で24例（うち23例がサンパウロ州）の麻疹確定例が報告されているが、パラナ州・クリチバでは症例なく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で確認されていない。ワクチン接種率低下による感染拡大の可能性はあり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はサンパウロ州での麻疹発生とクリチバへの予防的注意喚起。クリチバ・パラナ州では実際の症例は報告されていないため、これらは発生地域として扱わずブラジル全体として集約した。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 166 fresh H1N1 cases in Delhi in 24 hours
article.articleSummary: Delhi logged 166 fresh H1N1 cases in the last 24 hours, raising the cumulative tally to 2,612, with Influenza-A cases around 3,300 overall. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh toured Indira Gandhi Hospital in Dwarka to review preparedness across hospitals and the Health Department amid rising activity. Officials said Delhi is monitoring ongoing H1N1 activity and surveillance efforts across facilities. The daily count followed 138 cases the previous day. No infection source or lab-confirmation details are provided in the report. Separately, AAP leaders accused Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital of neglect, alleging shortages of prescribed medications and essential tests; AAP MLAs Sanjeev Jha and Kuldeep Kumar visited the facility to assess conditions.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで24時間に166件のH1N1新規感染
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例数増加が報告されているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報が不足しており、既知の病原体による国内流行の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、デリーでは例年流行がみられる。保健大臣による病院視察や野党による医療体制批判など政治的関心はあるが、重症度・死亡率・検査確定に関する情報が記事に含まれていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra 26 casos de sarampo; maioria não tinha vacinação completa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reports 26 measles cases; most were not fully vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in São Paulo state with 26 confirmed infections as of August 27, 2026. São Paulo city accounts for 23 cases, São Bernardo do Campo 2, Guarulhos 1. The majority of patients lacked a complete vaccination schedule. Vaccination remains available at health posts through September 1, with eligibility for people aged 6 months to 59 years. The report does not specify infection sources or travel/import status. The outbreak highlights gaps in immunization coverage within the metropolitan area and ongoing transmission. Authorities emphasize vaccination to curb spread, particularly in populations with incomplete vaccination. No deaths are mentioned in the report.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹26例確認、大半がワクチン未完了接種者
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹26例が確認されワクチン接種率の低さが背景にあるが、死亡例なく地域内で管理されているため、フルRRAには進まず継続的な経過観察が適切と判断した。
triage.notes: 麻疹はワクチン接種率低下により再興しやすい疾患であり、サンパウロ都市圏での接種率ギャップが継続的な感染拡大リスクを示している。ただし現時点では死亡例や国際的拡大の報告はなく、地域保健当局による予防接種キャンペーンで対応中。続報でケース数増加や地域拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo tem 26 casos de sarampo; vacina segue disponível
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo has 26 measles cases; the vaccine remains available.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, São Paulo state has reported 26 measles cases this year, with three new infections in the capital. All three unvaccinated individuals include two infants under one year old and a woman in her early 30s. The outbreak appears centered in São Paulo city, with a vaccination campaign ongoing. The state is using the measles–mumps–rubella (triple viral) vaccine to boost immunity; the campaign runs through 1 September, and children and adolescents under 15 can receive the vaccine at basic health units. In the capital and in São Bernardo do Campo, the vaccine is also available for adults up to 59 years old.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹26例、ワクチンは接種可能
triage.triage_reason: 国内での麻疹症例増加とワクチン未接種者による感染が確認されているが、規模は小さく国際的拡大の兆候はないため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 州レベルでのワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施中であり、地元自治体が対応している。未接種者（乳児・成人）への感染拡大が続いている点は流行しやすさの観点で注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ¡Alerta por ébola! ONU pide mil 100 millones de dólares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert! UN seeks $1.1 billion.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts UN to seek $1.1 billion to sustain and expand the response as part of a $2.1 billion international plan. Since authorities declared the outbreak on May 15, 2026, there have been more than 5,600 confirmed Ebola cases and over 2,700 deaths in the DRC. The virus is Bundibugyo, a rare Ebolavirus species for which there are currently no vaccines or treatments available. UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned that resources could run out within weeks if new contributions are not received, threatening essential surveillance, care, and containment operations. About 48 percent of the total program resources are in place, including a significant US contribution. The appeal aims to sustain the response through the coming months and prevent further escalation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒！国連が11億ドルの支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が5,600例超・死者2,700人超に達し、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない中、資金不足により対応が数週間で崩壊する恐れがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo種エボラウイルスはワクチン・治療法が確立されておらず、致死率が高い。国連が大規模な国際支援（11億ドル）を要請しており、資金不足が続けばサーベイランス・治療・封じ込め体制が崩壊する恐れがある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Lubero : vigilance maximale recommandée aux habitants de la chefferie des Bamate - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Lubero: Maximum Vigilance Recommended for the Inhabitants of the Bamate Chiefdom - ACP
article.articleSummary: On Aug 27, 2026, in Lubero, the Bamate Chiefdom in North Kivu, DRC, Mwami Shabani Mukosasenge urged maximum vigilance amid an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Since the outbreak declaration on May 15, 2026, the DRC had over 5,600 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths as of Aug 25. The Bamate authority warns the disease is extremely dangerous and can kill rapidly if not treated promptly. Residents are urged to report any symptoms compatible with Ebola to health services, avoid physical contact with patients or the deceased, and never handle or wash a corpse under suspicious circumstances. Emphasis on strict preventive measures: regular handwashing, avoid contact with body fluids, use protection when caring for the sick, and cooperate with health teams. Community involvement is essential to containment and decision-making.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロでのエボラ:バマテ首長領住民に最大限の警戒を推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が継続中(5,600例超、死亡2,700例超)であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 5月15日の流行宣言以降、5,600例超・死亡2,700例超と致死率が非常に高く、既に大規模な公衆衛生危機に発展している。フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: CRDT conta com estrutura preparada para atendimento seguro de doenças infectocontagiosas - Diário do Amapá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CRDT has prepared infrastructure for safe care of infectious and contagious diseases - Diário do Amapá
article.articleSummary: CRDT in Macapá, Amapá, Brazil, has prepared infrastructure for safe care of infectious and contagious diseases, prioritizing airborne pathogens such as tuberculosis and Hansen’s disease (leprosy). It uses separated workflows, dedicated air-conditioned consultation rooms, and respiratory protection with ventilation-focused strategies to reduce airborne particle exposure. The center provides infectious diseases, pneumology, and dermatology services, serving about 250–300 patients daily within the SUS framework to deliver specialized care near home. Access begins with clinical evaluation; suspected TB or Hansen’s disease patients are routed to CRDT after a general clinician assessment. Dermatology and pneumology appointments are scheduled via Super Fácil, while infectious disease care can be accessed directly. Hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00–17:00, at Rua Professor Tostes, Santa Rita, Macapá. Users must present SUS Card, personal documents, and any required referral.

triage.headline_ja: CRDT、感染症の安全な診療体制を整備 - Diário do Amapá
triage.triage_reason: 医療施設の平時の診療体制整備に関する記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 結核・ハンセン病は既知の疾患であり、記事は医療機関の施設・運用体制の紹介であって発生事例の報告ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、本記事は通常診療の説明のためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Το rapid test επιστρέφει - Τι ανακοίνωσε ο ΕΟΔΥ για τον ιό του Δυτικού Νείλου
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rapid test is back - What did EODY announce about the West Nile virus.
article.articleSummary: European-led effort in Greece aims to develop a rapid diagnostic test for West Nile virus and other mosquito-borne infections. Coordinated by Maria Gazouli of the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, with partners from Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil, the project uses nanotechnology to create a bedside test that can detect infection and identify the specific virus. Still in research, the test is not yet available; it targets a drop of blood with results in under an hour and without lab processing. First substantive results are expected within two years, with the program completing in 36 months and potential commercialization thereafter. In Greece, West Nile virus is rising: as of 26 August 2026, 232 cases (75 in the last week) and 19 deaths (all over 65). 73 hospitalized, 26 in ICU, 1 in a high-dependency unit. Cases span 61 municipalities in 18 regional units across five regions; Attica has the most (37 municipalities). Other distribution: Central Macedonia 12, Thessaly 9, Sterea Ellada 2, Peloponnese 1. Six additional municipalities are deemed high risk despite no cases yet: Heraklion (Attica), Nea Smyrni, Nea Filadelfeia–Nea Chalkidona, Dafni–Ymittos, Amphipolis, Serres, Thasos.

triage.headline_ja: ラピッドテストが復活 - EODY（ギリシャ疾病予防管理センター）が西ナイルウイルスについて発表した内容
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャで西ナイルウイルス感染が拡大し、19名の死亡・73名の入院（26名がICU）が報告されており、重症度・地域拡大・社会的関心（当局発表・新型迅速診断法の開発）の観点からシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 発生地域はギリシャ（対象国リスト外）。ブラジル等は研究協力パートナーとして言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Malinau libatkan desa dan RT percepatan penanggulangan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malinau engages villages and RTs to accelerate TB control.
article.articleSummary: Malinau, North Kalimantan, Indonesia, expands tuberculosis (TB) control beyond the Health Department by involving villages and RTs (neighborhood associations). Officials emphasize eliminating stigma that TB is a curse, hereditary, or confined to the poor to boost screening and treatment uptake. In line with Presidential Regulation No. 67/2021, cross‑sector collaboration engages the Regional Development Planning Agency (Bappeda), the Department of Community Empowerment and Village Affairs (DPMD), camats, village heads, and RT leaders to ensure education and case-finding reach the subdistrict level. After screening, these actors educate communities, encourage symptomatic individuals to seek testing, and support patients to adhere to treatment, while addressing housing conditions, ventilation, smoking, immunity, and close contact to reduce transmission. Plans include village-level strategies with adat and religious leaders, a pilot TB management project in one village, and 2027 APBD funds prioritized for health and education despite potential revenue declines.

triage.headline_ja: マリナウ、TBC対策加速のため村・RTを関与させる
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの拡充に関する行政的取り組みの記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は地域行政による既存の対策強化・啓発活動を報じるもので、異常な流行や新規発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados confirma 7 casos de chikungunya em uma semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados confirms 7 cases of chikungunya in one week.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Dourados, Brazil, reports seven new chikungunya confirmations in the 32nd epidemiological week (Aug 16–22), bringing the cumulative totals to 5,180 confirmed cases, 44 suspected, 5,197 discarded, and 47 awaiting classification. In the Indigenous Reserve, 3,190 notifications yield 2,314 confirmed cases. The outbreak has caused 18 deaths overall, including 11 Indigenous residents from the Bororó and Jaguapiru villages. The week 12 peak recorded 1,209 notifications and 672 confirmed. The city remains in a public health emergency; vector-control efforts by endemic agents—house-to-house visits, notifications, and fines—have contributed to a decline in cases. Authorities urge continued vigilance: eliminate standing water inside homes, keep backyards clean, and avoid improper waste disposal to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ドウラードス市、1週間でチクングニア熱7例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドウラードス市で公衆衛生緊急事態が継続中であり、累計5,180例確定・18名死亡（先住民11名含む）という重症度の高いアウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討すべきである。
triage.notes: 市当局は公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言済みで、ベクター対策（家屋訪問、罰金措置等）により症例数は減少傾向にあるが、先住民保護区での死亡例が多く注視が必要。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose exige atenção aos sinais e medidas de prevenção, orienta Hetrin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis requires attention to signs and preventive measures, says Hetrin.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis, transmitted by the female sandfly, is highlighted by Hospital Estadual de Trindade – Walda Ferreira dos Santos (Hetrin) in Trindade. It presents in two forms: tegumentary (cutaneous) leishmaniasis and visceral leishmaniasis. Cutaneous disease causes chronic skin lesions with raised borders that may require prolonged treatment. Visceral leishmaniasis can affect internal organs and manifest as fever, weakness, and hepatosplenomegaly with abdominal distension. No human vaccine exists; prevention relies on vector control and environmental hygiene. Recommendations include installing screens on doors and windows, keeping areas around homes clean, and removing clutter to reduce sandfly breeding sites. If persistent skin lesions or symptoms such as prolonged fever, weakness, or abdominal swelling occur, seek medical evaluation for diagnosis. The alert emphasizes vigilance and preventive measures as of 2026-08-27.

triage.headline_ja: リーシュマニア症は症状への注意と予防措置が必要、ヘトリン病院が助言
triage.triage_reason: 地域の病院による一般的な疾患啓発・予防啓発記事であり、特定の異常発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・トリンダーデ市の州立病院による、リーシュマニア症（皮膚型・内臓型）の一般的な予防啓発・症状注意喚起であり、具体的なアウトブレイクや症例数増加の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo lança campanha de vacinação contra o Ebola | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo launches Ebola vaccination campaign
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo launched an Ebola vaccination campaign on 27 August 2026, starting with frontline health workers in Ituri Province as authorities press to contain what officials describe as the country’s largest and deadliest outbreak. The outbreak began in Ituri on 15 May and has since spread to six provinces, with over 5,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 2,500 deaths. About 50,000 vaccine doses have arrived, enabling expansion to neighboring provinces in a ring vaccination approach toward the epicenter. The Ervebo vaccine, licensed for Zaire ebolavirus, is being used but its efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus is unproven; 20,000 of 70,000 doses are in a trial to assess cross-protection. Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no approved vaccine or treatment, while Bundibugyo-specific vaccine candidates are under development by Oxford and IAVI.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルスワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大・最も死亡率の高いエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、6州に拡大、5000人超の確定患者と2500人超の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクは同国史上最大・最も死亡率の高いエボラ出血熱の流行とされ、Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に懸念される。Ervebo(Zaireエボラ用)の交差防御効果は未確立で、Oxford・IAVIによるBundibugyo特異的ワクチン開発が進行中。国際的な支援（ワクチン供与、臨床試験）が既に行われている。
