article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू को लेकर स्वास्थ्य विभाग एलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department Alerts on Swine Flu
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) alert issued in Sant Kabir Nagar district, Uttar Pradesh, after cases reported in major cities; district currently has no cases and no panic. Monitoring is led by Chief Medical Officer Dr. Ramanuj Kanoj ia and Deputy CMHO Dr. RP Maurya. Symptoms of H1N1 resemble fever and include fever with body aches, red eyes, runny nose, sore throat, chills, sweating, fatigue, and in some cases diarrhea, abdominal pain, or vomiting. Transmission is airborne via sneezing and coughing. No definitive cure exists; treatment is symptom-based and may resolve in 3–5 days with regular medications. Samples will be sent for testing to BRD Medical College. Public advice emphasizes avoiding crowded places, especially during festivals when many outsiders arrive, and minimizing contact with potential cases while monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルーに関して衛生局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 現時点で当該地区に症例はなく、他都市での発生を受けた予防的アラートに留まるため、フルRRAの必要性は低いが動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1季節性インフルエンザに関する地方衛生当局の予防的注意喚起。現地区での確定例なし、パニックなしと明記。他都市の状況は不明。

article.articleHeadline: ▷ La OMS declara a Uganda oficialmente libre de ébola tras contener el brote #27Ago
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ▷ WHO declares Uganda officially Ebola-free after containing the outbreak #27Aug
article.articleSummary: Uganda has been declared Ebola-free by the Ministry of Health and the World Health Organization after 42 consecutive days with no new infections, the regulatory window twice the virus incubation period. The outbreak in Uganda totaled 20 Ebola virus disease cases and 2 deaths, with most linked to individuals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and hemorrhagic fever symptoms were noted. The last confirmed patient was discharged on July 16. Uganda’s rapid public-health response—surveillance, isolation, and treatment—prevented national spread at the border, contrasting with the DRC, which has reported over 5,600 cases and more than 2,700 deaths since May, marking one of the fastest-spreading EVD outbreaks in history. Border health measures helped avert healthcare-system collapse on the Congolese side.

triage.headline_ja: ▷ WHOがウガンダのエボラ終息を正式宣言、流行を制圧 #8月27日
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダはエボラ終息が宣言されたが、記事はDRCで5,600例以上・死者2,700人超という史上最速級のエボラ流行が継続中であることを明記しており、IHR基準に複数該当するため深刻な公衆衛生イベントとしてフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 見出し・主旨はウガンダのエボラ終息宣言だが、記事内で言及されているDRCの流行（5,600例以上、死者2,700人超）は現在進行中の重大イベントであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行状況について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Parents and teachers in Congo urge delay of school resumption as Ebola outbreak rages on
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern Ituri province (Bunia) and neighboring Nord Kivu host a rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus. The outbreak has 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, according to Congolese health authorities. Africa CDC officials warn case and death counts continue rising; only 30–40% of cases may be detected, suggesting the outbreak could be up to three times larger than tallies. Children under four have the highest case‑fatality rate, about 60%. Schools are due to reopen Sept 1, but parents and teachers in Ituri urge delaying return until protections improve. Measures include temperature screening on arrival and provision of sanitizing gel; water scarcity complicates hygiene. No approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus; vaccine trials underway, including Ervebo (Zaire strain) with front-line workers soon receiving doses. The UN requests $1.1B to augment a $2.13B plan, 48% funded.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの保護者と教師、エボラ流行が拡大する中で学校再開の延期を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ流行が急拡大し、致死率も高く（5,713例、死亡2,744例）、ワクチン・治療法未承認、国際支援要請額も巨額であることから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高いシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 検出率が30-40%と推定され、実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性。学校再開延期要求は社会的関心の高さを示す。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyoウイルス株であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ouganda déclare la fin d'Ebola, vigilance maintenue en RDC voisine - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda declares the end of Ebola, vigilance maintained in neighboring DRC - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Uganda officially declared the end of the Ebola virus disease outbreak on its territory as of 27 August 2026 after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases, according to Africa CDC. The achievement reflects strong national leadership, health worker dedication, sustained epidemiological surveillance, robust community engagement, and tight cross-border coordination. Africa CDC congratulated the Ugandan government, frontline teams, and partners involved, noting that interrupting each transmission chain brings the region closer to global eradication of the outbreak. Vigilance remains high, as the response continues in neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. Key measures—rapid detection, reinforced surveillance, and ongoing bilateral cooperation—are essential to protect local populations and halt transmission along borders.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ流行終息を宣言、隣国DRCでは警戒継続 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラ流行終息宣言は好材料だが、隣接するコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）では対応・警戒が継続中とされ、越境感染リスクが完全には払拭されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは『隣国での警戒継続・対応継続』と明記されており、越境感染監視の対象として含めた。ウガンダの流行終息自体は良好なニュースであり新規シグナルというより経過報告的位置づけ。

article.articleHeadline: Creche suspende aulas após confirmação de caso de sarna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Daycare center suspends classes after confirmation of a case of scabies.
article.articleSummary: Daycare center in Ibatiba, in the Caparaó region of Brazil, suspended classes after a confirmed case of scabies in a student. The infection was identified in one classroom, and the school promptly implemented measures to prevent transmission, notifying the Municipal Sanitation Surveillance, which advised on necessary precautions. As a preventive step, the facility will undergo cleaning and pest-control treatment over the weekend, with activities expected to resume on Monday, August 31. The Education Department stated that all feasible measures have been taken to reduce transmission and that the situation is being monitored. Scabies is a skin disease caused by a small mite; transmission occurs mainly through direct, prolonged contact with an infected person, particularly in close-contact settings. Symptoms include intense itching at night and skin lesions; the disease is treatable and controllable with appropriate measures.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の症例確認を受け、託児所が授業を停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は治療可能で一般的な皮膚疾患であり、単一の託児所内での限定的な発生に留まり、公衆衛生上の重大な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方の託児所における単発的な疥癬症例であり、自治体の衛生監視当局が対応し、既に管理下にある事案。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : un hôpital impose un protocole de prise en charge pour tout suspect d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: a hospital imposes a protocol for the management of any suspected Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, 27 August 2026 (ACP) – Reverend Mokili Referral Hospital in Kisangani, Tshopo, Democratic Republic of Congo, has instituted a strict management protocol for anyone with Ebola-like symptoms. Healthcare staff collect symptoms, contacts, and origin; samples are sent to provincial laboratory to confirm or exclude Ebola virus disease (EVD). While awaiting results, patients are isolated in a secure room to limit transmission to staff, other patients, and companions. If the test is negative, care proceeds for the diagnosed condition; if positive, patients are immediately referred to an Ebola treatment center for specialized care. Post-transfer, the room and potentially contaminated equipment undergo rigorous decontamination with safe disposal of non-disinfectable items. At Saint-Joseph Health Center in Tshopo, a triage system screens entrants—temperature checks and handwashing with chlorinated water—with isolation if suspected and escalation to response teams. Since the outbreak was declared in Tshopo, no suspected cases have been recorded at this center.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:病院がエボラ疑い患者全員に対応プロトコルを導入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ツショポ州で既に宣言されているエボラ出血熱の流行に関連する記事であり、疾患の重篤性と地域拡大のリスクから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生報告ではなく、既に宣言されたツショポ州のエボラ流行に対する病院の管理プロトコル導入を報じるもの。流行の規模・拡大状況・感染者数など詳細情報が本記事には含まれないため、フルリスク評価にて現状把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UN chief regrets lack of int'l attention to Ebola, calls for action
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing and largest in the country’s history. As of Aug. 25, 2026, 5,713 cases were confirmed and 2,744 people died, with about 500 new cases reported each week. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged immediate international action, warning that indifference, insufficient funding, and limited political attention impede containment despite known transmission-interruption strategies. The UN has proposed a 2.13 billion USD humanitarian plan for needs and response, with 48% funded; current resources will last weeks, not months, risking gaps as operations expand. The crisis devastates families and communities, with women and children disproportionately affected. The article calls for greater global attention and support to stop the outbreak. It does not provide details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国連事務総長、エボラへの国際的関心の欠如を憂慮し行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速・最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大中(致死率約48%)で、国際的な資金・関心不足が対応を阻害しており、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心の両面から深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 国連事務総長自らが国際的な資金不足・関心の低さを問題視して発言しており、既に大規模な人的被害（死者2,744人）が発生。資金は数週間分しか確保されておらず、対応が拡大するとギャップが生じるリスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : ouverture d'un nouveau centre de traitement à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: opening of a new treatment center in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts opening of a new Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Beni, North Kivu, by Médecins sans Frontières (MSF) with the Ministry of Health to speed diagnosis, treatment, and contact tracing, aiding containment across one of the hardest-hit areas. MSF already supports an ETC and isolation centers in Butembo. The Beni ETC adds to 18 isolation rooms (five more under construction at Kasabinyole) and four local health centers (Kanzulinzuli, Malepe, Madrandele, Kasabinyole) offering free consultations for common diseases, in order to ensure rapid hospitalization, dignified isolation, appropriate care and nutrition, while maintaining family contact per prevention measures. The 17th outbreak, declared May 15, has spread to six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, and Tshopo. As of Aug 22, >5,514 confirmed cases and 2,642 deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ベニに新たな治療センターを開設 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 第17次エボラ流行として6州に拡大し、5,514例超・死者2,642人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: MSFと保健省が共同でベニに新規治療センターを開設。第17次流行は北キブ、南キブ、イトゥリ、ハウトウエレ、バウエレ、チョポの6州に拡大しており、致死率が高く既に国際的な支援（MSF）が入っている。国境を越えた拡大リスクについては本記事に直接の記載はないが、地理的に近隣国への波及リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Observateur Paalga - Lutte contre la 17e épidémie d'Ébola: Ces signes d'espoir venus d'Ouganda et des berges du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Observateur Paalga - Fighting the 17th Ebola outbreak: These signs of hope coming from Uganda and the banks of the Congo
article.articleSummary: 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to devastate the eastern regions, with 55 health districts across six regions affected, and over 5,375 cases and more than 2,557 deaths reported by August 25. Projections warn of ongoing high mortality and transmission, with about one Congolese death every 30 minutes and three new infections. Treatments targeting the Zaire strain have performed poorly against Bundibugyo. On August 27, two glimmers of hope: (1) the World Health Organization declared Uganda free of outbreak risk after 42 days with no new cases, despite cross-border movement; 20 Ugandans were infected earlier in the outbreak in DRC, with 2 deaths and 18 recoveries. (2) Congo River–adjacent surveillance is to be boosted with 40 epidemiological posts within two weeks to curb cross-regional spread; Kinshasa will strengthen surveillance and isolation, and a London vaccine candidate is in early human trials.

triage.headline_ja: オブザーバトゥール・パーガ紙 – 第17次エボラ流行との闘い：ウガンダとコンゴ河岸から届く希望の兆し
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での第17次エボラ流行は死者2,557人超、感染者5,375人超と大規模で、複数地域に拡大し国境を越えた感染例（ウガンダ）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのアウトブレイクリスク解除（42日間新規感染なし）にも言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生国はDRCであり、キンシャサ含む複数地域での監視強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Jundiaí confirma caso de raiva em morcego em área rural | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jundiaí confirms rabies case in bat in a rural area | TVS+
article.articleSummary: As of 27 August 2026, Jundiaí reports a bat positive for rabies on a rural property in the Pinheirinho neighborhood. This is the city’s second bat rabies case in 2026. The affected animal, a bat of genus Artibeus, was found outside a residence and collected alive by VISAM. No human or domestic animal exposure has been reported, and a single positive bat does not indicate widespread transmission. VISAM continues surveillance, monitoring local bat populations and collecting specimens as needed for investigation. Residents are advised to avoid direct contact with bats; if exposure occurs, seek prompt medical assessment to determine the need for rabies post-exposure prophylaxis. Unusual bat activity should be reported to VISAM at (11) 4589-6340 or (11) 4589-6350 for evaluation and safe removal.

triage.headline_ja: ジュンジアイで農村地域のコウモリの狂犬病感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 単発のコウモリ1匹の狂犬病陽性例であり、人や家畜への感染は報告されておらず、広範な感染拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 地方の動物衛生当局(VISAM)による通常の監視活動の範囲内であり、人への感染例なし。今年2例目のコウモリ狂犬病確認だが局所的事例。

article.articleHeadline: "Nicht auf Kosten unserer Leben": Eltern im Kongo kämpfen gegen Schulstart mitten im Ebola-Ausbruch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not at the expense of our lives: Parents in the Congo fight against the start of the school year amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia city as a focal point. More than 5,700 confirmed infections and over 2,700 deaths reported; under-five mortality among Ebola cases around 60%. With no licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo virus, authorities face ongoing transmission as schools planned to reopen nationwide on 1 September, but many teachers and parents in Ituri call for delaying reopening due to risk. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres appeals for an additional $1.1 billion to fund the outbreak response; the UN's $2.13 billion plan is only 48% funded. WHO warns the outbreak remains uncontrolled and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola crisis, which killed over 11,000. Research into vaccines and treatments is underway but no approved options yet. Published 2026-08-27.

triage.headline_ja: 「私たちの命を犠牲にしないで」：コンゴの親たちがエボラ流行の最中の新学期開始に反対
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,700人以上感染・2,700人以上死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ワクチン未承認かつWHOが制御不能と警告しており、国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが記事本文はDRC（Ituri州、Bunia市）に集中しており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行で、2014-2016年西アフリカ危機を超える恐れがあるとWHOが警告している点は特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda completes 42-day period with no Ebola cases, ending outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda ends its Ebola outbreak after 42 consecutive days without a new confirmed case, the last patient seen on July 16, 2026. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, produced 20 confirmed cases since declaration on May 15, 2026. Of these, 15 were imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, while five were locally acquired among contacts and health workers linked to imported cases. Eighteen people recovered and two died. Over 800 contacts were identified and monitored during the response. The 42-day window—twice the upper bound of Ebola's incubation period—provides confidence that transmission chains have been interrupted. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus credited decisive action, enhanced surveillance at health facilities and communities, and strengthened entry-point controls for keeping people and goods moving safely. The outbreak has been declared over in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱の新規患者ゼロが42日間続き、アウトブレイク終息を発表
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行終息を報告する内容だが、感染源であるDRCでの流行が継続している可能性があり、越境再拡大リスクの観点から継続監視が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事はウガンダでのエボラ流行終息（42日間新規患者なし）を報じるもの。感染源はDRCからの輸入例（15例）であり、DRC側の流行状況が継続しているかは記事内に明記されていない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 岡山本土登革熱 一家三人群聚感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local dengue fever in Okayama: Three family members infected in a cluster.
article.articleSummary: Three local dengue fever cases in Gangshan District, Kaohsiung City, Taiwan form a family cluster; all infected with dengue virus serotype 2, with no overseas travel history. The index patient, a man in his 60s, developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia and nausea on August 26 and, after outpatient care and hospital referral, tested positive for dengue virus type 2. Two other household members were diagnosed; all three are hospitalized. Health authorities have launched a community-wide epidemiological investigation and conducted vector surveillance, targeting the home vicinity to remove breeding sources and implement urgent control to prevent spread. As of August 28, 2026, Taiwan reports 145 confirmed dengue cases nationwide, including 10 locally acquired cases—all in Kaohsiung—and 135 imported cases. Imported infections primarily from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), and the Maldives (16). Public urged to drain, clean, and scrub water containers and re-check after heavy rains for mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾・高雄岡山で地域デング熱、一家族3人が集団感染
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内の小規模な家族内クラスター（3例）で、既に当局が疫学調査とベクター対策を実施しており、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易への影響は想定されない。対象国リストにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾（高雄市岡山区）であり、CEPR対象国リストには含まれない。輸入例の出身国としてベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブが言及されているが、これらはイベント発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。台湾当局は既に感染源対策・疫学調査を実施済みで、事態はコントロール下にあると見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Δυτικού Νείλου: Στην ανάπτυξη rapid test ελληνική ομάδα του ΕΚΠΑ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile Virus: Greek EKPA team developing a rapid test.
article.articleSummary: West Nile Virus rapid-test development led by an Athens-based EKPA team, with partners in Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands and Brazil, aims to produce a rapid, point-of-care assay for West Nile virus and other mosquito-borne infections such as Zika. Led by Professor Maria Gazouli, the project uses nanotechnology to enable quick detection and discrimination of the infecting agent. The envisioned test would require a single drop of blood and deliver results in under an hour at the patient’s side. First results are expected in about two years; the program lasts 36 months with potential market availability thereafter. In Greece, West Nile activity is rising: 232 cases through August 26, including 75 in the last week; 19 deaths (all over 65). 73 hospitalised; 26 in ICU and one in a MAФ unit. Cases span 61 municipalities in 18 regional units and five regions, led by Attica (37). High-risk areas include Nea Smyrni, Nea Filadelfeia–Nea Chalkidona, Dafni–Ymittos, Amphipolis, Serres, Thasos; spread driven by climate change and floods.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス：アテネ国立カポディストリアス大学（EKPA）チームが迅速検査を開発中
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはギリシャ国内での西ナイルウイルス流行および迅速検査開発に関するもので、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）のいずれにも該当しない。ブラジルは研究協力パートナーとして名前が挙がるのみで、発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はギリシャにおける西ナイルウイルスの流行状況と迅速診断検査の開発（EKPA主導、イタリア・スペイン・エストニア・オランダ・ブラジルとの国際協力プロジェクト）。ブラジルは研究パートナー国であり、疾病発生国ではないため対象国リストには含めない。ギリシャ自体も対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ Uganda'daki Ebola salgınının sona erdiğini doğruladı - Havadis Gazetesi | Kıbrıs Haber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirmed that the Ebola outbreak in Uganda has ended - Havadis Gazetesi | Cyprus News
article.articleSummary: As of Monday, August 24, 2026, the World Health Organization confirmed Uganda’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has ended: the last patient was discharged and no new cases were observed for 42 days, with continued surveillance. In contrast, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) still faces Ebola, reporting 5,656 confirmed cases and 2,715 deaths as of that date, making it the country’s largest and deadliest outbreak to date. In Ituri Province, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths have been recorded; the outbreak was declared on May 15. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant. While contact tracing and testing are progressing, transmission remains highly active. WHO warns the risk remains high, particularly for neighboring countries sharing land borders, and an estimated $30 million in emergency funding is required to sustain logistics, medical supplies, and PPE delivery to the hardest-hit regions to prevent interruption of response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダのエボラ流行終息を確認 - Havadis Gazetesi | キプロス・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息は朗報だが、DRCでは5,656例・2,715人死亡という史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、ワクチン・治療法が未承認、国境を接する近隣国への拡大リスクをWHOが警告しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息が確認されたが、記事の主眼はDRCで継続中の大規模エボラ流行（Bundibugyo変異株、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンなし、$30M緊急資金要請）にある。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: UN-GUTERRES-PRESS ENCOUNTER-EBOLA-DR CONGO
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged intensified international action on the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, speaking to reporters at the United Nations headquarters in New York on Aug. 27, 2026. He lamented the lack of adequate international attention to the crisis and issued an urgent appeal to mobilize resources and support for containment efforts. The briefing underscored growing concern over Ebola in the DRC and called on member states and partners to accelerate engagement, coordination, and assistance to affected communities. The remarks were delivered during a press encounter at UN headquarters, highlighting the need for prompt, collective action to curb transmission. The report does not provide case counts or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 国連・グテーレス事務総長、記者会見でコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱について発言
triage.triage_reason: 国連事務総長が国際社会に対しコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機への支援強化を緊急に要請しており、WPRO基準の複数項目（重症度・持続的曝露・流行しやすさ・支援必要性）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事は国連本部（ニューヨーク）での記者会見の内容であり、感染発生地自体はDRCのみ。米国・ニューヨークは発言場所であり発生地域ではないため除外。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ウガンダでエボラ終息　コンゴは拡大続く -- ＷＨＯ：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak ends in Uganda; Congo outbreak continues to spread -- WHO: Jiji.com
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ebola outbreak has ended, WHO announced on August 27. The last patient was discharged in mid-July, and after a 42-day post-discharge window with no new cases, Uganda reported 20 infections, 18 recoveries and 2 deaths. By August 25, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's outbreak continued to spread rapidly, with 5,713 cases and 2,744 deaths. About 85% of cases are in Ituri Province in the northeast, where mining activity and heavy cross-border miner movement, coupled with armed clashes over resources, hinder containment. WHO had declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus praised Uganda’s rapid public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ終息　コンゴは拡大続く -- ＷＨＯ：時事ドットコム
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行はWHOがPHEICを宣言した重大な公衆衛生事案であり、5,713例・2,744死亡と拡大が続いており、越境労働者移動や武力衝突が対応を阻害しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息したためverified_locationsには含めない。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため除外。DRCのイトゥリ州で採掘活動と武力衝突が感染拡大の主要因。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda declared Ebola-free even as Congo faces deadly, fast-growing epidemic
article.articleSummary: On Aug 27, 2026, the World Health Organization declared Uganda Ebola-free after a 42-day period with no new infections, the last patient discharged July 16. Uganda had 20 Ebola infections and 2 deaths; 15 of these cases originated in Congo, while 5 were transmitted locally in Uganda. The neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo continues to endure a deadly, fast-growing Ebola outbreak, with at least 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths. The Congo outbreak began May 15, and Ugandan authorities reported cross-border transmission, including 2 deaths in Uganda. The 42-day window equals twice the upper limit of the Ebola incubation period and is used by WHO to confirm transmission chains have been cleared. The Congo outbreak is on track to surpass the largest Ebola epidemic, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダはエボラ終息を宣言、一方でコンゴは致死的かつ急速に拡大するエボラ流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,713例・2,744死亡という大規模で急速拡大中のエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHOにより終息宣言済みだが、記事の主題は継続中のDRCの大規模流行。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれず、記事本文でも言及がないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行が2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える規模になる可能性があり、国際的な注目・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱対策で資金拠出を 国連事務総長、各国に要請｜全国のニュース｜Web東奥
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Secretary-General urges countries to provide funding for Ebola response measures.
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned on August 27 that the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo—the largest in the country’s history—requires urgent funding for the humanitarian response. Speaking at UN Headquarters in New York, he urged countries to contribute to a US$2.13 billion humanitarian action plan. Although the United States has underwritten about 48% of the appeal, the plan remains roughly US$1.1 billion short. Guterres emphasized that global attention has not kept pace with the crisis, and he warned that indifference can spread like a virus and must be overcome. He called for broad international generosity to ensure life-saving measures reach affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱対策で資金拠出を 国連事務総長、各国に要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における史上最大規模のエボラ流行に対し、国連事務総長が資金不足を訴えており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的な支援ニーズが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はニューヨークの国連本部での発言を報じているが、実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国東部であり、米国・ニューヨークは会議開催地に過ぎないため除外した。既存の大規模アウトブレイクに関する資金拠出要請の続報。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: City logs 166 fresh H1N1 cases, tally 2,612: Pankaj
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 166 fresh H1N1 cases in the last 24 hours, raising the cumulative swine flu tally to 2,612, while Influenza-A cases climb to 3,300 (from 3,177). A day earlier the capital logged 138 new H1N1 infections, with total cases then at 2,446. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh visited Indira Gandhi Hospital to review preparedness for rising H1N1 and seasonal influenza, inspecting flu-management arrangements, isolation facilities, emergency services, testing infrastructure, medicines, and staff deployment. A dedicated flu clinic is now operational at the hospital, with isolated beds for influenza patients. Officials said hospitals were instructed to maintain at least five isolation beds; larger centers should hold 10 or more. They were also asked to maintain shift-wise rosters and ensure round-the-clock doctors and medical staff. The visit followed directives to strengthen emergency services and resource availability in Delhi government hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1新規166例、累計2,612例に:パンカジ
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例数が増加し行政の対応強化が報じられているが、重症度・死亡者数など詳細情報が不足しており、季節性の通常範囲内の増加である可能性が高い。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザの一種で、デリーでは毎年報告される疾患。保健大臣の病院視察など行政対応の強化が報じられているが、重症度や死亡者数など公衆衛生上の深刻性を示す具体的データが記事に含まれていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Salud amplía lista de países que requieren vacunación contra fiebre amarilla para viajeros desde Costa Rica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health expands list of countries that require yellow fever vaccination for travelers from Costa Rica.
article.articleSummary: Beginning August 31, Costa Rica’s Ministry of Health expands the list of countries for which Costa Rican citizens and residents traveling abroad must show yellow fever vaccination. The new additions are Bolivia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Trinidad and Tobago, Venezuela, Suriname, Guyana, and French Guiana. The vaccination requirement remains for travelers to Colombia, Brazil, Peru, and African destinations under national health regulations. Christian Valverde, Director General of Health, announced the update. Yellow fever is a viral disease transmitted primarily by mosquito bites. Health officials urged travelers to verify destination entry requirements in advance and complete vaccination in a timely manner to avoid entry issues.

triage.headline_ja: コスタリカ保健省、黄熱病予防接種が必要な渡航先国のリストを拡大
triage.triage_reason: コスタリカ発の渡航ワクチン要件に関する行政発表であり、対象国リストにおける具体的な発生・流行拡大の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はコスタリカからの渡航者向けワクチン要件の行政発表であり、対象国リスト（ボリビア、エクアドル、パラグアイ、トリニダード・トバゴ、ベネズエラ、スリナム、ガイアナ、フレンチギアナ、コロンビア、ブラジル、ペルー、アフリカ諸国）における黄熱病の具体的な発生状況や流行拡大についての記述はない。対象国リストの中でGeoNames該当国はBrazilのみ（既存の要件対象国として言及）。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda libre de ébola tras 42 días sin nuevos casos - Medios OBSON
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases - OBSON Media
article.articleSummary: Uganda was declared Ebola-free by the World Health Organization on 27 August 2026 after 42 days with no new cases, ending an outbreak that began with a case imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases and 2 deaths, with most infected individuals traveling from DRC. The last confirmed patient was discharged on 16 July 2026, and no onward transmission has been documented since. The eastern Uganda outbreak overwhelmed some health facilities but prompted robust containment and contact-tracing efforts. WHO and Uganda’s Ministry of Health concluded there is no further transmission linked to the imported case, noting they assessed transmission chains and importation dynamics to declare the country Ebola-free. The event underscores cross-border spillover risk with DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、42日間新規感染者なくエボラ終息を宣言 - OBSONメディア
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウガンダでのエボラ流行が終息宣言されたことを報じるフォローアップ記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の懸念や国際的拡大リスクは示されていない。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの発生国はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）。DRCは輸入元として言及されているが、DRC国内での発生ではなく主題ではないため、対象国リストの基準に基づきverified_locationsから除外した。既に終息が宣言されており、フォローアップ的な内容のためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en época de recortes, por Marta Ricart
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in an era of budget cuts, by Marta Ricart.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 100 days with 5,600 cases and 2,700 deaths; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths, apparently controlled. Case fatality rate about 47%. WHO says the epidemic is still growing in DRC. Some 16,000 vaccines have arrived, with 70,000 planned, mainly for health workers, though effectiveness against this strain is uncertain. By comparison, the 2018 outbreak took 235 days to reach 1,000 infections; this year 1,000 cases occurred in 40 days. Mortality is seven times higher than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (>11,000 deaths). Analysts attribute rapid spread to reduced international aid after the U.S. withdrew from the WHO and cut contributions; the U.S. has spent over $500 million on the response and imposes a travel rule: anyone who has been in DRC in the last 21 days cannot fly to the U.S. until another 21 days outside Congo. Security and access challenges limit detection (about 40%); calls for stronger regional health investments persist (WHO, UN, MSF, Africa CDC).

triage.headline_ja: 予算削減時代のエボラ出血熱 マルタ・リカルト
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生100日で5,600例・2,700人死亡（致死率約47%）と急速に拡大しており、WHOも流行拡大中と評価。米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的対応も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大（20例・2死亡、制御下との報道）およびアンゴラ・米国は対象国リスト外または感染発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。米国はWHO脱退・資金削減の影響を受け対応資金や渡航制限を実施している点で言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Congo begins Ebola vaccinations to fight country´s worst outbreak...
article.articleSummary: Congo launched Ebola vaccinations in Kisangani, Tshopo province, as part of its response to what authorities call the deadliest outbreak on record. Health Minister Roger Kamba said frontline health workers and people in contact with patients are first in line for Ervebo, used under a compassionate-use program, though the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola and Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus. The vaccination campaign covers 14 health zones across Tshopo, Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele. Six provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele and Bas-Uele. As of Tuesday, Congo had 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths (roughly 48% fatality). The outbreak is hindered by insecurity, displacement, a health workers’ strike, and large population movements; WHO warns it is out of control and may exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Vaccines: over 50,000 doses received; 70,000 approved, with 50,000 for frontline workers and 20,000 for a Bundibugyo-focused trial.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、同国史上最悪のエボラ流行に対応するためワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最悪とされるエボラ流行で確定患者5,713人・死者2,744人（致死率約48%）、WHOが制御不能で2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 使用ワクチンErvebo（ザイールエボラウイルス株用）と実際の流行株（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）に不一致があり、ワクチン効果に不確実性が残る点に注意。治安悪化・人口移動・医療従事者ストライキ等が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: 古特雷斯呼吁国际社会强化刚果（金）埃博拉疫情应对
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guterres calls on the international community to strengthen the Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged the international community to urgently strengthen the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), saying global attention, political focus, and resources are lagging as the outbreak expands. As of August 25, the DRC has 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths, with about 500 new cases weekly, disproportionately affecting women and children. The UN’s humanitarian and outbreak-response plan for the DRC seeks $2.13 billion, but funding is now less than half available. WHO officials note the current transmission remains highly active with no turning point yet, and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called this the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The outbreak began on May 15. Source: Xinhua News Agency.

triage.headline_ja: グテーレス国連事務総長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱対応強化を国際社会に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が拡大中で、死者数・感染者数が多く、国連事務総長が国際的な資金・支援強化を緊急に呼びかけている。
triage.notes: WHOは本流行を史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行と発表。資金不足（必要額の半分未満）が対応の障害となっており、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SP registra 3 novos casos de sarampo; todos em pessoas não vacinadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reports 3 new measles cases; all in unvaccinated individuals.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state: 3 new cases in the city of São Paulo, all unvaccinated, bringing total cases this year to 26 (23 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos). Nineteen cases involve individuals not vaccinated or with incomplete immunization. A vaccination drive runs through September 1, offering free measles vaccines to residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, with the option to update protection against rubella and mumps. Measles is highly contagious and airborne, presenting with high fever, red rash, cough, conjunctivitis, and malaise, and can lead to pneumonia, encephalitis, or death. No specific antiviral treatment exists; care is supportive and includes hydration and fever control. Early vaccination remains critical to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹新規3例を報告；全員未接種者
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で未接種者を中心とした麻疹の小規模な地域流行が継続しているが、重篤例や死亡例の報告はなく、既にワクチン接種キャンペーンで対応中であり、国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 累計26例（サンパウロ市23例、サンベルナルドドカンポ2例、グアルーリョス1例）、うち19例が未接種または不完全接種。地元当局が9月1日までワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施中で、地域レベルの対応で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo: ONU pide USD 1.100 millones para combatir el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: UN requests USD 1.1 billion to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UN seeks USD 1.1 billion to finance a USD 2.1 billion plan to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 25 August 2026, the outbreak has 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, with about 500 new cases weekly, disproportionately affecting women and children. This is the largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s history and is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no vaccines or treatments. Resources currently available would last only weeks unless funded, and operations cannot expand without additional money. The response is led by the Congolese government with support from the United Nations, the World Health Organization, and partners, focusing on surveillance, treatment, community engagement, and prevention of new infections. The appeal was announced by UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on 27 August 2026; the United States has made a significant contribution. Ongoing funding will be needed.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ：国連がエボラ対策に11億米ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定5,713例、死亡2,744例）で、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブジョ株が原因。IHR基準の複数該当かつ国連による大規模資金要請がなされており社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国は資金貢献国として言及されているが発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限に関する情報は記事中に明示されておらず不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Alagoas, Mato Grosso e Roraima estão em alerta para o aumento de SRAG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alagoas, Mato Grosso and Roraima are on alert for an increase in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Alagoas, Mato Grosso, and Roraima are on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) with rising activity, Fiocruz Infogripe bulletin 2026-08-27 reports. In Mato Grosso and Roraima, increases are mainly in 2–4-year-olds; in Alagoas, 2–14-year-olds. The causative virus is not yet identified; rhinovirus (common cold) is suspected to drive most pediatric cases, with metapneumovirus contributing less. Seasonal influenza A has ended; severe influenza A cases are low, with a slight rise in influenza B in Bahia and Mato Grosso. Four capitals - Aracaju, Belém, Boa Vista, João Pessoa - show long-term SRAG growth. Eight states - Amazonas, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, Sergipe - are at alert/risk/high risk without clear growth. RSV-related severe cases fall nationwide, though remain high in Roraima; under-2 infants see declines in RSV hospitalizations. COVID-19 severe respiratory cases stay very low.

triage.headline_ja: アラゴアス州、マットグロッソ州、ロライマ州が重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)増加に警戒
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節性呼吸器感染症（SRAGサーベイランス）の地域的増加であり、病原体は既知の一般的なウイルス（ライノウイルス、メタニューモウイルス等）が疑われ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: Fiocruz Infogripeによる定期的なサーベイランス報告で、原因病原体は未確定だがライノウイルスやメタニューモウイルスが疑われる。季節性の呼吸器感染症動向であり、COVID-19やインフルエンザAの重症例は低調。国際的な懸念は低いが、地域的な増加傾向のため経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 国連事務総長「エボラ出血熱対策で資金拠出を」　各国に要請
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Secretary-General calls for funding for Ebola hemorrhagic fever countermeasures; appeals to all countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire), described by UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres as the largest outbreak in Congo’s history. As of August 25, 2026, the country reports 5,713 infections and 2,744 deaths. The United Nations has prepared a humanitarian assistance plan totaling $2.13 billion, with about 48% funded, primarily by the United States; however, roughly $1.1 billion remains unfunded. Guterres urged all countries to contribute, warning that indifference itself is a virus to be overcome and that funding gaps undermine the response to the Ebola outbreak. The appeal emphasizes international solidarity and timely funding to sustain countermeasures against Ebola in the eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 国連事務総長「エボラ出血熱対策で資金拠出を」　各国に要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱がコンゴ史上最大規模で拡大し、死者2,744人・感染者5,713人に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国は資金提供国として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。史上最大規模のアウトブレイクであり、致死率は約48%と極めて高い。国連による資金拠出要請は国際支援の必要性を強く示している。

article.articleHeadline: HFU seeks compensation for mass pig deaths due to ASF in SWKH
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in South West Khasi Hills District (Meghalaya) causing mass pig deaths over the past three months, centered in Mawkyrwat's Shiliang Um Rilang area (Nongbrei Nongdom, Mawthong, Mawsep, Rangblang, Umdohlun). Farmers report losses of at least Rs 2 lakh each; HFU links the outbreak to pigs imported from outside the state. HFU President Commander Shangpliang criticizes the MDA-II government for allowing imports without testing, calling for testing centres at entry points such as Byrnihat. The union demands compensation for losses, vaccines for surviving livestock, and adequate veterinary staff across state hospitals, plus immediate testing infrastructure. HFU Central Body has directed units to compile a list of affected farmers. The union warns that unchecked imports and livestock losses could jeopardize the district’s pig supply and the state's target of a $10 billion economy by 2028.

triage.headline_ja: HFU、南西カーシ・ヒルズ地区でのASFによる養豚大量死に対する補償を要求
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はインド・メガーラヤ州で養豚に経済的被害を及ぼしているが、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生リスクは確認されていない。ただし発生継続と対応能力不足の懸念があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントはヒト感染症ではなく動物（豚）のASF流行であり、公衆衛生への直接影響は限定的。地域（Shaanxi, China）はBluedotの誤付与と判断し除外。経済的損失と行政対応の不備が社会的関心事となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases in Baguio down 39 percent; 1 confirmed dead
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Baguio City, Philippines, reached 14 confirmed cases from Jan 1 to Aug 15, 2026 (per Aug. 25 CESU statement), down from 23 in the prior year, with 1 laboratory-confirmed death: a male farmer who died June 14. Three other deaths occurred among suspected cases (two: construction worker and delivery rider, both died in June and tested negative; one student who died this month awaiting results). Of the 14 confirmed cases, 13 are male (about 92–93%) aged 24–71. Cases were reported across barangays Irisan, Camp 7, Bakakeng Central, Phil-Am Compound, Quirino-Magsaysay, Middle Quezon Hill, Outlook Drive, Happy Hollow, City Camp Proper and Kias. High-risk groups include farmers, construction workers, delivery riders, painters, animal caretakers, welders and other outdoor workers exposed to water or soil contaminated with rodent droppings; symptoms include fever 3–5 days, severe headache and reddened eyes, with jaundice possible in severe cases. Public health measures: education, rodent control, drainage clearing, PPE promotion with delivery hubs and construction sites; medicines available for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: バギオ市のレプトスピラ症患者数39%減、1人の死亡が確認
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の症例数は前年より減少しており、地域限定の風土病的事例で異常性・国際拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はヒト-ヒト感染しない環境由来感染症で、症例数は前年比減少。地域の公衆衛生対策（教育、ネズミ駆除、排水管理）で管理可能な状況。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تبدأ حملة تطعيم ضد "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo begins a vaccination campaign against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches Ebola vaccination campaign as it fights the country’s deadliest outbreak. Vaccination began August 28 in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province in the east, with frontline health workers among the first recipients. Health Minister Roger Kamba said the Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccine is used to protect responders, healthcare workers, and those in contact with patients. The outbreak has now affected six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, and Bas-Uele. Government figures through last Tuesday report 5,713 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, a case-fatality rate of about 48%. The vaccination drive aims to slow transmission as authorities continue to contain the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱に対するワクチン接種活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行（症例5,713件、死亡2,744件、致死率約48%）が6州に拡大し、ワクチン接種が開始されたため、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と非常に高く、6州に拡大していることから、DRC史上最も深刻なエボラ流行の一つとされる。ワクチン接種はErvebo（rVSV-ZEBOV）を用い、医療従事者・接触者を優先。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: le chef de l'ONU réclame 1,1 milliard de dollars pour l'aide humanitaire [Tv5monde Afrique] https://information.tv5monde.com/afrique/ebola-en-rdc-le-chef-de-lonu-reclame-11-milliard-de-dollars-pour-laide-humanitaire-2835142
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the UN chief demands $1.1 billion for humanitarian aid [Tv5monde Afrique]
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the focus, with United Nations Secretary-General calling for a $1.1 billion humanitarian appeal to support the response. Published August 27, 2026, the Tv5monde Afrique report centers on the funding request and the broader international relief effort, rather than detailing clinical data. The piece does not provide case counts, specific affected areas within the DRC, or laboratory confirmation details. It highlights the urgent need for international resources to address the outbreak’s humanitarian impact and to mobilize support from donors and agencies. The article conveys the scale of the appeal as part of ongoing global health and humanitarian responses to Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：国連事務総長が人道支援に11億ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重大な公衆衛生リスクであり、国連事務総長が11億ドルの人道支援を要請するという規模の大きさから、国際的な対応・支援が必要な深刻な状況と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は資金調達の要請に焦点を当てており、具体的な症例数や発生地域の詳細は記載されていない。エボラという疾患特性上、重症度・拡大リスクは高いと判断されるが、現地の詳細な疫学データは不明。

article.articleHeadline: 天籁童声"歌手徐杰去世，亲友澄清肝病离世传闻：真正原因是"流感并发症"，他四月初在台湾地区患上流感，后返回泰国工作病情加重住院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Heavenly Voice" Child Singer Xu Jie Dies; Friends and Family Clarify Rumors That Liver Disease Was the Cause of Death: The Real Reason Is Complications from Influenza; He Contracted Influenza in the Taiwan Region in Early April, Then Returned to Thailand for Work, and His Condition Worsened, Leading to Hospitalization.
article.articleSummary: Xu Jie, the Taiwanese child singer nicknamed 'Heavenly Voice,' died on July 19, 2026, aged 29. Rumors linked death to chronic liver disease, but family and friends told LiZhi News the real cause was complications from influenza. He contracted influenza in the Taiwan region in early April, returned to Thailand for work in early May, and was hospitalized on May 20 as his condition worsened. The family asked the public to understand the true cause and mourn appropriately. Previously reported as liver disease, Xu Jie rose to prominence after winning a cover of Zhang Shaohan's 'Lost Beauty' on Star Avenue at age 11, later appearing on Happy Camp and Hunan TV's Spring Festival Gala; he studied and worked in Thailand before his death. His parents remain grieving.

triage.headline_ja: 「天籁童声」の子供歌手・徐傑さん死去、親友が肝疾患説を否定：真の死因は「インフルエンザ合併症」。4月上旬に台湾でインフルエンザに罹患後、タイに戻って就労中に病状悪化し入院
triage.triage_reason: 個人の著名人がインフルエンザ合併症により死亡したという単発の人物ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常事態を示す情報がないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 著名人の死因に関する個人的な報道であり、インフルエンザのアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上のシグナルとは無関係。タイ・台湾での集団発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ nhiễm khuẩn Whitmore trong mùa mưa lũ, bác sĩ cảnh báo người dân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of melioidosis during the flood season, doctors warn the public.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Whitmore disease) caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei poses heightened risk during Vietnam's flood season. A 54-year-old diabetic driver from Ninh Bình, who worked in Phú Quốc, was admitted in critical condition with fever, headache, seizures, and progressive coma. MRI showed hypothalamic and cortical injury; labs indicated severe inflammation and infection with marked hyperglycemia and electrolyte disturbances. After nearly a month of intensive treatment including mechanical ventilation, the patient improved but remains under ongoing therapy and strict glucose control. Whitmore is acquired from soil and water and can cause pneumonia, septicemia, or multi-organ abscesses; central nervous system involvement can complicate recovery and cause lasting neurological deficits. Diabetes is a major risk factor; other chronic diseases and immune suppression also raise risk. To reduce exposure during floods, wear protective gear, cover wounds, and seek prompt medical care for fever, respiratory symptoms, or altered consciousness.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水期における類鼻疽（ウィットモア病）感染リスク、医師が住民に警告
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である類鼻疽の季節性注意喚起記事で単発重症例の報告。アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はないが、洪水期の継続的な感染リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 類鼻疽（Whitmore病）はベトナムの洪水期に毎年見られる土壌・水由来の風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。本記事は単一の重症患者例を用いた医師による季節性の公衆衛生啓発であり、集団発生の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: القبة الحديدية للبعوض رصد سلاح صيني بالذكاء الاصطناعي لحماية سكان كاليفورنيا من فيروس فيديو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Mosquito Iron Dome Detects a Chinese AI Weapon to Protect Californians from the Video Virus
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus risk in California rises as mosquito populations grow, according to the California Post. A new AI-powered device, Photon Matrix, aims to curb viral transmission by detecting mosquitoes, tracking their movements, and directing a blue laser at targets, using radar, LiDAR, and artificial intelligence. The article frames the device as a high-tech tool imported from China in its headline, labeling it a Chinese AI weapon, though described here as a public health measure to reduce exposure in California. Published 2026-08-28. Ongoing outbreak context: increased mosquito density in the state; no specific case or death counts are provided. No details on implementation timeline or regulatory status are given.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の『鉄のドーム』、カリフォルニア住民をウイルスから守るための中国製AI兵器を検知
triage.triage_reason: 米国カリフォルニア州における季節性の西ナイルウイルスに関する記事であり、対象国（中国等）での疾病発生ではなく中国製AI検知技術の紹介記事に過ぎないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国カリフォルニア州における蚊媒介性西ナイルウイルス対策としての中国製AI検知装置の紹介であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での疾病発生は確認できない。発生地域にChinaが記載されているが、これは技術の出所であり実際の感染発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas coloca 26 bairros em alerta por alto risco de transmissão da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas puts 26 neighborhoods on alert due to high risk of dengue transmission.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, issued a dengue high-risk alert for 26 neighborhoods across six regions as of August 27, 2026. From January 1 to August 24, 2026, the city confirmed 3,753 dengue cases and carried out 1,138,441 household visits for vector control, plus 53,382 fogging visits. Affected areas include Taquaral (East); Cidade Satélite Íris IV, Jardim Rossin, Núcleo Residencial Princesa D'Oeste, Cidade Satélite Íris I (Northwest); Jardim São Marcos, Jardim Campineiro, Vila Esperança, Vila Santa Isabel, Jardim Independência (North); Parque Residencial Vila União, Vila Palácios, Jardim Yeda, Jardim Bordon (Southwest); Jardim Campo Belo II, Cidade Singer II, Jardim Marisa, Jardim São Domingos, Vila Palmeiras I and II (South); Vila Industrial, Parque Itália, Jardim Leonor, São Bernardo, Ponte Preta, Parque Industrial (Southeast). The alert also covers smaller surrounding neighborhoods. About 80% of Aedes aegypti breeding sites are inside homes; residents are urged to remove water-holding containers, seal water tanks, and regularly check tires, cans, gutters, roofs, and plant-pot dishes. Aedes aegypti transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナス市、デング熱感染リスク上昇により26地区に警戒発令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内における季節性デング熱の地域的な公衆衛生対応であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常のベクター対策の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: カンピナス市当局による地域内デング熱対策（フォギング・家屋訪問等）の一環としての警戒発令であり、症例数（3,753件）は報告されているが重症度・死亡等の情報はなし。ブラジルにおける毎年の季節性流行パターンの範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Launches Ebola Vaccination Campaign
article.articleSummary: DR Congo began vaccinating against Ebola on 28 Aug 2026 using the Ervebo vaccine to protect front-line health workers and contacts of patients. The vaccination campaign was officially launched in Kisangani, capital of eastern Tshopo Province. The outbreak has spread to six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, and Bas-Uele. As of Tuesday, 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths have been reported, a fatality rate around 48%. The campaign aims to slow the deadliest Ebola outbreak recorded in the country by prioritizing frontline responders and people who have been in contact with confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例5,713人、死亡2,744人（致死率約48%）で6州に拡大している大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数が該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は『同国史上最も致死率の高いエボラ流行』と明記。ワクチン接種はフロントライン対応者と接触者を対象とした対応であり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクに対する継続的な公衆衛生対応として位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: [특징주] 신풍제약, 코로나19 재확산 조짐에 21%대 급등
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Stocks in Focus] Shinpoong Pharmaceutical jumps about 21% on signs of COVID-19 resurgence
article.articleSummary: Shinpoong Pharmaceutical jumps about 21% on signs of a COVID-19 resurgence in Korea and abroad. By 9:09 a.m. on 2026-08-28, the stock was ~10,780 won, up 21.95% as investors priced in renewed demand linked to earlier malaria drug Pyramax being developed as a COVID-19 therapy. In Korea, the KDCA reported Week 34 hospitalizations at tertiary and general hospitals rising to 61 from 31 (week 31), with upper-tier hospital inpatients increasing from 5 to 13; clinic-level virus detection rose from 5.9% to 11.3%. Variants BA.3.2 and NB.1.8.1 were detected domestically, suggesting a possible summer rebound. In China, July COVID-19 cases reached 522,000, and the positive rate among patients with influenza-like illness at outpatient/ED settings climbed to 21.2% for five consecutive weeks. Pyramax’s current approval remains for malaria, with no active COVID-19 program, making stock movements largely sentiment-driven and potentially volatile.

triage.headline_ja: [株式注目] 新豊製薬、新型コロナウイルス再拡大の兆しで21%急騰
triage.triage_reason: 韓国・中国でCOVID-19症例や入院数の増加傾向が報告されているが、記事の主眼は株式市場動向であり、公衆衛生上の深刻度や政府の対応方針は明確でないため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は主に韓国の製薬企業株価に関する内容で、COVID-19再拡大は投資家の期待材料として言及されている。韓国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国のデータ（7月52.2万例、ILI陽性率21.2%が5週連続）は対象国情報として記録。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果開始接種伊波拉疫苗 對抗該國史上最嚴重疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Begins Ebola Vaccination to Combat the Worst Outbreak in Its History
article.articleSummary: On Aug 27, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo began Ebola vaccination in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province, prioritizing frontline healthcare workers and others in contact with patients. The campaign uses the Ervebo vaccine, aiming to shield health workers and prevent nosocomial spread. The outbreak has affected six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and Tshopo—with 5,713 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths (case fatality ≈48%). The WHO warns the outbreak could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed more than 11,000. DR Congo has secured more than 50,000 doses, with WHO approval for up to 70,000. About 50,000 will be for frontline staff; 20,000 for clinical trials to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which Ervebo is not specifically licensed. Africa CDC will collect data to evaluate effectiveness during rollout across 14 health zones in Tshopo, Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ、史上最悪の疫病に対抗するためエボラワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 6州で5,713例・死亡2,744人（致死率約48%）に達し、WHOが2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性を警告するなど、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが複数該当するためフルRRA相当のシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOが承認した7万回分のワクチンのうち2万回分はBundibugyoエボラウイルスに対する臨床試験用であり、Ervebo未承認株への対応課題が残る。感染規模が2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える恐れがあるとの警告あり、国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Treatments and vaccines under trial amid the worst Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo's history
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-28, 100 days after the Ebola epidemic declaration in the Democratic Republic of Congo, researchers are racing to test the most promising treatments and vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain sweeping the Northeast. Described as the worst Ebola epidemic in DRC’s history, the report highlights ongoing trials of therapeutics and immunizations aimed at curbing transmission and reducing mortality. The focus is on rapidly generating evidence for diverse candidates as the Bundibugyo strain sustains transmission in affected regions. The outbreak prompts urgent public health action, swift evaluation of experimental options, and close coordination among local authorities and researchers amid an evolving crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪のエボラ流行の中、治療法とワクチンの試験が進行中
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC史上最悪とされるエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）の治療・ワクチン試験に関する内容。発生100日後の状況報告で、感染拡大が継続中とされる。

article.articleHeadline: 「無関心というウイルスも克服しなければ」国連事務総長　エボラ熱対策で資金拠出要請
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We must also overcome the virus of indifference," UN Secretary-General appeals for funding for Ebola countermeasures.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 August 2026, Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is described by UN Secretary-General António Guterres as the largest outbreak in the country’s history, with 5,713 infections and 2,744 deaths. The UN's humanitarian response plan totals $2.13 billion, about 48% funded largely by the United States, leaving roughly $1.1 billion unfunded. Guterres warned that international attention lags behind reality and urged nations to contribute to the appeal, warning that indifference is a 'virus' to be overcome. The appeal funds countermeasures and humanitarian activities to support the outbreak response. The report underscores the ongoing Congo outbreak and the critical funding gap required to sustain the response.

triage.headline_ja: 「無関心というウイルスも克服しなければ」国連事務総長　エボラ熱対策で資金拠出要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（感染5,713人、死亡2,744人）が継続中であり、国連が資金不足を訴えている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国は資金拠出国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。本アウトブレイクはDRC史上最大規模とされ、資金不足（約11億ドル）が対応の課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 岡山登革熱爆「家庭群聚」！疾管署曝今年10例本土病例居住地全在高雄
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gangshan dengue fever outbreak with a 'household cluster'! Taiwan CDC reveals 10 locally transmitted cases this year, all residing in Kaohsiung.
article.articleSummary: Gangshan District, Kaohsiung City, Taiwan reports a dengue fever outbreak in a household cluster with three new locally transmitted cases announced Aug 27, bringing the year’s locally transmitted total to 10, all Kaohsiung residents. The index patient, a man in his 60s, developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia, and nausea on Aug 26 and tested positive for dengue virus serotype 2. Local health authorities conducted home-area mosquito control, indoor spraying, and 400-meter risk-area investigations, with the Taiwan CDC expanding community surveys and vector-density monitoring. Nationally in 2026, Taiwan has 145 dengue cases: 10 locally transmitted (all in Kaohsiung) and 135 imported, from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), and Maldives (16). Heavy rains can increase standing water; residents should drain, empty, clean, and spray, and use approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535). Clinicians should assess TOCC and consider NS1 rapid testing when indicated.

triage.headline_ja: 岡山でデング熱が「家庭内クラスター」で拡大！疾病管理署、今年の本土感染10例はすべて高雄居住者と発表
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄における季節性デング熱の家庭内クラスターであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大の兆候は見られないが、蚊媒介感染症としての流行しやすさから経過観察が必要。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため地域検証上ピックアップの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾高雄市岡山区であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。記事中のベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入例の由来国であり、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。台湾CDCが既に地域調査・媒介蚊密度監視を実施中であり、国内対応で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo begint met vaccineren tegen grootste ebola-uitbraak ooit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo begins vaccinating against the largest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: As of August 28, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has launched a vaccination campaign against its largest Ebola outbreak in history, starting in Kisangani in the eastern region. The Ervebo vaccine is being used, though the current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which Ervebo is not specifically approved; whether it provides protection against Bundibugyo is unclear. The campaign prioritizes healthcare workers, others fighting the outbreak, and contacts of patients. Of 70,000 doses released for Congo, 50,000 are for frontline staff and the rest for a clinical study on Bundibugyo Ebola. The outbreak has 5,713 confirmed infections and 2,744 deaths across six provinces. The WHO warns the outbreak is not under control and could exceed West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, large refugee flows, healthcare worker strikes, and displacement between areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、史上最大のエボラ流行に対するワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行（5,713例、死亡2,744例）が6州に拡大し、WHOも制御不能と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 使用ワクチン(Ervebo)は現在の流行株であるBundibugyoエボラウイルスに対する承認適応外であり、有効性が不明である点は追加のリスク要因。治安不安、避難民の大量発生、医療従事者のストライキも流行制御の障害となっている。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが記事本文では主題として扱われていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情迅速蔓延 联合国秘书长吁提供援助
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly; UN Secretary-General calls for aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly. As of Aug 25, 2026, the country has 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths. The outbreak remains in active transmission with about 500 new cases per week, and women and children are disproportionately affected. The UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged the international community to intensify support, noting that global attention, political will, and resources lag behind the crisis. The $2.13 billion UN humanitarian appeal for Ebola response is only 48% funded, leaving resources to last only a few weeks. Guterres appointed a UN senior coordinator to lead five priority actions to curb transmission and will collaborate with the Africa CDC and partners to establish a comprehensive response. Agencies are preparing for possible spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大、国連事務総長が支援を訴え
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模感染拡大（5,713例、死亡2,744名）で国連が緊急支援を要請しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 近隣諸国への感染拡大の可能性が指摘されており、資金不足（人道支援アピールの48%のみ充足）による対応能力低下が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织宣布乌干达本轮埃博拉疫情结束
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO declares Uganda's current Ebola outbreak over.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 27, 2026, the World Health Organization and Africa CDC declared Uganda's current Ebola outbreak over. Since the last imported case was discharged on July 16, Uganda has recorded 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed infections. Total in Uganda: 20 confirmed cases, 18 recoveries, 2 deaths. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya credited decisive leadership, community trust, and rapid public health action for stopping transmission. Meanwhile, Ebola persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with data up to Aug 26 showing more than 5,700 confirmed cases and over 2,700 deaths, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine yet. The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI) announced on Aug 27 a collaboration with Egypt's Minapharm to advance a candidate vaccine, CEPI's fifth BDBV vaccine in development.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダの今回のエボラ出血熱流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息は対象国外だが、記事内でDRCにおける進行中のエボラ流行（確定患者5,700人超、死者2,700人超）が言及されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大歴（ウガンダへの輸出例）がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息宣言（ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外）。一方、DRCでは承認ワクチンがないブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行が継続中であり、CEPIとエジプトのMinapharmによるワクチン開発協力も進行中。DRCの状況は既知の継続的シグナルである可能性が高いが、規模の大きさから継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SP: casos de sarampo sobem para 26 e vacinação é intensificada em três cidades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP: Measles cases rise to 26 and vaccination is intensified in three cities
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise to 26 in São Paulo state, Brazil. Of the 26 laboratory-confirmed infections, 19 patients had not been vaccinated or had incomplete immunization. The latest three cases are in the capital: two infants under one year and a woman in her 30s; in the capital, 18 of 23 patients were unvaccinated. Transmission is via respiratory droplets and the disease is highly contagious; fever and skin rash are key symptoms. In response, vaccination has been intensified in São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, with eligibility expanded for ages 6 months to 59 years to receive the measles vaccine through Sept 1, regardless of vaccination history. Those who haven't had a dose in the last 30 days should seek a basic health unit; those without vaccination records should update vaccination status. State coverage remains below the 95% target (89.3% first dose, 74.6% second dose).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州：麻疹症例が26例に増加、3都市でワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹確認例が26例に増加し、多くが未接種者で乳児も含まれる。ワクチン接種率が目標(95%)を下回っており、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 州内のワクチン接種率が第1回89.3%、第2回74.6%と目標未達であり、感受性人口が多く残存している点が今後の拡大リスクとして注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem de 88,4 mil para menos de 6 mil em um ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall from 88.4 thousand to under 6 thousand in one year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Paraná, Brazil, dropped dramatically—from 88,488 cases in Aug 2025 to 5,878 confirmed by Aug 18, 2026, with five deaths this year (five in 2026 vs 129 by the same date in 2025). The 2025 epidemiological year totaled 305,594 notifications, 92,620 confirmed cases and 145 deaths; 2025 was the first year counted Jan–Dec, instead of mid-year to mid-year. In 2026, 4,890 autochthonous dengue cases have been confirmed in Paraná; remaining cases are imported. Despite the drop, El Niño-driven rains may increase Aedes aegypti breeding and transmission risk ahead of summer. Preventive measures include removing standing water, cleaning yards, and using repellent. A Wolbachia-release program continues to release infected mosquitoes to reduce vector development.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例が1年で8万8千件から6千件未満に減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は大幅に減少しており、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため、シグナルとしての意義は低い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。記事は症例数減少を報じる内容で、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: جوتيريش يحذر: تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يتجاوز سرعة الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guterres warns: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is outpacing the response.
article.articleSummary: As of 28 August 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is outpacing response capacity, UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warns. He told a UN press conference that the virus is spreading faster and more widely than current efforts can contain, though it is potentially controllable. The United Nations has allocated over $80 million to partners and unveiled a comprehensive plan valued at about $2.13 billion. The plan is only 48% funded to date, with substantial support from the United States; without additional resources, funds could run out within weeks, hindering expansion of field operations. Guterres urged securing an extra $1.1 billion to fully fund the plan. He framed the crisis as a humanitarian catastrophe in a fragile region, stressing rapid international action is crucial to stop transmission and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: グテーレス事務総長警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、対応能力を上回るスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: 国連事務総長が公式に対応能力を超える拡大を警告し、大規模な資金・国際支援が必要とされていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国は資金支援国として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh sốt xuất huyết gia tăng nhanh, bước vào giai đoạn đỉnh dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is rising rapidly, entering the peak phase of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 28 August 2026 08:16, dengue fever is rising rapidly across Vietnam, with the outbreak entering the peak phase in many localities nationwide. The Nhân Dân report notes several very severe cases, indicating a growing clinical burden. Unseasonably heavy rainfall and abnormal weather patterns are identified as factors likely to fuel transmission by expanding mosquito breeding sites. The article provides no specific case counts or laboratory confirmation details, and there is no mention of imported or exported cases. Published content highlights nationwide spread and ongoing epidemiological concerns as the peak nears. Reported by Thúy Quỳnh of Nhân Dân on 28 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が急速に増加し、流行のピークに入る
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム全国でデング熱がピークを迎え、重症例も報告されているが、具体的な症例数や検査確認情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムにおける季節性・毎年発生する感染症であり、異常な気象条件（大雨）が媒介蚊の繁殖を助長している点が特徴。具体的な症例数・検査確認情報がなく、IHR基準の判定は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு, பன்றி காய்ச்சலை கட்டுப்படுத்த தீவிர நடவடிகை: அமைச்சா் அருண்ராஜ் உறுதி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vigorous measures to contain dengue and swine fever: Minister Arunraj confirms.
article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu is pursuing vigorous measures to contain dengue and swine fever, Minister Arunraj confirms, after Villupuram DMK MLA V. Lakshmanan raised questions about H1N1 spread. He notes that dengue fever spikes during the monsoon season. For January 1–26, 2026, Tamil Nadu reported 12,856 confirmed dengue cases and 7 deaths. The figures underscore ongoing dengue transmission during the season, with authorities pledging intensified containment and vector-control efforts. The minister’s response foregrounds dengue surveillance and control in the monsoon period while addressing concerns about H1N1, though the report provides no additional details on H1N1 cases, infection sources, or laboratory confirmation beyond the confirmed case count and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と豚インフルエンザの抑制へ徹底した対策：アルンラージ大臣が確約
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期における季節性デング熱の流行状況と、州議会での質疑に対する行政対応を報じる内容であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。H1N1については具体的な症例情報が皆無。
triage.notes: 季節性デング熱（モンスーン期の恒常的な流行）に関する州レベルの行政対応記事。H1N1については症例数・感染源・検査確定情報が記事内に一切なく、詳細不明。政治的質疑への回答という文脈であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: बुखार-सर्दी जुकाम को हल्के में न लें, वायरल फीवर से बचने के लिए करें ये काम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't take fever, cold, and cough lightly; do these things to prevent viral fever.
article.articleSummary: Viral fever outbreak increasing rapidly in Mirzapur district, Uttar Pradesh, with the district hospital seeing over 270 patients daily presenting fever, cold, and cough. No swine flu cases reported yet, though symptoms overlap with influenza-like illness. Health officials advise masking, hand hygiene, avoiding cut fruits and foods left uncovered, and not taking medicines without doctor’s advice. Emphasis on sanitation: wash hands on returning home, avoid cold foods, and steer clear of street foods exposed to dust. Increase intake of fruits and fluids; government-supplied ORS recommended. Ensure no standing water in coolers. Dengue risk may follow rains; keep water containers clean. If fever develops, consult a doctor rather than self-medicating. Seek evaluation and medicines at the district hospital or local CHCs/PHCs.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱・風邪を軽視しないで。ウイルス性発熱を防ぐためにすべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州ミルザープル地区で発熱・咳等の患者が急増しているが、特定病原体の確認はなく（豚インフルエンザ症例は未報告）、一般的な健康啓発記事であり深刻性・異常性の判断材料が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン期の季節性ウイルス性発熱・デング熱予防に関する一般的な健康アドバイス記事。1日270人以上の患者報告があるが、特定病原体の確定診断や重症度データは記載されていない。豚インフルエンザ症例は否定されている。

article.articleHeadline: [특징주] 신풍제약, 中 코로나 확진자 증가에 16%↑
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Top stock] Shinpoong Pharmaceutical up 16% on rise in confirmed COVID-19 cases in China.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rise in China, with July new confirmed infections about 522,000, severe cases 487 and 1 death per the China CDC. The nationwide influenza-like illness (ILI) positive rate at 1,041 sentinel hospitals was 21.2% from July 27 to Aug 2, up 13 percentage points in five weeks. Authorities view the surge as seasonal/cyclical rather than a new pandemic, with most infections mild and no high-fatality-variant surge identified. In South Korea, COVID-19–related stocks surged on Aug 28: Shinpoong Pharmaceutical up 16.13% to 12,700 won at 10:06 a.m., while Cellid and JinMatrix rose about 10.6% and 9.9%, ARiBioLab ~5.1%, and Gangstem Biotech ~3.0%. The market movement reflects ongoing outbreak data, rather than an expected large-scale domestic wave.}

triage.triage_reason: 中国でCOVID-19/インフルエンザ様疾患が増加しているが、当局は季節性・周期的な流行と評価し重症化率も低いため、IHR基準は該当なし。株価反応など社会的関心はあるが、公衆衛生上の新規性・深刻性は限定的なため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は中国国内でのCOVID-19/ILI増加であり、韓国は関連製薬企業の株価反応のみで発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。中国CDCは季節性変動と説明し、高致死性変異株の出現は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo începe campania de vaccinare pentru Ebola: primii sunt medicii, asistentele și lucrătorii din prima linie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo launches Ebola vaccination campaign: the first to be vaccinated are doctors, nurses, and frontline workers.
article.articleSummary: On 28 August 2026, Congo launches an Ebola vaccination campaign prioritizing medical staff and frontline workers with Ervebo, a vaccine previously developed for Zaire ebolavirus. Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, hosts the launch; frontline workers receive first doses. Authorities note Ervebo has proven effective in past outbreaks caused by a different, more widespread strain, and is being evaluated for Bundibugyo. The government earmarks 20,000 doses for a clinical trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo, while the WHO has approved 70,000 total doses for vaccination in Congo, with 50,000 reserved for frontline personnel. The campaign covers 14 health zones across Tshopo, Bas-Uele, and Haut-Uele. As of this week, Congo reported over 5,700 Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths, with Ituri as the epicenter, among the deadliest outbreaks in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始：医師・看護師・最前線労働者が最初に接種
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,700人超の症例・2,744人の死者を記録する大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、Bundibugyo株という通常のワクチン対象株とは異なる株が関与している点で異常性・深刻性ともに高く、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 本流行は既に大規模かつ長期化しているアウトブレイクであり、Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン効果が臨床試験段階にあることから、株の違いによる予防効果の不確実性が今後の拡大リスクに影響する可能性がある。国際的拡大・渡航制限の有無については記事内に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: ウガンダのエボラ熱が収束 ＷＨＯ、コンゴは拡大続く｜全国のニュース｜Web東奥
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's Ebola outbreak has subsided; WHO says Congo continues to expand.
article.articleSummary: As of August 28, 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC report Uganda’s Ebola outbreak has subsided, while the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Congo) continues to experience spread. In Uganda, since May there have been 20 confirmed Ebola infections and 2 deaths; the last patient was discharged in mid-July, and a 42-day period with no new infections has elapsed, meeting the criterion to declare the outbreak over. In the Congo, the outbreak remains active with 5,713 infections and 2,744 deaths to date. WHO is coordinating with local authorities to strengthen the response in Congo. The report does not detail transmission sources or any imported/exported cases, nor does it provide further data on clinical presentation or laboratory confirmations beyond case counts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ熱が収束 ＷＨＯ、コンゴは拡大続く｜全国のニュース｜Web東奥
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が継続し、死亡者数が多く公衆衛生上重大な影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは収束が確認されたため対象国リストに含まれるコンゴのみを抽出。ウガンダは対象国リストに存在しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान में स्वाइन फ्लू का बढ़ा खतरा, 27 दिन में मिले 55 केस; जानें क्या हैं लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu threat has increased in Rajasthan; 55 cases detected in 27 days; know the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) threat has intensified in Rajasthan, with 55 new cases detected in August 2026 across roughly 27 days, marking the highest monthly tally this year. From January to August, Rajasthan has reported 146 Swine flu cases. Health authorities say they are closely monitoring rising H1N1 activity in Delhi and other states, and have directed medical facilities to stay prepared. Top officials note that there is no confirmed emergence of a new or more virulent strain; the circulating virus is already active, according to ICMR, and there is no need to panic. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue. Young children, older adults, pregnant women, and those with underlying illnesses are at higher risk for complications.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州で豚インフルエンザの脅威が増大、27日間で55件の感染確認；症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の症例増加が報告されているが、新規変異株の出現はなく、パニックの必要はないと当局が明言。ヒト-ヒト感染は既知の季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、続報を注視するレベル。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの症例数増加。新規変異株の出現なしとICMRが確認済み。デリー等他州でも活動増加を監視中との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: 國內爆3例登革熱本土確診！全都住在高雄　疾管署：有疑似症狀應盡速就醫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three locally transmitted dengue fever cases confirmed in Taiwan; all of them reside in Kaohsiung. Taiwan CDC: Those with suspected symptoms should seek medical care promptly.
article.articleSummary: Three locally transmitted dengue fever cases confirmed in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, forming a household cluster. The index patient, a man in Gangshan District aged in his 60s, developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia and nausea on August 26 and was diagnosed with dengue virus type 2 after hospital testing; two other cohabitants also tested positive for dengue virus type 2, and all three are hospitalized. Nationally, 145 dengue cases this year: 10 locally acquired (all in Kaohsiung) and 135 imported, mainly from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27) and the Maldives (16). No overseas travel history for the local cases. Health authorities expanded contact tracing and intensified vector-control around residences, including larval-source reduction, entomological surveys, and community education. Clinicians are advised to use NS1 rapid tests and to collect travel/occupation/contact/clustering histories. Residents should seek prompt care for fever and dengue-like symptoms and cooperate with prevention measures, especially after heavy rainfall.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で登革熱の地域内感染3例確認！全員高雄在住　疾病管理署「疑わしい症状があれば速やかに受診を」
triage.triage_reason: 高雄市での家庭内クラスター（3例）は媒介動物由来の感染症で地域内感染拡大の可能性はあるが、症例数は少なく重症例・死亡の報告もなく、対象国リストに該当する発生国が確認できないため。
