article.articleHeadline: 喜报！祁阳市斩获永州市结核病防治技能竞赛团体一等奖等多项大奖_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Good news! Qiyang City wins the Team First Prize in Yongzhou City's Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Skills Competition, as well as several other major prizes.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 26, 2026, Yongzhou City’s Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Skills Competition concluded in Lengshuitan District. The Qiyang team captured the Team First Prize, with all four contestants (two in prevention/control and two in clinical diagnosis/treatment) winning prizes. The event was organized by the Yongzhou City Health Commission, the City Center for Disease Control and Prevention, and the City Central Hospital, and it assessed TB fundamentals, prevention and control, laboratory testing, and clinical management through a public-health knowledge written exam and practical case analyses. The Qiyang team earned four first prizes, three second prizes, and two third prizes, demonstrating strong frontline TB expertise. The success highlights ongoing TB-control capacity-building, and Qiyang plans to consolidate gains, address gaps, and prepare for the provincial TB prevention skills contest.

triage.headline_ja: 喜報！祁陽市が永州市結核病防治技能競技会で団体一等賞など多数の受賞を獲得

triage.notes: 記事は結核防治技能競技会の受賞報告であり、実際のTB発生・流行に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: LSD hingga Flu Burung, Ini Penyakit Hewan yang Bisa Dilaporkan Warga ke Disnakkeswan Sigi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From Lumpy Skin Disease to Avian Influenza, These Are the Animal Diseases That Residents Can Report to Disnakkeswan Sigi
article.articleSummary: Residents of Sigi Regency, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia, can report livestock and animal-health concerns to the Disnakkeswan Sigi via WhatsApp, email, or in-person. Reports include suspected diseases such as Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD/PMK), Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), rabies, and avian influenza. Reports serve as an early-detection system, enabling field teams to conduct inspections, diagnose, treat, quarantine, or vaccinate as needed. The service also educates farmers, collects data to map disease patterns, plan programs, and budget. It oversees livestock movement, slaughter, and veterinary drug distribution, and handles issues like fake feed or expired medicines. Contact: WhatsApp +62 813-4103-3403; email disnakkeswan.kabsigi@gmail.com; office: Jalan Pramuka, Mpanau, Sigi Biromaru; open for face-to-face consultations every Thursday from 08:15 to 16:00 WITA. Published Aug 28, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: LSDから鳥インフルエンザまで、住民がSigi県家畜保健局に報告できる動物の病気

article.articleHeadline: ウガンダのエボラ熱が収束
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's Ebola outbreak has subsided.
article.articleSummary: On August 27, 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC declared that the Ebola outbreak in Uganda has subsided, while the Congo outbreak continues. In Congo, transmission remains ongoing, with 5,713 infections and 2,744 deaths reported to date. WHO and local authorities are strengthening the response in Congo. The update highlights a divergent regional trajectory: Uganda’s outbreak has ended, but Congo continues to experience persistent transmission.

article.articleHeadline: ウガンダのエボラ熱が収束　ＷＨＯ、コンゴは拡大続く

article.articleSummary: As of Aug 27, 2026, Uganda’s Ebola outbreak has subsided per WHO and Africa CDC, recording 20 confirmed infections and 2 deaths since May, with no new cases for 42 days after the last patient was discharged in mid-July, meeting the criteria to declare the outbreak over. WHO is coordinating with local authorities to strengthen response in Congo; Uganda has been declared over, though regional vigilance remains warranted.

triage.headline_ja: 【茨城新聞】ウガンダのエボラ熱が収束
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国では感染が継続し、感染者5,713人・死者2,744人に達する大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準（深刻性・国際拡大リスク）を満たすためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのアウトブレイクはWHO基準により終息が宣言されたが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国では感染拡大が継続しており、地域的な警戒が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: RDCongo inicia vacinação para combater surto mais rápido da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: DR Congo begins vaccination to combat the fastest outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo began Ebola vaccination with Ervebo, prioritizing frontline health workers in Kisangani, Tshopo, as authorities battle Africa’s fastest outbreak. As of Aug 25, 2026, the country reported 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, with the epidemic centered in Ituri and described as the deadliest of 17 outbreaks there. Insecurity, displacement, health-worker strikes, and large-scale movement hinder containment. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak remains out of control and could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths; that outbreak has ended. More than 50,000 Ervebo doses have arrived; about 50,000 are for health workers and frontline staff, 20,000 for a trial testing Ervebo against Bundibugyo, the current strain. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. A compassionate-use program facilitates Ervebo, with data collection to assess efficacy; 14 health zones in Tshopo, Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele are included. Minapharm/CEPI-backed vaccine development is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国が史上最速の流行に対処するためワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行規模、国際的拡大＝ウガンダへの伝播）に加え、WHOが「制御不能」と警告する史上最速・最悪規模のエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダで20例（うち15例はDRCからの輸入例）報告されたが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。当該ウガンダの流行自体は終息済み。DRCの流行はイトゥリ州を中心に過去17回の流行中最悪とされ、5,713例確定・2,744例死亡（2026年8月25日時点）と極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Flu Singapura Tembus 100 Ribu Kasus, Vietnam Imbau Warga Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singapore Flu Tops 100,000 Cases; Vietnam Urges Citizens to Be Vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Singapore's hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD), also called Singapore flu, has topped 100,000 cases. In Vietnam, authorities urged citizens to be vigilant against HFMD or Singapore flu on August 25, 2026, as infections surge during the back-to-school season. The Vietnamese Ministry of Health called for enhanced prevention through strengthened cooperation between families and educational institutions to curb transmission. The advisory underscores a rising outbreak as children return to classrooms, signaling heightened risk of school-associated spread. While the report highlights the Singapore high caseload, it frames Vietnam's response as a preventive public health effort aimed at early intervention, hygiene, and awareness among households and schools to limit further waves of infection.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールで手足口病（シンガポール風邪）が10万例を超える、ベトナムは国民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病（HFMD）はシンガポールで流行拡大が報告されベトナムでも学校再開に伴う感染増加への警戒が呼びかけられているが、IHR基準への明確な該当は確認できず、情報も限定的なため継続観察が適切。
triage.notes: シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ベトナムでは学校再開に伴うHFMD増加への注意喚起が政府から出されており、季節性・地域性の流行と考えられるため重症度は高くないと推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland: African swine fever confirmed in three Kohima villages, DC restricts pork movement
article.articleSummary: As of 28 August 2026, African swine fever has been confirmed in three Nagaland villages—Kiruphema Bawe, Chiechama and Nerhema—in Kohima district, following positive lab reports from the Chief Veterinary Officer, Kohima. Kohima District Commissioner B. Henok Buchem designated a 1‑km infected zone around the premises and a 10‑km surveillance zone. The order bans export, import and movement of live pigs and pork products into, within or out of the zones; pork markets and butchery shops within the zones must close. Pig farmers should restrict visitors, disinfect premises daily, and report any unusual illness or mortality among pigs to the Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services Department; suspicious deaths must be reported. Carcasses must be buried per official protocols; dumping in water bodies or open areas is prohibited. Public urged to avoid meat from unknown sources; violators face penalties under the Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランド州:コヒマ管内の3村でアフリカ豚熱を確認、地区長官が豚肉流通を制限
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は動物のみに感染し人への健康影響はなく、発生も地域限定的で既に行政による移動制限・検疫措置が実施されているため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は豚のみに感染するウイルス性疾患であり、人畜共通感染症ではない。インド北東部では過去にも散発的な発生が報告されており、今回も地区当局による感染ゾーン設定・移動禁止などの標準的な防疫対応が取られている。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫：乌干达伊波拉疫情结束
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in Uganda has ended.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-28, the World Health Organization announced that Uganda's Ebola outbreak has ended after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases—twice the virus’s longest incubation period. The last patient was discharged on 16 August 2026. Uganda reported 20 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 2 deaths; nearly all cases were imported from neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo. Congo's Ebola outbreak continues, with over 5,600 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths, the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. The Ugandan cases were predominantly import-related from DRC, with ongoing surveillance, contact tracing, and isolation measures; cross-border transmission risks persist, underscoring regional public health coordination needs.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:ウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行が終息
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息は朗報だが、感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国では5,600人超の確定患者・2,700人超の死者を出す史上最速拡大のエボラ流行が継続中であり、越境感染リスクが残るためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事の主眼はウガンダ流行終息だが、コンゴ民主共和国での大規模かつ史上最速のエボラ流行継続が重要な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Nam tài xế nguy kịch vì bệnh Whitmore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Male driver in critical condition due to Whitmore's disease.
article.articleSummary: 54-year-old male driver from Ninh Bình, Vietnam, working at a construction site in Phú Quốc, developed fever with headache, followed by seizures and altered consciousness. Diagnosed with Whitmore (melioidosis) in diabetes. Blood culture grew Burkholderia pseudomallei. On admission to National Institute of Infectious Diseases, he was obtunded with focal seizures; MRI showed thalamic and cortical lesions. He required endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation, with antibiotics and metabolic management. After about a month of treatment, his condition improved substantially, but he must complete the full therapy and maintain glycemic control, with ongoing recovery monitoring. Whitmore is a soil- and water-borne infection caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, with pneumonia, bacteremia, or CNS involvement. Diabetes increases risk. During the rainy season, avoid mud and dirty water; wear boots and gloves and cover wounds. Seek care if fever, cough, dyspnea, headache, fatigue, or altered consciousness follow soil or water exposure, and inform clinicians of any contact.

triage.headline_ja: 男性ドライバー、ウィットモア病により重篤状態
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例報告であり、糖尿病を基礎疾患に持つ患者における土壌・水由来の環境感染症（メリオイドーシス）で、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、公衆衛生上の異常拡大や国際的リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシス（ウィットモア病）はベトナムでは既知の風土病であり、土壌・水を介した環境感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はしない。単発の重症例報告であり、地域的アウトブレイクや異常な増加を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, l'Uganda chiude il focolaio mentre in Congo il virus continua a correre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Uganda closes the outbreak while in Congo the virus continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak over on August 27 after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases since the last patient was discharged on July 16. Total in Uganda: 20 confirmed cases, 18 recoveries, 2 deaths; 15 infections imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and five contracted locally among contacts or healthcare workers linked to imported cases. Authorities traced 836 contacts and intensified surveillance in 36 high‑risk districts and at 38 entry points. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the largest Ebola outbreak on record continues, with 5,584 confirmed cases and 2,680 deaths across 57 health zones in six provinces as of August 23; Ituri remains the epicenter, with spread to Nord Kivu and Haut‑Uélé, and a weekly increase of 563 cases and 302 deaths. The WHO urges sustained surveillance, laboratories, and rapid response, and does not advocate border closures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、ウガンダは流行終息を宣言するも、コンゴでは感染拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、死者2,680人・確認例5,584人に達し、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息宣言済みだが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。コンゴでの流行は継続中で史上最大規模であり、WHOも監視強化を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak may be 3 times larger than official count: Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak may be three times larger than official counts, Africa CDC warns, with 5,713 confirmed infections and 2,744 deaths through Aug 25; if threefold, about 17,100 infections and a case-fatality ratio of 48%. Community deaths comprise about 63% of the two weeks to Aug 24, down from roughly half earlier. The outbreak spans six eastern provinces, with Ituri hotspots and growth in Katwa, North Kivu, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; declared mid-May. Weak contact tracing, insecurity and response disruptions drive under-detection; genomic data are mainly from Ituri, limiting visibility elsewhere. Africa CDC has shifted to house-to-house active case finding, though coverage is uneven. About $867 million has been released, but last-mile delivery and payroll issues persist; five checkpoints in Haut-Uélé were closed for unpaid workers, and North Kivu treatment capacity exceeds beds. If the pace continues, it could surpass the 2013–16 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、アフリカCDCによれば公式発表の3倍規模の可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が公式統計の3倍規模（推定約17,100人感染、CFR48%）に達する可能性があり、地域拡大・資金/対応能力の課題も深刻でIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 感染者数の過小報告、コミュニティ死亡率の上昇、資金の最終供給・給与未払い問題など対応能力の課題が指摘されており、2013-16年西アフリカ流行を超える規模に至る可能性が示唆されている。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo inicia vacunación contra el brote de ébola más letal en la historia de ese país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo begins vaccination against the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches vaccination against Ebola, targeting the deadliest outbreak in its history. In Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, on Aug 27, Health Minister Roger Kamba administered Ervebo to a frontline worker as vaccination begins nationwide. The outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri province and is the most lethal among 17 prior outbreaks, with 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths as of Aug 25, 2026. The response faces significant challenges: insecurity, displacements, a health-worker strike, and mass population movements; the WHO says the situation is out of control and could surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed over 11,000. Over 50,000 Ervebo doses have arrived; 70,000 doses have been authorized for use in DRC. About 50,000 doses are for frontline workers and health staff; 20,000 will be used in a trial to study protection against Bundibugyo virus. The vaccination program covers 14 health zones in Tshopo, Bas-Uele, and Haut-Uele, under compassionate-use.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、同国史上最も致死率の高いエボラ流行に対するワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 致死率・症例数が過去最大規模で、WHOが「制御不能」と評価し2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性を指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリーでは言及されておらず、主題国はDRCのみのため除外。WHOが制御不能と評価し、治安不安・住民移動・医療従事者ストライキ等により国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 開學倒數！新冠、流感、腸病毒夾擊　「這些症狀」應儘速就醫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-school countdown: COVID-19, flu, and enteroviruses strike simultaneously—these symptoms warrant prompt medical attention.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports simultaneous transmission of COVID-19, influenza, and enteroviruses as schools reopen, with dengue risk rising after rain. Dengue: 134 confirmed by Aug 24, including 7 locally in Kaohsiung and 127 imported from Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Maldives. Prevention: eliminate standing water and wear masks in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces. COVID-19 remains on a plateau. Week 33 (Aug 16–22) outpatient visits: 24,995; 59 local severe cases and 19 deaths (Aug 18–24). Since Oct 2025: 480 severe cases and 73 deaths; majority 65+ or with chronic disease; 86.5% unvaccinated; subvariant PQ.16.1.1. Influenza: Week 33 visits: 94,340; 64 severe cases (59 H1N1, 5 H3N2) and 15 deaths; H1N1 about 69.7% of A-type. Season totals: 1,139 severe, 220 deaths; 63.8% of severe are 65+; 82.4% with chronic disease; 71.0% unvaccinated. Enteroviruses: Week 33 visits 6,546; year-to-date 6 severe infections including 1 death; Coxsackie A6 most common, followed by EV-D68 and Coxsackie A16. Warning signs: drowsiness, confusion, limb weakness, seizures, persistent vomiting, tachypnea or tachycardia; seek urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: 開学カウントダウン！新型コロナ・インフルエンザ・腸ウイルスが同時流行「これらの症状」は速やかに受診を
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ・腸ウイルス・デング熱の定例サーベイランス報告であり、対象国リストに台湾が含まれず、輸入デング症例の由来国（インドネシア・ベトナム）は発生国ではないため除外。異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。

triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性感染症（デング熱、COVID-19、インフルエンザ、エンテロウイルス）の定期サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は見られない。対象国リストに含まれる国（インドネシア・ベトナム）はデング熱輸入例の出身地として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo inicia la vacunación contra el brote de ébola más letal registrado en su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo begins vaccination against the deadliest Ebola outbreak in its history.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo launches a vaccination campaign against the deadliest and fastest Ebola outbreak in its history, centered in Ituri with spread to Kisangani in Tshopo and across Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele. As of 2026-08-27, 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths have been reported. Frontline health workers are prioritized and will receive Ervebo, a vaccine effective against other Ebola strains, while trials test an approved vaccine for the current Bundibugyo virus outbreak. More than 50,000 Ervebo doses have been received; the WHO has approved 70,000 doses for use, with 50,000 for frontline workers and the remainder for compassionate-use trials evaluating efficacy against Bundibugyo. The campaign spans 14 health zones across the three provinces. The WHO says the outbreak is out of control and could exceed the 2014-2016 West Africa deaths (>11,000), amid insecurity, displacement, and a health-worker strike.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、史上最も致死的なエボラ流行に対するワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速・最多死亡者数のエボラ流行が発生し、WHOが「制御不能」と表明。複数州への拡大、医療従事者ストライキ等の要因もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文ではDRC国内（Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele）での流行のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Tổng thư ký LHQ kêu gọi viện trợ 1,1 tỷ USD cho CHDC Congo chống dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Secretary-General calls for $1.1 billion in aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with over 5,600 confirmed cases and more than 2,700 deaths since the May 15 start. United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres appeals for $1.1 billion in additional funding to fully support the relief plan; the United States has contributed much of a $2.1 billion package. Egyptian Minapharm, via ProBioGen in Berlin, announced a potential Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine, backed by CEPI with $16.5 million to advance from laboratory work to Phase 1 trials in Africa. CEPI is funding four other vaccine candidates—Moderna (mRNA), University of Oxford and Serum Institute of India (ChAdOx platform), and two rVSV-based vaccines from Hilleman and Public Health Vaccines. Minapharm’s MVA-based vaccine aims to provoke both B- and T-cell responses for durable immunity. WHO recommends large-scale Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) trials in DRC to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 国連事務総長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対策に11億ドルの支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続中で、死者数が2,700人を超え、国連が大規模な国際支援を要請している。重篤性・国際的関心・支援必要性が明確であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行に関するもので、ワクチン開発（ドイツ・エジプト・米国・インドの研究機関が関与）についても触れているが、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。他国（米国、エジプト、ドイツ、インド）はワクチン開発拠点として言及されているに過ぎず、発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan Reports 55 Cases Of H1N1 In August, Highest Monthly Count So Far
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports 55 positive H1N1 (swine flu) cases in August, the highest monthly count this year, bringing the 2026 total to 146 since January. Health and Family Welfare Minister Gajendra Singh Khimsar said officials are closely monitoring the rise in some states, particularly Delhi, and directed medical institutions to ensure necessary preparations. Principal Secretary Gayatri Rathore provided a month-by-month tally: January 2, February 3, March 20, April 22, May 25, June 14, July 5, August 55. There is no confirmation of spread of a new or more virulent H1N1 strain. The update signals ongoing swine flu activity in the state, prompting heightened vigilance and readiness in healthcare facilities for diagnosis, treatment, and isolation as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州、8月にH1N1感染55例を報告 – 今年最多の月間件数
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例数増加が報告されているが、新規変異株や重症化・国際的拡大の兆候はなく、既知の疾病パターンの範囲内であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、新規または強毒株の出現は確認されていない。州当局が監視を強化している状況で、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu tally rises by 166 in a day; Health Minister inspects Dwarka hospital
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 166 new H1N1 (swine flu) cases in the last 24 hours, with the year’s H1N1 total at 2,612 and Influenza A cases around 3,300. Health Minister Pankaj Kumar Singh inspected Indira Gandhi Hospital in Dwarka to assess preparedness for rising infections. Officials showed a dedicated Swine Flu/H1N1 clinic and an isolation ward where positive cases are admitted. The visit reviewed beds, oxygen, medicines, IV fluids, testing facilities, and other essential infrastructure, with interaction among doctors, healthcare workers, and patients. Preparatory measures include heightened monitoring of government hospitals and ensuring adequate stocks of medicines, testing capability, specialist doctors, nursing staff, and laboratory technicians, plus sufficient bed capacity. Public guidance emphasizes avoiding crowded places, maintaining hand hygiene, and providing special care for children and the elderly.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでスワインフル(H1N1)感染者数が1日で166人増加、保健大臣がドワルカの病院を視察
triage.triage_reason: デリーでのH1N1感染者数が急増（1日166例増、年間累計2,612例）し、保健大臣が病院を視察するなど政府の関心が高まっているため、WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）を満たし社会的関心もあることからピックアップ対象とする。
triage.notes: H1N1（スワインフル）はインドで季節性に流行する既知の感染症であり、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、感染者数の急増と行政の積極的対応が見られるため経過観察を含むピックアップ判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）启动埃博拉疫苗接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches Ebola vaccination
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) launched Ervebo Ebola vaccination on August 27 in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province, to curb a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. The initial recipients are frontline health workers and others in contact with Ebola patients. There is no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Ervebo, approved for Zaire ebolavirus, may offer some protection based on early lab/animal data, but efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven. Vaccination operates under a compassionate-use framework with data collection to assess real-world impact. DRC has received 16,520 Ervebo doses to date. The World Health Organization coordinating group has allocated 70,000 doses: 20,000 for a Phase III trial to evaluate protection against Bundibugjo ebolavirus, and 50,000 for frontline workers. As of August 25, cumulative confirmed cases reached 5,713 with 2,744 deaths and 1,269 recoveries (CFR 48%).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 既に5,713人の確定患者、2,744人の死亡（致死率48%）を記録するBundibugyoエボラウイルス流行が進行中であり、WHOが調整するワクチン接種が開始されるなど、複数のIHR基準に該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種は稀少であり、既承認ワクチン（Ervebo、Zaire種向け）の有効性が未確立のため、フェーズIII臨床試験と compassionate use の両面で対応している点が特筆される。致死率48%と非常に高く、既に大規模流行であるためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus HIV di Halmahera Selatan Bertambah Setiap Tahun, Kadinkes Imbau Waspada Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV Cases in South Halmahera Regency Increase Each Year, Health Office Head Urges Vigilance Against Transmission
article.articleSummary: 210 confirmed HIV cases in South Halmahera Regency, North Maluku, Indonesia, as of 28 August 2026, per the Halmahera Selatan Health Office. The tally comprises 183 cases accumulated in 2024–2025 and 27 cases from January–July 2026. Health Office Head Asia Hasyim explains HIV damages immune cells and can progress to AIDS—typically about a decade after infection—leaving patients vulnerable to infections. Transmission occurs via contact with HIV-containing body fluids: blood, semen, vaginal fluids, anal fluids, and breast milk, with the highest incidence linked to sex with changing partners. Authorities urge vigilance to prevent transmission and warn of potential spread to adolescents; parents and couples should monitor activities. To improve early detection and management, the Halmahera Selatan Health Office will continue expanding the Free Health Check program (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG).

triage.headline_ja: 南ハルマヘラ県でHIV感染者数が毎年増加、保健局が感染予防への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、記事は地域保健局による年次症例数の増加傾向と注意喚起を報じる定例的な内容であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域保健局によるHIV/AIDS予防・早期発見のための無料健康診断プログラム拡大の呼びかけであり、突発的な感染症危機の兆候ではない。慢性疾患の年次統計報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: ウガンダでエボラ熱収束、WHOが発表　2700人超死亡のコンゴでは感染拡大続く
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak contained in Uganda, WHO announces; in Congo, where more than 2,700 have died, the outbreak continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: On July 27, the World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC announced that the Ebola outbreak in Uganda has been contained. Uganda reported 20 confirmed infections and 2 deaths since May; the last patient was discharged in mid-July, and 42 days without new cases met the containment criterion. By contrast, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola transmission persists, with 5,713 infections and 2,744 deaths reported to date, and no clear path to containment. WHO is coordinating with local authorities to strengthen the response in the DRC, but the outbreak continues to spread. This update highlights divergent trajectories within the region: Uganda achieving containment while the Congo outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ熱収束、WHOが発表　2700人超死亡のコンゴでは感染拡大続く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,713人感染・2,744人死亡と大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、収束の見通しが立っていないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は収束済みのため対象国リストに含まれるウガンダ（対象国リスト外）は除外。DRCでの継続的な感染拡大が主な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ada Virus Zika di Bali, CDC Keluarkan Travel Health Notice untuk Wisatawan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is a Zika virus in Bali; the CDC issues a Travel Health Notice for travelers.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus in Bali prompted the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to issue a Travel Health Notice on August 7, 2026, warning travelers returning from Bali about potential infection. The notice notes that Zika transmission predominantly occurs through Aedes mosquito bites and can also spread from pregnant women to their fetuses, as well as via sexual contact. While the article does not report a confirmed local outbreak or case counts, it cites infections among travelers who have returned from Bali. The warning highlights heightened risk for vulnerable groups, especially pregnant individuals, given the association between Zika infection during pregnancy and serious birth defects. Travelers planning trips to Bali or returning from Bali should take preventive measures against mosquito bites and practice safe sex to mitigate transmission.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島でジカウイルス発生、CDCが旅行者向けに渡航健康注意情報を発出
triage.triage_reason: 米国CDCがバリ島渡航者に対しジカウイルス感染に関する渡航健康注意情報を発出し、渡航者間での感染拡大が確認されていることから国際的拡大及び渡航制限リスクの基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はバリ島での確定的なローカルアウトブレイクや症例数を報告しておらず、渡航者の感染例に基づくCDC通知が主内容。重症度や公衆衛生への具体的影響は不明であり、続報での確認が必要。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 開學倒數！新冠、流感、腸病毒夾擊　「這些症狀」應儘速就醫 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back-to-school countdown! COVID-19, influenza, and enteroviruses strike simultaneously — these symptoms warrant prompt medical attention.
article.articleSummary: As schools reopen, Taiwan faces concurrent outbreaks of COVID-19, influenza, and enteroviruses, with dengue risk rising in Kaohsiung. By Aug 24, dengue had 134 confirmed cases (7 local, all in Kaohsiung; 127 imported from Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Maldives). COVID-19 remains at a plateau: Week 33 (Aug 16–22) saw 24,995 ED visits, 59 local severe cases and 19 local deaths; since Oct 2025, 480 severe cases and 73 deaths, mainly among 65+ with chronic disease; 86.5% unvaccinated; PQ.16.1.1 dominant. Flu: Week 33 recorded 94,340 ILI visits; 64 severe cases (59 H1N1, 5 H3N2) and 15 deaths (all H1N1). Year-to-date: 1,139 severe and 220 deaths; 71.0% unvaccinated. Enteroviruses: Week 33 had 6,546 visits; Coxsackie A6 top, followed by EV-D68 and Coxsackie A16; 6 severe/critical infections this year, including 1 death. Warn signs include lethargy, weakness, vomiting; seek hospital care promptly. Masking recommended in crowded or poorly ventilated settings.

triage.headline_ja: 開学カウントダウン！新型コロナ、インフルエンザ、腸ウイルスが同時流行――「これらの症状」があれば速やかに受診を
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における新型コロナ・インフルエンザ・腸ウイルス・デング熱の定例サーベイランス報告であり、季節性の想定内の流行状況を示すもので、対象国（台湾は対象外）にも該当せず、国際的な異常性・拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱の輸入例（インドネシア・ベトナム・モルディブ由来）が言及されているが、これらは感染発生地ではなく感染源国としての記載であり、本記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）における季節性感染症サーベイランスである。

article.articleHeadline: Rise in vector-borne diseases exposes Pune civic health staff shortage
article.articleSummary: In Pune, surge in dengue and chikungunya exposes vector-control manpower shortage as PMC hires 265 contractual workers in addition to 150 permanent posts. For 2026, Pune reports 1,081 suspected dengue cases with 46 positives; August shows 410 suspected and 20 positives (vs 323/12 last month). Chikungunya totals reach 15, eight in August; one malaria case this year. Standing committee chairman Shrinath Bhimale directs priority recruitment and immediate deployment to hotspots, citing delays and urging readiness before the monsoon. The city has issued 1,708 notices against breeding sites, with fines around ₹2.65 lakh. A special drive to destroy breeding sites, increase surveillance, and spraying is ordered, alongside regular reviews to ensure manpower reaches high-need areas.

triage.headline_ja: プネーでベクター媒介性感染症が増加、市の保健職員不足が露呈
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱の季節的増加と人員不足という地域的な公衆衛生対応課題に関する内容であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、モンスーン前の状況として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱ともに毎年の流行パターンであり、記事は市当局の人員不足対応に焦点。前月比で症例数増加傾向あるが重症度・死亡数の情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: 埃及藥廠獲資助1650萬美元 為非洲研發伊波拉疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Egyptian drugmaker secures $16.5 million in funding to develop an Ebola vaccine for Africa.
article.articleSummary: Egypt's Minapharm Biopharma Group secured $16.5 million from CEPI to develop an experimental Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo virus, with aims to transfer production capacity to Egypt and bolster Africa's outbreak response. The grant funds preclinical work and a first-in-human Phase I trial in Africa to evaluate safety and immunogenicity; if Phase I is favorable, CEPI, supported by the European Commission and the U.S. State Department, may fund larger trials for emergency-use authorization and full approval. The vaccine's active component will be developed by ProBioGen in Berlin and then shipped to Egypt for final formulation. Bundibugyo virus was first identified in Bundibugyo, Uganda (2007); it caused outbreaks in the DRC in 2012. There is no approved vaccine or antiviral for Bundibugyo virus; treatment remains supportive. In May 2026, a DRC Ebola outbreak caused 2,325 deaths, the deadliest on record in the country.

triage.headline_ja: エジプトの製薬会社がCEPIから1650万米ドルの資金を確保し、アフリカ向けエボラワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン研究開発への資金提供に関する報道であり、新規の感染症発生や進行中のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。DRCの過去のアウトブレイク（2026年5月）への言及は背景情報に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエジプトの製薬会社Minapharmが受けたCEPIからのワクチン開発資金であり、現在進行中の感染症発生イベントを報じるものではない。DRCの2026年5月のアウトブレイク（2325人死亡）は過去の実績として言及されているのみで、本記事の発生地域には該当しない。Bundibugyoウイルスの初発地であるウガンダは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: 北京疾控提醒：咳嗽咳痰超2周要警惕！开学季校园结核防控7问7答
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing CDC reminds: A cough with sputum lasting more than two weeks warrants vigilance! 7 Questions and 7 Answers on campus tuberculosis prevention and control during the back-to-school season.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) on Beijing campuses calls for vigilance as students return to school. TB spreads mainly through respiratory droplets; crowded classrooms, dormitories, and libraries facilitate transmission. Key symptoms: cough for more than two weeks, sputum, hemoptysis, fever, night sweats, fatigue, and weight loss. Suspected cases should promptly visit a TB-designated facility and provide accurate information to clinicians. If diagnosed, report to the school; those with contagious risk may require leave of absence until contagion subsides, then return with medical clearance. TB is curable with standard, full-course treatment; adherence is essential. Close contacts should be screened; latent infection may warrant preventive therapy. Prevention: proper ventilation, no spitting, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, adequate sleep, nutrition, and exercise. Schools should screen new entrants and staff, monitor symptoms, track absences, and ensure ventilation and disinfection plus health education.

triage.headline_ja: 北京疾控提醒：咳嗽咳痰超2周要警惕！开学季校园结核防控7问7答（咳や痰が2週間以上続く場合は要注意！新学期における学校結核予防対策7つの質疑応答）
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではなく、新学期に向けた結核予防に関する一般的な啓発・注意喚起記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は北京市疾病予防管理センターによる一般向け結核予防啓発情報であり、具体的な発生数増加やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu surge: 304 cases in 48 hrs, tally crosses 2,600 before winter - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (Influenza A H1N1) surges in Delhi, with 2,612 swine flu cases reported this year and 304 new infections across 48 hours, including 166 in the last 24 hours; Influenza A totals exceed 3,300. The early rise precedes the usual influenza season (Nov–Jan) and is linked to humid monsoon conditions and crowded, enclosed spaces, putting schoolchildren and residents in dense areas at higher risk. ICMR says the circulating virus is not a new strain; about 97–98% of Influenza A samples test positive for the same virus, with minor genetic changes and no pattern of a major outbreak. Most cases are mild, but infection can affect the lungs and cause serious respiratory illness in some patients. Delhi hospitals are to maintain isolation beds, oxygen, medicines, and testing facilities; capacity could be increased if needed, Health Minister Dr Pankaj Singh said.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザが急増：48時間で304例、冬前に累計2,600例超え - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: デリーで季節外れの豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）急増が報告され、行政・メディアの関心も高いため、WPRO基準複数該当と社会的関心の両方を満たす。
triage.notes: ICMRは新規株ではなく既知株の変異範囲内と発表しており、大規模流行のパターンは確認されていない。ただし季節前の急増と混雑環境での感染拡大リスクから注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 高溫多雨加境外移入 國內登革熱風險升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High temperatures and heavy rainfall, along with imported cases from abroad, raise domestic dengue fever risk.
article.articleSummary: On August 28, 2026, Taiwan’s CDC confirmed a dengue fever family cluster in Gangshan District, Kaohsiung City, with six members and three confirmed cases hospitalized; all have no overseas travel history, and cases are concentrated around their home as authorities conduct expanded community testing and vector control. This marks the second domestic dengue cluster this year; the previous June outbreak at Kaohsiung Min-Sheng Hospital involved an imported case and six local transmissions. Nationally, 145 dengue cases have been reported this year: 10 indigenous (all in Kaohsiung) and 135 imported, mainly from Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Maldives, with totals below 2025 levels. Authorities warn that high temperatures and heavy rainfall, coupled with the end of summer holidays and inbound travelers or Southeast Asian students, raise domestic risk. Core prevention emphasizes eliminating breeding sources; floods also heighten risks for leptospirosis and melioidosis, with protective measures including gloves, boots, masks, and diluted bleach disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 高温多雨と海外からの輸入例増加により、国内デング熱リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 発生地域は台湾（対象国リスト外）であり、記事で言及されるベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入例の由来国として触れられているに過ぎず、実際の発生地ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 本イベントの主たる発生地は台湾（高雄市）であり、対象国リストに台湾が含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。ベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入症例の出身地として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: देहरादून में H1N1 इन्फ्लूएंजा के सात नए मरीज मिले: कुल 59 संक्रमित, अस्पतालों को सतर्क रहने के निर्देश - seven new influenza cases in doon hospitals instructed to remain alert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven new H1N1 influenza patients found in Dehradun: total 59 infected, hospitals instructed to stay vigilant.
article.articleSummary: In Dehradun, Uttarakhand, swine flu (H1N1 influenza) infections have reached 59 from 148 samples tested, with 7 new cases confirmed on Thursday among 18 samples. Of the total, 41 are Dehradun residents and 18 from other areas. So far, 40 patients have recovered, 14 are active (13 under treatment), and five deaths have been recorded (death cause pending after a death audit). COVID-19 (coronavirus) results show 1 new positive from 17 samples tested on Thursday; total positives are 18 from 110 samples tested to date, including eight in Dehradun and others from different districts/state. Fifteen have recovered, three remain in hospital, and no COVID-19 deaths have been reported yet. Authorities ordered masks for all staff at Doon Hospital and district hospital COVID wards, with isolation for suspected cases. Those with fever, cough, sore throat, breathlessness, or body aches should seek testing; extra precautions advised for elderly, children, and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラードゥーンでH1N1インフルエンザの新規患者7人確認：感染者計59人、病院に警戒指示
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタラーカンド州で季節性H1N1インフルエンザとCOVID-19の症例が報告されているが、既知の疾患であり異常性は低く、地域限定の流行と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1インフルエンザとCOVID-19の地域内サーベイランス報告。死亡5例（死因は死亡audit待ち）、感染者59人だが、季節性流行として既知のパターンに合致し、国際的な異常性・拡大リスクは低いと判断。地方当局が病院への警戒指示を出し対応中で、外部支援の必要性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue and leptospirosis cases increasing in TN's Krishnagiri district
article.articleSummary: Dengue and leptospirosis are rising in Krishnagiri district, Tamil Nadu. In 2025, dengue cases totaled 475; by the third week of August 2026, 239 dengue infections had been reported, including 98 in Hosur City Municipal Corporation, 30 in Hosur block, and 19 in Shoolagiri block. Leptospirosis increased from 44 cases last year to 92 this year; since 2021 this represents the second-highest annual leptospirosis tally for Krishnagiri, with 2024 recording a peak of 214 cases. In response, the district administration is deploying anti-larval and fogging operations. A total of 483 Domestic Breeding Checking workers across 10 blocks, town panchayats, municipality, and municipal corporation have been trained in anti-dengue measures. Health officials underscore ongoing containment to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州クリシュナギリ県でデング熱とレプトスピラ症の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・レプトスピラ症は季節性の媒介動物由来感染症で、地域単位での増加が報告されているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく、地元行政による通常の防除対応が行われている段階。
triage.notes: 地方（クリシュナギリ県）レベルでの季節性感染症の増加報告。過去のピーク（2024年のレプトスピラ症214件）を下回っており、地元行政が防除措置（防蚊・啓発）を実施中。重症度・死亡例・入院状況等の詳細情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 民主刚果开始接种伊波拉疫苗 对抗国内史上最严重疫情 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo begins Ebola vaccine rollout to combat the worst outbreak in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo begins Ebola vaccine rollout using Ervebo, starting in Chopo Province with Kisangani as the capital for the response. First recipients include healthcare workers and frontline responders; the plan covers 14 health zones across Chopo, Upper Welaï, and Lower Welaï. The outbreak, described as the worst in the country’s history, has 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths (case fatality ~48%), spanning six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, as well as Upper and Lower Welaï and Chopo. The epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo virus, while Ervebo is approved for the Zaïre virus strain and may offer partial protection; vaccine efficacy against Bundibugyo is under study. Authorities have secured over 50,000 doses (WHO has approved up to 70,000; ~50k for frontline, 20k for clinical trials). Data collection during rollout will assess effectiveness amid insecurity and displacement affecting response and lab result delays contributing to resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 民主刚果、史上最悪の国内エボラ流行に対抗するためワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数(重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク)に該当し、DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（致死率約48%）が継続していることから、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 流行株がBundibugyoウイルスであるにもかかわらず、Zaïre株用ワクチン(Ervebo)を使用している点、治安不安・人口移動によりデータ収集や検査結果の遅延が生じている点は継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo: Organização das Nações Unidas (ONU) cita "vírus da indiferença" em alerta contra crise de ebola na República Democrática (RD) Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: United Nations (UN) cites "virus of indifference" in warning about the Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned that Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 500 new cases per week, disproportionately affecting women and children. He framed the crisis as a “virus of indifference,” noting insufficient international attention and funding amid one of the world’s most fragile settings, particularly Ituri Province where conflict has displaced roughly 1 million people and access to health care and food is limited. In eastern Congo, health workers and community teams operate under constant threat, with ambulance and treatment-center attacks killing more than 40 health workers. The response, led by the DR Congo government with WHO and the African Union, rests on five pillars: community engagement to counter misinformation; strengthened epidemiological surveillance; expanded treatment capacity; dignified, safe burials; and blocking transmission along river routes and borders. Funding covers only about half of the $2.13 billion needed; the window to act is closing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国連（UN）がコンゴ民主共和国（DR Congo）のエボラ危機に対する警告で「無関心のウイルス」と表現
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが週約500例のペースで拡大し、死亡者多数・医療従事者への攻撃・資金不足という深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 国連事務総長がエボラ危機を『無関心のウイルス』と表現し、資金不足（必要額の約半分のみ確保）と治安不安（医療従事者40人以上死亡）を指摘。イトゥリ州を中心に紛争地域での対応が困難な状況。国際的拡大の直接的証拠は本文にないが、脆弱な国境地域・人口移動の多さからリスクありと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ilocos region logs 6 deaths due to leptospirosis
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Ilocos Region caused 6 deaths and 85 confirmed cases from January 1 to August 8, 2026. Pangasinan has 46 cases; La Union 13; Ilocos Norte 12; Ilocos Sur and Dagupan City 6 each. DOH notes deaths amid continuing rains, highlighting floodwater exposure as a risk; cases are 52% lower than 177 in the same period last year. Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection from water or soil contaminated by infected animal urine, entering through cuts. Residents are urged to avoid floodwater when possible; if exposure is unavoidable, wear waterproof boots, cover wounds, and wash exposed areas with soap and clean water. Seek medical attention for fever, headache, muscle or calf pain, vomiting, chills, abdominal pain, red eyes, or jaundice after flood exposure. Doxycycline is prescription-only; obtain care at a health center.

triage.headline_ja: イロコス地方でレプトスピラ症により6人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 毎年発生する季節性のレプトスピラ症で、症例数は前年より52%減少しており異常性は低いが、死亡例が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: DOHが洪水後のレプトスピラ症予防を呼びかけているが、症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向にあり、既知の季節性感染症として国内対応で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares Uganda Ebola-free after 42 days without new case
article.articleSummary: Uganda was declared Ebola-free on 28 August 2026 after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease cases, ending an outbreak that began 15 May 2026 and recorded 20 confirmed cases, 18 recoveries and 2 deaths. The last patient, an imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was discharged on 16 July; local transmission was interrupted on 28 July after 42 days without a locally acquired infection. More than 800 contacts were identified and monitored. Containment attributed to early detection, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, surveillance at facilities and entry points, and community engagement. Despite Uganda’s success, the neighboring DRC continues to report ongoing Bundibugyo virus transmission, underscoring continued regional surveillance and cross-border preparedness. The WHO and Africa CDC emphasized coordinated response and advised against broad travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ウガンダで新規感染例なく42日経過後にエボラ終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの流行は終息したが、隣国DRCで同ウイルス（ブンディブジョ株）の感染が継続中であり、国境を越えた再燃リスクが残るため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの終息宣言だが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれない。DRCでの継続的な感染拡大が明記されているためDRCのみを verified_locations に含めた。既知の流行の進展報告であり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、DRCの状況は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 高溫多雨加境外移入 國內登革熱風險升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Domestic dengue fever risk rising amid high temperatures, heavy rainfall, and imported cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk in Taiwan rises as Kaohsiung's Gangshan District reports a household dengue cluster. On August 27, 2026, Taiwan's CDC confirmed three dengue cases among a six-person family; all patients hospitalized with no overseas travel history, catalyzing expanded community testing around the home as health authorities monitor for additional cases. This marks the second domestic dengue cluster this year; the prior June outbreak at Kaohsiung's Minsheng Hospital involved an imported case triggering local transmission. Nationwide, Taiwan has 145 dengue cases so far this year: 10 locally acquired, all in Kaohsiung City, and 135 imported, mainly from Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Maldives. Authorities warn that persistent high temperatures and heavy rainfall, coupled with returning travelers and Southeast Asian students, heighten risk. Prevention hinges on eliminating breeding sites to reduce the vector density. Authorities also caution about leptospirosis and melioidosis following floods, advising protective gear and diluted bleach disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 高温多雨と海外からの移入が重なり、国内のデング熱リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・高雄でデング熱の家庭内クラスターが確認され、地域内感染のリスクが高まっているが、重症例や死亡は報告されておらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域として台湾（高雄）が主体であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は空。ベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入例の出身地として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Virusul Ebola face ravagii, iar ONU cere 1.1 miliarde de dolari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is wreaking havoc, and the UN is calling for $1.1 billion.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts a UN appeal for $1.1 billion to fund the humanitarian response plan as existing funds run dry. Declared May 15, the epidemic has affected six provinces and caused 2,744 deaths as of August 25. About 12 million people are in direct need of assistance amid rapid transmission. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warns that current resources would cover only a few weeks, urging full funding to scale up operations. The Bundibugyo strain dominates this outbreak; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment yet, though clinical trials continue. In a contingency measure, 70,000 doses of Ervebo (Zaire strain) have been delivered to the DRC to assess possible protection against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが猛威を振るい、国連が11億ドルの支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が6州に拡大し死者2,744人、1200万人が支援を必要とする深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、国連が大規模資金支援を要請するなど国際的関心・支援ニーズが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・特効薬が未確立のブンディブギョ株による大規模流行。Ervebo（ザイール株用）70,000回分が試験的に配布されているが有効性は未確認。既存資金枯渇が懸念され、緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Behind every case, a person': the man leading DRC's Ebola fight on the human cost hidden behind the numbers
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 5,656 confirmed cases and 2,715 deaths as of 24 August, the largest and deadliest outbreak since 1976 and the 17th in the DRC; outbreak first declared in May. Prof. Pierre Akilimali, head of the National Public Health Institute and incident manager for a multi-agency response, emphasizes that behind every case is a person and a family, while acknowledging cases may rise as community engagement improves and treatment centres adapt. Cross-border risk involves Uganda, which has recently declared itself Ebola-free after several border cases. The eastern DRC’s war-weary, distrustful context includes attacks on clinics, complicating response. The effort calls for regional and international solidarity, with concerns about funds channeled through NGOs and delayed wages; authorities insist responses must strengthen, not collapse, the broader health system and maintain access to care for other conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 「一件一件の裏に、一人の人間がいる」：数字の裏に隠された人的被害と向き合うDRCのエボラ対策責任者
triage.triage_reason: 1976年以来最大・最悪規模のエボラ流行（コンゴ民主共和国、5,656例・2,715死亡）であり、ウガンダへの越境リスクや治安不安による対応の困難さも報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事中で越境リスクとして言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウガンダは既にエボラ終息宣言済みと記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Pastikan Belum Ada Kasus Flu Singapura di Natuna: Warga Diminta Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office Confirms No Singapore Influenza Cases in Natuna: Residents Urged to Be Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), also known as Singapore Flu, is not reported in Natuna Regency, Riau Islands, as of August 28, 2026. Batam City records a high HFMD burden with 493 cases from January to August 13, 2026 across 23 health facilities. Natuna authorities stress no local HFMD cases yet but maintain heightened surveillance due to substantial cross‑border mobility via ports and airports linking Batam to the rest of the Riau Islands. HFMD is described as a viral illness that typically resolves on its own and is not considered highly dangerous. Preventive guidance emphasizes personal hygiene and adherence to PHBS (Clean and Healthy Living Behavior). The article highlights vigilance at border communities to curb spread while Batam experiences ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、ナトゥナでのシンガポール風邪（手足口病）の症例は未確認であると発表：住民に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ナトゥナでは症例未確認だが、バタム市では493例の手足口病（HFMD）が発生し人的移動を通じた拡散リスクが懸念されるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: HFMD（手足口病）は一般的に軽症で自然治癒する疾患とされ、バタム市での高い発生数はあるが、ナトゥナでは症例未確認。地域保健当局は港湾・空港経由の人的移動によるリスクを警戒しているが、深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola corre in Congo: oltre 2.700 morti, ora la sfida è trovare vaccini e cure in tempo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo: over 2,700 deaths, now the challenge is to find vaccines and cures in time.
article.articleSummary: More than 2,700 deaths from Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease have occurred in just over 100 days in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with WHO data as of 12 August showing 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths across 54 health zones in six provinces; by 24 August, no vaccines or treatments exist specifically for Bundibugyo. The outbreak’s management centers on rapid case finding, isolation, supportive care, and contact tracing. On 2 July, the PARTNERS trial (Oxford) launched to compare MBP134 monoclonal antibody, remdesivir, their combination, and standard care, aiming to enroll 1,200 patients—the fastest anti-Ebola randomized trial to date. A second trial, Ebo-PEP, tests post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir within five days of exposure. Three vaccine candidates (adenoviral vector, mRNA, and a platform similar to Ebola Zaire) are in development, while Ervebo is being tested for cross-protection, with about 70,000 doses mobilized (16,250 in Kinshasa). The episode highlights health-system fragility, conflict-related displacement, and the need for sustained surveillance and international cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急速に拡大：死者2,700人超、今はワクチンと治療法を時間内に見つけることが課題
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行により多数の死者・感染者が発生し、ワクチン・治療薬未確立、6州54保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラの大規模流行。既承認ワクチン・治療薬が本株には未確立であり、複数の臨床試験（PARTNERS試験、Ebo-PEP試験）が進行中。医療体制の脆弱性や紛争による人口移動も懸念事項として指摘されている。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान में अगस्त माह में स्वाइन फ्लू के 55 मामले सामने आए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Rajasthan, 55 swine flu cases were reported in August.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreaks in Rajasthan, India, saw 55 new laboratory-confirmed cases in August 2026, the highest monthly total this year. Since January 2026, Rajasthan has reported 146 H1N1 cases. Health Minister Gajendra Singh Khivnesar said authorities are monitoring the rising trend seen in other states, notably Delhi, and have instructed medical facilities to ensure preparedness. Gayatri Rathod, Chief Secretary of the Health Department, provided monthly counts: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 20, Apr 22, May 25, Jun 14, Jul 5, Aug 55. No evidence of a new or more virulent H1N1 strain; ICMR says the currently circulating virus remains active, and there is no need to panic. Swine flu is a respiratory infection; common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue. Most patients recover with proper care; higher risk for young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州で8月にスワイン・フル(H1N1)55例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: H1N1感染者数が季節的に増加しているが、ICMRは新規株ではなく通常の循環株と説明しており、パニックの必要はないとしている。他州（デリー）への拡大傾向はあるが、重症度や国際的拡大の明確な情報はなく、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: ラジャスタン州における季節性H1N1インフルエンザの月次増加報告。デリーなど他州でも増加傾向が見られるが、ICMRは既存株の循環であり新規株ではないと説明。重症例・死亡例の詳細情報は記事に含まれず、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 古特雷斯呼吁国际社会强化刚果（金）伊波拉疫情应对|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guterres urges the international community to strengthen the Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda are highlighted. In the DRC, as of Aug 25, 2026, there are 5,713 confirmed EVD cases and 2,744 deaths, with about 500 new cases weekly across a wide area; women and children are disproportionately affected. Secretary-General António Guterres urged faster international funding and action, noting the UN humanitarian and outbreak-response appeal of $2.13 billion is less than half funded and that attention and resources remain inadequate. The World Health Organization reports the current DRC outbreak remains highly active with no turning point yet. Separately, the WHO Africa Regional Office announced Uganda’s Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has ended: last treated patient discharged July 16, with 42 days of no new cases, meeting the standard for declaring cessation. Uganda’s outbreak began May 15, involving 20 cases (15 imported from DRC, 5 local) and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: グテーレス事務総長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行への対応強化を国際社会に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,713例・死亡2,744例、週500例増と大規模かつ拡大継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、国際的な資金・対応強化が求められている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国連事務総長による国際的関心の高さも確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダのエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）は42日間新規感染なしで終息宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCの流行は依然活発で拡大継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）启动伊波拉疫苗接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches Ebola vaccination.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo began Ervebo vaccination in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province in eastern DR Congo, on 2026-08-27 to address a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. Ervebo is approved to prevent Zaire ebolavirus, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains unclear, though early laboratory and animal data hint at possible protection. Vaccination targets frontline health workers and those in contact with Ebola patients under a compassionate-use framework, with data collection to assess real-world impact. The WHO-coordinated effort will allocate 70,000 doses: 20,000 for Phase 3 trials to evaluate protection against Bundibugyo virus and 50,000 for frontline personnel. DR Congo has reported 5,713 cases and 2,744 deaths (case fatality rate 48%) as of 2026-08-25, with 16,520 doses already received for this response; no specific vaccine or therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行（症例5,713件、死亡2,744件、致死率48%）が継続中であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ以上満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本件はすでにWHO協調下で大規模対応（ワクチン接種、フェーズ3試験）が進行中の既知の流行拡大事案であり、致死率48%と非常に深刻。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事内に明記されていないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄新增3起本土登革熱病例 一家六口同住已3人確診住院 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports three new locally transmitted dengue fever cases; three of a six-member household have been diagnosed and hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Three locally transmitted dengue fever cases reported in Kaohsiung’s Gangshan district within a six-member family; three of the household have been diagnosed and hospitalized, with no overseas travel history and exposure mainly near home. The index case is a man in his 60s who developed fever, myalgia, arthralgia and nausea on August 26; testing confirmed dengue fever, and two of the other five residents also tested positive; all three confirmed cases are dengue virus serotype 2 and currently hospitalized. Authorities expanded epidemiological investigations in the community and implemented urgent vector-control around the residence, including vector-density surveys, breeding-site removal, and health education. Nationwide 2026 dengue figures: 145 confirmed cases, 10 local (all in Kaohsiung) and 135 imported, primarily from Vietnam (28), Indonesia (27), and Maldives (16); total remains lower than 2025 (154).

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で新たに3件の本土感染デング熱例、一家6人中3人が発症・入院
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市での家族内デング熱クラスター（本土感染）は限定的規模で、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地はTaiwan（高雄市）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。ベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブは輸入例の出発国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: यूपी में स्वाइन फ्लू से पहली मौत, लखनऊ में महिला मरीज ने तोड़ा दम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First swine flu death in Uttar Pradesh; a woman patient dies in Lucknow.
article.articleSummary: First swine flu (H1N1 influenza) death this season reported in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. A 50-year-old woman from Indiranagar died at Balrampur Hospital after progressive respiratory distress. She had fever, cold and breathing difficulty, and swine flu was confirmed by a private pathology report on 24 August. She was admitted on 25 August; the family did not inform the hospital of the positive result at admission. Despite oxygen support, she died on 27 August around 2:30 PM. After death, the positive report came to light, prompting hospital precautions. Samples from 17 doctors and staff involved, and some patients, were sent to King George's Medical University (KGMU) for testing; isolation was advised for those exposed. Chief Medical Officer NB Singh said ELISA confirmation is needed. Health officials will trace contacts, monitor the family, and advise prompt testing if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: UP州で豚インフルエンザによる初の死亡、ラクノウで女性患者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる単発死亡例で、既知の疾患であり異常性は低い。医療従事者への接触者調査が進行中だが、拡大の兆候や社会的関心の高まりは確認できず、続報を注視するレベル。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）による地域内の単発死亡例。医療スタッフ17名の検体検査と接触者への隔離勧告が実施されているが、地域内で対応可能な規模であり、国際的な拡大リスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, cinquant'anni dopo: la storia di un'epidemia che si ripete
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, fifty years on: the story of an epidemic that repeats itself.
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 5,677 cases and 2,717 deaths as of 24 August 2026, the second-largest Ebola outbreak by case count and the largest in the DRC. A New England Journal of Medicine commentary uses half a century of foci to highlight persistent gaps in epidemic preparedness. It recalls 1976 dual outbreaks—in Yambuku, DRC (Zaire ebolavirus) and Nzara, Sudan (Sudan ebolavirus)—where a 44-year-old teacher sparked nosocomial transmission, yielding 318 cases and 280 deaths (88% CFR). The piece contrasts with the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak (>28,000 cases, >11,000 deaths) and exports to the US and Italy, which prompted WHO to declare a PHEIC in August 2014. The authors stress frontline health workers and communities, and note legacies such as Africa CDC (2017).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、50年後：繰り返される流行の歴史
triage.triage_reason: 現在DRCとウガンダで進行中のエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）が5,677例・2,717死亡に達し、DRC史上最大規模かつ史上2番目の規模の流行となっており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はNEJMの解説記事で、現在進行中のDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行（5,677例、2,717死亡、CFR高い）について歴史的文脈から論じている。ウガンダも発生国だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの史上最大規模の流行であり、既に大きな公衆衛生危機として認識されているためフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Vaccination: बढ़ते खतरे के बीच वैक्सीन क्यों है जरूरी? जानें इसके फायदे और बचाव के तरीके swine flu vaccination why is the vaccine essential amidst the rising threat discover its benefits and preventiv
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Vaccination: Why is the vaccine essential amidst the rising threat? Learn its benefits and preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu cases are rising in Delhi and several other states as of 28 August 2026. Symptoms include high fever, cough, cold, sore throat, and sometimes breathing difficulties. To curb spread, vaccination with the Seasonal Influenza Vaccine (Moderna Quadrivalent Flu Shot) is recommended; vaccines are updated yearly to cover circulating strains and swine flu. The vaccine is suitable for individuals aged six months and older, though those with serious health conditions should consult a doctor first. Immunity typically develops about two weeks after vaccination, reducing the risk of severe illness and hospitalization. High‑risk groups—young children, pregnant women, the elderly, and people with diabetes, heart, or lung disease—should especially prioritize vaccination. In private hospitals, vaccine prices range from a few hundred to roughly 1,000–2,000 INR per dose.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザワクチン接種：拡大する脅威の中でワクチンが必要な理由とは？その効果と予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: デリー周辺で季節性の豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）症例が増加しているとの記述はあるが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・重症度データがなく、内容はワクチン接種を推奨する一般的な健康情報記事にとどまる。毎年繰り返される季節性インフルエンザの範疇であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ/豚インフルエンザワクチン接種を促す健康アドバイス記事であり、具体的な症例数や重症度データが記載されていないため、感染症危機シグナルとしての緊急性は低いと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: DRC begins vaccinating front-line healthcare workers against Ebola
article.articleSummary: DRC began vaccinating front-line health workers against Ebola, prioritizing this group; the first injections were given in Kisangani. The vaccine distributed this week—Ervebo, licensed for a different Ebola strain—has not established effectiveness against Bundibugyo. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo, and clinical trials are underway. More than 50,000 doses have been received. WHO-approved 70,000 Ervebo doses are allocated to the DRC, with about 20,000 set aside for a clinical trial to test effectiveness against the latest strain. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri province near the Uganda border, with ring vaccination expanding outward. As of Tuesday, 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths have been reported. It is the DRC’s deadliest Ebola outbreak, unfolding under insecurity, displacement, a health workers' strike, and heavy population movements; WHO says it is out of control and may surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、最前線の医療従事者へエボラワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（5,713例・2,744死亡）で、WHOが制御不能と表明し2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性を指摘している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、既存のErvebo（別株用）の有効性は未確立。ウガンダ国境近接のイトゥリ州が中心だが、ウガンダ・アンゴラは記事上で発生国として明示されていないため対象国から除外した。治安不安・住民避難・医療従事者のストライキ等が流行拡大要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận 2.020 trường hợp mắc sốt xuất huyết tại 115 phường, xã
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records 2,020 dengue fever cases in 115 wards and communes.
article.articleSummary: As of 28 August 2026, Hanoi has recorded 2,020 dengue fever cases across 115 of 126 wards/communes, with no fatalities. The outbreak is entering a seasonal uptrend, with 83 clusters and 26 active, including hotspots in Hong Van and Dan Hoa; authorities are applying standard outbreak-control measures. Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease totals 4,715 cases (126 wards), with one active outbreak and no deaths. Measles: 388 cases (110 wards); Pertussis: 101 cases (55 wards). COVID-19: 1,542 cases (120 wards). Adenovirus infections rose in summer, with 536 cases since 1 July 2026 (101 wards), no deaths. Ebola, Nipah, Mpox not detected. Public health actions emphasize environmental hygiene, mosquito control (eliminate standing water), vaccination, mask use with respiratory symptoms, and vigilance as students return to school. Dengue peak week (Aug 7–14): 316 cases in 74 wards, 11 new outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ市、115の坊・社でデング熱2,020例を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は季節性の増加傾向にあり死亡例はないが、流行地域の広がり（126坊・社中115）とクラスター発生があり継続的な監視が必要。IHR基準は明確に該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性流行の一環であり、死亡例なし・当局が標準的な対策を実施中。他の疾患（手足口病、麻疹、百日咳、COVID-19、アデノウイルス）も併記されているが、いずれも重篤性や異常性を示す情報はない。エボラ・ニパ・Mpoxは検出なしと明記。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola ​‌⁠​‍⁠‍⁠⁠‌‍​​⁠​‍​‍‌​kills 2,700 In DRC As UN Chief Seeks $1.1bn - News Agency Of Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused at least 2,700 deaths, with about 500 new cases weekly. UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged expansion of funding, seeking $1.1 billion as humanitarian operations remain 48% funded and could run out. WHO interventions slowed transmission but have not reversed the trend amid insecurity, displacement, and weak health systems. In Ituri Province, displacement has surged, complicating surveillance, tracing, and treatment; more than 40 healthcare workers have been killed and facilities attacked. Responders have deployed 35 safe burial teams, 286 community-based teams, and 2,500 volunteers; over 260 experts and 330 tonnes of medical and logistical supplies have been sent. WFP supports frontline operations; IOM screened over one million people and launched an 11-country cross-border preparedness plan. Burundi has no confirmed case, while Uganda has declared the Bundibugyo outbreak over after 42 days, with 20 infections and two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRCで2,700人死亡 国連事務総長が11億ドルの資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者2,700人、週500人の新規感染という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、治安悪化・人口移動により国際的拡大リスクも存在するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは同種アウトブレイクを42日間新規感染なしで終息宣言済み、ブルンジは確定例なし。両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bitten by Dog, Began Barking Months Later: How 15-Year-Old Mirzapur Boy Defied Final-Stage Rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh: 15-year-old Karan contracted rabies from a dog bite on December 8, 2025, after missing timely anti-rabies vaccination. Four months later, around March 13–14, 2026, he collapsed and began barking and could not drink water; doctors described hydrophobia and final-stage rabies. He was treated first at local facilities and then at BHU and other hospitals, where officials reportedly advised isolation and warned of death within days. A retired Harhua health worker arranged vaccination; Karan received five rabies vaccines over about 22 days, followed by two more doses about a week apart a month later. He subsequently recovered fully and returned to class 9. The case is described as the first reported Uttar Pradesh recovery from the final stage of rabies, with rapid improvement noted within 24 hours of injection and ongoing full recovery.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に噛まれた少年、数ヵ月後に吠え始める：ミルザプルの15歳少年はいかにして狂犬病の最終段階を乗り越えたか
triage.triage_reason: 個別の狂犬病患者1名の生存に関する human interest 記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な疫学的パターンを示すものではない。狂犬病はインドで固有流行しており、公衆衛生上の新たなシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一患者の生存例を報じる医療human interestストーリーであり、アウトブレイクやクラスターの報告ではない。狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染しないため流行しやすさの観点でも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: US gives Uganda drugs for Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: United States donates monoclonal antibody MBP134 to Uganda to bolster Ebola preparedness as the Democratic Republic of Congo's Bundibugyo outbreak continues. Uganda has no active cases, but cross-border movement from DRC, with more than 4,500 confirmed cases and over 2,000 deaths as of mid-August 2026, raises risk. MBP134, developed by Mapp Biopharmaceutical with BARDA support, neutralizes Ebola virus particles and shows activity against Bundibugyo in pre-clinical studies. The treatment is not commercially available and would be used under compassionate-use arrangements, enabling rapid deployment of countermeasures if Ebola is imported. Donation was handed to Uganda's Ministry of Health at National Medical Stores; Uganda recently declared the end of its 2026 outbreak (20 cases, 18 recoveries, 2 deaths). U.S. has pledged over $619 million for Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ対策のためウガンダに治療薬を提供

triage.notes: 米国とウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのブンディブジョ株エボラ流行が主題であり、これが実際の発生地域として確認された。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान: स्वाइन फ्लू के 146 मामले; ICU में मंत्री किरोड़ी लाल मीणा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan: 146 Swine Flu cases; Minister Kirori Lal Meena in the ICU.
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reported 55 swine flu (H1N1) cases in August—the highest monthly total this year—with cumulative cases reaching 146 since January 2026. In a high-profile development, Agriculture Department Cabinet Minister Dr. Kirori Lal Meena is also infected and has been in intensive care for several days. Authorities say there is no evidence of a new or more virulent H1N1 strain, and the current virus remains active, requiring vigilance but not panic. Health officials note the monthly breakdown: January 2, February 3, March 20, April 22, May 25, June 14, July 5, and August 55. The Indian Council of Medical Research confirms ongoing circulation of the same strain. Typical swine flu symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue; higher risk in children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities. Preventive care and timely medical consultation are advised.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1ではあるが、8月の症例数が今年最多となり閣僚がICUに入院するなど社会的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: ICMRは既存株の継続的流行であり新規変異株の証拠はないとしているが、閣僚の感染・ICU入院により政治的・社会的関心が高まっている点が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda receives WHO recognition for Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Uganda was recognized by WHO for successfully interrupting Ebola transmission of Bundibugyo virus and completing 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases. The outbreak in Uganda involved 20 confirmed cases, with 18 recoveries and 2 deaths (case fatality rate 10%). Discharges began with the last patient on June 16 and the outbreak was declared finished on July 28. Fifteen cases were imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, while five Ugandan nationals contracted the virus while caring for imported cases. The recognition was presented to Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi by WHO Africa Regional Director Dr Mohamed Yakub Janabi. Ongoing cross-border monitoring with DRC continues, and Uganda urges lifting of travel restrictions by several countries. Lessons will inform preparedness against future public health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ対応でWHOから表彰を受ける
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）アウトブレイクは終息宣言済みだが、感染源であるDRCとの国境を越えた監視が継続しており、渡航制限の解除要請もあるため、今後の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのアウトブレイクは7月28日に終息宣言され、20例（回復18・死亡2）で終了。感染源となったDRCとの国境監視は継続中であり、DRC側の現状（新規感染の有無）については記事内に明確な情報がないため『不明』とした。

article.articleHeadline: Έρχεται ράπιντ τεστ για τον Ιό του Δυτικού Νείλου - Αποτέλεσμα σε λιγότερο από ώρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid test for West Nile virus coming — results in under an hour.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus outbreak persists in Greece, with 75 new cases and 6 deaths reported in the past week by EODY, including a 13-year-old hospitalized patient. The virus has appeared in 35 municipalities in the Attica region. Researchers from the Medical School of the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens (EKPA) are developing a nanotechnology-based rapid diagnostic test that uses one drop of blood and aims to yield results in under one hour. The project, started in winter, seeks to differentiate West Nile virus from other mosquito-borne viruses; clinical studies are planned. If successful, results are expected within about two years, with market release around 36 months. International partners include Italy, Spain, Estonia, the Netherlands, and Brazil, alongside Greece.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルスの迅速検査が登場へ―1時間未満で結果判明
triage.triage_reason: ギリシャでの西ナイルウイルス流行に関する内容だが、対象国リストに該当する国が発生地ではなく、迅速診断技術開発の話題が中心であるため、対象国に関するシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 感染発生国はギリシャ（対象国リスト外）。ブラジル・イタリア・スペイン・エストニア・オランダは診断技術開発の国際共同研究パートナーとして記載されているのみで、感染発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ONU reforça vigilância contra ebola no Burundi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN strengthens surveillance against Ebola in Burundi.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in neighboring DR Congo and Uganda prompts strengthened surveillance in Burundi, which has no confirmed cases. The Ituri province outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine exists, with WHO reporting over 5,600 cases and about 2,700 deaths in the region as of the latest update. To prevent entry and spread, UN/OCHA enhanced health surveillance at strategic border points, and since late June more than 75,000 travelers have undergone health screenings with thermal scanners, including at Bujumbura International Airport. UN teams train health professionals (nurses and community health workers) and equip journalists to cover health emergencies; about 30,000 posters in Kirundi, Swahili, and French have been distributed. WHO supports Burundi in prevention and laboratory procedures. Emergency funding: CERF released $2 million via UN Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher, as part of a broader $24 million for rapid containment near high-risk borders.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、ブルンジでのエボラ出血熱対策の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC（イツリ州）で5,600例超・死者約2,700人に及ぶワクチンなしのブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス流行が継続中であり、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC（イツリ州）で発生中のエボラ流行とその周辺国（ブルンジ、ウガンダ）への警戒強化。ブルンジは確定患者なし、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: जब उतरने लगे बच्चों का डेंगू बुखार, जानिए क्यों इस वक्त बढ़ता है खतरे का ग्राफ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When dengue fever among children began to fall, find out why the risk graph is rising now.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in children poses its greatest danger after fever begins to fall, during a critical 24–48 hour phase when recovery is most delicate. Observed during the rainy season, which brings higher dengue risk, parents may prematurely lower guard as the fever subsides. Dr. Neha Rastogi, Senior Consultant in Infectious Diseases at Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram, explains this period can be marked by fluid leakage, falling blood pressure, and compromised blood flow rather than by fever alone. During recovery, monitor hydration, urine output, activity level, and symptoms such as persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, nose or gum bleeding, breathing difficulty, or skin that is very cold or pale, or fainting. Platelet count alone should not guide decisions; doctors consider symptoms, blood pressure, hematocrit, urine, and other tests. Do not give platelet-raising drugs or analgesics without medical advice. Ensure rest, fluids, nutrition, and follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 子どものデング熱、熱が下がり始めた時こそ危険レベルが高まる理由とは？

article.articleHeadline: मुंबईकरांनो, 'स्वाईन फ्लू' बळावतोय; रुग्णसंख्येत होतेय झपाट्याने वाढ, तीन महिन्यांत ३०९ रुग्णांची नोंद
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbaikars, Swine Flu is on the rise; the number of cases is increasing rapidly, with 309 cases reported in three months.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (Influenza A, H1N1) cases are rising in Mumbai, mirroring trends in other major Indian metros, with 309 cases reported from June to August. The Indian Medical Association (IMA) says the situation is not alarming and urges vigilance, while not promoting panic. Under the supervision of the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), the circulating virus is seasonal Influenza A (H1N1) with no new genetic changes detected. Most infections are mild and self-limiting. Common symptoms include sudden high fever, chills, persistent dry cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue, headache, and nasal congestion; children may experience nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Antibiotics are not effective against a viral influenza; avoid azithromycin, amoxicillin-clavulanate, or cefixime without a doctor’s advice. Seek urgent care for severe signs such as breathing difficulty, chest pain, blue lips/fingers, confusion, seizures, or persistent vomiting. In children, refusal to feed, extreme sleepiness, or marked labored breathing are warning signs.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ市民の皆さん、'豚インフルエンザ'が拡大中；患者数が急増、3か月間で309人の患者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)で遺伝子変異なし、症状は軽症・自己限定的とIMA/ICMRが評価しており、パニックを煽らないよう呼びかけている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加であり、新規変異や異常な重症化は報告されていない。IMAは警戒を呼びかけつつも「alarming ではない」と明言している。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Launches Ebola Vaccination Drive Amid Ongoing Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths, the deadliest in the nation's history, centered in Ituri province near Uganda. Vaccination began this week targeting frontline health workers in Kisangani, with over 50,000 vaccine doses received. The stock is licensed for a different Ebola strain, while the circulating strain is Bundibugyo, and trials are underway to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo; about 20,000 of 70,000 doses from WHO will be used in these trials. First vaccinations administered in Kisangani; expansion to surrounding provinces ring-like toward the outbreak center. Challenges include insecurity, population displacement, health worker strike, and widespread movements. The WHO warns outbreak remains out of control and could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa scale; there is no approved treatment or preventive for Bundibugyo yet. Health workers request more vaccine doses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、進行中のエボラ流行の中でワクチン接種活動を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（5,713例、死亡2,744人）が継続し、WHOが制御不能と警告。国境地域での拡大リスク、承認薬剤なしの新規流行株（Bundibugyo）という異常性から、IHR基準3項目・WPRO基準5項目に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 流行株Bundibugyoに対する承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、既存ワクチンの効果検証段階。ウガンダ国境付近での発生であり越境拡大リスクがあるが、ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安悪化・住民移動・医療従事者ストライキ等の管理上の課題も報告されている。
