article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand Swine Flu: झारखंड में H1N1 का बढ़ता खतरा, 10 दिन में 24 संक्रमित, RIMS के डॉक्टर भी चपेट में
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jharkhand Swine Flu: Rising threat of H1N1 in Jharkhand, 24 infected in 10 days, doctors at RIMS also affected.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 Swine Flu cases are rising in Jharkhand, with 24 infections confirmed in 10 days. In Ranchi, 11 suspected samples tested at the Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) Microbiology Dept yielded 8 positives; the department head, Dr. Ashok Kumar Sharma, is among the infected. In private labs, Micro Praxis Lab confirmed 16 cases in the same 10-day window, and other major private labs report 1–2 new cases daily, bringing the total to 24. Most patients had recently returned from other cities or states and developed fever, sore throat, cold, and cough. Health authorities have issued alerts; all district civil surgeons are instructed to monitor suspected cases. ICMR advises precautions. Transmission is via droplets from coughing or sneezing; recommendations include avoiding crowds, wearing masks when needed, and practicing hand hygiene. Seek care for high fever, severe throat pain, or breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州のスワインフル（H1N1）:感染拡大の脅威、10日間で24人感染、RIMSの医師も感染
triage.triage_reason: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ病原体であり異常性は低いが、医療従事者への感染拡大やヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、地域内（ジャールカンド州ランチ）での感染例増加と医療従事者への感染が報告されているが、重症度や死亡例の情報はなく、国際的な影響は限定的と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: UP Reports First Swine Flu Death Of Season As 50-Year-Old Woman Dies In Lucknow
article.articleSummary: Lucknow reports its first swine flu death of the season after a 50-year-old Indiranagar resident died at Balrampur Hospital. The woman developed cold, fever and breathing difficulties; a private laboratory confirmed swine influenza in a report dated August 24, and she was admitted to Balrampur on August 25. Her condition worsened, requiring oxygen support, and she died around 2:30 pm on Thursday. Only after death did relatives show doctors a swine flu–positive report on a mobile phone. Health authorities collected samples from 17 doctors and staff who treated her and sent them to King George’s Medical University for testing; isolation advised for staff and some patients. Officials are verifying the diagnostic test (ELISA confirmation) and conducting contact tracing to map places visited and people exposed. Family members are in isolation with medicines; testing and monitoring continue.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタルプラデーシュ州でシーズン初の豚インフルエンザ死亡例、ラクナウで50歳女性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）による単発死亡例であり、地域内での通常の医療対応（接触者調査・隔離）が行われている段階。異常性・国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、重症化（死亡）事例であるため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）による単発死亡例。地域保健当局が接触者17名の検体採取・隔離措置・KGMUでの確認検査を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Comenzó la vacunación contra la cepa mortal de ébola en República del Congo que dejó 2.744 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination against the deadly Ebola strain began in the Republic of the Congo, which left 2,744 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo launched a vaccination campaign against the current Ebola outbreak—the largest in the country’s history—prioritizing frontline health workers with the Ervebo vaccine. Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, hosted the launch as the outbreak reaches 5,713 cases and 2,744 deaths, with Ituri as the epicenter. The outbreak spans Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, and South Kivu, though South Kivu has had no new cases in over 80 days. Authorities have received over 50,000 Ervebo doses for frontline staff, plus 20,000 doses for clinical trials to test efficacy against Bundibugyo under a compassionate-use program. Contact tracing is 84.6% (below the 85% target); 1,269 recoveries and 770 people are in isolation or Ebola treatment centers. The WHO cautions the outbreak could exceed the West Africa 2014–2016 toll, with more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で致死性エボラ株に対するワクチン接種開始、死者2,744人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、5,713例・死者2,744人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHOも西アフリカ2014-2016年規模を超える可能性を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事見出しは誤って『Republic of the Congo』と記載しているが、本文・データ（Ituri, Tshopo, Kisangani等）はDRC(コンゴ民主共和国)の流行を指しており、DRCとして扱う。接触者追跡率が目標未達（84.6%<85%）で流行継続リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: خبرگزاری آریا - نیمی از افراد مبتلا به ابولا در کنگو جان باخته اند
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ariya News Agency - Half of those infected with Ebola in Congo have died.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola has killed 2,744 people out of 5,713 confirmed infections as of 28 August 2026. Response operations continue across six provinces and 58 health zones, with about 770 patients in isolation or hospitalized and ongoing surveillance for suspected cases. The country’s latest Ebola outbreak began in April 2026, marking the seventeenth outbreak in Congo since 1976. Ebola is a viral disease causing high fever, internal bleeding and organ failure, transmitted mainly via direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person, and is associated with a high case-fatality rate. All focal points remain engaged in containment and monitoring as counts are updated.

triage.headline_ja: アリアニュース通信 - コンゴでエボラに感染した人の半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（感染5,713人、死亡2,744人、致死率約48%）が6州58保健区に拡大し、隔離・入院患者も多数で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染の継続的リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 2026年4月に始まったコンゴ民主共和国での第17次エボラ流行。致死率が高く、複数州にわたる大規模な対応活動が継続中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事内に明示的情報がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Why India needs to look beyond typhoid to address the health burden of Salmonella infections
article.articleSummary: India faces a dual Salmonella burden: typhoid (S. Typhi) and non-typhoidal Salmonella (NTS). A Lancet study (2023 data) estimates 4.9 million typhoid cases and about 7,850 deaths in India, with ~730,000 hospitalisations and fluoroquinolone resistance in 82% of those cases. Typhoid spreads via contaminated food and water; NTS causes gastroenteritis but can invade the bloodstream in children, the elderly, and immunocompromised. Outbreaks include an eggs-linked Salmonella outbreak sickening 98 people since November, reflecting a broader contamination chain from farms to kitchens. A One Health perspective is needed: safe water, sanitation, hygiene, and robust food safety in the informal sector. Antimicrobial resistance is rising: fluoroquinolone resistance among S. Typhi reached ~85% in 2015–19; ceftriaxone resistance observed in Thane (2025) outbreak (44/167). Carbapenem-resistant S. Typhi with blaNDM-5 reported. Blood culture remains the main diagnostic before antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: インドがサルモネラ感染症の健康負担に対処するには腸チフス以外にも目を向ける必要がある理由
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクではなく、既存の腸チフス・非チフス性サルモネラ感染症の疫学的負担と薬剤耐性（AMR）拡大に関する解説記事。急性の公衆衛生イベントとしての緊急性は低いが、フルオロキノロン耐性やカルバペネム耐性菌の出現など耐性トレンドは継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の急性アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、腸チフス・NTS感染症の疫学的負担とAMR（フルオロキノロン耐性85%、セフトリアキソン耐性、blaNDM-5カルバペネム耐性）の増加傾向に関する解説・分析記事。ただしAMRの進行は公衆衛生上重要な継続監視事項。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تطلق نداء عاجلاً لتوفير 1.1 مليار دولار لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations launches an urgent appeal to provide $1.1 billion to confront an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: The United Nations launches an urgent appeal for $1.1 billion to confront the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, warning that indifference could worsen the crisis. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said the current Congo Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing in history and is expanding beyond the system’s capacity to contain, though stopping transmission remains possible. The response plan costs $2.13 billion, with more than $80 million already allocated to UN partners. The United States has contributed a major share, funding 48% of the plan, but authorities warn that existing resources will run out within weeks without additional funding as expansion is required. The Ebola crisis is described as a humanitarian catastrophe affecting families and communities in one of the most fragile health environments, underscoring the need for sustained international attention and resources to save lives and halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行対応のため11億ドルの緊急支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で「史上最速の拡大」とされるエボラ出血熱流行が発生し、封じ込め能力を超えて拡大しており、国連が11億ドルの緊急資金要請を行うなど重大な公衆衛生上の懸念と国際的関心が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 米国は資金提供国として言及されているが疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。エボラ流行の具体的な感染者数・死亡者数の記載はないが、国連事務総長が『史上最速の拡大』と表現し、既存資源が数週間で枯渇する危機的状況にあると警告している。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 फ्लू के 3-4 दिन बाद फिर से चढ़ने लगा तेज बुखार? डॉक्टर से समझें यह किस खतरे का है संकेत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 flu: After 3-4 days, the fever started rising again? Learn from a doctor what danger this signals.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza in India often presents a severe first 3–4 days with high fever, body aches, throat irritation, and fatigue; most patients improve within 3–7 days. However, a sudden fever rebound after 3–4 days, worsening cough with heavy sputum, or new shortness of breath may signal secondary bacterial pneumonia, a major WHO-recognized complication. High-risk individuals include the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and patients with diabetes, asthma, heart disease, or weakened immunity. Do not self-medicate with antibiotics, since viral flu does not respond to antibiotics; antibiotics should be used only after a clinician confirms bacterial infection via exam, chest X-ray, or blood tests. Seek urgent care for signs of labored breathing, chest pressure or pain, confusion, very low urine output, or fever returning with chills. After fever subsides, monitor for 4–5 days to prevent progression and protect recovery.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1インフルエンザ:3〜4日後に再び発熱が上昇？医師が解説するその危険信号とは
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではなく、H1N1感染後の二次感染（細菌性肺炎）への注意を促す一般的な医療情報記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、H1N1罹患後のセルフケア・受診タイミングに関する健康啓発記事。具体的な患者数・地域・流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: High leptospirosis cases among children 'alarming' -- Manila hospital doctor
article.articleSummary: Manila's Ospital ng Maynila Medical Center reports a leptospirosis surge with nine pediatric and eleven adult cases in the emergency department as of Thursday evening, prompting conversion of vacant upstairs rooms into dedicated leptospirosis wards. Hospital director Dr. Reynaldo Salinel Jr. and Manila Mayor Isko Moreno redirected resources amid overwhelmed facilities, with a surge linked to flooding around August 17 and expectations of more arrivals due to ongoing heavy rains. Symptoms include fever, headache, and muscle pain; progression to Weil's disease can involve the lungs, brain, kidneys, and liver. Medicines are restocked; staffing will be augmented with job-order personnel for information dissemination. Public guidance emphasizes avoiding floodwaters, boiling drinking water, wearing boots, maintaining hygiene, and flu vaccination to reduce illness risk.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の小児患者増加は「憂慮すべき」――マニラの病院医師
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の季節性レプトスピラ症の増加であり、既知のパターンだが病院の対応能力を超える患者数となっており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 洪水を契機とした季節性のレプトスピラ症の増加であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。マニラ市長・病院が対応中で、地域内での管理可能な状況とみられるが、大雨継続によりさらなる患者増加の可能性がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: क्या कोरोना की तरह देशभर में फैल सकता है स्वाइन फ्लू? क्या कहते हैं डॉक्टर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can swine flu spread across the country like the coronavirus? What do doctors say.
article.articleSummary: Delhi, India, reports rising H1N1 influenza cases. As of Aug 28, 2026, 24-hour tallies show 166 new H1N1 cases, bringing the total to 2,612, with Influenza A cases included to push overall counts to about 3,300. Authorities emphasize no need for panic; healthcare facilities—doctors, nurses, lab technicians, medicines, oxygen, beds, and testing—are prepared. Dr. Vinay Bhatt of Yashoda Hospital notes H1N1 is an influenza virus that spreads easily between people, especially in crowded or enclosed spaces, leading to local spikes. High-risk groups include the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and those with asthma, COPD, or other serious conditions, who face higher risk of pneumonia. Warning signs include persistent fever, worsening cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, or falling oxygen saturation. Vaccination helps reduce severity, and preventive steps include staying home when sick, covering coughs/sneezes, and hand hygiene, with extra caution around vulnerable individuals.

triage.headline_ja: コロナのように豚インフルエンザは全国に広がる可能性があるのか？医師の見解は
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）症例が増加しているが、当局は医療体制整備済みで「パニックの必要なし」と発表しており、季節性の通常範囲内の増加とみられる。ヒト-ヒト感染拡大の可能性はあるため継続的な動向注視が望ましい。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザであり、記事も『パニック不要』との医師・当局の見解を伝える内容。症例数（24時間で166例、累計2612例、インフルエンザA全体で約3300例）は増加傾向だが、重症度や国際拡大に関する具体的懸念は記載なし。季節性の推移として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: สสจ.โคราชสถานการณ์โควิด ป่วย 1,216 ราย เสียชีวิต 3 ราย อำเภอเมืองระบาดสูงสุด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Public Health Office COVID-19 Situation: 1,216 cases, 3 deaths; Mueang District has the highest outbreak.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand: As of Aug 25, 2026, 1,216 cumulative cases and 3 deaths since Jan 1. Outbreak intensified during the rainy season with 274 cases in July and 807 in August (66.3% of yearly total). Muang Nakhon Ratchasima District leads with 631 cases, followed by Pak Chong (89) and Chum Phuang (48). High-risk groups include day laborers/construction workers (26.5%) and students (10.6%). Apparent higher fatalities in Phra Thong Kham, Kham Thale So, and Pak Chong are attributed to small case counts, not a more virulent variant. Four measures: (1) targeted surveillance and proactive screening in dense economic zones and crowded communities (Muang and Pak Chong); (2) stringent screening and immediate isolation in workplaces and schools; (3) protection of the vulnerable 70+ via village health volunteers and subdistrict health centers with hospital referral; (4) reinforced infection control in healthcare facilities. Public urged to maintain hygiene, wear masks in crowded areas, wash hands, and use ATK tests when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: ナコンラチャシマ県保健事務所、新型コロナウイルス感染症の状況：患者1,216人、死者3人、ムアン郡で最も感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患（COVID-19）による通常の季節的増加であり、変異株の兆候もなく、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の懸念も見られない定例的な地方公衆衛生報告。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による定例のCOVID-19統計報告。死亡率の増加は小規模なケース数によるものと説明されており、変異株の懸念は否定されている。国内対応措置のみで対処可能とされている。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية تبدأ حملة تطعيم ضد إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo begins an Ebola vaccination campaign - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo launched an Ebola vaccination campaign on Thursday in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, to slow the deadliest outbreak the country has recorded. Frontline health workers and others in contact with patients are prioritized for Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) vaccination, per the health ministry. The outbreak has spread across six eastern provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele and Bas-Uele—with 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths (roughly a 48% case-fatality rate). The epidemic continues amid insecurity, displacement, health worker strikes, and large population movements. WHO says the outbreak remains out of control and could surpass the West Africa 2014–2016 crisis. More than 50,000 vaccine doses have arrived; 70,000 doses have been approved for use, including 50,000 for frontline/healthcare workers and 20,000 for a clinical trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始 - シュルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行が拡大し、致死率約48%、6州に拡大、WHOが「制御不能」と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは本流行が2014-2016年の西アフリカ危機を超える可能性があると警告。治安不安、住民移動、医療従事者のストライキ等が対応を困難にしている。ワクチン（Ervebo）配布と臨床試験（Bundibugyoエボラウイルスに対する）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: โคราชโควิดระบาดพุ่ง! พบป่วยสะสม 1,216 ราย ดับแล้ว 3 สสจ.ย้ำยังต่ำกว่าค่ามัธยฐาน 5 ปี พร้อมสั่งยกระดับ 4 มาตรการคุมเข้ม
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Korat COVID outbreak surges! Cumulative cases reach 1,216 with 3 deaths; Provincial Public Health Office says it remains below the five-year median and orders four stricter control measures.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 outbreak in Nakhon Ratchasima Province (Korat), Thailand: cumulative 1,216 cases and 3 deaths from Jan 1 to Aug 25, 2026. August accounted for 807 cases (66.3% of the year), with July 274; the annual total remains below the five-year median. District distribution shows Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima leading with 631 cases, followed by Pak Chong (89) and Chum Phuang (48). High-risk occupations include laborers (26.5%) and students (10.6%). Four measures were approved: (1) targeted disease control with proactive screening in dense, crowded areas (notably Mueang and Pak Chong); (2) screening of workers and students with immediate isolation of positives; (3) protection of vulnerable groups by assigning community health volunteers and primary health care centers to monitor and refer elderly 70+ for hospitalization; (4) strengthened infection control in health facilities. Public health guidance urges masking in crowds, frequent handwashing, and ATK testing for fever-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: コラート県でCOVID感染拡大！累積患者1,216人、死亡3人。県衛生局は5年間の中央値より依然低いと強調しつつ4つの強化対策を指示
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患(COVID-19)であり、症例数は過去5年の中央値以下と当局が説明しており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。既に対策が実施され管理可能な状況。
triage.notes: 地方の季節的なCOVID-19流行報告であり、当局は例年の範囲内と評価している。既に4つの対策を実施済みで自国内で管理可能。

article.articleHeadline: Majmunske boginje (mpox) ponovno se šire: Virus se pojavio u novim zemljama, može li se epidemija zaustaviti?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox (mpox) is spreading again: The virus has appeared in new countries. Can the outbreak be stopped?
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is resurfacing globally, with Guinea-Bissau reporting its first cases, signaling spread to new countries. Since 2022, nearly 190,000 lab-confirmed mpox infections have been reported in 145 countries. The illness begins with flu-like symptoms (fever, chills, muscle pains) and then a vesicular rash that crusts. Mpox is endemic in parts of Africa and has spread beyond, driven by two clades: Congo Basin (Clade I) and West African (Clade II); West African spurred the 2022 outbreak, while a newer Clade I was detected in DR Congo in 2024. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern in Aug 2024 and lifted it in Sept 2025 as cases declined. UNICEF reports 46 suspected cases in Guinea-Bissau, including 23 children under 15, with higher risk for severe disease in young children. Vaccines exist for exposed or high-risk individuals, but supplies remain concentrated in high-income countries.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘（Mpox）が再拡大：ウイルスが新たな国々で確認、流行は止められるか？
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxが新規国（ギニアビサウ）へ拡大し、DRCではクレードIによる継続的な発生があり、WHOがPHEICを宣言した経緯を持つ。国際的拡大・重症化リスク・ワクチン供給の不均衡など複数の懸念事項が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は主にギニアビサウでの新規発生だが、ギニアビサウは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCはクレードIの継続的な発生源として明確に言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan Sees 2026's Highest Monthly H1N1 Surge With 55 Cases In August, Tally At 146
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports 55 H1N1 (swine flu) cases in August 2026, bringing cumulative total to 146 since January. Monthly counts: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 20, Apr 22, May 25, Jun 14, Jul 5, Aug 55. Health Minister Gajendra Singh Khimsar and Principal Secretary Gayatri Rathore say no confirmation of a new or more virulent H1N1 strain; ICMR notes the circulating virus is active and urges no public panic. Authorities have directed medical institutions to prepare for rising cases amid a broader uptick in some states, particularly Delhi. H1N1 is a respiratory infection; common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body ache, and fatigue. Most patients recover with proper care, though young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with serious illnesses are at higher risk of complications.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州、2026年最高の月間H1N1急増：8月に55件、累計146件
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（既知株）だが2026年最多の月間増加を記録し、当局が医療機関に症例増加への備えを指示するなど行政的関心が高まっているため、フルRRAでの経過確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 新規または高病原性株の確認はなく、ICMRはパニック不要と発表。ただし季節性増加が例年より急激であり、デリー等他州でも増加傾向がみられるため継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: New Dengue Antibody Cuts Viral Load in Indian Phase II Trial
article.articleSummary: Phase II trial of Dengue-mAb, a single-dose monoclonal antibody, conducted at 12 hospitals in India, shows rapid reduction in dengue viremia and faster fever clearance in adults aged 18–60 with fever onset within 48 hours. In 250 randomized participants (249 analyzed), dosing at 3,5,7, or 9 mg/kg IV vs placebo. At 24 hours, adjusted mean log reduction in viremia ranged 0.77–1.21 logs compared with placebo. Among the 32 participants with detectable viremia at baseline, 5,7,9 mg/kg groups cleared viremia by 8 hours, whereas placebo cleared by 72 hours. Fever clearance among baseline febrile patients occurred by median 3.5 hours (5 mg/kg) and 2.0 hours (7 mg/kg) versus 26.8 hours with placebo; 24‑hour fever clearance: 92.9% (3 mg/kg), 100% (5 & 7 mg/kg), 94.1% (9 mg/kg) vs 58.3% placebo. No treatment-related serious adverse events. Phase III planned; results apply to non-severe dengue in adults.

triage.headline_ja: 新規デング抗体、インドの第II相試験でウイルス量を減少
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は治療薬（モノクローナル抗体）の臨床試験結果に関する報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: デング熱の発生状況ではなく治療薬の臨床試験報告のため、疫学的シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Mask, Covid-19 test kit sales jump at convenience stores amid signs of resurgence
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 resurgence in Korea as the detection rate reaches 9.1% in the second week of August, with hospital admissions up 2.4-fold over the past month, per KDCA. Neighboring China reports 522,000 new cases last month (about 6.6x June’s 79,000), 487 severe cases and one death. In Korea, prevention-product demand climbs at convenience stores: self-test kit sales rise 50.3% at GS25 (Aug 1–Thu vs a month earlier), 93% at 7-Eleven, and 45.7% at CU; masks up 10.3% at GS25, including a 204.4% surge for infant/child masks; cold medicine up 8.8% at GS25, 19% at 7-Eleven, and 12.2% at CU. The uptick aligns with the new school semester, suggesting households with children are driving infant-mask purchases, with potential further demand if spread continues.

triage.headline_ja: コンビニでマスク・新型コロナ検査キットの売上急増、再流行の兆し
triage.triage_reason: 韓国・中国でCOVID-19感染者数や入院数が増加しているが、重症例・死亡率は低く、季節的な再流行の範囲内とみられるため、直ちにフルリスク評価に進むほどの深刻性は確認できない。
triage.notes: 韓国（Republic of Korea）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。中国については新規感染者数・重症例・死亡例のデータが記事に明示されているため対象国として記載。COVID-19自体は既知の疾患であり、季節的増加の範囲内と考えられるが、感染者数の急増（前月比6.6倍）は継続的な動向確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Febre do Nilo Ocidental: o que se sabe sobre vírus que matou uma pessoa no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile fever: What is known about the virus that killed a person in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever, caused by West Nile virus (Orthoflavivirus nilense), has four confirmed cases in Brazil in 2026: two in São Paulo and two in Santa Catarina, with one fatality (a 77-year-old woman in Imbituba, SC). A probable case is in Piauí. The virus is maintained mainly in birds and transmitted by Culex mosquitoes; humans and horses are incidental dead-end hosts. About 80% of infections are asymptomatic; 20% develop fever, headache, body aches, and sometimes rash, often misdiagnosed as dengue. Less than 1% develop neuroinvasive disease (meningitis, encephalitis, poliomyelitis-like paralysis); about 10% of those die, with higher risk after age 70. There is no human vaccine or specific antiviral; management is supportive. The virus has circulated in Brazil for ~20 years, with past detections in Pantanal horses (2009) and elsewhere; Ceará studies suggest underdiagnosis, and the virus may persist in birds and mosquitoes but not sustain onward human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイル熱：ブラジルで1人が死亡したウイルスについて分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで西ナイル熱による死亡例が確認されたが、感染は鳥・蚊媒介で持続的なヒト-ヒト感染はなく、症例数も少数（確定4例、疑い1例）であるため、直ちにフルRRAを要するシグナルとは言えないが、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 西ナイルウイルスはブラジルで約20年前から循環しており、鳥・蚊を介した維持サイクルがあるが、ヒトは終末宿主でヒト-ヒト感染は確認されていない。今回の死亡例は77歳女性で高齢者リスクが高いことが背景。ブラジル国内での散発的発生であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 喜报！烟台市奇山医院曾维静荣获山东省结核病防治技能竞赛个人三等奖-今日推荐-水母网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Good news! Weijing Zeng of Qishan Hospital in Yantai has won the third prize in the Shandong Province Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Skills Competition (Individual Category) - Today’s Recommendation - Shuimu Net.
article.articleSummary: As of August 27, 2026, Zeng Weijing of Qishan Hospital, Yantai, won the third prize in the Clinical Diagnosis and Treatment category at the 2026 Shandong Province Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Skills Competition. The provincial final featured 16 teams and 96 competitors, with rounds including theoretical exams, on-site skills, and a team final. Topics spanned tuberculosis basics, epidemiology, laws and regulations, surveillance, patient management, health promotion, infection control, laboratory testing, radiologic diagnosis, anti-tuberculosis drugs, and drug-resistant TB management. The award recognizes the hospital’s TB clinical diagnosis and treatment capabilities and its role in technical guidance, talent training, and emergency response for Yantai. The hospital plans to deepen training, strengthen medical–prevention integration, and translate competition gains into improved patient management, service flow, and high-quality TB control to help end TB epidemics and protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: 喜報！煙台市奇山医院の曾維静氏が山東省結核病予防管理技能大会個人部門で三等賞を受賞
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生や公衆衛生上の異常事象ではなく、結核対策技能競技会での個人受賞を報じる内容であり、いずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の発生や流行に関する内容ではなく、医療従事者の技能競技会での受賞を紹介する人事・広報系記事である。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू को लेकर स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department Alert Regarding Swine Flu
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) and other respiratory infections trigger heightened vigilance in Haldwani district. Under the chairmanship of Chief Medical Officer Dr. Rashmi Pant, a virtual review with Medical College Haldwani, Base Hospital, BD Pandey District Hospital Nainital, Ramnagar Joint Hospital, and various CHCs/PHCs outlined preparedness. Hospitals must ensure adequate beds, oxygen supply, essential equipment, testing facilities, and treatment stocks; staff should be ready for emergencies. Screening and continuous surveillance of suspected cases were emphasized, with early identification of respiratory symptoms—fever, cough, sore throat, breathing difficulty, or extreme weakness—and prompt referral to higher centers when severe symptoms appear. The message stresses that while there is no need to panic, caution is essential and patients with such symptoms should seek timely medical advice. The alert aligns with ongoing efforts to manage swine flu and other respiratory illnesses in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザに関して保健部門が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インド・ハルドワニ地区で豚インフルエンザ(H1N1)への警戒強化と医療機関の準備体制構築が報じられているが、実際の感染者数や重症例に関する具体的情報がなく、季節的な予防的対応の域を出ない。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、記事は行政の予防的警戒態勢の発表に留まる。具体的な患者数・死亡者数などのデータがなく、フルRRAに進める根拠は不足している。続報で感染者数や重症化状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Yapon ordusu İkinci Dünya müharibəsi zamanı öz əsgərləri üzərində ağcaqanadlarla yayılan xəstəliklər üzrə təcrübələr aparıb
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Japanese army conducted experiments on its own soldiers concerning mosquito-borne diseases during World War II.
article.articleSummary: World War II-era Imperial Japanese Army units conducted bacteriological weapon research in China using disease-carrying vectors, focusing on malaria via mosquitoes, plague via fleas, and typhus via arthropods. Evidence from Unit 731 in Harbin, Heilongjiang Province, plus the 1855 Division and Japanese medical facilities, shows dedicated insect-rearing sections and cross-institution collaboration. Documents indicate May–August 1940 experiments with live infectious vectors; a 1943 article in the Japanese Army Medical Corps journal details the work. At a Chiba Prefecture military hospital, mosquitoes fed on blood from malaria-infected soldiers and then bit 10 Japanese soldiers hospitalized for psychiatric illness; several developed fevers above 40°C, headaches, and loss of appetite. The findings underscore the criminal nature of treating humans as experimental materials and confirm domestic and foreign collaboration in biowarfare research.

triage.headline_ja: 日本軍は第二次世界大戦中、蚊媒介性疾患について自国兵士を対象に実験を行った
triage.triage_reason: 第二次世界大戦時の歴史的事象に関する記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上のイベントではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は歴史的事象（731部隊による人体実験）に関する報道であり、現在の感染症発生・流行を示すものではない。疾患名（マラリア・ペスト）や地域（中国黒龍江省）はBluedot APIが歴史的文脈から誤って抽出したものであり、現行の公衆衛生イベントとして扱う必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo začalo očkovať proti ebole. Vakcína je určená na iný variant, jej účinnosť preto zostáva otázna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo has begun vaccinating against Ebola. The vaccine is intended for a different variant, so its effectiveness remains questionable.
article.articleSummary: As of August 28, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo began Ebola vaccination in Kisangani, eastern Congo, targeting frontline health workers and contacts after Ebola claimed more than 2,700 lives. The Ervebo vaccine, effective against Ebola Zaire, is being used despite the outbreak being driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine exists, raising doubts about effectiveness. The government plans tens of thousands of doses, and the World Health Organization said Congo will receive about 70,000 Ervebo doses. Since mid-May, Congo has reported 5,713 Ebola infections and 2,744 deaths, nearly half of cases. Ebola spreads via close contact with infected individuals or contaminated materials and presents with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラワクチン接種開始。ワクチンは異なる変異株用のため、効果は疑問視される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,713人感染・2,744人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、使用ワクチンが流行株（Bundibugyo）に非対応という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 流行株（Bundibugyo）に対する承認ワクチンが存在せず、既存のErveboワクチン（Zaire株対応）の有効性が不明であることが最大のリスク要因。WHOによる約70,000回分のワクチン供給が予定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat records 42 Chandipura virus cases, 28 deaths since June 30
article.articleSummary: Gujarat has recorded 42 laboratory-confirmed Chandipura virus cases and 28 deaths since the current surveillance period began on June 30, according to state health data updated to Aug 27. A total of 324 suspected cases have been reported; results for 314 of the 324 have been returned, with 42 positives. The case fatality proportion among confirmed patients is about 66.7%. Chandipura virus is an arbovirus transmitted by sandflies, causing acute encephalitis and disproportionately affecting children. The National Centre for Disease Control notes laboratory confirmation by quantitative PCR among methods. The outbreak follows monsoon-season surveillance, with cases reported from multiple districts rather than a single village. With 10 samples pending, figures may rise or fall as results come in. Previous outbreaks in Gujarat include 2024, when NCDC deployed a multidisciplinary team for surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州、6月30日以降にチャンディプラウイルス感染42例・死亡28例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率约67%の脳炎を引き起こすチャンディプラウイルスの感染が複数地区で確認され、死亡者数も多いため、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性からIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の脳炎ウイルスで、小児に多く発症し致死率が高い。2024年にも同州で発生歴があり、季節性（モンスーン期）のアウトブレイクとみられる。国際的拡大の証拠はないが、致死率の高さと複数地区での発生から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases are rising: Cancer specialist explains when flu symptoms should actually worry you, how to build resilience
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-28, H1N1 (swine flu) cases are rising. Cancer specialist Dr. Arpit Bansal notes that disease severity varies widely even within the same household, depending on health and immunity. He cautions not to panic but to heed warning signs and seek timely medical advice. Bansal advocates proactive health screening, citing vitamin D as a key factor; he routinely checks vitamin D levels before surgery, targeting 50–80 ng/mL, noting that many Indians are deficient. He also highlights gut health as central to immunity, recommending adequate fibre, fermented foods, a varied diet, about seven hours of sleep, and staying hydrated to support the body's flu response. The piece stresses resilience through prevention and timely care.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1症例が増加中：がん専門医が、インフルエンザ症状のいつが本当に心配すべきタイミングか、レジリエンスの高め方を解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例増加に関する健康アドバイス記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares end of Uganda's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda has declared the end of its 2026 Ebola outbreak after 42 consecutive days without a new confirmed case, the World Health Organization announced in an online briefing. Uganda’s Health Ministry had already declared transmission interrupted on July 28. The outbreak began May 15 following an imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and involved 20 confirmed cases, with 18 recoveries and 2 deaths. It was caused by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In May, health screening and security measures were strengthened at border crossings near Bunagana as cases rose. WHO emphasizes continued surveillance to detect and respond rapidly to any potential new infections. The announcement underscores cross-border cooperation and ongoing public health measures to prevent resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラ流行は終息宣言されたが、DRCからの輸入例に起因し稀な株であるため、再燃・越境拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。ただし対象国リストに該当する発生地はなく、現時点で新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ​Lucknow Swine Flu Alert: लखनऊ में स्वाइन फ्लू से महिला की मौत, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट; सिविल-बलरामपुर में आइसोलेशन वार्ड तैयार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow Swine Flu Alert: Woman dies of swine flu in Lucknow; Health Department on alert; Isolation ward prepared at Civil Hospital Balrampur
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India reports a swine flu (H1N1) death: a 50-year-old woman from Indiranagar died during treatment at Balrampur Hospital, prompting a full health department alert and contact tracing. Relatives are advised to exercise caution and monitor health. Separate isolation wards have been prepared: 12 beds at Civil Hospital, Hazratganj, and 6 beds at Balrampur Hospital, with oxygen, ventilators, medicines, and testing facilities for severe cases. Health authorities note three new H1N1 cases in the past month, bringing January-to-date totals to 13 since January. Experts indicate that seasonal changes escalate H1N1 activity; transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces. Key symptoms include high fever with chills, persistent cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, body and muscle pains, weakness, and possible breathing difficulty in severe cases. Preventive measures emphasize masking, hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, proper tissue disposal, and seeking prompt medical care for breathing problems.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1による単発の死亡例で、地域の保健当局が警戒・隔離病棟準備を行っているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、情報も限定的なため経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تبدأ حملة تطعيم ضد الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo begins a vaccination campaign against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has launched an Ebola vaccination campaign, with the rollout officially started in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province. Health workers and frontline responders were among the first recipients. The outbreak has affected six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, and Bas-Uele. As of last Tuesday, the country reported 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths, giving an overall case fatality rate around 48%. The outbreak is unfolding in eastern DRC under severe conditions, driven by insecurity, displacement, health worker strikes, and large-scale population movements. The World Health Organization says it remains out of control and on track to surpass the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak, the deadliest on record, which killed more than 11,000 people, mostly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

article.articleHeadline: La lluita contra rellotge contra l'Ebola al Congo: "Serà una epidèmia llarga" - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The race against the clock against Ebola in the Congo: "It will be a long epidemic" - 3CatInfo
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at an unprecedented rate three months after the emergency declaration, with cases now across six provinces, not only Ituri. The current outbreak is caused by a Bundibugyo variant, less common than Zaire, for which no vaccine or authorized treatment exists. Diagnostic tests show lower reliability for this strain. MSF medical coordinator Olimpia de la Rosa warns the transmission velocity is historically fast and half of recent deaths occurred in the last three weeks. As of August 25, 2026, MSF reports 5,713 cases and 2,744 deaths (48% CFR), making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak. Community distrust complicates containment, with 60% of new cases dying at home or in communities before seeking care; containment requires robust community engagement. Uganda reported a few cases in July but is Ebola-free; France logged one case in June. International support is critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラとの時間との戦い：「長期の流行になるだろう」 - 3CatInfo
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）流行が6州に拡大し、致死率48%、5,713例・2,744死亡という深刻な状況で、ワクチン・治療法がなく国際的拡大（ウガンダ、フランス）も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダとフランスでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブジョ株はワクチン・承認された治療法がなく、診断検査の信頼性も低いため、対応の難易度が高い。
